papers.title: Auditing Recorded Predictive Lead Service-Line Classifications Against Physical Verification: A Statewide Study of New York
papers.abstract_en: Under the US Lead and Copper Rule Revisions, a utility may determine a service line's material with a predictive model instead of inspecting it. New York State publishes, per address, which method was used. Almost no address carries both a model classification and a physical verification, so the check is between populations within a utility rather than paired addresses. We screen all 153 New York localities that classified at least 100 addresses this way. Seventy-five (49%), covering 125,990 addresses or 57% of those screened, record one value. Zero variance alone is not misconduct: 68 of the 75 match their own verification or have too little to test. Seven are contradicted by their own crews, six beyond any sampling explanation. Five are boroughs of New York City, which file as one system; one is East Rochester, 550 km away. New York City is the largest case: a predictive model is the recorded basis for 43,215 addresses, and on all of them the recorded material is "Known Other". The city records "Unknown" on 121,779 addresses, 1,880 already excavated, and lead on 120,692. In the model bucket both counts are zero, and the 95% upper bound on the rate is 0.0085%. Across the rest of New York the same method records lead or the hedge "Unknown but could be lead" on 12.21% of 176,888 addresses, a comparison whose weaknesses we report. The model-cleared population is newer, median year built 1984 against 1930, and construction era accounts for about a third of the gap and not the rest: holding era fixed, records-based classification finds lead at 4.3-31.9%, physical verification at 1.5-14.5%, the model in no era. Six era-aware estimators place the expected lead lines among them at 1,150-1,450. Two findings need no comparison: 7,782 of these addresses are in pre-1940 buildings, and the archived 2025 snapshot shows the public-side determination was copied from a customer-side model output.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Analysis code and data provenance: https://github.com/msarmadsohail/predictive-lead-service-line-audit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对纽约州按地址公布的预测性供水管线材质分类（predictive lead service-line classifications）进行审计，将其与物理开挖验证进行对照。作者筛选了 153 个至少分类 100 个地址的地方辖区，发现 75 个辖区只记录单一材质结果；其中 7 个辖区的结果与现场施工记录矛盾，纽约市的预测模型桶内 43,215 个地址全部记录为 Known Other，铅检出率为零。研究认为这属于记录层面无法用抽样解释的系统性问题。
Motivation: 美国《铅铜规则修订案》允许公用事业公司用预测模型而非实际开挖来确定供水管线材质，但纽约州公开数据中几乎没有同一地址同时具备模型分类和物理验证，因此需要从群体层面审计模型记录是否可信。
Method: 作者筛选纽约州全部 153 个至少用预测模型分类 100 个地址的地方辖区，利用公用事业内部群体对照、零方差检验、施工记录矛盾、年代分层估计以及 95% 置信上界等统计手段，比较模型分类与物理验证两种记录来源。
Result: 75 个辖区（覆盖 125,990 个地址）只记录单一材质；其中 68 个与自身验证一致或样本过少，7 个被施工记录直接反驳。纽约市是最大案例：43,215 个模型分类地址全部记录为 Known Other，铅检出数零，95% 上界为 0.0085%；而该市其他记录方式在 121,779 个地址上记录 Unknown、120,692 个地址记录铅。模型清除群体较新（中位建成年份 1984 对 1930），年代效应只能解释约三分之一差异；六种年代感知估计预期铅线数为 1,150–1,450 条。另有 7,782 个地址位于 1940 年前建筑，且 2025 年快照显示公共侧判定是从用户侧模型输出复制而来。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些发现并不依赖交叉验证即可成立：NYC 的模型桶内铅记录为零且存在拷贝痕迹，表明记录型预测分类在纽约州产生了无法用抽样解释的偏差，需要进一步审计与监管关注。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Source Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Network topology inference from graph signals is central to graph signal processing with applications in neuroscience, sensor, and social networks. In practice, target-domain samples are scarce while heterogeneous source-domain data are abundant. Fusing these sources is challenging: Euclidean averaging works for homogeneous sources but degrades sharply as inter-source divergence grows, collapsing distinct geometries into an inflated, biased consensus. We exploit the Wasserstein metric's distribution-preserving properties to counter heterogeneity while preserving each source's intrinsic geometry. We propose MS-WDRO, a multi-source Wasserstein distributionally robust graph learning framework that fuses heterogeneous sources via their weighted Wasserstein barycenter, a geometrically principled nominal distribution, then builds an ambiguity ball around it to hedge residual uncertainty. Minimizing worst-case risk yields a tractable regularized Laplacian estimator solved efficiently via a provably convergent ADMM scheme. We establish non-asymptotic guarantees: a finite-sample concentration bound for the empirical barycenter, a pooling bias lower bound proving naive aggregation is suboptimal, and an out-of-sample excess risk bound decaying at a parametric rate with only logarithmic dependence on source count. To calibrate hyperparameters governing robustness, sparsity, and source fusion, we unroll the solver into a differentiable architecture trained end-to-end, achieving data-adaptive calibration beyond cross-validation while retaining interpretability. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and the multi-site ABIDE~I neuroimaging dataset show MS-WDRO consistently outperforms seven baselines in graph recovery, sample efficiency, and downstream diagnostic utility, with the largest gains in the sample-scarce regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MS-WDRO，一个用于图信号网络拓扑推断的多源 Wasserstein 分布鲁棒图学习框架。针对目标域样本稀缺、源域异质数据丰富的场景，该方法用各源数据的加权 Wasserstein 重心构造名义分布，并在其周围构建 ambiguity ball 以对冲残余不确定性，最终得到可求解的正则化拉普拉斯估计器。作者给出非渐近理论保证，并通过合成基准和 ABIDE I 神经影像数据实验表明其在图恢复、样本效率和下游诊断效用上优于七个基线。
Motivation: 实际中目标域样本稀缺而源域数据丰富且异质，简单的欧几里得平均在源间差异增大时会急剧退化，把不同几何结构压缩成膨胀且有偏的共识。需要一种能保留各源内在几何、同时融合异质源的方法来提升网络拓扑推断。
Method: 提出 MS-WDRO 框架：利用 Wasserstein 度量的分布保持特性，通过加权 Wasserstein 重心融合异质源作为几何上有依据的名义分布，再在其周围构建 ambiguity ball 对冲残余不确定度。最小化最坏情形风险得到可解的正则化拉普拉斯估计器，并用可证明收敛的 ADMM 方案高效求解；此外将求解器展开为可微架构做端到端训练，实现数据自适应的超参数校准。
Result: 理论方面给出经验重心的有限样本集中界、证明朴素聚合次优的池化偏差下界，以及以参数速率衰减且对源数量仅呈对数依赖的样本外超额风险界。实验上，在合成基准和 ABIDE I 多站点数据上，MS-WDRO 在图恢复、样本效率和下游诊断效用上一致优于七个基线，且在样本稀缺场景收益最大。
Conclusion: 作者强调利用 Wasserstein 重心和分布鲁棒优化可以同时处理源异质性与目标域样本稀缺，且可展开架构使超参数校准保持可解释性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 理论方面给出经验重心的有限样本集中界、证明朴素聚合次优的池化偏差下界，以及以参数速率衰减且对源数量仅呈对数依赖的样本外超额风险界。实验上，在合成基准和 ABIDE I 多站点数据上，MS-WDRO 在图恢复、样本效率和下游诊断效用上一致优于七个基线，且在样本稀缺场景收益最大。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调利用 Wasserstein 重心和分布鲁棒优化可以同时处理源异质性与目标域样本稀缺，且可展开架构使超参数校准保持可解释性。

papers.title: A Layered Simplex Architecture for Large Alphabets
papers.abstract_en: Probability estimation over large alphabets under log loss is a well-studied problem, with celebrated methods such as the Good-Turing estimator. We introduce and study a new Bayesian estimator with four notable properties. First, its construction is exceptionally simple: multiply independent uniform draws from the probability simplex coordinate-wise and renormalize. Depth is the only structural parameter, and averaging over depths eliminates the need to tune it. Second, the regret of the resulting mixture, the excess code length it pays relative to a code that knows the source, admits an explicit and efficiently computable expression. Third, despite its simplicity and lack of tuned constants, the estimator is competitive across a diverse set of synthetic and real-text benchmarks with substantially more specialized methods, including Good-Turing. Fourth, the tractability of its regret allows us to identify scaling laws in data, alphabet size, and depth. For Zipf targets with exponent above one, the regret has a simple reading as long as the sample reveals only a small fraction of the alphabet. It closely matches the description length of the set of discovered symbols, at one bit of code per bit of description, plus a further cost per symbol. The data exponent is therefore the rate at which new symbols are discovered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对大字母表（large alphabets）上对数损失（log loss）下的概率估计问题，引入一种构造极简的贝叶斯估计器：将来自概率单纯形的独立均匀采样逐坐标相乘再归一化，深度（depth）是唯一结构参数，对深度取平均即可免去调参。摘要称其遗憾（regret）具有显式且可高效计算的表达式，并在合成与真实文本基准上与包括 Good-Turing 在内的更专门方法表现相当；对指数大于 1 的 Zipf 目标，遗憾的解释与新符号发现速率直接相关。
Motivation: 大字母表上的概率估计是经典问题，已有 Good-Turing 等方法，但该工作希望获得一个构造简单、无需调整常数且遗憾可解析的贝叶斯估计框架，以揭示数据量、字母表大小和深度之间的标度律。
Method: 提出分层单纯形（layered simplex）贝叶斯估计器：从概率单纯形中独立均匀抽样，逐坐标相乘后重新归一化；深度是唯一结构参数，并通过在深度上取平均来避免调参；其混合分布的遗憾具有显式且可高效计算的表达形式。
Result: 摘要报告该估计器在多样化的合成与真实文本基准上与包括 Good-Turing 在内的更专门方法具有竞争力；对指数大于 1 的 Zipf 目标，当样本仅揭示字母表的小部分时，遗憾近似等于已发现符号集合的描述长度，即每比特描述对应一比特编码并附加每符号成本，数据指数对应新符号发现速率。
Conclusion: 由于遗憾的可解性，作者能够识别数据量、字母表大小与深度之间的标度律（scaling laws）；该无需调常数的简单估计器足以与专门方法竞争。

papers.title: Spike-based Belief Propagation in Nonlinear Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a Bayesian control framework that integrates spike-based dynamics with probabilistic inference for adaptive control. Bayesian inference is widely regarded as a core computational principle of brain function, providing a normative framework for perception, decision-making, and learning under uncertainty. By combining a biologically inspired spiking neural model with Bayesian inference principles, we propose a brain-like control algorithm capable of operating in uncertain environments. We use the mountain car parking problem as a benchmark with non-linear dynamics. Our results demonstrate that the proposed controller can successfully update states in real time and generate goal-directed action plans through spike-driven dynamics. The results highlight the proposed model's potential as a bridge between computational neuroscience and probabilistic control theory.
papers.comment: Accepted at NCTA 2026 (18th Int'l Conf. on Neural Computation Theory and Applications), part of IJCCI 2026, Angers, France. Pre-peer-review submitted version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合脉冲动力学（spike-based dynamics）与概率推断（probabilistic inference）的贝叶斯控制框架，用于不确定环境下的自适应控制。作者以具有非线性动力学的山地车停车问题（mountain car parking problem）为基准，实验表明该脉冲驱动控制器能够实时更新状态并生成目标导向的动作计划。作者认为该模型是计算神经科学与概率控制理论之间的一座桥梁。
Motivation: 贝叶斯推断被广泛视为大脑功能的核心计算原则，但如何将生物启发的脉冲神经模型与贝叶斯控制结合起来，在不确定环境中实现类脑自适应控制，仍是一个有待填补的空白。
Method: 将生物启发的脉冲神经模型（spiking neural model）与贝叶斯推断原理相结合，提出一种类脑控制算法，并在非线性动力学基准（山地车停车问题）上进行验证。
Result: 摘要报告该控制器能够实时更新状态，并通过脉冲驱动动力学（spike-driven dynamics）生成目标导向的动作计划，成功完成基准任务。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该模型具备连接计算神经科学与概率控制理论的潜力，但未讨论扩展至其他任务或与现有贝叶斯控制方法的定量对比。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PETA:Parameter-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Virtual Screening
papers.abstract_en: Accurately ranking active ligands for a target protein pocket from massive chemical libraries remains a central challenge in virtual screening. DrugCLIP and its recent extensions substantially accelerate this process by encoding protein pockets and molecules into a shared embedding space. Despite this progress, further performance improvements typically require retraining the entire model, incurring substantial computational overhead and making target-specific customization inefficient. In this work, we formulate the specialization of pretrained virtual screening models to individual pockets as a test-time adaptation problem and propose PETA, a parameter-efficient framework that directly adapts pretrained model at test time. Given a target pocket, PETA constructs pocket-specific negatives through molecular diffusion and chemical validity filtering, and further moves them toward the reference ligand retrieved from structural databases via embedding-space mixup to create more challenging ranking tasks. A ranking objective then places greater emphasis on suppressing high-scoring invalid candidates that could contaminate the top-ranked screening results, providing structured supervision for lightweight adaptation. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that this lightweight, pocket-specific adaptation outperforms both pretrained and fully retrained baselines while updating only the LayerNorm parameters, which account for approximately $0.03\%$ of the full model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PETA，一种面向虚拟筛选的参数高效测试时适应框架。作者将预训练虚拟筛选模型针对单个蛋白口袋的定制化建模为测试时适应问题，通过分子扩散和化学有效性过滤构造口袋特异性负样本，并用嵌入空间 mixup 将其移向参考配体以构造更难排序任务，仅更新 LayerNorm 参数（约占全模型 0.03%）即可超过预训练基线和全量重训练基线。
Motivation: DrugCLIP 等模型通过共享嵌入空间加速虚拟筛选，但进一步提升性能通常需要重训整个模型，计算开销大，且难以高效地针对特定蛋白口袋做定制化。
Method: 将预训练虚拟筛选模型的专化建模为测试时适应问题；给定目标口袋，先用分子扩散和化学有效性过滤构造口袋特异性负样本，再通过嵌入空间 mixup 把这些负样本移向从结构数据库检索到的参考配体，形成更有挑战性的排序任务；排序目标着重抑制得分高的无效候选，为轻量级适应提供结构化监督。
Result: 在多个基准上的实验显示，仅更新 LayerNorm 参数（约占全模型 0.03%）的轻量口袋特异性适应即可优于预训练基线和全量重训练的基线。
Conclusion: 论文表明参数高效的测试时适应可以替代昂贵的全模型重训练，实现高效的目标特异性虚拟筛选定制。

papers.title: Where Does the Union Bound Go? Best-Arm Identification and Strong FWER Control
papers.abstract_en: In fixed-confidence best-arm identification, proofs often use a union bound across the competing arms. From a multiple-testing point of view this can look puzzling: if the best arm is unique, only one hypothesis of the form ``arm $i$ is best'' can be true. Why then should there be a Bonferroni-type factor of $K-1$? The answer is that there are two natural ways to orient the hypotheses. In one orientation, best-arm identification is literally a strong familywise-error-rate (FWER) problem with $K-1$ true nulls. In the opposite orientation, exactly one null is true, but a pairwise implementation can falsely reject that one null through any of $K-1$ comparisons. Thus the multiplicity has not disappeared; it just pops up in different places. This note makes the equivalence explicit in the terminology of both communities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从多重检验视角澄清固定置信度最佳臂识别（best-arm identification）中的联合界（union bound）使用。作者指出，当最佳臂唯一时，只有形如“臂 i 最佳”的一个假设为真，但 Bonferroni 型因子 K−1 仍会出现，原因在于存在两种自然的假设定向方式：一种使问题成为带 K−1 个真零假设的强 FWER 问题，另一种使恰好一个零假设为真，但成对实现会通过 K−1 个比较错误地拒绝该零假设。该注记在两组社区的术语下将两种定向的等价性显式化。
Motivation: 最佳臂识别证明中常用的联合界在多重检验视角下看似矛盾：若最佳臂唯一，为何会出现 Bonferroni 型因子？作者旨在厘清这一困惑并说明多重性并未消失，只是在不同位置出现。
Method: 通过分析两种自然定向的假设表述，将最佳臂识别分别映射为经典 FWER 控制问题和带单一真零假设的成对比较问题，并显式证明二者在多重性结构上的等价性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果；其核心结果是概念性的，即证明 K−1 的多重性因子在两种假设定向中必然出现，只是表现形式不同。
Conclusion: 作者强调该注记是为了在两社区（最佳臂识别与多重检验）的术语下明确等价性，帮助理解联合界在最佳臂识别中的合理性。

papers.title: Bringing analytic rigor to agentic AI for science: The Brain Researcher platform for neuroimaging data analysis
papers.abstract_en: AI agents can execute scientific analyses, but an analytic output becomes a defensible claim only after alternatives are weighed and the claim is limited to what the evidence supports. Agents may reproduce failures including selective analysis, premature declarations of success and optimization of imperfect criteria. We present Brain Researcher, an agentic research harness operating in a neuroimaging researcher's computational environment under rules for admissible analyses, required checks and claim scope. In benchmarks, Brain Researcher increased first-choice tool-selection accuracy across seven models by 70.2 percentage points (23.3% without it versus 93.6% with it) and verifiable grounding from 4.6% to 22.0%. In collaborator-led and self-evolving studies, multiverse analyses exposed analytic-choice sensitivity, and scientific review classified claims as accepted, qualified, revised, blocked, rejected or deferred. By linking decisions to evidence and provenance, Brain Researcher embeds methodological judgment within the workflow, not after it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Brain Researcher，一个运行在神经影像研究者计算环境中的智能体研究框架 (agentic research harness)，通过设定可接受分析规则、必要检查与声明范围来约束 AI 代理的科学分析流程。基准测试显示，在七个模型上该框架将首选工具选择准确率从 23.3% 提升至 93.6%，可验证依据 (verifiable grounding) 从 4.6% 提升至 22.0%；合作者主导与自进化研究中的多宇宙分析 (multiverse analysis) 暴露了分析选择的敏感性，科学评审将声明分为接受、有条件接受、修订、阻止、拒绝或推迟六类。
Motivation: AI 代理能够执行科学分析，但分析输出只有在权衡备选方案并将声明限定在证据支持范围内后才能成为可辩护的结论；代理可能重现选择性分析、过早宣布成功以及优化不完善标准等失败。
Method: 通过在神经影像研究者的计算环境中实施一套可执行规则来约束分析，包括可接受分析的边界、必须执行的检查和声明范围的控制，并将决策与证据及来源 (provenance) 关联，从而把方法论判断嵌入工作流程之中。
Result: 在基准测试中，Brain Researcher 使七种模型的首选工具选择准确率提升 70.2 个百分点（无框架 23.3% 对比有框架 93.6%），可验证依据从 4.6% 提升至 22.0%；合作者主导和自进化研究中，多宇宙分析暴露了分析选择的敏感性，科学评审可将声明分类为接受、有条件接受、修订、阻止、拒绝或推迟。
Conclusion: 通过将决策与证据和来源关联，Brain Researcher 将方法学判断嵌入工作流程而非事后进行；其应用场景限定于神经影像数据研究的计算环境。

papers.title: MaliciousSkillBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Malicious Agent Skill Detection
papers.abstract_en: Agent Skills extend LLM agents with reusable instruction packages that may also include scripts, resources, and service configuration. This creates a direct distribution channel for malicious behavior, yet existing malicious-Skill datasets are fragmented across sources, artifact formats, evidence regimes, and benign coverage; duplicated and structurally related content further complicates direct aggregation and evaluation. We present MaliciousSkillBench, a comprehensive benchmark for malicious Agent Skill detection. We consolidate 13 public sources, 11 of which contribute Core malicious artifacts, and reduce 8,414 raw malicious records to 7,539 normalized-unique identities in 4,588 operational structural families. After conservative cross-label conflict exclusion, the primary benchmark contains 9,740 Skills: 7,505 malicious and 2,235 benign. To characterize its coverage, we harmonize 11 attack categories for 4,983 malicious identities with supported source-native mappings and find substantial differences in threat composition across sources. We then evaluate three learned text detectors and three off-the-shelf Skill scanners. Learned detectors achieve 0.882-0.932 Random Macro-F1 but only 0.653-0.665 under Source-Disjoint evaluation; the strongest word TF-IDF SVM scores 0.932/0.916/0.665 on Random/structural-disjoint/Source-Disjoint while retaining 95.6% malicious recall but producing 62.4% benign FPR on held-out sources. Off-the-shelf scanners occupy different but also unsatisfactory operating regimes, reducing false positives only at the cost of sharply lower malicious recall. Together, these results show that reliable malicious-Skill detection requires both broader cross-source benchmark coverage and evaluation that jointly measures attack detection and benign over-flagging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MaliciousSkillBench，一个用于恶意 Agent Skill 检测的综合基准。作者整合 13 个公开来源（其中 11 个贡献核心恶意工件），将 8,414 条原始恶意记录归约为 7,539 个标准化唯一身份、4,588 个操作结构族，并在排除跨标签冲突后构建包含 9,740 个 Skills（7,505 恶意、2,235 良性）的主基准。评估显示学习型检测器在随机划分下 Random Macro-F1 为 0.882-0.932，但在 Source-Disjoint 评估下仅 0.653-0.665，表明跨来源泛化仍是关键瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有恶意 Skill 数据集分散于多个来源，工件格式、证据体系和良性覆盖不一致，重复与结构相关的内容使直接聚合和评估困难，缺乏统一、可比的基准来支撑恶意 Agent Skill 检测研究。
Method: 整合 13 个公开来源并进行归一化去重和结构族归纳，统一 11 类攻击类别映射；评估三种学习型文本检测器与三种现成 Skill 扫描器，采用 Random、structural-disjoint 和 Source-Disjoint 三种评估设置。
Result: 学习型检测器在 Random 评估下获得 0.882-0.932 的 Macro-F1，但在 Source-Disjoint 下仅 0.653-0.665；最强的词 TF-IDF SVM 在 Random/structural-disjoint/Source-Disjoint 上得分 0.932/0.916/0.665，保持 95.6% 恶意召回却产生 62.4% 的良性 FPR。现成扫描器能降低误报，但以恶意召回大幅下降为代价。
Conclusion: 可靠的恶意 Skill 检测需要更广的跨来源基准覆盖，以及同时衡量攻击检测能力和良性过度标记（over-flagging）的评估方法。

papers.title: AvatarDynamizer: From Static to Dynamic Human Avatars via Generative Dynamic Textures
papers.abstract_en: For full-body avatars, modeling surface dynamics is crucial for overcoming the uncanny valley and achieving perceptual realism. Person-agnostic methods recover static 3D avatars from monocular images, videos, or text prompts, but their skeleton-driven animations lack realistic surface dynamics such as clothing wrinkles. In contrast, person-specific methods achieve high-quality rendering and realistic dynamics, but require expensive multi-view captures for each individual. Recent generalizable dynamic avatar methods struggle to embed surface dynamics, leading to either limited multi-view consistency or dynamic expressiveness. To this end, we propose AvatarDynamizer, a generative method that transforms an off-the-shelf static 3D avatar into a controllable, realistic, and multi-view-consistent 4D avatar. We introduce a novel texture-space surface-dynamics embedding and formulate avatar dynamics modeling as conditional texture generation. Our encoder--decoder representation embeds pose-dependent dynamics into dynamic texture maps, enabling compatibility with pre-trained video diffusion models while decoding them into 3D Gaussians for multi-view consistent rendering. Since existing datasets are limited in scale, sequence length, or motion diversity, we collect a large-scale multi-view dataset with long sequences covering diverse skeletal motions and surface dynamics. Experiments show that our method effectively animates static avatars with faithful surface dynamics and outperforms competing generalizable methods in visual fidelity, especially under limited dynamic training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AvatarDynamizer，一种生成式方法，将现成的静态 3D 人体头像转化为可控、逼真且多视图一致的 4D 头像。作者引入纹理空间中的表面动态嵌入，把头像动态建模表述为条件纹理生成，使用编码器-解码器表示将姿态相关动态编码为动态纹理图，并解码为 3D 高斯进行多视图一致渲染。实验表明该方法能有效为静态头像赋予忠实表面动态，在视觉保真度上优于通用泛化方法，尤其在动态训练数据有限时。
Motivation: 现有通用（person-agnostic）方法从单目图像、视频或文本恢复静态 3D 头像，但骨架驱动动画缺乏衣物褶皱等真实表面动态；个体专用（person-specific）方法质量高却需要昂贵的多视图采集；近期可泛化动态头像方法难以嵌入表面动态，导致多视图一致性或动态表现力受限。
Method: 提出纹理空间表面动态嵌入（texture-space surface-dynamics embedding），将头像动态建模转化为条件纹理生成；采用编码器-解码器表示，把姿态相关动态编入动态纹理图，以兼容预训练视频扩散模型，再解码为 3D 高斯实现多视图一致渲染。同时收集了包含长序列、多样骨骼运动与表面动态的大规模多视图数据集。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能够以忠实表面动态驱动静态头像，并在视觉保真度上优于竞争的可泛化方法，尤其在动态训练数据有限的情况下。
Conclusion: 作者认为将动态建模转化为条件纹理生成并结合预训练扩散模型与 3D 高斯渲染，是提升可泛化动态头像质量的有效路径；现有数据集在规模、序列长度或运动多样性上的不足可通过采集大规模多视图长序列数据缓解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The impact of feature engineering and an optimisation framework for ocean colour machine learning
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) is widely used for the development of ocean colour algorithms, but most studies focus on model parameter training and hyperparameter tuning. The optimisation of the data that feeds the models - i.e., Feature Engineering (FE) - is not fully explored. We assess the impact of FE in ocean colour machine learning models and we propose an optimisation framework that includes seven sequenced levels of data transformation: i. band choice, ii. log scaling, iii. spectral shape normalisation, iv. index extraction, v. principal component analysis, vi. feature scaling, and vii. zero-to-one scaling. We demonstrate the application for Multi-layer perceptron, Support Vector Machines, and eXtreme Gradient Boosting Trees on Sentinel-3 OLCI observations in the Norwegian coastal waters. The models are trained to estimate Chlorophyll-a concentration [Chl-a] and Secchi disk depth (Zsd). Results show that accuracy is highly variable among FE found in six studies using Sentinel-3 OLCI and the ones that we optimise. The R range from 0.01 to 0.55 for [Chl-a] and from 0.15 to 0.68 for Zsd, where the optimised FE shows the top results. The ML models with optimised FE could also improve by two times the R and reduce up to 63% of the mean absolute error when compared to CHL_OC4ME and CHL_NN standard algorithms. Nevertheless, no common optimised FE is found for all target variables and ML models, suggesting that FE optimisation is necessary for each application. Therefore, our proposed framework can be key for improving the accuracy of water quality monitoring in coastal waters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究特征工程 (Feature Engineering) 对海洋颜色机器学习模型的影响，并提出一个包含七个递进数据变换层级的优化框架，用于估算叶绿素-a 浓度和 Secchi 盘深度。作者在挪威沿海水域的 Sentinel-3 OLCI 观测数据上，对多层感知机、支持向量机和 XGBoost 树进行了验证。结果显示优化后的特征工程显著提升精度，但目前不存在适用于所有目标变量和模型的最优特征工程。
Motivation: 海洋颜色算法中机器学习研究多集中于模型参数训练和超参数调优，而对输入数据本身的特征工程优化尚未被充分探索，这可能导致模型精度受限。
Method: 提出一个包含七个顺序层级的特征工程优化框架：波段选择、对数缩放、光谱形状归一化、指数提取、主成分分析、特征缩放和零到一缩放，并用于不同 ML 模型以估算 [Chl-a] 和 Zsd。
Result: 六项已有研究中的特征工程在 [Chl-a] 上 R 范围为 0.01–0.55，Zsd 上为 0.15–0.68，优化后的特征工程取得最优结果；与 CHL_OC4ME 和 CHL_NN 标准算法相比，优化后的 ML 模型可将 R 提高两倍，并将平均绝对误差最高降低 63%。但未发现对所有目标变量和模型通用的最优特征工程。
Conclusion: 特征工程优化对每个具体应用都是必要的，所提出的框架有望提升沿海水域水质监测的精度。

papers.title: Unified and Efficient Point-Line Local Features
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view computer vision pipelines typically rely on accurate sparse keypoints and robust descriptors. While incorporating line features has shown clear benefits for matching and pose estimation, existing point-line approaches remain inefficient: they detect points and lines separately, use increasingly heavy networks, and depend on CPU-bound heuristics that hinder real-time performance. We introduce a Unified Efficient Points and Lines (UPAL) feature extractor that jointly extracts keypoints, line segments, and feature descriptors within a single lightweight architecture. A shared backbone provides common representations that feed different branches for point and line features. Line segments are recovered through an accelerated post-processing stage, an enhanced and highly efficient variant of the LSD algorithm. UPAL matches or exceeds state-ofthe-art performance in both point and line applications while significantly reducing computational cost, achieving, for instance, a 4x speedup and 10x smaller memory footprint over the ALIKED + DeepLSD pipeline. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/francois141/upal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 UPAL，一种统一且高效的点线局部特征提取器，在单一轻量级架构中联合提取关键点、线段和特征描述子。共享骨干网络为点和线分支提供共同表示，线段通过加速后的 LSD 算法变体后处理恢复。摘要称其匹配或超过点、线应用的现有最佳性能，同时显著降低计算开销。
Motivation: 多视图视觉管线依赖稀疏关键点和鲁棒描述子，而现有 point-line 方法分别检测点和线，使用越来越重的网络并依赖 CPU 端启发式，阻碍实时性能。
Method: 提出 UPAL 特征提取器，用单个轻量架构联合提取关键点、线段和描述子；共享骨干馈送点、线不同分支，线段通过增强且高效的 LSD 算法变体（加速后处理阶段）恢复。
Result: 摘要报告 UPAL 在点和线应用中匹配或超过当前最佳性能，同时显著降低计算成本，例如相比 ALIKED + DeepLSD 管线实现 4 倍加速和 10 倍更小的内存占用。
Conclusion: 强调统一架构配合高效后处理可以在不损失精度的情况下大幅降低计算与内存开销，并公开代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interrupting the Loop: Periodic Subject Changes Raise Judged Surprise and Connection in Base Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Where does the novelty a base language model produces with no task come from, and what can an LLM judge of a long stream actually see? We dismantle a cognitively inspired generation loop over 24 conditions on three base models. Most of its effect lives in one operation: a new subject injected every few hundred tokens (an interruption) into a stream whose literal repetition is damped (habituation). We judge windows of generated text only, with the premise as the unit (n=10) and a judge measured for repeatability, against a second judge family and against human readers. Under that protocol the interruption raises judged surprise by 1.2 to 1.4 points and connection by 0.8 over habituation alone. A connective that asks for continuity hurts; a bare paragraph break adds nothing detectable on fresh text; a reset context does at least as well as a kept one; and a pre-registered replication on new premises confirms the primary contrast. Three things the window judge could not see changed the first version of this study, and we think they are of general use. The judge scores the experimenter's injected sentence as the model's own. A fixed rotation of injected sentences makes the model replay its earlier segments from beyond the judge's horizon, and the judge scores the replay as surprise and connection (65-80% of post-interruption windows at periods 150-300). And the local gains do not compose: no arm produces an integrated document. The salience monitor, the in-loop judge, memory across interruptions and a judge-gated Review run with a gate that opens add nothing. On a problem with a verifier (online bin packing), the interruption multiplies valid, distinct candidate heuristics three- to fourfold without raising the quality of the best. We report an evaluation protocol for long generation and a controlled characterization of a simple intervention, not a mechanism of creativity.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对三个基础语言模型在无任务条件下运行的认知启发式生成循环进行拆解，共覆盖24种条件，发现其主要效果集中于一种操作：在文本流中每隔几百个 token 注入一个新主语（打断），同时抑制字面重复（习惯化）。评估只针对生成文本的窗口，以 premise 为判别单位（n=10），并用可重复性校验过的判别器与第二类判别器及人类读者对照。结果显示，打断相对单独习惯化将判定惊喜度提高1.2–1.4点、连接性提高0.8点，预注册复制确认了主要对比。
Motivation: 基础语言模型在无任务条件下产生的新颖性来源尚不明确，且一个长文本流中 LLM 判别器实际能看到什么也缺乏受控刻画；作者希望定位生成循环中真正起作用的组件，并给出可靠的评估协议。
Method: 以认知启发的生成循环为框架，在三个基础模型上做24种条件的受控对比；只评判生成文本窗口，以 premise 为单位（n=10），对判别器做可重复性测量，并与另一判别器族和人类读者对照；同时加入预注册复制实验，并在线装箱（online bin packing）这类有验证器的问题上考察打断的效果。
Result: 摘要报告打断使判定惊喜度提高1.2–1.4点、连接性提高0.8点；固定轮换注入句子会让模型在判别器视野之外重放早期片段，而这些重放被判定为惊喜和连接（周期150–300时占被打断后窗口的65–80%）；在线装箱中打断将有效且不同的候选启发式数量提高三到四倍，但最佳候选质量没有提升。
Conclusion: 作者明确表示这是一套长生成评估协议和单一干预变量的受控刻画，而非创造力机制；局部增益不组合，任何条件都没有产出整合文档，且显著性监视器、循环内判别器、跨打断记忆以及门控 Review 等组件均无额外贡献。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EXIMO: VLM Guided Exploration of VLA Policies
papers.abstract_en: How to efficiently finetune robot policies to learn new tasks on the fly? State of the art robotic manipulation policies are based on behaviour cloning of large vision-language-action (VLA) models with billions of parameters on huge teleoperation datasets. While this simple approach has enabled significant advances for robotic manipulation, finetuning of VLA policies for learning new tasks still remains an open problem. In particular, collecting teleoperation datasets requires hundreds of hours of expensive human labour and the alternative, reinforcement learning (RL), can be notoriously sample-inefficient especially for long-horizon tasks. In addition, RL with VLAs imposes several challenges due to the model's size and architectural design. In this work, we propose EXIMO, an efficient algorithm for finetuning of VLA policies. EXIMO operates in three stages: explore, imitate, and optimize. During the explore phase, EXIMO equips the VLA with a vision language model (VLM) that acts as a planner. The VLM thinks and breaks down challenging long-horizon problems into shorter ones for the VLA. The VLM, together with the VLA, is used to collect an orchestrated dataset on new tasks. During the imitate phase, the VLA is finetuned with the orchestrated data. Finally, during the optimize stage, we use residual off-policy RL to further finetune the policy. In our experiments, we ablate all three stages of EXIMO and show that it outperforms existing approaches significantly in terms of sample-efficiency and final performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EXIMO，一种面向视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）策略的高效微调算法，用于让机器人快速学习新任务。EXIMO 采用探索、模仿、优化三阶段流程：先用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为规划器将长程任务分解为短程子任务并与 VLA 协作收集编排数据集，再用该数据微调 VLA，最后用残差离策略强化学习（residual off-policy RL）进一步优化。摘要报告该方法在样本效率和最终性能上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: VLA 策略的微调仍是开放问题：遥操作数据集收集需要大量人工成本，而强化学习（RL）在长程任务上样本效率低，且 VLA 的模型规模和架构设计给 RL 带来额外挑战。
Method: EXIMO 分三阶段运行：探索阶段中，VLM 扮演规划器，将困难的长程问题分解为更短的子问题供 VLA 执行，并与 VLA 一起在新任务上收集编排数据集；模仿阶段用该数据集对 VLA 进行行为克隆式微调；优化阶段使用残差 off-policy RL 对策略做进一步微调。
Result: 实验对三个阶段分别进行消融，结果显示 EXIMO 在样本效率和最终性能上显著超越现有方法；摘要未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 EXIMO 提供了一种高效的 VLA 策略微调途径，能够结合 VLM 规划与 RL 优化来应对长程任务学习。

papers.title: Reliable Neural Collapse Approximation for Open-World Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) methods aim to bridge the domain gap between the source and target domains. However, traditional TTA methods become ineffective when the label distribution shift occurs, a challenge commonly referred to as an open-world scenario. In this paper, we introduce a new method named Reliable Neural Collapse approximation (ReNC) for Open-World Test-Time Adaptation (OWTTA). Specifically, we leverage neural collapse as a structural prior for reliable target-domain adaptation. Guided by this prior, we justify that the pre-trained classifier weights can serve as the prototypes of the source domain. By measuring the similarity between samples and prototypes, we filter out the Out-Of-Distribution~(OOD) samples for reliable updates. Furthermore, we propose a neural collapse approximation mechanism to refine these prototypes, ensuring they can gradually adapt to the target domain while maintaining the neural collapse structure. Extensive experiments on several open-world benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method. Our empirical analysis suggests that ReNC better preserves NC-related properties in the target domain, providing useful evidence for explaining reliable OWTTA and offering new insights for model design. Code is available at https://github.com/JiaqiLin-AI/ReNC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放世界测试时适应（Open-World Test-Time Adaptation, OWTTA）中标签分布偏移的问题，提出可靠神经坍缩近似方法（Reliable Neural Collapse approximation, ReNC）。该方法利用神经坍缩（neural collapse）作为结构先验，将预训练分类器权重视为源域原型，通过样本与原型相似度过滤分布外（OOD）样本，并设计原型细化机制使其逐步适应目标域。实验表明该方法在开放世界基准上优于现有方法，并更好地保留目标域中与神经坍缩相关的性质。
Motivation: 传统测试时适应（TTA）方法在发生标签分布偏移的开放世界场景下失效，需要一种能在目标域存在未知类别样本时仍可靠进行无源适应的机制。
Method: 提出 ReNC：以神经坍缩为结构先验，论证预训练分类器权重可作为源域原型；基于样本与原型的相似度过滤 OOD 样本；并设计神经坍缩近似机制细化原型，使其在保持神经坍缩结构的同时逐步适配目标域。
Result: 在多个开放世界基准上的大量实验表明所提方法具有优越性；经验分析显示 ReNC 能更好地保留目标域中与神经坍缩相关的性质，为可靠 OWTTA 提供解释证据和模型设计新见解。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用神经坍缩结构先验可以有效缓解开放世界测试时适应中的不可靠更新问题，并指出该机制可为后续模型设计提供启示。

papers.title: Write Once, Run Everywhere: The Axon DSL for Shape-Safe and Framework-Agnostic LLM Architectures
papers.abstract_en: The entire ecosystem of open-source language models effectively relies on a single platform. What if this platform was forced to shut down tomorrow? Implementing and maintaining efficient model definitions and translating them between different training and inference regimes is a resource-heavy task that severely limits model efficiency and portability, hindering both scaling and deployment. Here, we present Axon, a strongly typed domain-specific language with Haskell-like syntax, that enables a write-once, run everywhere paradigm for LLM architectures. By basing collaboration on a language specification rather than a specific framework's vision, Axon fosters open cooperation and empowers researchers to implement highly specialized architectures without giving up optimization infrastructure or accepting deployment lock-in. Axon allows for concise, auditable specifications that can be automatically compiled to standalone implementations for leading frameworks: PyTorch, PyTorch with Triton, JAX, MLX and vLLM. In 467 inference benchmarking experiments on models ranging from 135M to 32B parameters, we demonstrate median speedups of 7% on PyTorch, 12% on PyTorch with Triton, 91% on JAX, and 107% on MLX, compared to the reference implementations from Transformers. When deployed as native vLLM architectures with PagedAttention and KV-cache, Axon models achieve a 58% median speedup over Transformers implementations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Axon，一种具有类似 Haskell 语法的强类型领域专用语言 (DSL)，旨在为 LLM 架构实现 write-once, run-everywhere 范式。Axon 能将简洁、可审计的模型规格自动编译为 PyTorch、PyTorch with Triton、JAX、MLX 和 vLLM 的独立实现。在 135M 到 32B 参数模型的 467 次推理基准实验中，相比 Transformers 参考实现，Axon 在 PyTorch、PyTorch with Triton、JAX、MLX 上分别取得 7%、12%、91%、107% 的中位加速；作为原生 vLLM 架构（含 PagedAttention 和 KV-cache）部署时取得 58% 的中位加速。
Motivation: 开源语言模型生态实质上依赖单一平台，一旦该平台不可用将造成严重冲击；同时，在不同训练和推理框架之间维护与转换高效模型定义成本高昂，制约了模型效率、可移植性以及规模化与部署。
Method: Axon 是一种强类型 DSL，采用 Haskell-like 语法，以语言规范而非特定框架愿景为基础。研究者用其编写简洁、可审计的架构规格，再由编译器自动生成面向 PyTorch、PyTorch with Triton、JAX、MLX 与 vLLM 的独立实现。
Result: 在 135M 至 32B 参数模型的 467 次推理基准实验中，相较于 Transformers 参考实现，Axon 在 PyTorch 上取得 7% 的中位加速，PyTorch with Triton 上 12%，JAX 上 91%，MLX 上 107%；部署为带 PagedAttention 与 KV-cache 的原生 vLLM 架构时取得 58% 的中位加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为，基于语言规范进行协作能让研究者实现高度专门化的架构，同时不必放弃优化基础设施或接受部署锁定；Axon 的目标是在不绑定特定框架的前提下提升 LLM 架构的可移植性与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evidence Before Expansion: Reuse, Spawn, or Defer in Lifelong Expert Pools
papers.abstract_en: Streaming systems that maintain a pool of expert models must repeatedly decide whether to reuse an existing expert for arriving data, spawn a new one, or defer. We present a decision layer that makes all three outcomes statistically meaningful. Reuse and spawn are posed as one-sided sequential hypotheses on a conditional (mechanism-level) discrepancy, separated by an indifference zone; defer is exactly the state in which neither betting e-process has accumulated sufficient evidence. We prove finite-time anytime validity for the observable surrogate discrepancy of a predictable discriminator sequence, and an unconditional one-sided transfer to the population quantity in which each side's slack is the excess risk of a single discriminator; an empirically observed downward-bias regularity makes the spawn side exactly conservative. Recency without sacrificing the guarantee is obtained by a restarted e-detector: a bank of unwindowed betting supermartingales at geometrically spaced restart times (O(log t) memory), with the error budget spent over restart instances, which preserves lifetime anytime validity; spending over expert-creation order likewise controls multiplicity for unboundedly many experts. On synthetic multi-concept streams, Electricity, Covertype, and the recurrence-heavy INSECTS benchmark, the instance-accounted restarted bank achieves zero false spawns and zero false reuses after switches and matches or exceeds the retired windowed heuristic (INSECTS-reoccurring accuracy 0.675), making the deployed algorithm and the guaranteed algorithm one and the same.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对流式系统中专家模型池的维护决策，提出一个统计上有意义的决策层，统一处理重用现有专家、生成新专家或延迟决策三种选择。重用与生成被建模为条件机制差异的单侧序贯假设检验，并用 e-process 累积证据，延迟则对应两个 betting e-process 均未累积足够证据的状态。作者证明可预测判别器序列的代理差异具有有限时间任意时间有效性，并通过重启 e-检测器在不牺牲保障的前提下实现对新数据的递归响应。实验在合成多概念流、Electricity、Covertype 和 INSECTS 基准上报告了零误生成、零误重用，且匹配或超过旧的窗口启发式方法。
Motivation: 流式系统需不断对到达的数据决定是重用既有专家、生成新专家还是延迟决策，但现有启发式缺乏统计上一致的保障，难以区分这三种结果的意义。
Method: 提出一个决策层，将重用与生成设为关于条件机制差异的单侧假设检验（含不可区分区），延迟定义为两个 betting e-process 均无充分证据的状态。证明对可预测判别器序列可观测代理差异的有限时间任意时间有效性，并给出向总体量的无条件单侧转移。使用重启 e-检测器（几何间隔重启的无窗 betting supermartingales 组，O(log t) 内存）在保持终身任意时间有效性的同时恢复递归性，并通过按专家创建顺序分配错误预算来控制无限多专家的多重比较。
Result: 在合成多概念流、Electricity、Covertype 和周期性较强的 INSECTS 基准上，按实例计数的重启银行在概念切换后实现零误生成 (zero false spawns) 和零误重用 (zero false reuses)，并匹配或超过退役的窗口式启发式方法（INSECTS-reoccurring 准确率为 0.675）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该算法使实际部署的算法与带统计保证的算法成为同一个，即在实际运行时也能维持任意时间有效性；并指出经验观察到的向下偏差规律使生成侧具有精确保守性。

papers.title: Separating Covariate Shift from Mechanism Change with Two Discriminators: CJSD, a Conditional Discrepancy with an Exact Covariate-Concept Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Streaming systems that maintain a pool of expert models must repeatedly decide whether to reuse an existing expert for arriving data, spawn a new one, or defer. We present a decision layer that makes all three outcomes statistically meaningful. Reuse and spawn are posed as one-sided sequential hypotheses on a conditional (mechanism-level) discrepancy, separated by an indifference zone; defer is exactly the state in which neither betting e-process has accumulated sufficient evidence. We prove finite-time anytime validity for the observable surrogate discrepancy of a predictable discriminator sequence, and an unconditional one-sided transfer to the population quantity in which each side's slack is the excess risk of a single discriminator; an empirically observed downward-bias regularity makes the spawn side exactly conservative. Recency without sacrificing the guarantee is obtained by a restarted e-detector: a bank of unwindowed betting supermartingales at geometrically spaced restart times (O(log t) memory), with the error budget spent over restart instances, which preserves lifetime anytime validity; spending over expert-creation order likewise controls multiplicity for unboundedly many experts. On synthetic multi-concept streams, Electricity, Covertype, and the recurrence-heavy INSECTS benchmark, the instance-accounted restarted bank achieves zero false spawns and zero false reuses after switches and matches or exceeds the retired windowed heuristic (INSECTS-reoccurring accuracy 0.675), making the deployed algorithm and the guaranteed algorithm one and the same.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于流式专家模型池的决策层，在复用 (reuse)、新建 (spawn) 与推迟 (defer) 三种动作之间做统计上有意义的抉择。方法基于条件差异量 CJSD 的单侧序贯假设检验，用两组判别器分离协变量漂移 (covariate shift) 与机制变化 (mechanism change)，并通过带无差异区间的 betting e-process 实现有限时间 anytime 有效性。摘要报告在合成多概念流、Electricity、Covertype 与 INSECTS 基准上实现零误新建与零误复用，且 INSECTS-reoccurring 准确率达到 0.675。
Motivation: 流式系统维护专家模型池时，需要反复决定新到达数据应复用现有专家、新建专家还是推迟决策；现有窗口化启发式缺乏统计保证，难以区分协变量漂移与真正的机制变化。
Method: 将复用与新建建模为关于条件（机制层）差异量的一侧序贯假设，并用无差异区间 (indifference zone) 隔开；推迟恰好对应两个 betting e-process 都未累积足够证据的状态。作者证明可观测替代差异量的有限时间 anytime 有效性，并通过重启的 e-detector（几何间隔重启时间的无窗口 betting supermartingale 组，O(log t) 内存）在不牺牲保证的前提下实现近期数据加权。
Result: 摘要报告该重启检测器在合成多概念流、Electricity、Covertype 和 INSECTS 基准上，在切换后实现零误新建和零误复用，且匹配或超过旧的窗口化启发式（INSECTS-reoccurring 准确率 0.675），使部署算法与有保证的算法一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过将误差预算分配到重启实例和专家创建顺序来控制多重性，可对无界数量的专家保持终身 anytime 有效性；观察到向下的经验偏差使得新建侧恰好保守。范围限于流式专家池的决策层，不涉及天气或降水领域的应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TESTNAV: Pareto-Guided Search for Compositional Robustness Testing
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models remain vulnerable to real-world input perturbations, especially when multiple corruptions co-occur in the same input (e.g., brightness shifts and motion blur). Compositional testing reveals these interaction effects but introduces two challenges: combinatorial growth of the perturbation space as dimensions and severity levels increase, and uneven diagnostic value-many combinations yield unrealistically degraded inputs with limited practical relevance. We present TESTNAV, 1 a Pareto-guided robustness testing framework for efficiently exploring discrete, compositional perturbation spaces when only a limited number of perturbation configurations can be evaluated. TESTNAV prioritises severe yet realistic failures by formulating robustness testing as bi-objective optimisation: maximise performance degradation while preserving input fidelity measured by modality-specific metrics (e.g., SSIM and KID for vision; chrF and BERT-F1 for language and code). It uses NSGA-II to approximate the bi-objective Pareto front. Across four benchmarks spanning vision, natural language, and code generation, TESTNAV recovers Pareto fronts up to 2.15x faster than search-based baselines, using 35.8%-89.3% of the discrete perturbation space defined by four perturbation dimensions with six levels each.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TESTNAV，一个 Pareto 引导的鲁棒性测试框架，用于在离散组合扰动空间中高效寻找既严重又真实（severe yet realistic）的失败配置。它将鲁棒性测试建模为双目标优化：最大化性能退化同时保持输入保真度，并用 NSGA-II 逼近 Pareto 前沿。在视觉、自然语言和代码生成四个基准上，TESTNAV 比基于搜索的基线快最高 2.15 倍恢复 Pareto 前沿，且仅探索扰动空间的一部分。
Motivation: 深度学习模型面对多个同时发生的真实世界扰动（如亮度偏移加运动模糊）时仍然脆弱，而组合式测试会带来两个挑战：扰动空间随维度和严重程度呈组合式增长，以及大量组合产生不现实且诊断价值有限的输入。需要一种在评估预算受限时仍能优先发现严重但真实故障的探索方法。
Method: 将鲁棒性测试表述为双目标优化问题，目标是最大化模型性能退化并最大化输入保真度，保真度由模态特定指标（视觉用 SSIM 和 KID，语言与代码用 chrF 和 BERT-F1）度量；使用 NSGA-II 来逼近双目标 Pareto 前沿，从而在离散组合扰动空间中引导搜索。
Result: 在覆盖视觉、自然语言与代码生成的四个基准上，TESTNAV 比基于搜索的基线快最多 2.15 倍恢复 Pareto 前沿，并且只需评估由四个扰动维度、每维六个级别构成的离散扰动空间的 35.8%–89.3%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将鲁棒性测试视为 Pareto 引导的双目标优化，可以高效地发现严重且真实的失败组合，并在预算有限的条件下有效探索组合扰动空间。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Interpretable Feature Learning for RF Fingerprinting via Polar MKANs
papers.abstract_en: Radio frequency (RF) fingerprinting authenticates wireless devices from hardware-induced I/Q impairments, typically with deep learning feature extractors that are accurate but opaque, limiting their use in security critical settings. We propose Polar Monotonic Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (Polar MKAN), a block partitioned monotonic encoder on polar inputs in which each latent dimension depends exclusively on magnitude or phase, yielding channel separation and monotone responses by construction. On a synthetic gain and carrier frequency offset (CFO) benchmark, Polar MKAN reaches 57.2 percent DCI Disentanglement versus at most 12.9 percent for unpartitioned baselines. We further evaluate the detection accuracy trade off on real data and the sensitivity to blind CFO compensation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Polar Monotonic Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (Polar MKAN)，一种基于极坐标输入的块分区单调编码器，用于射频(RF)指纹识别。每个潜在维度在构造上仅依赖幅度或相位，从而保证通道分离和单调响应。在合成增益与载波频偏(CFO)基准上，Polar MKAN 达到 57.2% 的 DCI 解耦度，而未分区基线最高仅 12.9%。摘要还在真实数据上评估了检测精度权衡以及对盲 CFO 补偿的敏感性。
Motivation: RF 指纹识别通常依赖深度学习特征提取器，虽然精度高但缺乏可解释性，限制了其在安全关键场景中的应用。
Method: 提出 Polar MKAN，将输入变换至极坐标后采用块分区单调编码器，强制每个潜在维度只由幅度或相位决定，从而在构造层面实现通道分离与单调响应。
Result: 在合成增益与 CFO 基准上，Polar MKAN 的 DCI 解耦度达到 57.2%，显著高于未分区基线的最高 12.9%；并在真实数据上进一步评估了检测精度与盲 CFO 补偿的权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为极坐标下的块分区单调结构可在 RF 指纹识别中实现可解释的特征学习，同时真实数据上的检测精度与 CFO 补偿敏感性仍需权衡考虑。

papers.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet these environments are hand-built and static: blind to an agent's weaknesses, and quickly left behind as it improves. While recent environment generation methods attempt to address this, they require domain-specific pipelines, rely on expensive or unreliable verifiers, and still produce static environments. To alleviate the engineering burden of rebuilding environments from scratch, we propose Environment Harness (EnvHarness), a programmable layer of plug-in components that wraps a static environment to reshape its behavior without modifying the underlying logic. Operating through standard interfaces, EnvHarness applies across diverse domains while ensuring every reshaped environment retains its original verifier. To automate this process, we introduce EnvRigger, which treats the target policy as a black box, observing its execution trajectories to synthesize EnvHarness components targeting diagnosed flaws, and validating them via fresh rollouts. Across five benchmarks in four domains, EnvHarness outperforms both original environments and domain-specific environment generation pipelines, achieving up to a 9.0-point improvement on held-out instances with 9.8% fewer execution steps. Furthermore, EnvHarness provides a superior optimization signal for reinforcement learning, enabling continuous, targeted co-evolution of the policy and its environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EnvHarness（Environment Harness），一个可编程的插件组件层，用于包装静态 LLM agent 环境并重塑其行为，而无需修改底层逻辑；配套的 EnvRigger 将目标策略视为黑盒，通过观察其执行轨迹来合成组件并验证。在四个领域的五个基准上，EnvHarness 超越了原始环境和领域特定的环境生成流水线，在保留实例上最高提升 9.0 分，并减少 9.8% 的执行步骤。摘要还报告其能为强化学习提供更优的优化信号，实现策略与环境的持续定向共同进化。
Motivation: LLM agent 依赖的环境大多手工构建且静态，既对 agent 的弱点无感知，又会在 agent 提升后迅速过时；现有的环境生成方法需要领域特定流水线，依赖昂贵或不可靠的验证器，且仍产出静态环境。作者希望减轻从零重建环境的工程负担。
Method: 提出 EnvHarness，作为一层可编程插件组件，通过标准接口包装静态环境来重塑其行为，同时确保每个重塑后的环境保留原始验证器。引入 EnvRigger，将目标策略作为黑箱，观察其执行轨迹来合成针对已诊断缺陷的 EnvHarness 组件，并通过新 rollout 验证这些组件。
Result: 在四个领域的五个基准上，EnvHarness 同时优于原始环境和领域特定的环境生成流水线，在保留实例上最高提升 9.0 个百分点，并减少 9.8% 的执行步骤；此外，它为强化学习提供了更优的优化信号，支持策略与环境的持续共同进化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 EnvHarness 通过标准接口在多个领域通用，且每个重塑环境都保留原始验证器；与 EnvRigger 结合的自动化流程支持策略与环境的持续、定向共同进化。摘要未说明局限性。

papers.title: A Repeated Measurements Approach to $SoH$ Battery Modelling of Cyclic Aged Data in a Laboratory Environment
papers.abstract_en: This document describes the application of a first order linearised nonlinear repeated measurements approach to the analysis of battery cell ageing profiles generated under controlled conditions in a laboratory. The primary advantage of the model is it reflects the obvious structure in the data. Consequently, it is a two-component of variance model: variation within ageing profiles (measurement noise) and variation among ageing profiles (test-to-test or cell-to-cell) variation. Novel regularised iterative generalised least squares parameter identification schemes, with optimal hyper-parameter re-estimation, are used to identify the hierarchical nonlinear model. The training data comprised $SoH$ profiles for 10 cells aged at various constant discharge and charge current cycles at a fixed chamber environmental temperature of 25 [$^\circ$C]. Each cell $SoH$ profile is modelled using a simple power law expression, whereas the variation in ageing parameters is modelled using a single knot cubic B-spline. $SoH$ is accurately predicted to $\pm 0.191\%$ for $SOH \in [0,20]$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种一阶线性化的非线性重复测量方法，用于分析实验室受控条件下电池循环老化数据。模型采用两分量方差结构，分别刻画老化曲线内部的测量噪声和曲线之间（测试间或电池间）的变异。作者使用带最优超参数重估的正则化迭代广义最小二乘算法识别层次非线性模型，并用单个节点的三次B样条建模老化参数变异，在SoH∈[0,20]范围内预测精度达到±0.191%。
Motivation: 电池老化数据存在明显的层次结构（同一条老化曲线内与不同老化曲线之间），传统模型未充分利用这一结构。该方法通过两分量方差模型更忠实地反映数据的固有结构，从而提升SoH预测精度。
Method: 采用一阶线性化的非线性重复测量模型，将每个电池的SoH曲线表示为简单幂律，参数内变异由单节点三次B样条刻画。参数估计使用新型正则化迭代广义最小二乘（iterative generalized least squares）方案，并包含最优超参数重估过程。
Result: 模型在实验室10个电池、25°C恒温、不同恒流充放电循环条件下的训练数据上，对SoH∈[0,20]区间实现了±0.191%的精确预测。
Conclusion: 本文展示了一种能反映老化数据层次结构的电池SoH建模方法，并在实验室条件下取得高精度预测，适用于受控老化数据的分析。

papers.title: A knowledge-guided agentic framework for mitigating patient-context ambiguity in health queries
papers.abstract_en: Patients often submit short, underspecified queries to healthcare chatbots that lack the patient-specific information needed to determine an appropriate response. Although these queries may be linguistically clear, they can support multiple plausible answers depending on undisclosed factors such as symptoms, diagnoses, medications, allergies, or dietary restrictions. A language model answering such a query directly may therefore rely on unsupported assumptions about the patient. We introduce a knowledge-guided agentic framework for mitigating patient-context ambiguity before final response generation. The framework operates between the patient and an otherwise unchanged downstream language model. It interprets the initial query, uses a task-specific knowledge graph to construct a set of plausible hypotheses, identifies the missing patient-context variables needed to distinguish among them, and asks targeted follow-up questions. The original query and the acquired context are then combined into a clarified prompt for the downstream model. We evaluated the framework across five language models using two controlled ambiguity-mitigation benchmarks: diagnosis retrieval from 1,034 symptom queries with clinically relevant evidence systematically masked, and dietary-safety classification from 487 queries with decisive health context omitted. The framework was compared with direct answering of the underspecified query and with rephrasing the same query without acquiring new patient information. In diagnosis retrieval, it increased overall exact Top-1 accuracy by at least 57.1 percentage points and selective exact Recall@5 by at least 77.7 percentage points across the five evaluated models compared with direct prompting. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对患者向医疗聊天机器人提交短而缺乏上下文的查询时，语言模型可能基于未说明的症状、诊断、用药或过敏等患者信息做出无根据假设的问题，提出一个知识引导的代理框架（agentic framework）。该框架位于患者与下游语言模型之间，先解析初始查询，利用任务特定的知识图谱（knowledge graph）构建多个合理假设，识别区分这些假设所缺失的患者上下文变量，并提出有针对性的追问；随后将原始查询与获得的上下文合并为澄清提示交给下游模型。在五个语言模型上的两个受控歧义消解基准中，该框架相比直接提示显著提升了诊断检索与饮食安全分类的表现。
Motivation: 患者的健康查询常常语言通顺但信息不完整，同一句查询可能因未披露的病情、用药或饮食限制而有多个合理答案。直接让语言模型作答会依赖对患者的未经验证的假设，导致不合适的回复，因此在生成最终回答前消解患者上下文歧义非常重要。
Method: 框架作为患者与下游不变语言模型之间的中间层，包含四个步骤：解释初始查询、用任务特定知识图谱构建一组合理假设、找出区分这些假设所需的缺失患者上下文变量、向患者提出针对性追问；最后把原始查询和获取的上下文合并成澄清提示输入下游模型。
Result: 在诊断检索基准（1,034 条症状查询，系统性掩蔽临床相关证据）上，相比直接提示，五个评估模型中的总体精确 Top-1 准确率至少提升 57.1 个百分点，选择性精确 Recall@5 至少提升 77.7 个百分点；在饮食安全分类基准（487 条查询，省略决定性健康上下文）上，五个模型的准确率均提高，其中四个模型取得最高的 Matthews correlation coefficient。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在最终响应生成前通过知识图谱引导的追问来获取缺失的患者上下文，可以避免语言模型对患者作无根据假设，并在一系列不同下游模型上普遍提升答案的可靠性。

papers.title: DIFFCZSL: Compositional Zero-Shot Learning Regularized by Diffusion Representations
papers.abstract_en: Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL) aims to recognize unseen attribute-object compositions by leveraging knowledge of primitive concepts learned from seen compositions. Although recent works achieve impressive performance in CZSL by leveraging large vision-language models, they primarily rely on discriminative representations that may not explicitly preserve the structured relationships between primitive concepts and their compositions. Motivated by the recent success of diffusion-based classifiers and their competitive performance relative to discriminative models, we investigate whether intermediate diffusion representations can provide complementary cues for CZSL. To this end, we propose DIFFCZSL, a diffusion-augmented framework that injects generative priors from pre-trained diffusion models into CLIP-based CZSL pipelines. We extract intermediate diffusion representations and project them into the CLIP embedding space to provide auxiliary supervision on both image and text modalities. Through contrastive alignment between CLIP embeddings and diffusion features during training, our method encourages the embedding geometry toward richer composition-aware semantics, while introducing no additional cost at inference time. Extensive experiments on three public CZSL benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CLIP-based baselines under both closed-world and open-world settings. Our results highlight the complementary strengths of generative diffusion representations and discriminative vision-language models for compositional generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DIFFCZSL，一种将预训练扩散模型的中层扩散表示注入 CLIP 的 compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) 流程的框架。作者抽取中间扩散表示并投影到 CLIP 嵌入空间，在图像和文本两个模态上提供辅助监督，训练时对 CLIP 嵌入与扩散特征做对比对齐，推理时无额外开销。在三个公开 CZSL 基准上，该方法在 closed-world 和 open-world 设置下均一致优于强 CLIP 基线。
Motivation: 现有依赖大型视觉语言模型的 CZSL 方法主要使用判别式表示，不一定显式保留 primitive concept 与其组合之间的结构化关系。作者受扩散模型分类器近期成功的启发，探索中间扩散表示能否为 CZSL 提供互补线索。
Method: 提出 DIFFCZSL，将预训练扩散模型中的生成先验注入 CLIP 式 CZSL 流程：抽取中间扩散表示并投影到 CLIP 嵌入空间，对图像与文本模态提供辅助监督；训练时通过 CLIP 嵌入与扩散特征之间的对比对齐，使嵌入几何朝向更富组合感知语义的方向。
Result: 在三个公开 CZSL 基准上的实验表明，该方法在 closed-world 和 open-world 设置下都相对强 CLIP 基线取得一致提升，且不增加推理成本。
Conclusion: 结果表明生成式扩散表示与判别式视觉语言模型在组合泛化上具有互补优势。

papers.title: A 360-Degree Vision Dataset for Learning Yaw Control on GPS-Denied Micro-UAVs in Disaster-Response-Relevant Environments
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel data-driven approach to camera-based autonomy for micro-drones in GPS-denied, radio-challenging indoor environments. The target application is disaster and emergency response, where micro-UAVs can provide rapid situational awareness in hazardous settings such as firefighting and chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) incidents while reducing risk for human responders. When the communication link is lost, the micro-drone uses a learned yaw controller to autonomously navigate toward open space, preserving onboard sensor data that would otherwise be lost with the vehicle. A custom micro-drone equipped with a 360-degree camera was used to record diverse industrial, underground, and training scenarios representative of communication-denied field operations. We introduce a preprocessing pipeline that converts equirectangular 360-degree footage into planar front views and dynamically generates image-label pairs for AI training. We then train and compare multiple convolutional neural network variants that predict a continuous yaw command from a single monocular view. Evaluation on a held-out test set confirms the feasibility of the learned yaw-prediction approach. A semi-autonomous real-world test further demonstrates the practicality of the method while revealing key failure modes, particularly reflections and glare.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/ASME International Conference on Advanced Intelligent Mechatronics (AIM), Genoa, Italy, July 6-10, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向微型无人机在 GPS 拒止、通信受限室内环境中的数据驱动视觉自主方法，目标场景是消防和 CBRN 等灾害应急响应。作者使用搭载 360 度相机的定制微型无人机录制工业、地下和训练场景，设计预处理流程将等距柱状 (equirectangular) 全景画面转换为平面正视图像并动态生成图像-标签对，随后训练并比较多种卷积神经网络 (CNN) 变体，从单目视图预测连续偏航 (yaw) 指令。留出测试集上的评估确认了学习式偏航预测的可行性，半自主真实世界测试展示了实用性，同时暴露出反光和眩光等主要失效模式。
Motivation: 在 GPS 拒止且无线通信易中断的室内灾害场景中，微型无人机需要自主能力；当通信链路丢失时，学习式偏航控制器可引导无人机飞向开阔空间，从而保留本会随飞行器丢失的机载传感器数据。
Method: 使用配备 360 度相机的定制微型无人机采集多样化场景数据，构建将全景等距柱状画面转换为平面正视图像的预处理流水线，并动态生成用于 AI 训练的图像-标签对；在此基础上训练并比较多个 CNN 变体，使其从单张单目视图预测连续偏航指令。
Result: 在留出测试集上的评估确认了学习式偏航预测方法的可行性；半自主真实世界测试进一步验证了实用性，并揭示了主要失效模式，尤其是反光和眩光。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在通信拒止环境中具备可行性且可在真实场景中实际应用，但指出反光和眩光等失效模式仍待解决；未给出具体数值结果。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种面向微型无人机在 GPS 拒止、通信受限室内环境中的数据驱动视觉自主方法，目标场景是消防和 CBRN 等灾害应急响应。作者使用搭载 360 度相机的定制微型无人机录制工业、地下和训练场景，设计预处理流程将等距柱状 (equirectangular) 全景画面转换为平面正视图像并动态生成图像-标签对，随后训练并比较多种卷积神经网络 (CNN) 变体，从单目视图预测连续偏航 (yaw) 指令。留出测试集上的评估确认了学习式偏航预测的可行性，半自主真实世界测试展示了实用性，同时暴露出反光和眩光等主要失效模式。

summary_sections.result: 在留出测试集上的评估确认了学习式偏航预测方法的可行性；半自主真实世界测试进一步验证了实用性，并揭示了主要失效模式，尤其是反光和眩光。

papers.title: Listening Forward: Next Patch Embedding Prediction Enables Scalable Audio Learners
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has driven substantial progress in audio representation learning, though existing methods have increasingly relied on elaborate pre-training recipes to reach competitive performance. A markedly different pre-training philosophy underpins the most influential progress in language modeling and, more recently, in visual representation learning: rather than train encoders as static feature extractors, models are trained to predict the next element, a discrete token or a continuous embedding, from the preceding context. Autoregressive prediction thereby provides a unified pre-training interface that transfers across modalities, compelling the model to learn the underlying data distribution. We ask whether such a simple causal paradigm can yield strong audio learners, given that audio's temporal structure makes autoregressive prediction of patch embeddings a natural fit. We introduce NAPE (Next-Audio-Patch-Embedding prediction), a self-supervised framework in which a causal Transformer predicts each next patch embedding of a log-mel spectrogram from the previous ones, using causal masking and stop-gradient as its sole training signal. The design is intentionally minimalist, avoiding reconstruction decoders, acoustic tokenizers, student-teacher setups, and auxiliary regularization losses. Across six audio and speech benchmarks, NAPE achieves state-of-the-art fine-tuning performance on several tasks, scales consistently across encoder sizes, and yields strong linear-probing results. NAPE also produces structured attention patterns without explicit supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NAPE (Next-Audio-Patch-Embedding prediction)，一种极简的自监督音频表示学习框架：用因果 Transformer 预测 log-mel 频谱图中下一个 patch embedding，仅靠因果掩码 (causal masking) 和 stop-gradient 作为训练信号。摘要称在六个音频和语音基准上，NAPE 在多个任务上达到最先进的微调性能，在不同编码器规模上一致扩展，并得到强线性探测结果，且无需显式监督就产生结构化的注意力模式。
Motivation: 现有音频自监督学习 (SSL) 方法依赖复杂的预训练配方（如重构解码器、声学 tokenizer、师生框架、辅助正则）才能达到有竞争力的性能；作者希望验证更简单、跨模态统一的因果自回归预测范式（预测下一个离散 token 或连续 embedding）能否同样训练出强音频学习者。
Method: 提出 NAPE：一个因果 Transformer 根据之前的所有 patch embedding 预测 log-mel 频谱图的下一 patch embedding，训练信号仅为因果掩码与 stop-gradient，刻意避免重构解码器、声学 tokenizer、师生设置和辅助正则化损失。
Result: 摘要报告在六个音频和语音基准上，NAPE 在多个任务上取得 state-of-the-art 微调性能，随编码器规模增大表现一致提升，并取得强线性探测结果；模型还自发出现结构化的注意力模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为简单的因果自回归 patch embedding 预测可以成为可扩展且有效的音频表示学习范式，无需复杂预训练组件；该结论主要基于摘要所报告的基准实验和注意力分析。

papers.title: PolicyGuide: From Guarding One Action to Guiding the Whole Workflow for Policy-Compliant LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Customer-service LLM agents must follow organizational policy when acting on a user's behalf. Compliance failures arise from either forbidden actions, such as granting an ineligible change, or omitted procedural requirements, such as identification or confirmation. Runtime safeguards can intervene on risky actions, but action-local checks do not guide an agent through a multi-step procedure. Workflow-following systems support prescribed process execution, but primarily target workflow completion rather than safeguarding agent behavior. PolicyGuide instead compiles each domain policy into a workflow graph and invokes a proactive verifier at user-turn boundaries. From persisted graph state, the verifier reconciles open requests and returns step-specific remediation along a policy-compliant path. Across the $τ^2$-bench airline, retail, and telecom domains with a GPT-5.4 agent and verifier, PolicyGuide raises mean $\mathrm{Pass}^4$ from $0.42$ to $0.62$, with the largest gain on telecom ($0.19$ to $0.61$), the most workflow-structured domain. The same workflows transfer to Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 2.5 Pro agents. Complementary evaluations find the lowest observed attack-success rate under adversarial users and the strongest procedural compliance in an author-designed workflow-level validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolicyGuide，将组织策略编译为工作流图，并在用户轮次边界调用主动验证器，从而在代理执行多步流程时提供合规引导。在 τ^2-bench 的航空、零售、电信三个域上，使用 GPT-5.4 代理与验证器将平均 Pass^4 从 0.42 提升到 0.62，其中电信域提幅最大（0.19 到 0.61）。该工作流还可迁移到 Claude Sonnet 4.6 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro 代理。
Motivation: 客服 LLM 代理在代表用户行事时必须遵守组织策略，但运行时防护只针对单个风险动作，无法引导代理走完多步流程；而工作流遵循系统主要追求流程完成，并不以保障代理行为安全为核心。
Method: PolicyGuide 将每条领域策略编译为工作流图，并在用户轮次边界触发主动验证器；验证器基于持久化的图状态，协调未完成请求并返回沿合规路径的逐步修复建议。
Result: 在 τ^2-bench 上，平均 Pass^4 从 0.42 提升到 0.62，电信域从 0.19 提升到 0.61（该域工作流结构化程度最高）；相同工作流迁移到 Claude Sonnet 4.6 与 Gemini 2.5 Pro 代理依然有效。补充评估显示在对抗性用户下取得最低的观察攻击成功率，并在作者设计的工作流级验证中表现出最强的程序合规性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，把领域策略编译为工作流图并引入主动验证，可以在同一框架内兼顾策略合规与流程引导，且所得工作流具备跨代理模型的迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoLumNet: Monotone Optimal Transport for Single-Shot Exposure Correction
papers.abstract_en: Single-shot exposure correction aims to map an arbitrarily degraded image---whether under-exposed, over-exposed, or a spatial mixture of both---to a well-exposed output from a single capture. We present AutoLumNet, a framework that decomposes this task into a global monotone tone curve and a bounded local residual, making the global component the locus of formal guarantees. The tone curve is parameterized as the normalized cumulative integral of a strictly positive density, ensuring strict monotonicity by construction rather than by penalty. We prove that this parameterization (i)~preserves the pairwise luminance ordering of all pixels and all spatial extrema unconditionally, and (ii)~is dense in the space of valid tone corrections, containing the one-dimensional optimal-transport map from the input to any target luminance distribution. A differentiable sorted-sample Wasserstein-2 objective drives the learned curve toward the OT optimum during training. Spatially varying effects that the global map provably cannot address---local shading, chrominance shifts, and clipped-region restoration---are handled by a bounded residual decoder with dual-branch convex fusion, for which we provide an explicit sufficient condition for local order preservation. Experiments on five benchmarks (MSEC, SICE, LCDP, LOL-v1, LOL-v2-real) show that AutoLumNet achieves state-of-the-art PSNR and SSIM across both under- and over-exposure regimes at 11.2\,ms per frame, and generalizes zero-shot to pure low-light benchmarks without retraining. To our knowledge, AutoLumNet is the first exposure-correction method to unite structural monotonicity, optimal-transport optimality, and bounded local adaptivity within a single trainable architecture. Code is available at https://github.com/kraihan/Autolumnet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoLumNet 提出一种单次曝光校正框架，将任意欠曝、过曝或混合曝光的图像映射为正常曝光图像。方法将全局单调色调曲线参数化为严格正密度的归一化累积积分，从而在构造上保证严格单调性，并证明该参数化包含从输入到任意目标亮度分布的一维最优传输映射；局部残差由带有双分支凸融合的有界残差解码器处理。实验在 MSEC、SICE、LCDP、LOL-v1、LOL-v2-real 五个基准上取得 SOTA PSNR/SSIM，速度 11.2 ms/帧，并零样本泛化到纯低光基准。
Motivation: 单次曝光校正需要处理欠曝、过曝及空间混合曝光，现有方法难以同时保证全局色调映射的单调性、最优传输最优性和局部自适应能力，缺乏可证明的排序保持保证。
Method: 将任务分解为全局单调色调曲线与有界局部残差；色调曲线参数化为严格正密度的归一化累积积分以构造性保证严格单调性，训练中使用可微的排序样本 Wasserstein-2 目标驱动曲线逼近最优传输映射；局部残差解码器采用双分支凸融合，并给出局部排序保持的充分条件。
Result: 在 MSEC、SICE、LCDP、LOL-v1、LOL-v2-real 五个基准上，AutoLumNet 在欠曝和过曝场景均取得 SOTA PSNR 与 SSIM，每帧处理 11.2 ms，且无需重训练即可零样本泛化到纯低光基准。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个在同一可训练架构中统一结构单调性、最优传输最优性与有界局部适应性的曝光校正方法。

papers.title: Online Test-Time Adaptation for Generalizable Dynamic Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Generalizable dynamic graph anomaly detection (DGAD) enables pretrained detectors to identify anomalies in unseen target domains without costly retraining. However, existing methods often fail for two reasons. First, they mainly rely on domain-agnostic patterns and miss domain-specific patterns that keep evolving. Second, they assume access to the full target domain data, whereas in more practical online test-time adaptation settings, target data arrive sequentially in unlabeled chunks. To address these limitations, we formulate online test-time adaptation for generalizable DGAD and propose OTTA-DGAD. OTTA-DGAD first extracts dynamic prototypes, i.e., evolving representations of normal and anomalous patterns, from temporal ego-graphs and stores them in a memory buffer. The buffer selectively retains general patterns shared across the source domains used for pretraining while incorporating new patterns from the target domain. An anomaly scorer then compares incoming edge representations against these prototypes to identify both general and domain-specific anomalies. During adaptation, OTTA-DGAD updates the memory buffer using reliable pseudo-labels identified through confidence-based detection. It further enriches each target chunk with relevant representations retained from previous chunks, compensating for information loss resulting from the sequential arrival of data. Extensive experiments under strict test-then-adapt OTTA settings demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on ten real-world datasets from diverse domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OTTA-DGAD，面向可泛化的动态图异常检测（DGAD）中的在线测试时适应（online test-time adaptation）问题。方法从时序 ego-graph 中提取动态原型（dynamic prototypes）并存入记忆缓冲区，利用基于置信度的伪标签更新缓冲区，同时用历史块信息补偿顺序数据到达造成的损失。实验在十个真实世界数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 结果。
Motivation: 现有可泛化 DGAD 方法主要依赖跨域通用模式而忽略不断演化的域特定模式，且假设可访问完整目标域数据；实际在线测试时适应场景中目标数据以未标注块顺序到达。
Method: OTTA-DGAD 先提取正常与异常模式的动态原型并存入记忆缓冲区，缓冲区选择性保留源域共享的通用模式并纳入目标域新模式；异常评分器比较输入边表示与原型，适应阶段用基于置信度检测的可靠伪标签更新缓冲区，并用之前块保留的相关表示丰富当前目标块。
Result: 在严格的 test-then-adapt 在线测试时适应设置下，十个来自不同领域的真实数据集上表现达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过动态原型与记忆缓冲区的在线更新，OTTA-DGAD 能同时识别通用与域特定异常，并缓解顺序数据到达造成的信息损失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: For AI agents to be useful beyond simple chat, they must hold sensitive user context such as calendars, credentials, health records, and financial data. We study whether the mere presence of such secrets in a model's context window introduces hidden correlations into the model's benign outputs, allowing reconstruction even when the model correctly refuses direct extraction. We further study whether an adversary can actively engineer prompts that amplify this effect, using the model as a covert carrier to transmit secrets through seemingly innocuous text. In both cases, this limited leakage is exploited using a novel adaptive attack that assumes black-box access to the underlying model. In controlled experiments across eight proprietary models, we find that 2-digit in-context secrets are reconstructed with near-perfect accuracy and 4-digit secrets at 82\% exact match, all from outputs the model produces in response to ordinary, non-adversarial requests. We observe that more capable models leak more: stronger instruction-following amplifies sensitivity to in-context secrets, suggesting leakage is a byproduct of capability as opposed to a patchable bug. We show this leakage enables two practical attacks: (1) a trained classifier that infers semantic predicates about user memories (e.g., health conditions, financial events) from routine natural-language outputs, and (2) an RL-trained adversary that extracts full Social Security Numbers from a production-style agent.

TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型上下文窗口中的敏感秘密是否会渗入模型对普通良性请求的输出，从而让攻击者在模型正确拒绝直接提取的情况下仍能重建秘密。作者提出一种假设黑盒访问的自适应攻击，并在八个专有模型上的受控实验中实现近乎完美的 2 位秘密重建和 82% 的 4 位秘密精确匹配。文章进一步展示该泄漏可支撑两类实际攻击：用训练好的分类器从日常文本输出推断用户记忆的语义谓词，以及用 RL 训练的对手从生产型 agent 中提取完整的社会安全号码。
Motivation: AI agent 需要在对话之外持有日历、凭证、健康记录和财务数据等敏感上下文，因此需要验证仅凭秘密存在于上下文窗口这一事实，是否就会在良性输出中引入可被利用的隐藏相关性。
Method: 提出一种基于黑盒访问的新型自适应攻击，既考察秘密被动泄漏，也研究对手是否可通过主动构造 prompt 放大该效应从而把模型当作隐蔽信道。文中还训练了用于语义谓词推理的分类器，以及用于提取完整社会安全号码的 RL 对手。
Result: 在八个专有模型的受控实验中，2 位上下文秘密近乎完美重建，4 位秘密的精确匹配率达 82%，且均来自模型对普通非对抗性请求的输出；更强指令跟随能力的模型泄漏更多。
Conclusion: 作者认为该泄漏是模型能力提升的副产品而非可修补的 bug，并表明它足以支撑针对用户记忆和生产型 agent 的实用攻击；文章范围为受控实验与专有模型。

papers.title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents have made substantial progress in code generation, yet most existing systems assume a predefined repository architecture. This assumption does not hold in zero-to-all code generation, where an agent must construct an entire software project directly from natural-language requirements while maintaining a modular repository architecture throughout development. We present Repo0, a continuous structural evolution framework for zero-to-all code generation. Repo0 maintains an explicit architectural state instantiated as a Dual-Directed-Acyclic-Graph (Dual-DAG), consisting of a requirement-level DAG, a component-level DAG, and their alignment relation. Starting from natural-language requirements, it iteratively evolves component boundaries through structural actions guided by modularity metrics until structural convergence, after which the converged architecture guides test-driven development code generation. We evaluate Repo0 on six real-world repositories from RepoCraft using GPT-5 mini and DeepSeek V3.2. Repo0 achieves the highest Functionality Coverage and Pass Rate across all settings. Compared with RPG, the strongest repository-planning baseline, Repo0 improves Functionality Coverage by up to 20.08 percentage points and Pass Rate by up to 29.74 percentage points. Ablation and structural-evolution analyses further demonstrate the importance of the Dual-DAG architectural state, modularity-guided structural evolution, and explicit structural convergence.
papers.comment: Our code and data are available at https://github.com/cslsolow/Repo0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Repo0，一个面向零到全（zero-to-all）代码生成的连续结构演化框架。针对现有系统假设预定义仓库架构的问题，Repo0 从自然语言需求出发，用 Dual-Directed-Acyclic-Graph (Dual-DAG) 显式维护架构状态，通过由模块化度量引导的结构动作迭代演化组件边界直到结构收敛，再用收敛后的架构指导测试驱动开发（test-driven development）的代码生成。在 RepoCraft 的六个真实仓库上使用 GPT-5 mini 和 DeepSeek V3.2 评估，Repo0 在所有设置下取得最高的 Functionality Coverage 和 Pass Rate。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体在代码生成上已有显著进展，但多数系统假设存在预定义的仓库架构；在零到全代码生成中，智能体需要直接从自然语言需求构建整个软件项目并在整个开发过程中维持模块化仓库架构，这一假设不再成立。
Method: Repo0 维护一个显式架构状态，实例化为 Dual-DAG，由需求级 DAG、组件级 DAG 及其对齐关系组成；从自然语言需求开始，通过由模块化度量（modularity metrics）引导的结构动作持续演化组件边界，直至结构收敛，然后用收敛架构指导测试驱动开发的代码生成。
Result: 在 RepoCraft 的六个真实仓库上，配合 GPT-5 mini 和 DeepSeek V3.2，Repo0 在所有设置下取得最高 Functionality Coverage 和 Pass Rate；相比最强的仓库规划基线 RPG，Functionality Coverage 最高提升 20.08 个百分点，Pass Rate 最高提升 29.74 个百分点。消融与结构演化分析表明 Dual-DAG 架构状态、模块化引导的结构演化以及显式结构收敛的重要性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，对零到全代码生成而言，Dual-DAG 架构状态、由模块化度量引导的结构演化以及显式结构收敛是关键要素；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distributional Extrapolation for Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Predicting combinatorial effects from limited-range observations is a fundamental challenge in many scientific domains, including drug discovery and hyperparameter optimization. We study combinatorial extrapolation, where training data consists of axis-aligned samples with only one active covariate, while test-time inputs involve multiple simultaneously active covariates. We introduce DExtrI, a method for extrapolating interaction effects beyond the support of the training data. We provide theoretical guarantees characterizing when such extrapolation is possible. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that DExtrI successfully generalizes to unseen combinations of covariates. Our approach enables applications such as predicting previously untested drug combinations and improving the efficiency of hyperparameter optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究组合外推（combinatorial extrapolation）问题：训练数据中每个样本只有一个活动协变量（axis-aligned samples），而测试输入包含多个同时活动的协变量。作者提出 DExtrI 方法，用于外推训练数据支持范围之外的交互效应，并给出刻画何时可外推的理论保证。合成和真实数据实验表明，DExtrI 能泛化到未见过的协变量组合，可用于预测未测试的药物组合以及提升超参数优化效率。
Motivation: 从有限范围的观测预测组合效应是药物发现和超参数优化等领域的基础性挑战，现有方法难以处理训练与测试输入在活动协变量数量上不一致的情形。
Method: 提出 DExtrI，一种针对交互效应外推的方法，通过利用轴对齐的单一活动协变量训练样本来推断多个同时活动协变量下的联合效应，并提供理论保证刻画可外推的条件。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，DExtrI 能成功泛化到训练中未出现的协变量组合；摘要还指出该方法可支持预测未测试的药物组合并提升超参数优化效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DExtrI 使训练支持之外的交互效应外推成为可能，并带来药物组合预测和超参数优化两方面的实际应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAPO: Single-Rollout Autoregressive Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has become a critical stage in the post-training of large language models. Existing critic-free, group-relative methods estimate policy advantages from multiple rollouts, avoiding the substantial memory overhead of conventional proximal policy optimization (PPO) and achieving strong performance on long-horizon interactive tasks. Despite their success, recent studies revealed three limitations: (1) Lack explicit value generalization and effective temporal credit assignment; (2) Suffer from potential advantage collapse in long-horizon complex tasks; (3) Require a costly trade-off between sampling budget and policy performance. In this work, we propose Single-rollout Autoregressive Policy Optimization (SAPO), a low-memory and compute-efficient framework in which the policy and value functions share a single autoregressive backbone. SAPO exploits the autoregressive structure of LLMs to produce policy and value predictions at distinct causal boundaries with shared parameters, while independently optimizing the PPO objectives and auxiliary on-policy SARSA objectives. To robustly estimate the contribution of each turn, we further introduce a trajectory-level generalized advantage estimator that combines lambda-returns with batch normalization. Experiments across ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B show that SAPO trains stably and outperforms PPO and GRPO by mean +15.1 and +12.1 percentage points, respectively, while eliminating the memory cost of a separate critic model and reducing per-iteration runtime by 33.2% over PPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAPO（Single-rollout Autoregressive Policy Optimization），一种低内存、计算高效的智能体强化学习框架，用于 LLM 后训练。SAPO 让策略与价值函数共享同一个自回归主干，在 LLM 的不同因果边界上同时产生策略与价值预测，并分别优化 PPO 目标与辅助的 on-policy SARSA 目标；同时引入结合 lambda-returns 与 batch normalization 的轨迹级广义优势估计器（GAE），以稳健估计每个回合的贡献。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B 的实验表明，SAPO 训练稳定，平均性能分别超过 PPO 和 GRPO 15.1 与 12.1 个百分点，并比 PPO 减少 33.2% 的每轮迭代运行时间。
Motivation: 现有无评论家（critic-free）的组相对方法（如 GRPO）通过多次 rollout 估计优势，虽避免了 PPO 的高内存开销，但存在三个问题：缺乏显式价值泛化与有效的时序信用分配、在长程复杂任务中可能出现优势坍缩（advantage collapse）、以及需要在采样预算与策略性能之间做昂贵的权衡。
Method: 提出 SAPO 框架，策略与价值函数共享单一自回归主干，在 LLM 的不同因果边界（causal boundaries）处用共享参数产生策略与价值预测，并独立优化 PPO 目标与辅助的 on-policy SARSA 目标；为估计每个回合的贡献，引入结合 lambda-returns 与 batch normalization 的轨迹级广义优势估计器。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上以 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B 为基座模型，SAPO 训练稳定，平均比 PPO 高 15.1 个百分点、比 GRPO 高 12.1 个百分点；同时省去了独立 critic 模型的内存开销，并将相对 PPO 的每轮迭代运行时间降低 33.2%。
Conclusion: SAPO 表明，通过策略与价值共享自回归骨干并结合轨迹级优势估计，可以在不引入独立评论家模型的情况下实现稳定、低内存且高效的智能体强化学习训练；其验证范围集中在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 任务及 Qwen2.5 系列模型上。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Specification-delta-driven data governance: an empirical study of the «spec-delta» as the unit of change in lakehouse data platforms
papers.abstract_en: Spec Driven Development SDD has consolidated the idea that the specification rather than the code should be the primary artefact governing AI assisted work. Tools such as GitHub Spec Kit, and proposals such as Constitutional SDD, have formalised this principle in the software domain, while the executable data-contracts literature has extended it to schema and quality enforcement at run time. Nevertheless, the treatment of the specification delta OpenSpec's core idea that every change should produce a reviewable increment of requirements as the unit of change in data platforms remains empirically unexplored, even though many data-platform changes are contractual (new datasets, service-level agreements, metric semantics, access policies) rather than purely code changes. This work formalises the spec-delta concept, proposes a taxonomy of data platform changes according to their suitability for incremental specification, and defines a controlled experiment comparing a spec-delta-driven workflow against a conventional code pull-request workflow without a delta. The response variables are discovery to deployment time, the density of defects reaching the Silver and Gold lakehouse layers, cross-tool metric divergence, and reviewer cognitive load measured with NASA TLX. The paper explicitly reserves a demonstration-and-laboratory section for instantiation on a real lakehouse environment. The contribution is not a tool but reproducible evidence and an applicability guide that helps to avoid the up front over specification antipattern.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文将 OpenSpec 的规范增量（spec-delta）概念形式化，提出数据平台变更的分类法，并设计受控实验比较 spec-delta 驱动的工作流与不含 delta 的常规代码 pull-request 工作流。响应变量包括从发现到部署的时间、到达 Silver 与 Gold 湖仓层的缺陷密度、跨工具指标分歧以及用 NASA TLX 评测的审阅者认知负荷。作者明确说明其贡献不是工具，而是可复现的证据与适用性指南，并预留了在真实 lakehouse 环境中的演示与实验室部分。
Motivation: 尽管 Spec Driven Development 和数据契约（data contracts）文献已把规范视为一等工件，但将规范增量作为数据平台变更单元的做法仍缺乏实证研究；而数据平台中的许多变更是契约性的（新数据集、服务级别协议、指标语义、访问策略），并非纯代码变更。
Method: 形式化定义 spec-delta 概念，提出一个按增量式规格化适用性对数据平台变更进行分类的分类法（taxonomy），并定义一个受控实验：将 spec-delta 驱动工作流与无 delta 的常规代码 pull-request 工作流进行对比。实验响应变量为发现到部署时间、到达 Silver 和 Gold 湖仓层的缺陷密度、跨工具指标分歧，以及以 NASA TLX 度量的审阅者认知负荷。
Result: 摘要未报告量化结果；核心交付物是受控实验的设计与可复现证据框架，并明确保留 demonstration-and-laboratory 章节用于在真实 lakehouse 环境上的实例化。
Conclusion: 论文强调其贡献是可复现证据与适用性指南，旨在帮助避免前置过度规格化（up-front over-specification）反模式；实证结论仍需在真实数据平台环境中通过预留的演示和实验来验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Adaptive Probabilistic Shielding by Learning MDPs for Safe Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic shielding is a technique for safe reinforcement learning (RL). Typically, a static observer -- called the shield -- constrains the learning agent's actions to those for which acting safely remains feasible. Traditionally, the shield is computed from the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov decision process (MDP). Thus, this technique is not applicable when the MDP model is not given a priori, which, unfortunately, is the case in typical RL applications. In this paper, we study the problem of computing a shield in the setting where the transition graph of the MDP is known, but the transition probabilities are unknown. Our approach integrates probabilistic shielding with online model learning: as the RL agent explores the environment, we estimate the transition probabilities. From this estimate, we compute a shield. While the shield may be conservative initially, it adapts as the model estimate becomes more precise. Thus, the shield improves in tandem with the RL agent. This paradigm of adaptive probabilistic shielding raises a number of challenges, such as when to recompute the shield and how to balance between exploration and safety during learning. We empirically evaluate multiple variants of this paradigm across several environments.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. To be published in the proceedings of RV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究当MDP的转移概率未知但转移图已知时，如何为安全强化学习计算概率屏蔽（probabilistic shielding）。作者将概率屏蔽与在线模型学习结合，在RL智能体探索环境时估计转移概率并据此计算屏蔽，屏蔽从保守逐步自适应精确。论文还探讨了屏蔽重计算时机与探索-安全平衡等挑战，并在多个环境中进行了经验评估。
Motivation: 传统概率屏蔽需要预先知道底层MDP的转移概率，这在典型RL应用中通常不可得，限制了该安全技术的适用性。本文针对转移图已知但概率未知的场景，希望在模型不完全已知时仍能提供安全保障。
Method: 提出自适应概率屏蔽范式：将概率屏蔽与在线模型学习集成，利用RL探索过程中估计的转移概率来计算屏蔽，并随估计精度提升而自适应改进。文中还讨论了屏蔽重计算的时机以及学习过程中探索与安全之间的平衡问题。
Result: 摘要报告了在多个环境中对多种该范式变体的经验评估，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为自适应概率屏蔽能够在MDP概率未知时使屏蔽随RL智能体同步改进，同时指出该范式需要解决重计算时机与探索-安全平衡等问题。
