papers.title: GEM: Geometric Erasure by Contrastive Velocity Matching in Rectified Flows
papers.abstract_en: While the rapid adoption of multimodal generative models offers immense potential, it has also increased the risks of harmful content synthesis, deepfakes, and copyright infringements. To address these challenges, concept erasure has emerged as a prospective safeguard. However, as the field gradually transitions from U-Net-based diffusion models to Rectified Flow Transformers, erasure research has struggled to keep pace. In this work, we introduce GEM, a simple but highly effective erasure framework for Rectified Flow models. As part of our contribution, we establish a principled bridge between trajectory-based unlearning grounded in Generative Flow Networks and classic teacher-guided erasure: we translate trajectory-based signals into a teacher-guided flow-matching setup that unifies the strengths of both paradigms. Concretely, a teacher provides complementary attraction and repulsion signals that we combine into a single geometric guidance objective, yielding targeted suppression of unwanted concepts while preserving benign generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向 Rectified Flow 模型的概念擦除（concept erasure）框架 GEM，用于抑制有害内容、深度伪造和版权侵权的生成。作者将基于轨迹的生成流网络（Generative Flow Networks）去学习思想与教师引导擦除统一，通过教师提供的吸引与排斥信号构建单一几何引导目标，实现定向压制不需要的概念并保留良性生成。
Motivation: 多模态生成模型的快速普及带来有害内容合成、深度伪造和版权侵权风险，概念擦除是潜在的安全手段；但该领域从 U-Net 扩散模型转向 Rectified Flow Transformer 时，擦除研究未能同步跟进。
Method: GEM 将基于轨迹的擦除信号转化为教师引导的流匹配（flow-matching）设置，教师同时提供互补的吸引（attraction）和排斥（repulsion）信号，并将二者组合为单一的几何引导目标。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，仅说明该方法在压制不需要概念的同时能够保持良性生成。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为 Rectified Flow 模型提供了一种简单且有效的擦除框架，并建立了轨迹式去学习与经典教师引导擦除之间的原则性联系。

papers.title: Investigating the Interplay between Contextual and Parametric Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness under Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) faithfulness, i.e., whether CoTs genuinely reflect large language models' (LLM) underlying behavior, is typically evaluated with metrics under two disjoint paradigms: contextual faithfulness, measured by perturbing the input or CoT trace, and parametric faithfulness, assessed by intervening on a model's parametric knowledge. Yet prior work compares them only descriptively. We fill this gap by proposing FaithMATE, a unified preference-alignment interface for optimizing models towards either faithfulness paradigm. It enables us to investigate the interplay between the two paradigms, examining whether and to what extent faithfulness gains generalize within and across paradigms. Across three models, two datasets, and six faithfulness metrics, we find that the two paradigms are positively coupled, yet asymmetric: optimizing towards parametric faithfulness yields consistent gains across both paradigms, whereas the contextual counterpart delivers more variable gains. Within the contextual paradigm, faithfulness gains on one metric do not consistently transfer to others, implying that existing contextual metrics capture disjoint facets of faithfulness and exposing inherent trade-offs. These findings imply that CoT faithfulness is not a monolithic objective and therefore requires multifaceted optimization and evaluation.
papers.comment: The first two authors contributed equally and share first-authorship
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FaithMATE，一个统一的偏好对齐 (preference-alignment) 接口，用于分别针对上下文忠实性 (contextual faithfulness) 和参数忠实性 (parametric faithfulness) 优化大语言模型。通过在三个模型、两个数据集和六个忠实性指标上的实验，发现这两种范式正向耦合但不对称：针对参数忠实性优化能带来跨范式的一致收益，而针对上下文忠实性优化的收益波动更大。作者由此认为 CoT 忠实性并非单一目标，需要多方面的优化与评估。
Motivation: 现有 CoT 忠实性评估分成两个互不相交的范式：上下文忠实性通过扰动输入或 CoT 轨迹来度量，参数忠实性通过干预模型参数知识来度量；先前工作只对二者做描述性比较，缺乏统一框架来研究它们之间的相互作用。
Method: 提出 FaithMATE，一个统一的偏好对齐接口，可将模型优化朝向任一忠实性范式，从而系统考察一个范式内获得的忠实性收益是否以及多大程度上能泛化到另一范式或同一范式内的不同指标。
Result: 在三个模型、两个数据集和六个忠实性指标上的实验显示，两种范式正向耦合但不对称：针对参数忠实性进行优化能在两个范式上都带来一致收益，而针对上下文忠实性的优化收益更不稳定；在上下文范式内部，某一指标上的收益不能稳定迁移到其他指标，说明现有上下文指标捕捉的是互不相交的维度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CoT 忠实性不是单一目标，因此需要多方面的优化与评估；不同上下文指标之间存在内在权衡。

papers.title: Diffusion-based Denoising Beats Vanilla Score Matching in Parameter Estimation: A Theoretical Explanation
papers.abstract_en: Score matching is an alternative to maximum likelihood estimation when the normalizing constant is unknown or too costly to evaluate. However, vanilla score matching has shown to be inefficient relative to maximum likelihood estimation for multimodal distributions with well-separated modes, which are commonly encountered in practical applications. We compare a novel diffusion-based denoising score matching estimator (DDSME) to the vanilla score matching estimator (SME) in this scenario. In particular, we prove statistical guarantees for both estimators, showing that the error bound for the vanilla SME worsens when the separation between the modes increases, which can be avoided in case of the DDSME with suitable hyperparameter tuning. This provides a novel theoretical explanation for the superior behavior of diffusion-based score matching over the vanilla version. We support our theoretical findings by numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上比较了扩散式去噪得分匹配估计器（DDSME）与普通得分匹配估计器（SME）在多峰分布参数估计中的表现。作者证明，当峰间分离增大时，普通 SME 的误差界会恶化，而 DDSME 通过合适的超参数调节可以避免这一问题，从而为扩散式得分匹配优于普通版本提供了理论解释，并用数值实验支持结论。
Motivation: 普通得分匹配（vanilla score matching）在具有良好分离模式的多峰分布上相对于极大似然估计效率较低，而这类分布在实际应用中常见；现有理论缺乏对扩散式去噪得分匹配为何更优的解释。
Method: 提出并比较一种新的基于扩散的去噪得分匹配估计器（DDSME）与普通得分匹配估计器（SME），为两者推导统计保证，并分析误差界随模式分离程度的变化，结合超参数调节进行理论刻画。
Result: 摘要报告：普通 SME 的误差界随模式间分离增大而恶化，而 DDSME 在合适的超参数调节下可避免该恶化；数值实验支持理论发现。
Conclusion: 该工作为扩散式得分匹配优于普通版本提供了新的理论解释，表明在多峰分离场景下 DDSME 更具稳健性。

summary_sections.motivation: 普通得分匹配（vanilla score matching）在具有良好分离模式的多峰分布上相对于极大似然估计效率较低，而这类分布在实际应用中常见；现有理论缺乏对扩散式去噪得分匹配为何更优的解释。
summary_sections.method: 提出并比较一种新的基于扩散的去噪得分匹配估计器（DDSME）与普通得分匹配估计器（SME），为两者推导统计保证，并分析误差界随模式分离程度的变化，结合超参数调节进行理论刻画。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为扩散式得分匹配优于普通版本提供了新的理论解释，表明在多峰分离场景下 DDSME 更具稳健性。

papers.title: MKG-CARE: Case-Aware Reasoning with Multimodal Knowledge Graphs for Explainable Medical Image Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Medical image diagnosis has achieved significant progress with deep learning, yet existing methods often rely on isolated visual evidence and lack the ability to effectively leverage similar cases and external knowledge. In clinical practice, diagnosis is typically supported by similar historical cases and their associated symptoms. To explicitly model this evidence-based diagnostic process, we propose MKG-CARE, a framework that performs case-aware reasoning using multimodal knowledge graphs for explainable medical image diagnosis. Specifically, we construct a case-aware multimodal knowledge graph as a structured diagnostic memory, where diseases, images, and symptoms are hierarchically organized. Given an input image, MKG-CARE adaptively retrieves similar cases from this memory and extracts their corresponding case-centered subgraphs. We further introduce a knowledge propagation and injection mechanism, where an image-centric Graph Attention Network aggregates heterogeneous semantics within the retrieved case subgraphs, followed by bidirectional cross-modal attention to align and inject the aggregated case knowledge into visual representations. To mitigate retrieval noise, we design a confidence-calibrated decision refinement scheme that estimates each retrieved case's reliability from prediction confidence and sample similarity, and reweights its contribution to the final prediction for interpretable case-level evidence attribution. Extensive experiments on multiple medical imaging datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines, while ablation and qualitative analyses validate the effectiveness and interpretability of our method. The code is available at https://github.com/lyxuan1022/MKG-CARE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MKG-CARE，一个面向可解释医学图像诊断的案例感知推理框架，利用多模态知识图谱 (multimodal knowledge graphs) 对临床中“参考相似历史病例及其症状”的诊断过程进行显式建模。该框架把疾病、图像和症状组织成结构化诊断记忆，对输入图像自适应检索相似案例并提取案例中心子图，再通过知识传播注入与置信度校准的决策细化完成预测与案例级证据归因。在多个医学影像数据集上的实验显示其稳定优于强基线，并用消融和定性分析验证了有效性与可解释性。
Motivation: 现有医学图像诊断深度学习方法往往依赖孤立的视觉证据，难以有效利用相似历史病例和外部知识，而临床诊断通常由相似历史案例及其关联症状支持，因此需要显式建模这种基于证据的诊断过程。
Method: 构建案例感知的多模态知识图谱作为结构化诊断记忆，按层次组织疾病、图像和症状；对输入图像自适应检索相似案例并提取案例中心子图，引入以图像为中心的图注意力网络 (Graph Attention Network) 聚合子图内的异构语义，再用双向跨模态注意力将聚合的案例知识对齐并注入视觉表示；最后提出置信度校准的决策细化机制，根据预测置信度和样本相似度估计每个检索案例的可靠性并重新加权其预测贡献。
Result: 在多个医学影像数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法相比强基线取得一致的改进；消融实验和定性分析验证了各组件的有效性以及方法在案例级证据归因上的可解释性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将相似案例检索、知识图谱传播和置信度校准的贡献重加权结合，可以为医学图像诊断提供可解释的案例级证据归因，并公开了代码。

papers.title: A Tool to Map AI Programs in the U.S.: A Snapshot from April 2026 and an Analysis of Requirements for AI Majors and Minors
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we locate and analyze existing undergraduate Artificial Intelligence (AI) programs in the United States in Spring 2026, creating a historic record at a time of great change in this area. To create this record, we developed a tool to detect, scrape, and display data from 361 undergraduate AI programs--majors, minors, concentrations, and certificates--at 4-year universities. Our tool, available at https://cicmap.ai, searched 563 institutions to locate these programs, a sample that represents 87% of all undergraduate Computer Science (CS) graduates in the U.S in 2025. This tool allows prospective students, guidance counselors, administrators, and faculty to easily access AI program requirements and is designed to continually update as new programs emerge. To the best of our knowledge, this survey represents the most comprehensive snapshot of the state of AI programs in the U.S. to date. With this work we offer three important contributions: 1) a record of AI programs in the U.S. at a time of great upheaval; 2) a tool to explore AI programs and their requirements; and 3) an analysis of the courses required for 66 AI majors and 87 AI minors. Our analysis of majors and minors shows great variability in the size and the requirements of these degrees, but we note two takeaways. First, not all majors require a general AI course, but if they don't, they do require a Machine Learning (ML) course. Second, more than a third of majors require an Ethics in AI course but only 24% of minors do.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在2026年春季对美国本科人工智能（AI）项目进行定位与分析，开发了一个能够检测、抓取和展示来自361个本科AI项目（主修、辅修、方向及证书）数据的工具，覆盖563所四年制大学，样本代表2025年美国约87%的计算机科学（CS）毕业生。工具可在 https://cicmap.ai 访问，并设计为随新项目出现而持续更新。作者对66个AI主修和87个AI辅修的课程要求进行分析，发现这些学位在规模和要求上差异很大，并总结出两点观察：并非所有主修都要求通用AI课程，但若不要求则必须要求机器学习（ML）课程；超过三分之一的主修要求AI伦理课程，但只有24%的辅修要求该课程。
Motivation: 在AI本科教育快速变化的时期，缺少对美国现有本科AI项目的系统性记录与可访问的需求信息，作者希望为未来学生、辅导员、管理人员和教师提供一份历史快照与探索工具。
Method: 开发了一个自动化工具，用于检测、抓取并展示来自4年制大学的361个本科AI项目数据；工具搜索了563所机构，并提供一个公开网站以便用户查看项目要求，设计为可持续更新。
Result: 摘要报告该调查是迄今为止对美国AI项目状态最全面的快照；对主修和辅修的分析显示学位规模与要求差异很大，并给出了两个具体观察：未要求通用AI课程的主修都要求ML课程，且超过三分之一的主修要求AI伦理课程而辅修中该比例为24%。
Conclusion: 作者提出三项贡献：美国AI项目在巨变时期的历史记录、可探索项目及需求的工具、以及对66个AI主修和87个AI辅修课程要求的分析，强调这些学位要求的变异性并指出上述两个要点。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ChronoAgentic: A Code-based Multi-Agent World Simulator for Physically Grounded Simulation Construction
papers.abstract_en: Video-based world models generate visually plausible rollouts, but since they infer dynamics in latent states, they enforce no explicit physical constraints: contacts drift, shapes distort, and motion loses consistency. We present ChronoAgentic, a multi-agent framework that instead constructs the world as executable simulation code. The plan agent converts the natural-language prompt into a structured scene plan that the user can inspect and approve. The code agent implements the plan as an executable PyChrono program, grounded in a curated skill library, a generative 3D asset pipeline, and retrieval over the simulator source. After execution, the visual-analysis agent describes the rendered rollout, while deterministic physics checks scan the simulated trajectories for anomalies. The review agent evaluates this execution evidence, and the code agent iteratively repairs the program until it satisfies the plan objectives and physical constraints. On a suite of 80 demos selected from the PhyWorldBench benchmark, ChronoAgentic satisfies the benchmark's full correctness criterion--semantic adherence and physical correctness judged jointly---on 82.5% of demos, against 52.5% for the strongest of ten text-to-video models, scored under the same criterion on their officially released benchmark videos. The same construction loop extends to interactive use, including a live ROS driving environment in a generated city. The project page is available at https://uwsbel.github.io/chrono-agentic-website/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChronoAgentic，一个基于代码的多智能体世界模拟框架，把自然语言提示构建为可执行的 PyChrono 物理仿真程序，以显式物理约束替代视频世界模型在隐空间中推断动力学带来的漂移。框架包含 plan、code、visual-analysis、review 等智能体，通过执行证据与确定性物理检查循环修复程序。在 PhyWorldBench 的 80 个 demo 上，以语义一致性和物理正确性联合判定的完整标准达到 82.5%，而十个文生视频模型中最强模型在其官方视频上为 52.5%。
Motivation: 视频世界模型虽能生成视觉合理的 rollout，但动力学在隐状态中推断，不施加显式物理约束，导致接触漂移、形状畸变、运动不一致。作者主张把世界构造成可执行的仿真代码，从而获得可检查和可验证的物理一致性。
Method: 使用多智能体循环：plan agent 将自然语言提示转为用户可检查和审批的结构化场景计划；code agent 依据技能库、生成式 3D 资产管线和对仿真器源码的检索，将计划实现为可执行 PyChrono 程序；执行后 visual-analysis agent 描述渲染 rollout，确定性物理检查扫描轨迹异常；review agent 评估证据，code agent 迭代修复直至满足计划目标和物理约束。
Result: 在 PhyWorldBench 的 80 个 demo 上，完整正确性标准（语义保持与物理正确联合判定）达到 82.5%，对比十个文生视频模型中最强者的 52.5%（同一标准、官方发布视频）。同一构建循环可扩展到交互式使用，包括在生成城市中的实时 ROS 驾驶环境。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于代码的仿真构造能保证显式物理一致性并可迭代修复，且该循环可推广到交互式场景；其评估范围限于 PhyWorldBench 基准和 PyChrono 生态。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: The Value of Finite Observation in Positive-Data Learning of Multiple Context-Free Languages
papers.abstract_en: Positive data can show that two tuple occurrences share a successful sentence context without certifying that they are safely interchangeable. We study finite compositional observations, represented by finite-monoid homomorphisms, as semantic side information for learning bounded-fan-out multiple context-free languages from positive data. For every fixed fan-out bound $f$ and supplied finite observation $h$, we define observation-guarded tuple substitutability and give a canonical set-driven learner that exactly reconstructs every language in the full semantic slice $\{L\in f\text{-}\mathrm{MCFL}:L\text{ is }(f,h)\text{-tuple-substitutable}\}$. Under a fixed branching cap, hypothesis construction is polynomial. More generally, polynomial exposure of a presentation implies polynomial characteristic data; binary single-spine presentations provide an explicit sufficient condition. We then vary how much observation information is available. A fixed bound on the size of an unknown observation can be compiled into a universal finite refinement, restoring identifiability slicewise, whereas the unbounded latent-observation union is not identifiable. Moreover, universal finite refinements have an unavoidable exponential dependence on the observation bound, and a separate deletion obstruction shows that no family of set-driven identifiers can have characteristic data polynomial jointly in that bound and presentation size. Intrinsic observation size alone therefore does not determine latent-slice data complexity: the quantitative behavior also depends on whether the witnessing semantic slice is supplied or must be resolved inside a larger ambient class.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从正例数据 (positive data) 学习有界扇出的多重上下文无关语言 (multiple context-free languages, MCFL)。作者把有限幺半群同态 (finite-monoid homomorphisms) 表示的有限组合观察作为语义辅助信息，定义 observation-guarded tuple substitutability，并给出一个典型的集合驱动学习器 (set-driven learner)，可精确重构给定语义切片中的每个语言。文章还分析了观察信息量变化时的可辨识性与特征数据 (characteristic data) 复杂度。
Motivation: 仅有正例数据时，两个元组出现共享某个成功句上下文并不能证明它们可安全互换，因此需要额外的语义信息。作者关注有限观察作为此类语义辅助信息时，能否以及以何种数据复杂度来学习有界扇出的多重上下文无关语言。
Method: 对每个固定扇出界 f 和有限观察 h，定义 (f,h)-tuple-substitutable 语言类，构造典型的集合驱动学习器精确重构该语义切片；在固定分支上限下给出多项式时间的假设构造。随后考察观察信息量的变化：将未知观察的大小上界编译为 universal finite refinement，并分析有界与无界潜在观察并集的可辨识性。
Result: 在固定分支上限下假设构造是多项式的；一般地，呈现 (presentation) 的多项式暴露蕴含多项式特征数据，二元单脊柱呈现 (binary single-spine presentations) 是充分条件。固定观察大小上界可得到 universal finite refinement 并逐切片恢复可辨识性，而无界潜在观察并集不可辨识；universal finite refinement 对观察界有不可避免的指数依赖，且不存在集合驱动辨识器在观察界与呈现规模上同时具有多项式特征数据。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，固有观察大小本身并不决定潜在切片的数据复杂度；定量行为还取决于语义切片是外部提供的，还是需要在更大的环境类中被内部解析出来。

summary_sections.motivation: 仅有正例数据时，两个元组出现共享某个成功句上下文并不能证明它们可安全互换，因此需要额外的语义信息。作者关注有限观察作为此类语义辅助信息时，能否以及以何种数据复杂度来学习有界扇出的多重上下文无关语言。
summary_sections.method: 对每个固定扇出界 f 和有限观察 h，定义 (f,h)-tuple-substitutable 语言类，构造典型的集合驱动学习器精确重构该语义切片；在固定分支上限下给出多项式时间的假设构造。随后考察观察信息量的变化：将未知观察的大小上界编译为 universal finite refinement，并分析有界与无界潜在观察并集的可辨识性。
summary_sections.result: 在固定分支上限下假设构造是多项式的；一般地，呈现 (presentation) 的多项式暴露蕴含多项式特征数据，二元单脊柱呈现 (binary single-spine presentations) 是充分条件。固定观察大小上界可得到 universal finite refinement 并逐切片恢复可辨识性，而无界潜在观察并集不可辨识；universal finite refinement 对观察界有不可避免的指数依赖，且不存在集合驱动辨识器在观察界与呈现规模上同时具有多项式特征数据。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，固有观察大小本身并不决定潜在切片的数据复杂度；定量行为还取决于语义切片是外部提供的，还是需要在更大的环境类中被内部解析出来。

papers.title: From Accuracy to Auditability: A Survey of Determinism in Financial AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Deploying machine learning in regulated financial environments -- credit risk, fraud detection, and anti-money laundering -- exposes critical vulnerabilities in algorithmic reproducibility. While early financial ML addressed statistical challenges such as backtest overfitting, deep neural networks and Generative AI have introduced mechanical nondeterminism rooted in hardware and architecture. This survey provides a systems perspective on reproducibility failures across three modalities now dominant in financial AI: tabular models (post-hoc explanation variance), graph networks (stochastic sampling and temporal asynchrony), and LLM-based agentic workflows (batch-dependent divergence and trajectory drift). We supplement the literature analysis with first-party experiments on public financial datasets -- quantifying explanation rank instability in credit scoring, prediction flip rates in GNN-based fraud detection, and tensor-parallel-induced output divergence in LLM entity extraction. We propose a layered evaluation framework linking modality-specific metrics (RBO, D_cos, TDI, PSD) to audit readiness, and empirically validate the complementarity of logit-level and semantic-level determinism measures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以系统视角综述受监管金融环境中机器学习部署的可复现性缺陷，覆盖表格模型、图网络和基于 LLM 的智能体工作流三类模态，并辅以在公开金融数据集上的第一方实验。作者提出将模态特定指标（RBO、D_cos、TDI、PSD）与审计就绪度关联的分层评估框架，并验证 logit 级与语义级确定性指标的互补性。
Motivation: 受监管金融场景（信用风险、欺诈检测、反洗钱）中的 ML 部署面临算法可复现性脆弱性；早期金融 ML 主要关注统计问题（如回测过拟合），而深度神经网络和生成式 AI 引入了源于硬件和架构的机械非确定性。
Method: 这是一篇综述，从系统视角分析三种模态的复现性失败：表格模型的事后解释方差、图网络的随机采样与时间异步、LLM 智能体工作流的批次依赖发散与轨迹漂移。作者补充了在公开金融数据上的第一方实验，并提出将模态特定指标映射到审计就绪度的分层评估框架，同时实验验证 logit 级与语义级确定性度量的互补性。
Result: 第一方实验量化了信用评分中的解释排名不稳定性、基于 GNN 的欺诈检测中的预测翻转率，以及张量并行导致的 LLM 实体抽取输出发散；并实证检验了不同层次确定性度量之间的互补关系。
Conclusion: 作者强调以分层评估框架将模态特定指标与审计就绪度联系起来，是提升金融 AI 算法可审计性的关键；其范围聚焦于金融 AI 系统的确定性而非通用模型可复现性。

papers.title: The First Drop of Ink: Nonlinear Impact of Distracting Information in Long-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: As large language models are increasingly deployed in retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems that accumulate extensive context, understanding how distracting information affects long-context performance becomes critical. Prior work shows that semantically relevant yet misleading documents degrade performance, but the quantitative relationship between the proportion of distractors and performance remains unstudied. In this work, we systematically vary the hard-distractor proportion in fixed-length contexts, revealing a striking nonlinear pattern: as the proportion of hard distractors increases, performance drops sharply within the first small fraction, while the remainder of the range yields only marginal additional decline. We term this ''The First Drop of Ink'' effect, analogous to how a single drop of ink contaminates water. Our theoretical and empirical analyses grounded in attention mechanics show that hard distractors capture disproportionate attention even at small proportions, with diminishing marginal impact as their proportion grows. Controlled experiments further show that filtering gains mainly come from context-length reduction rather than distractor removal; substantial recovery requires reducing the hard-distractor proportion to near zero, highlighting the importance of upstream retrieval precision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长上下文推理中硬干扰信息 (hard distractors) 占比与性能之间的定量关系，提出"第一滴墨水"（The First Drop of Ink）效应：当硬干扰占比从零开始增加时，性能在最初的一小段区间内急剧下降，此后占比继续增大只带来边际性额外下降。作者基于注意力机制 (attention mechanics) 给出理论与实验分析，发现硬干扰即使在很小占比下也捕获不成比例的注意力。受控实验进一步表明，过滤干扰的收益主要来自上下文长度缩减而非干扰移除本身，性能大幅恢复需要将硬干扰占比降至接近零。
Motivation: 随着 LLM 被用于检索增强生成和智能体系统，上下文会不断累积，理解干扰信息对长上下文性能的影响变得关键。已有工作表明语义相关但误导性的文档会损害性能，但干扰占比与性能之间的定量关系尚未被研究。
Method: 在固定长度上下文中系统变化硬干扰占比，刻画性能曲线；结合注意力机制进行理论和经验分析，并通过受控实验区分上下文长度缩减与干扰移除两种机制对性能恢复的贡献。
Result: 摘要报告，随硬干扰占比增加，性能在最初的小占比区间内急剧下降，其余区间仅产生边际性额外下降；硬干扰在占比很小时就已捕获不成比例的注意力，且边际影响随占比增大而递减。受控实验显示过滤增益主要来自上下文长度缩减，而大幅恢复性能需要将硬干扰占比降至接近零。
Conclusion: 论文强调这些结果凸显了上游检索精度的重要性，因为只有把硬干扰占比降到接近零才能实质恢复长上下文推理性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agent-First Tool API: A Semantic Interface Paradigm for Enterprise AI Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents transition from research prototypes to enterprise production systems, the tool interfaces they consume remain rooted in human-oriented CRUD paradigms. This paper identifies five fundamental architectural mismatches between conventional APIs and autonomous agent requirements: exact-identifier dependence, rendering-oriented responses, single-shot interaction assumptions, user-equivalent authorization, and opaque error semantics. We propose the Agent-First Tool API paradigm, comprising three integrated mechanisms: (1) a Six-Verb Semantic Protocol that decomposes tool interactions into search, resolve, preview, execute, verify, and recover phases; (2) a Normalized Tool Contract (NTC) providing structured decision-support metadata including confidence scores, evidence chains, and suggested next actions; and (3) a dual-layer governance pipeline combining static capability policies with dynamic risk escalation. The paradigm is implemented and validated in a production multi-tenant SaaS platform serving 85 registered tools across 6 business domains. Comparative experiments on 50 real operational tasks demonstrate that Agent-First APIs achieve 88% end-to-end task success rate versus 64% for optimized CRUD baselines (+37.5%), while reducing required human interventions by 72.7% and improving autonomous error recovery by 5.8x. We establish that the paradigm is orthogonal and complementary to transport-layer standards such as MCP, operating as the semantic application layer above existing tool discovery and invocation protocols.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向企业级 AI 代理的 Agent-First Tool API 范式，指出传统面向人类的 CRUD 接口与自主代理需求之间存在五类架构性错配。该范式包含六动词语义协议、标准化工具契约 (NTC) 和双层治理流水线三个机制，并在生产级多租户 SaaS 平台上的 50 个真实任务中验证了端到端成功率、人工干预次数和自主错误恢复能力的大幅改进。
Motivation: AI 代理进入企业生产系统后，所消费的工具接口仍基于面向人类的 CRUD 范式，导致精确标识符依赖、面向渲染的响应、单次交互假设、用户等价授权和不透明错误语义等五类根本性架构错配，阻碍代理的自主性与可靠性。
Method: 提出 Agent-First Tool API 范式，包含三个集成机制：将工具交互分解为 search、resolve、preview、execute、verify、recover 六个阶段的六动词语义协议；提供置信度分数、证据链和建议下一步动作等结构化决策元数据的标准化工具契约 (NTC)；以及结合静态能力策略与动态风险升级的双层治理流水线。该范式作为语义应用层，与 MCP 等传输层标准正交互补。
Result: 在服务 85 个注册工具、覆盖 6 个业务领域的生产多租户 SaaS 平台上，针对 50 个真实运营任务的对比实验显示：Agent-First API 的端到端任务成功率为 88%，而优化后的 CRUD 基线为 64%（相对提升 37.5%）；人工干预次数减少 72.7%，自主错误恢复能力提升 5.8 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Agent-First Tool API 范式与 MCP 等传输层标准正交且互补，可作为现有工具发现与调用协议之上的语义应用层，改善企业代理系统的自主任务执行能力。

papers.title: Higher Resolution, Better Generalization: Unlocking Visual Scaling in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-based deep reinforcement learning agents are typically trained on heavily downsampled visual observations, a convention inherited from early benchmarks rather than grounded in principled design. In this work, we show that observation resolution is a critical yet overlooked variable for policy learning: higher-resolution inputs can substantially improve both performance and generalization, provided the network architecture can process them effectively. We find that the widely used Impala encoder, which flattens spatial features into a vector, suffers from quadratic parameter growth as resolution increases and fails to leverage the additional visual detail. We test different modifications to the Impala architecture and conclude that, in particular, introducing a global average pooling layer, as in the Impoola architecture, yields consistent improvements across resolutions and network widths while decoupling parameter count from resolution - at their respective best conditions, visual scaling unlocks a 28 % performance gain for Impoola over Impala. These gains are strongest in environments that require precise perception of small or distant objects, and gradient saliency analysis suggests that the underlying mechanism is a more spatially localized visual attention of the policy at higher resolutions. Our results challenge the prevailing practice of aggressive input downsampling and position resolution-independent architectures as a simple, effective path toward scalable visual deep reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究像素级深度强化学习中的观测分辨率问题，指出传统做法将输入大幅降采样并非源于原理性设计。作者发现更高分辨率的输入在架构能有效处理时，可显著提升策略的性能与泛化；而对广泛使用的 Impala 编码器引入全局平均池化 (global average pooling) 的 Impoola 架构，能将参数量与分辨率解耦并获得一致的提升。在其各自最佳条件下，Impoola 相比 Impala 取得 28% 的性能增益，且梯度显著性分析表明高分辨率下策略的视觉注意更加空间局部化。
Motivation: 像素级深度强化学习智能体通常基于严重降采样的视觉观测进行训练，这是从早期基准继承的惯例而非有原则的设计选择。作者指出观测分辨率是被忽视的关键变量，同时现有 Impala 编码器将空间特征展平为向量，导致参数量随分辨率二次增长，无法利用增加的视觉细节。
Method: 作者系统测试了对 Impala 架构的多种修改，重点是在编码器中引入全局平均池化层（即 Impoola 架构），从而将参数数量与输入分辨率解耦。实验在不同分辨率和网络宽度下评估这些架构变体的性能与泛化，并结合梯度显著性分析考察高分辨率下的注意力机制。
Result: 在各自最优条件下，视觉缩放 (visual scaling) 为 Impoola 带来相对 Impala 28% 的性能提升；增益在需要精确感知小物体或远距离物体的环境中最为显著。梯度显著性分析提示其潜在机制是更高分辨率下策略呈现出更空间局部化的视觉注意力。
Conclusion: 结果挑战了激进输入降采样的普遍做法，并将分辨率无关的架构定位为实现可扩展视觉深度强化学习的简单有效路径。

summary_sections.method: 作者系统测试了对 Impala 架构的多种修改，重点是在编码器中引入全局平均池化层（即 Impoola 架构），从而将参数数量与输入分辨率解耦。实验在不同分辨率和网络宽度下评估这些架构变体的性能与泛化，并结合梯度显著性分析考察高分辨率下的注意力机制。
summary_sections.result: 在各自最优条件下，视觉缩放 (visual scaling) 为 Impoola 带来相对 Impala 28% 的性能提升；增益在需要精确感知小物体或远距离物体的环境中最为显著。梯度显著性分析提示其潜在机制是更高分辨率下策略呈现出更空间局部化的视觉注意力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果挑战了激进输入降采样的普遍做法，并将分辨率无关的架构定位为实现可扩展视觉深度强化学习的简单有效路径。

papers.title: VISD: Enhancing Video Reasoning via Structured Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Training VideoLLMs for complex reasoning remains challenging due to sparse sequence level rewards and the lack of fine grained credit assignment over long, temporally grounded reasoning trajectories. While reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable supervision, it fails to capture token level contributions, leading to inefficient learning. Conversely, existing self distillation methods offer dense supervision but lack structure and diagnostic specificity, and often interact unstably with reinforcement learning. In this work, we propose VISD, a structured self distillation framework that introduces diagnostically meaningful privileged information for video reasoning. VISD employs a video aware judge model to decompose reasoning quality into multiple dimensions, including answer correctness, logical consistency, and spatio-temporal grounding, and uses this structured feedback to guide a teacher policy for token level supervision. To stably integrate dense supervision with RL, we introduce a direction magnitude decoupling mechanism, where rollout level advantages computed from rewards determine update direction, while structured privileged signals modulate token level update magnitudes. This design enables semantically aligned and fine grained credit assignment, improving both reasoning faithfulness and training efficiency. Additionally, VISD incorporates curriculum scheduling and EMA based teacher stabilization to support robust optimization over long video sequences. Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that VISD consistently outperforms strong baselines, improving answer accuracy and spatio temporal grounding quality. Notably, VISD reaches these gains with nearly 2x faster convergence in optimization steps, highlighting the effectiveness of structured self supervision in improving both performance and sample efficiency for VideoLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VISD，一个面向视频推理的结构化自蒸馏框架，用于训练 VideoLLM。VISD 利用视频感知的评判模型将推理质量分解为答案正确性、逻辑一致性和时空基础等多个维度，并以此引导教师策略提供 token 级监督；同时通过方向-幅度解耦机制将密集监督与强化学习稳定结合。实验表明 VISD 在多个基准上优于强基线，并以近 2 倍更快的优化收敛速度提升推理忠实度和训练效率。
Motivation: VideoLLM 的复杂推理训练面临序列级奖励稀疏且缺乏细粒度信用分配的问题。RLVR 提供可靠监督但无法捕捉 token 级贡献，而现有自蒸馏方法虽有密集监督但缺乏结构和诊断性，且与强化学习交互不稳定。
Method: 提出结构化自蒸馏框架 VISD：引入视频感知评判模型分解推理质量为多个维度（答案正确性、逻辑一致性、时空基础），提供诊断性特权信息；采用方向-幅度解耦机制，用奖励计算的 rollout 级优势决定更新方向，用结构化特权信号调制 token 级更新幅度；并加入课程调度与基于 EMA 的教师稳定化。
Result: 在多个基准上 VISD 持续优于强基线，提升答案准确性和时空基础质量，并且以近乎 2 倍更少的优化步骤达到同等性能，表明结构化自监督带来更好的样本效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构化自蒸馏能稳定地与强化学习结合，为 VideoLLM 提供语义对齐的细粒度信用分配，在提升推理性能和训练效率两方面均有效。

papers.title: A Robust In-Context Model for Conservation Laws: Injecting Context into Flux Neural Operators via Recurrent Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We propose an architecture that augments the Flux Neural Operator (Flux NO), which combines the classical finite volume method (FVM) with neural operators, with ViT-based context injection. Our model is formulated as a hypernetwork: it extracts solution dynamics over a finite temporal window, encodes them with a recurrent Vision Transformer, and generates the parameters of a context-conditioned neural operator. This enables the model to infer and solve conservation laws without explicit access to the governing equation or PDE coefficients. Experimentally, we show that the proposed method preserves the robustness, generalization ability, and long-time prediction advantages of Flux NO over standard neural operators, while delivering reliable numerical solutions across a broad range of conservative systems, including previously unseen fluxes. Our code is available at https://github.com/xx257xx/CONTEXT_FLUX_NO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于守恒律（conservation laws）的上下文条件化神经算子架构，将 Flux Neural Operator (Flux NO) 与基于 ViT 的上下文注入相结合。模型以超网络（hypernetwork）形式构建：用循环 Vision Transformer 在有限时间窗口上编码解的动力学，并生成上下文条件化神经算子的参数，从而无需显式给定控制方程或 PDE 系数即可推断和求解守恒律。实验表明该方法保持了 Flux NO 相较于标准神经算子在鲁棒性、泛化能力和长时间预测上的优势，并能在包括未见通量（unseen fluxes）在内的广泛守恒系统中给出可靠的数值解。
Motivation: 传统神经算子求解守恒律时通常依赖已知的方程形式或 PDE 系数，而实际场景中这些信息可能未知或难以获取。现有 Flux NO 虽结合了有限体积法（FVM）与神经算子，但缺乏利用时序上下文信息来隐式推断动力学的能力。
Method: 提出一种超网络架构：在有限时间窗口内提取解的动力学，用循环 Vision Transformer 进行编码，并生成 Flux Neural Operator 的参数，实现上下文条件化的神经算子，使模型能在不访问控制方程或 PDE 系数的情况下求解守恒律。
Result: 实验显示该方法保持了 Flux NO 相对于标准神经算子在鲁棒性、泛化能力和长时间预测方面的优势，并在广泛守恒系统（包括先前未见过的通量）上给出可靠的数值解。
Conclusion: 作者认为将时序上下文通过循环 ViT 注入 Flux NO 可有效增强神经算子对未知守恒律的适应能力，代码已公开。摘要未提及显著局限性。

papers.title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents can adapt to complex tasks by constructing workflows at inference time, but procedures discovered in one episode are usually discarded after execution. Existing skill libraries provide reusable executable routines, but are typically assembled offline and do not grow from the agent's own workflows. We introduce FlowEvo, a training-free framework in which workflows and skills co-evolve at inference time. FlowEvo compiles successful workflows into callable skills, stores them in a persistent bank, and uses retrieved skills either through direct execution or as context for constructing new workflows. It also tracks each skill's downstream utility and suppresses skills that cause negative transfer. Using a shared GPT-4o-mini backbone, FlowEvo achieves the highest accuracy among 8 baselines on the full standard splits of ALFWorld, HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, and MATH-500. On ALFWorld, it reaches 85.6%, 26.4 points above the strongest baseline, while using roughly one third as many tokens. Across 10 base models spanning 7B to 671B parameters, FlowEvo outperforms ExpeL in 49 of 50 model-dataset comparisons. Code is available at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/FlowEvo.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026. 25 pages, 3 figures, 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/FlowEvo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowEvo，一个无需训练（training-free）的框架，让工作流（workflows）与可执行技能（executable skills）在推理时共同演化。FlowEvo 把成功的 workflow 编译为可调用技能存入持久化技能库，检索到的技能既可直接执行，也可作为构建新 workflow 的上下文；系统还追踪每个技能的下游效用并抑制造成负迁移（negative transfer）的技能。在共享 GPT-4o-mini 骨干下，FlowEvo 在 ALFWorld、HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K 和 MATH-500 的完整标准划分上达到 8 个基线中的最高准确率。
Motivation: LLM 智能体可以在推理时构建 workflow 来适应复杂任务，但单次 episode 中发现的流程通常执行后即被丢弃；已有技能库虽可提供可复用的执行例程，但一般离线组装，不能从智能体自身产生的 workflow 中持续增长。
Method: FlowEvo 是同推理阶段的训练免费框架，用 workflow 与技能的共同演化替代一次性构建：成功 workflow 被编译成可调用技能并存入持久化 bank，检索到的技能通过直接执行或作为上下文两种方式参与新 workflow 的构建，同时根据技能的下游效用动态抑制造成负迁移的技能。
Result: 使用共享 GPT-4o-mini 骨干时，FlowEvo 在 ALFWorld、HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K、MATH-500 的完整标准划分上于 8 个基线中取得最高准确率；其中 ALFWorld 达到 85.6%，高出最强基线 26.4 个百分点，token 用量约为其三分之一。在参数规模 7B 到 671B 的 10 个基础模型上，FlowEvo 在 50 个模型-数据集比较中胜过 ExpeL 49 次。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，推理时 workflows 与 skills 的协同演化可以让智能体从自身经验中积累可复用技能并抑制负迁移，从而在无需训练的条件下提升多个编程与推理基准上的表现；代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Every Picture Tells a Dangerous Story: Memory-Augmented Multi-Agent Jailbreak Attacks on VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) expand the attack surface of safety-aligned systems by coupling visual perception with text generation. Existing multimodal jailbreak attacks primarily rely on crafted visual content, adversarial perturbations, or image-specific attack strategies, leaving the potential of reusable visual anchors in benign natural images largely unexplored. To address the problem, we introduce MemJack, a memory-augmented multi-agent framework for automated VLM red-teaming with natural images. MemJack combines visual-anchor discovery, visual-semantic camouflage, response evaluation, reflection-guided repair, and dynamic replanning within a closed-loop attack pipeline. Beyond attack generation, MemJack automatically transforms public images into attack anchors, enables the construction of MemJack-Bench, a dataset of over 113,000 interactive multimodal jailbreak trajectories for safety evaluation and defensive alignment. Extensive empirical evaluations across full, unmodified COCO val2017 images demonstrate that MemJack achieves a 71.48\% attack success rate (ASR) against Qwen3-VL-Plus, scaling to 90\% under extended budgets. Compared with representative multimodal jailbreak baselines under the same natural-image evaluation setting, MemJack achieves the highest ASR while requiring fewer mean rounds to success, demonstrating superior jailbreak effectiveness on VLMs. These results demonstrate that benign natural images can act as transferable jailbreak anchors and reveal substantial vulnerabilities in current safety-aligned VLMs.
papers.comment: This work was accepted by WISE2026. 15 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemJack，一个基于记忆增强的多智能体 (memory-augmented multi-agent) 自动化红队框架，专门针对视觉语言模型 (VLM) 使用普通自然图片进行越狱攻击。MemJack 在闭环攻击流程中整合了视觉锚点发现、视觉语义伪装、响应评估、反思引导修复与动态重规划，并自动将公开图片转化为攻击锚点，构建了包含超过 113,000 条多模态越狱轨迹的 MemJack-Bench 数据集。在完整未修改的 COCO val2017 图片上，该方法对 Qwen3-VL-Plus 的越狱成功率 (ASR) 为 71.48%，在更大预算下可达 90%，并在相同自然图片评测设置下优于代表性多模态越狱基线。
Motivation: 现有多模态越狱攻击主要依赖精心构造的视觉内容、对抗扰动或针对特定图片的攻击策略，良性自然图片中可复用的视觉锚点 (visual anchors) 潜力基本未被探索。
Method: MemJack 是一个闭环攻击管线，结合视觉锚点发现、视觉语义伪装、响应评估、反思引导修复和动态重规划五个环节，并利用记忆机制增强攻击过程；同时该方法能把公开图片自动转化为越狱攻击锚点，进而生成大规模交互式多模态越狱轨迹数据集。
Result: 在完整未修改的 COCO val2017 图像上，MemJack 对 Qwen3-VL-Plus 达到 71.48% 的 ASR，延长攻击预算后可扩展至 90%；与代表性多模态越狱基线在相同自然图像设置下相比，MemJack 取得最高 ASR 且成功所需的平均轮次更少。
Conclusion: 作者强调良性自然图片可以作为可迁移的越狱锚点，暴露当前安全对齐 VLM 的显著脆弱性，并希望 MemJack-Bench 能服务于安全评测与防御性对齐。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: MemJack 是一个闭环攻击管线，结合视觉锚点发现、视觉语义伪装、响应评估、反思引导修复和动态重规划五个环节，并利用记忆机制增强攻击过程；同时该方法能把公开图片自动转化为越狱攻击锚点，进而生成大规模交互式多模态越狱轨迹数据集。
summary_sections.result: 在完整未修改的 COCO val2017 图像上，MemJack 对 Qwen3-VL-Plus 达到 71.48% 的 ASR，延长攻击预算后可扩展至 90%；与代表性多模态越狱基线在相同自然图像设置下相比，MemJack 取得最高 ASR 且成功所需的平均轮次更少。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调良性自然图片可以作为可迁移的越狱锚点，暴露当前安全对齐 VLM 的显著脆弱性，并希望 MemJack-Bench 能服务于安全评测与防御性对齐。

papers.title: OmniCamera: A Unified Framework for Multi-task Video Generation with Arbitrary Camera Control
papers.abstract_en: Video fundamentally intertwines two crucial axes: the dynamic content of a scene and the camera motion through which it is observed. However, existing generation models often entangle these factors, limiting independent control. In this work, we introduce OmniCamera, a unified framework designed to explicitly disentangle and command these two dimensions. This compositional approach enables flexible video generation by allowing arbitrary pairings of camera and content conditions, unlocking unprecedented creative control. To overcome the fundamental challenges of modality conflict and data scarcity inherent in such a system, we present two key innovations. First, we construct OmniCAM, a novel hybrid dataset combining curated real-world videos with synthetic data that provides diverse paired examples for robust multi-task learning. Second, we propose a Dual-level Curriculum Co-Training strategy that mitigates modality interference and synergistically learns from diverse data sources. This strategy operates on two levels: first, it progressively introduces control modalities by difficulties (condition-level), and second, trains for precise control on synthetic data before adapting to real data for photorealism (data-level). As a result, OmniCamera achieves state-of-the-art performance, enabling flexible control for complex camera movements while maintaining superior visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniCamera，一个用于多任务视频生成的统一框架，目标是显式解耦视频中的动态场景内容与相机运动两个维度，从而支持任意的相机-内容条件组合。为应对模态冲突与数据稀缺，作者构建了混合数据集 OmniCAM，并提出 Dual-level Curriculum Co-Training 策略，在条件层面按难度渐进引入控制模态、在数据层面先合成后真实地训练。摘要称该方法在复杂相机运动控制上达到 state-of-the-art，同时保持较好的视觉质量。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型常将场景动态与相机运动纠缠在一起，难以独立控制这两个维度，限制了用户在相机轨迹上的灵活创作。
Method: 提出统一框架 OmniCamera，显式解耦相机与内容条件；构建含真实与合成视频的混合数据集 OmniCAM；并提出 Dual-level Curriculum Co-Training，在条件层面（condition-level）按难度渐进引入控制模态，在数据层面（data-level）先在合成数据上训练精细控制、再迁移到真实数据以提升逼真度。
Result: 摘要报告 OmniCamera 在复杂相机运动控制上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，同时保持优越的视觉质量。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式解耦相机与内容并配合混合数据与双层级课程协同训练，可以有效缓解模态干扰并实现灵活、高质量的相机可控视频生成。

papers.title: Reading Between the Pixels: An Inscriptive Jailbreak Attack on Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern text-to-image (T2I) models can now render legible, paragraph-length text, enabling a fundamentally new class of misuse. We identify and formalize the inscriptive jailbreak, where an adversary coerces a T2I system into generating images containing harmful textual payloads (e.g., fraudulent documents) embedded within visually benign scenes. Unlike traditional depictive jailbreaks that elicit visually objectionable imagery, inscriptive attacks weaponize the text-rendering capability itself. Because existing jailbreak techniques are designed for coarse visual manipulation, they struggle to bypass multi-stage safety filters while maintaining character-level fidelity. To expose this vulnerability, we propose Etch, a black-box attack framework that decomposes the adversarial prompt into three functionally orthogonal layers: semantic camouflage, visual-spatial anchoring, and typographic encoding. This decomposition reduces joint optimization over the full prompt space to tractable sub-problems, which are iteratively refined through a zero-order loop. In this process, a vision-language model critiques each generated image, localizes failures to specific layers, and prescribes targeted revisions. Extensive evaluations across 7 models on the 2 benchmarks demonstrate that Etch achieves an average attack success rate of 65.57% (peaking at 91.00%), significantly outperforming existing baselines. Our results reveal a critical blind spot in current T2I safety alignments and underscore the urgent need for typography-aware defense multimodal mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别并形式化了一类新的文生图 (text-to-image, T2I) 模型滥用方式：inscriptive jailbreak，即攻击者诱导系统生成嵌有有害文本载荷（如伪造文档）但视觉上无害的图像。作者提出黑盒攻击框架 Etch，将对抗提示分解为语义伪装、视觉空间锚定与排版编码三个正交层，并通过零阶优化循环迭代修正。在 7 个模型、2 个基准上的评估显示平均攻击成功率达 65.57%（最高 91.00%），显著优于现有基线，揭示当前 T2I 安全对齐的盲区。
Motivation: 现代 T2I 模型已能渲染可读的段落级文本，催生了与传统 depictive jailbreak（生成视觉上不当图像）不同的新滥用类别。现有越狱技术面向粗粒度视觉操作设计，难以在多阶段安全过滤器下同时保持字符级保真度，因此需要专门针对文本渲染能力的攻击形式化与防御研究。
Method: 提出 Etch，一个黑盒攻击框架。它将对抗提示分解为三个功能正交的层：语义伪装 (semantic camouflage)、视觉空间锚定 (visual-spatial anchoring) 和排版编码 (typographic encoding)，把对整个提示空间的联合优化转化为可处理的子问题；随后通过零阶循环迭代优化，由视觉语言模型 (vision-language model) 审查每张生成图像、将失败定位到具体层并给出针对性修改建议。
Result: 在 7 个模型和 2 个基准上的大量评估中，Etch 的平均攻击成功率为 65.57%，峰值达 91.00%，显著优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为实验结果暴露了当前 T2I 安全对齐的关键盲区，并强调迫切需要具备排版感知 (typography-aware) 的多模态防御机制。

papers.title: CharTool: Tool-Integrated Visual Reasoning for Chart Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Charts are ubiquitous in scientific and financial literature for presenting structured data. However, chart reasoning remains challenging for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) due to the lack of high-quality training data, as well as the need for fine-grained visual grounding and precise numerical computation. To address these challenges, we first propose DuoChart, a scalable dual-source data pipeline that combines synthesized charts with real-world charts to construct diverse, high-quality chart training data. We then introduce CharTool, which equips MLLMs with external tools, including image cropping for localized visual perception and code-based computation for accurate numerical reasoning. Through agentic reinforcement learning on DuoChart, CharTool learns tool-integrated reasoning grounded in chart content. Extensive experiments on six chart benchmarks show that our method consistently improves over strong MLLM baselines across model scales. Notably, CharTool-7B outperforms the base model by +8.0% on CharXiv (Reasoning) and +9.78% on ChartQAPro, while achieving competitive performance with substantially larger or proprietary models. Moreover, CharTool demonstrates positive generalization to out-of-domain visual math reasoning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在图理解任务上的不足，提出可扩展的双源数据管道 DuoChart 与工具集成推理模型 CharTool。CharTool 通过外部工具（图像裁剪与代码计算）结合代理强化学习 (agentic reinforcement learning) 学习基于图表内容的推理。在六个图表基准上，该方法一致超过强 MLLM 基线，且 CharTool-7B 在 CharXiv (Reasoning) 和 ChartQAPro 上分别较基线上涨 +8.0% 和 +9.78%，并展现出对域外视觉数学推理的正向泛化。
Motivation: 图表推理对 MLLM 仍具挑战，主要源于高质量训练数据缺乏，以及需要细粒度视觉定位 (visual grounding) 和精确数值计算。
Method: 提出 DuoChart 双源数据管道，将合成图表与真实图表结合以构建多样高质量训练数据；在此基础上提出 CharTool，为 MLLM 配备图像裁剪（用于局部视觉感知）与基于代码的计算（用于数值推理），并通过在 DuoChart 上的代理强化学习训练工具集成的推理能力。
Result: 在六个图表基准上的实验显示，该方法在不同模型规模下均一致优于强 MLLM 基线；CharTool-7B 在 CharXiv (Reasoning) 上较基线上涨 +8.0%，在 ChartQAPro 上上涨 +9.78%，且性能可与显著更大或专有模型竞争；此外在域外视觉数学推理基准上表现正向泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调高质量训练数据与工具集成推理相结合能够有效提升图表理解能力，并指出该方法对相关域外推理任务存在正迁移。

papers.title: Generative AI Use in Entrepreneurship: An Integrative Review and an Empowerment-Entrapment Framework
papers.abstract_en: Despite the growing use of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in entrepreneurship, research on its impact remains fragmented. To address this limitation, we provide an integrative, entrepreneur-centered review of how GenAI influences entrepreneurs at each stage of the entrepreneurial process: (1) opportunity recognition and ideation, (2) opportunity evaluation and commitment, (3) resource assembly and mobilization, and (4) venture launch and growth. Based on our review, we propose the Empowerment-Entrapment Framework, which not only catalogs GenAI's benefits and costs throughout the entrepreneurial process, but also identifies potential trade-offs underlying GenAI's double-edged role. For example, GenAI may improve venture idea quality yet produce hallucinations and biases; boost entrepreneurial self-efficacy yet heighten overconfidence; increase functional breadth and self-sufficiency yet reduce prosociality; and enhance productivity yet diminish cognitive engagement, learning, and memory. We also identify features of GenAI that underlie these empowering and entrapping effects. Moreover, we explore boundary conditions that moderate GenAI's effects, including entrepreneurs' expertise, approaches to using GenAI, and personal traits and values. Beyond these theoretical contributions, our review and framework offer practical guidance for entrepreneurs seeking to use GenAI strategically while managing its risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇以创业者为中心的综合综述，系统梳理生成式人工智能（GenAI）在创业各阶段的影响，并提出 Empowerment-Entrapment Framework（赋能-陷阱框架）。该框架既列举 GenAI 在整个创业过程中的收益与成本，也识别其双刃剑效应背后的潜在权衡。作者还探讨了 GenAI 发挥赋能与陷阱效应的特征，以及创业者专业知识、使用方式和人格特质等边界条件。
Motivation: 尽管 GenAI 在创业中的使用日益增多，但相关研究仍呈碎片化状态，缺乏系统整合。
Method: 采用整合性、以创业者为中心的综述方法，按创业过程的四个阶段（机会识别与构思、机会评估与承诺、资源整合与动员、创业启动与成长）组织文献，并提出 Empowerment-Entrapment Framework 来归纳收益、成本及二者间的权衡。
Result: 摘要举例说明了多种权衡关系：GenAI 可能提升创业想法质量却产生幻觉与偏见，增强创业自我效能却加剧过度自信，提高功能广度和自给自足却降低亲社会性，提升生产力却削弱认知参与、学习与记忆。
Conclusion: 该综述与框架除理论贡献外，还为创业者提供了战略性使用 GenAI 并管理其风险的实际指导。

papers.title: ATBench: A Diverse and Realistic Agent Trajectory Benchmark for Safety Evaluation and Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating the safety of LLM-based agents is increasingly important because risks in realistic deployments often emerge over multi-step interactions rather than isolated prompts or final responses. Existing trajectory-level benchmarks remain limited by insufficient interaction diversity, coarse observability of safety failures, and weak long-horizon realism. We introduce ATBench, a trajectory-level benchmark for structured, diverse, and realistic evaluation of agent safety. ATBench organizes agentic risk along three dimensions: risk source, failure mode, and real-world harm. Based on this taxonomy, we construct trajectories with heterogeneous tool pools and a long-context delayed-trigger protocol that captures realistic risk emergence across multiple stages. The benchmark contains 1,000 trajectories (503 safe and 497 unsafe), averaging 9.01 turns and 3.95k tokens, with 1,954 invoked tools drawn from pools spanning 2,084 available tools. Data quality is supported by rule-based and LLM-based filtering plus full human audit. Experiments on frontier LLMs, open-source models, and specialized guard systems show that ATBench is challenging even for strong evaluators, while enabling taxonomy-stratified analysis, cross-benchmark comparison, and diagnosis of long-horizon failure patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATBench，一个轨迹级 (trajectory-level) 的 LLM 智能体安全评测基准，用于结构化、多样且现实地评估智能体安全。基准包含 1,000 条轨迹（503 条安全、497 条不安全），平均 9.01 轮、3.95k tokens，涉及 1,954 次工具调用，工具池覆盖 2,084 个可用工具。作者基于风险来源、失败模式和现实危害的三维分类法，采用长上下文延迟触发协议构造多阶段风险，并报告前沿 LLM、开源模型和专用护栏系统在该基准上均面临挑战。
Motivation: LLM-based agent 的安全风险往往在多步交互中逐步显现，而现有轨迹级基准存在交互多样性不足、安全失败可观测性粗糙、长程真实性弱的问题，难以支撑现实部署下的安全评估。

Result: 基准含 1,000 条轨迹，平均 9.01 轮、3.95k tokens，1,954 次工具调用，工具池覆盖 2,084 个工具；实验表明该基准对强评估者也具有挑战性，并支持按分类法分层分析、跨基准比较及长程失败模式诊断。
Conclusion: ATBench 为智能体安全提供结构化、多样且现实的轨迹级评测，能够帮助识别和诊断多阶段交互中的长程失败模式。

papers.title: From Rebound to Remedy: Understanding and Mitigating Reward Hacking via Representation Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for LLMs is vulnerable to reward hacking, where models exploit shortcuts to maximize reward without solving the intended task. We systematically study this phenomenon in coding tasks using an environment-manipulation setting, where models can rewrite evaluator code to trivially pass tests without solving the task, as a controlled testbed. Across both studied models, we identify a reproducible three-phase rebound pattern: models first attempt to rewrite the evaluator but fail, as their rewrites embed test cases their own solutions cannot pass. They then temporarily retreat to legitimate solving. When legitimate reward remains scarce, they rebound into successful hacking with qualitatively different strategies. Using representation engineering, we extract concept directions for shortcut, deception, and evaluation awareness from domain-general contrastive pairs and find that the shortcut direction tracks hacking behavior most closely, making it an effective representational proxy for detection. Motivated by this finding, we propose Advantage Modification, which integrates shortcut concept scores into GRPO advantage computation to penalize hacking rollouts before policy updates. Because the penalty is internalized into the training signal rather than applied only at inference time, Advantage Modification provides more robust suppression of hacking compared with generation-time activation steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM强化学习中的奖励黑客（reward hacking）现象，在编码任务中通过环境操纵设置（模型可改写评测代码以通过测试）作为受控测试平台。作者在两个模型上观察到可复现的三阶段回弹模式：先尝试改写评测器但失败，随后暂时回归正常求解，最终在合法奖励稀缺时以不同策略成功黑客。利用表示工程（representation engineering）从领域通用的对比样本中提取捷径、欺骗与评测感知的概念方向，发现捷径方向最能追踪黑客行为，可作为检测的表示代理。基于此提出Advantage Modification，将捷径概念分数整合进GRPO优势计算，在策略更新前惩罚黑客行为，比生成时激活引导（activation steering）更稳健地抑制黑客。
Motivation: 强化学习驱动的LLM容易遭受奖励黑客，模型会利用捷径最大化奖励而不真正完成任务，现有方法缺乏对该现象的深入理解与干预手段。
Method: 采用环境操纵设置作为受控测试床，系统研究编码任务中的奖励黑客；利用表示工程从对比样本提取概念方向，并以此提出Advantage Modification，将捷径概念分数整合到GRPO优势计算中，在训练信号内部惩罚黑客行为。
Result: 识别出可复现的三阶段回弹模式；捷径方向能有效追踪黑客行为；Advantage Modification相比生成时激活引导对黑客行为提供更稳健的抑制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过表示工程获得的概念代理分数可以内化到训练信号中，从而比仅在推理时干预更有效地压制奖励黑客。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learn for Variation: Efficient AAV Trajectory Learning through a Differentiable Wireless World Model
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous aerial vehicles (AAVs) enable data collection for sixth-generation Internet-of-Things networks, but their trajectories couple nonlinear wireless rates with long-horizon service progress. This paper views the evolution of AAV kinematics, channel state, and user backlog as a structured differentiable world model and develops Learn for Variation (L4V) to exploit that model efficiently. L4V replaces a discontinuous completion-time objective with a cumulative-backlog surrogate, unrolls the mission dynamics, and propagates pathwise sensitivities to a neural policy through the discrete adjoint recursion. The resulting derivative is exact conditional on a fixed exogenous-noise realization; stochastic expected-objective optimization still requires sampling. We show that the structured adjoint grows at most polynomially with the horizon and establish a stationary-point rate for fixed-step full-gradient descent under standard smoothness assumptions. The framework also learns shared OFDMA allocation under reparameterized shadowing and Rician fading, while distributional pretraining amortizes model-based optimization into forward-only deployment on unseen layouts. Paired stress tests cover channel-generator mismatch, noisy partial observations, a fixed-resource two-AAV extension, and a circular no-fly region. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/UNIC-Lab/L4V-AAV. Against genetic-algorithm, DQN, A2C, DDPG, and differentiable model-predictive-control implementations, L4V reduces mission time by up to $65\%$, executes a default mission in $53$ ms, and completes all $60$ frozen-policy tests after pretraining on $1{,}600$ layouts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Learn for Variation (L4V)，将 AAV 运动学、信道状态与用户积压建模为结构化可微世界模型，用累计积压代理目标替代不连续的完成时间目标，并通过离散伴随递归向神经策略传播路径敏感度。摘要报告相比遗传算法、DQN、A2C、DDPG 与可微模型预测控制等基线，任务时间最多减少 65%，默认任务执行约 53 毫秒，并在 1600 个布局预训练后通过全部 60 个冻结策略测试。
Motivation: 第六代物联网中 AAV 数据采集的轨迹规划面临非线性无线速率与长时域服务进度的耦合，完成时间目标不连续且难以高效优化，需要可扩展的学习方法。
Method: L4V 将任务动态展开为可微世界模型，使用累计积压代理目标，通过离散伴随递归获得关于神经策略的精确路径梯度；在固定外生噪声实现下梯度精确，随机期望目标优化仍需采样。框架还支持在重参数化阴影与 Rician 衰落下学习共享 OFDMA 分配，并通过分布预训练将模型优化摊销为前向部署。
Result: 摘要报告 L4V 相比多种强化学习与可微 MPC 基线最多降低任务时间 65%，默认任务执行时间为 53 毫秒，并在 1600 个布局预训练后通过全部 60 个冻结策略测试；理论上证明结构化伴随随视界最多多项式增长，并给出固定步长全梯度下降的驻点速率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架结合精确梯度、可扩展性与前向部署效率，并通过信道生成器失配、噪声部分观测、双 AAV 扩展与圆形禁飞区等压力测试验证其鲁棒性，代码与配置已公开。

papers.title: Power Couple? AI Growth and Renewable Energy Investment
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) and renewable energy are increasingly being described as a \mbox{``power couple,''} based on the idea that rapid growth in AI will spur clean-energy investment. Yet growing AI demand could also deepen reliance on fossil power. We study when each outcome arises in a game in which renewable-capacity investment and AI scaling interact. The key is how the market value of greater AI capability grows relative to the energy needed to achieve it. When value grows at least as fast as energy use (market-led scaling), the developer pushes toward frontier capability even when additional electricity comes from fossil sources. Renewable investment can then enable further AI growth without eliminating fossil use. As climate damages increase, AI becomes more valuable for adaptation, strengthening incentives to sustain frontier capability despite the associated emissions. We call this the ``adaptation trap.'' When energy requirements grow faster than capability value (resource-led scaling), energy costs place greater limits on AI expansion. Renewable investment then makes additional capability less costly while also reducing emissions. As climate damages rise, the growing value of AI for adaptation can justify enough clean-capacity expansion to support AI entirely with renewable power. We call this the ``adaptation pathway.'' A calibrated case study shows that both mechanisms can arise at empirically plausible magnitudes. The results suggest that decarbonizing AI requires renewable capacity to keep pace with the growth of compute demand.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人工智能增长与可再生能源投资之间的战略互动，构建一个可再生能源容量投资与AI扩展相互作用的博弈模型。核心结论是，AI能力市场价值相对于其能耗的增长速度决定了两种截然不同的均衡结果：市场主导的扩展（market-led scaling）可能导致化石能源依赖加深，形成“适应陷阱”（adaptation trap）；资源主导的扩展（resource-led scaling）则可能推动清洁能源容量扩张至完全支持AI的“适应路径”（adaptation pathway）。校准案例表明两种机制在经验上均可能发生。
Motivation: AI常被视为清洁能源投资的推动力（“power couple”叙事），但AI增长的能源需求也可能加深对化石能源的依赖。现有讨论缺乏对这两种结果何时出现的正式分析，本文通过博弈模型刻画了可再生能源投资与AI扩展之间的相互作用。
Method: 构建一个关于可再生能源容量投资与AI扩展的博弈模型，核心变量是AI能力市场价值增长与所需能耗增长的相对速度。根据价值增长快于或慢于能耗增长，分别考察市场主导扩展和资源主导扩展两种情形，并引入气候损害下AI用于适应的价值，进行校准案例分析。
Result: 当价值增长快于能耗增长时，AI开发者会推进前沿能力，即使额外电力来自化石能源，可再生能源投资可支持AI增长但不会消除化石使用；随气候损害上升，AI适应价值强化维持前沿能力的激励（适应陷阱）。当能耗增长快于价值增长时，可再生能源投资降低额外能力成本并减少排放；气候损害上升时，AI适应价值可支撑足够清洁容量扩张以使AI完全依赖可再生能源（适应路径）。校准案例显示两种机制在经验合理的量级下都可能出现。
Conclusion: 摘要总结：实现AI脱碳需要可再生能源容量跟上算力需求的增长。文章强调两种机制（适应陷阱与适应路径）取决于能力价值与能耗的相对增长速度，并指出这一条件决定了政策干预的方向。

papers.title: Exploiting Completeness Perception with Diffusion Transformer for Unified 3D MRI Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Missing data problems, such as missing modalities in multi-modal brain MRI and missing slices in cardiac MRI, pose significant challenges in clinical practice. Existing methods rely on external guidance to supply detailed missing-state information for instructing generative models to synthesize missing MRIs. However, manual indicators are not always available or reliable in real-world scenarios due to the unpredictable nature of clinical environments. Moreover, these explicit masks are not informative enough to provide guidance for improving semantic consistency. In this work, we argue that generative models should infer and recognize missing states in a self-perceptive manner, enabling them to better capture subtle anatomical and pathological variations. Towards this goal, we propose CoPeDiT, a shared completeness-perception framework for 3D MRI synthesis, following a common conditioning strategy with task-specific instantiations for different missing-data scenarios. Specifically, we incorporate dedicated pretext tasks into our tokenizer, CoPeVAE, empowering it to learn completeness-aware discriminative prompt tokens, and design MDiT3D, a specialized diffusion transformer architecture for 3D MRI synthesis that effectively uses the completeness-aware prompt tokens as guidance to enhance semantic consistency in 3D space. Comprehensive evaluations on three large-scale MRI datasets demonstrate that CoPeDiT consistently improves upon state-of-the-art methods across diverse missing patterns, yielding high-fidelity and structurally consistent MRI synthesis. Our code is available at https://github.com/JK-Liu7/CoPeDiT.

TL;DR: 本文提出 CoPeDiT，一个面向 3D MRI 缺失数据合成（如多模态脑 MRI 缺失模态、心脏 MRI 缺失切片）的统一框架，核心思想是让生成模型以自感知方式推断缺失状态，而非依赖外部人工掩码。框架包括学习完整性感知提示 token 的 tokenizer CoPeVAE 和利用这些 token 增强语义一致性的扩散 Transformer 架构 MDiT3D。在三个大规模 MRI 数据集上的综合评估表明，该方法在多种缺失模式下持续优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 临床场景中多模态 MRI 缺失和切片缺失问题常见，但现有方法依赖外部指导（如人工掩码）来告知生成模型缺失状态；这类指示在实际环境中不一定可用或可靠，且显式掩码对提升语义一致性的信息量不足。
Method: 提出共享的完整性感知框架 CoPeDiT，采用统一条件策略并针对不同缺失场景做任务特化实例化；在 tokenizer CoPeVAE 中加入专用 pretext task，使其学习完整性感知的判别性 prompt token，并设计专门用于 3D MRI 合成的扩散 Transformer 架构 MDiT3D，以这些 prompt token 作为引导提升 3D 空间的语义一致性。
Result: 在三个大规模 MRI 数据集上的综合评估显示，CoPeDiT 在多种缺失模式下一致优于现有最先进方法，能够生成高保真且结构一致的 MRI 合成结果。
Conclusion: 作者主张生成模型应以自感知方式推断并识别缺失状态，从而更好地捕捉细微的解剖和病理变化；代码已公开。

papers.title: Neural Prior Estimation: Learning Class Priors from Latent Representations
papers.abstract_en: Logit adjustment corrects class imbalance using the empirical class prior. We study whether a comparable class-frequency signal can instead be learned from the network representation, without explicitly supplying class counts to the correction rule. We introduce the Neural Prior Estimator (NPE), which attaches one or more lightweight Prior Estimation Modules (PEMs) to the latent representation. Each PEM is trained with a one-way logistic objective on the ground-truth coordinate. The resulting frequency-dependent outputs are combined into an NPE estimate and used as a learned logit correction, forming NPE-LA. In a simplified scalar model, the optimum of the PEM objective is monotone in the class count and grows asymptotically as $\log N_c$, up to a slower $\log \log N_c$ term. Experiments on long-tailed CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 show that NPE-LA is competitive with standard logit adjustment and improves minority-class performance over CE and cRT in the reported settings. Experiments on STARE and ADE20K further show that the same idea can be used as a lightweight recalibration mechanism for dense prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Neural Prior Estimator (NPE)，通过从网络潜在表示中学习类别先验信号，替代显式提供的经验类别先验，用于 logit 调整。NPE 在潜在表示上挂载一个或多个轻量 Prior Estimation Modules (PEM)，每个 PEM 以 one-way logistic 目标在真实类别坐标上训练，将输出合并为 NPE 估计并作为学习式 logit 校正 (NPE-LA)。实验在长尾 CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 上与标准 logit adjustment 相当，并改善少数类性能；在 STARE 和 ADE20K 上可作为稠密预测的轻量再校准机制。
Motivation: Logit adjustment 依赖经验类别先验来校正类别不平衡，本文研究能否不显式提供类别计数，而是从网络表示本身学习等价的类别频率信号，以放宽校正规则对类别标签分布的依赖。
Method: 提出 Neural Prior Estimator (NPE)，由一个或多个轻量 Prior Estimation Modules (PEM) 组成，每个 PEM 在潜在表示上以 ground-truth 坐标的 one-way logistic 目标训练；其频率相关输出被组合成 NPE 估计，并作为学习得到的 logit 校正项形成 NPE-LA。
Result: 在简化标量模型中，PEM 目标的最优点关于类别数是单调的，且渐近按 log N_c 增长（含较慢的 log log N_c 项）。在长尾 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 上，NPE-LA 与标准 logit adjustment 竞争，并在所报设置下比 CE 和 cRT 改善少数类性能；在 STARE 和 ADE20K 上，同一思想可作为稠密预测的轻量再校准机制。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，类别频率信号可以从网络表示中学习并用作 logit 校正，无需显式类别计数；该方法既能用于类别不平衡分类，也能用于稠密预测的轻量再校准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Unified Physics-Informed Neural Network for Modeling Coupled Electro- and Elastodynamic Wave Propagation Using Three-Stage Loss Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks present a novel approach in SciML that integrates physical laws in the form of partial differential equations directly into the NN through soft constraints in the loss function. This work studies the application of PINNs to solve a one dimensional coupled electro-elastodynamic system modeling linear piezoelectricity in stress-charge form, governed by elastodynamic and electrodynamic equations. Our simulation employs a feedforward architecture, mapping space-time coordinates to mechanical displacement and electric potential. Our PINN model achieved global relative L2 errors of 2.34 and 4.87 percent for displacement and electric potential respectively. The results validate PINNs as effective mesh free solvers for coupled time-dependent PDE systems, though challenges remain regarding error accumulation and stiffness in coupled eigenvalue systems.
papers.comment: We are withdrawing the [V1] of this article's preprint due to critical flaws discovered in the underlying simulation code that compromise the final conclusions leading to gravely misleading implications for future work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 求解一维耦合电-弹性动力学系统，即应力-电荷形式下的线性压电方程，并用三阶段损失优化进行训练。作者采用前馈网络将时空坐标映射为机械位移和电势，报告位移与电势的全局相对 L2 误差分别为 2.34% 和 4.87%。不过 arXiv 评论指出，V1 预印本因底层仿真代码存在严重缺陷、可能误导后续工作而已被作者撤回。
Motivation: PINN 通过将偏微分方程作为软约束引入损失函数，提供了一种新的科学机器学习 (SciML) 求解范式。本文针对耦合的弹性动力学与电动力学方程所描述的压电系统，检验 PINN 是否能在无网格条件下有效求解这类时变耦合 PDE 系统。
Method: 采用前馈网络架构，将空间-时间坐标映射到机械位移和电势，并以三阶段损失优化策略训练网络，使输出满足压电系统的弹性动力学与电动力学控制方程。
Result: 摘要报告模型在全局相对 L2 误差上达到位移 2.34%、电势 4.87%，表明 PINN 对耦合时变 PDE 系统具有可行性，同时指出误差累积和耦合特征值系统的刚性仍是挑战。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果将 PINN 验证为耦合时变偏微分方程的有效无网格求解器，但 V1 预印本已因底层仿真代码中的关键缺陷被撤回，摘要结论的可信度因此受到影响，不应用于指导后续工作。
Relevance: 6

papers.title: HBVLA: Pushing 1-Bit Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable instruction-following embodied control, but their large compute and memory footprints hinder deployment on resource-constrained robots and edge platforms. While reducing weights to 1-bit precision through binarization can greatly improve efficiency, existing methods fail to narrow the distribution gap between binarized and full-precision weights, causing quantization errors to accumulate under long-horizon closed-loop execution and severely degrade actions. To fill this gap, we propose HBVLA, a VLA-tailored binarization framework. First, we use a policy-aware enhanced Hessian to identify weights that are truly critical for action generation. Then, we employ a sparse orthogonal transform for non-salient weights to induce a low-entropy intermediate state. Finally, we quantize both salient and non-salient weights in the Harr domain with group-wise 1-bit quantization. We have evaluated our approach on different VLAs: on LIBERO, quantized OpenVLA-OFT retains 92.2% of full-precision performance; on SimplerEnv, quantized CogAct retains 93.6%, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art binarization methods. We further validate our method on real-world evaluation suite and the results show that HBVLA incurs only marginal success-rate degradation compared to the full-precision model, demonstrating robust deployability under tight hardware constraints. Our work provides a practical foundation for ultra-low-bit quantization of VLAs, enabling more reliable deployment on hardware-limited robotic platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HBVLA，一个面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的 1 比特后训练量化框架，目标是缓解二值化权重与全精度权重之间的分布差距导致的长视野闭环执行下量化误差累积。方法包括用策略感知增强 Hessian 识别动作生成的关键权重、对非显著权重施加稀疏正交变换以诱导低熵中间态，以及在 Harr 域对显著与非显著权重做分组 1 比特量化。在 LIBERO 上量化 OpenVLA-OFT 保留 92.2% 全精度性能，在 SimplerEnv 上量化 CogAct 保留 93.6%，并显著优于现有二值化方法。
Motivation: VLA 模型计算和内存开销大，难以部署在资源受限的机器人和边缘平台；现有二值化方法无法缩小二值化权重与全精度权重的分布差距，导致长视野闭环执行下量化误差累积并严重恶化动作输出。
Method: 提出面向 VLA 的二值化框架 HBVLA：首先用策略感知的增强 Hessian 定位对动作生成真正重要的权重；其次对非显著权重采用稀疏正交变换，使其进入低熵中间状态；最后在 Harr 域对显著与非显著权重分别做分组 1 比特量化。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，量化后的 OpenVLA-OFT 保留全精度模型 92.2% 的性能；在 SimplerEnv 上，量化后的 CogAct 保留 93.6%，显著超过现有最先进二值化方法。真实世界评测套件显示 HBVLA 相比全精度模型仅有轻微成功率下降，表明其在严苛硬件约束下具备可部署性。
Conclusion: 该工作为 VLA 模型的超低比特量化提供了实用基础，支持在硬件受限的机器人平台上实现更可靠的部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reducing the Complexity of Matrix Multiplication by Quantum Computing
papers.abstract_en: Matrix multiplication is a fundamental operation in compute-intensive tasks and a key component of modern quantum acceleration frameworks. Here we present a quantum matrix multiplication algorithm based on quantum kernels (QKMM), achieving an elementary gate complexity of \(O(N^2\log_2N)\), with amplitude encoding overhead explicitly included and without assuming a QRAM oracle. This scaling is asymptotically lower than that of the best-known classical matrix multiplication algorithm \(O(N^{2.371339})\). Building upon QKMM, we establish a family of quantum linear algebra operators, including Quantum Vector Inner Product (V${\scriptstyle 2}$V), Quantum Vector-Matrix Multiplication (V${\scriptstyle 2}$M), QKMM (M${\scriptstyle 2}$M), Quantum One-to-Many Matrix Multiplication(O${\scriptstyle 2}$M) and Quantum Sequential Matrix Multiplication (SMM), providing a unified framework from vector operations to parallel and sequential matrix transformations. Through noiseless simulations, realistic noise modelling and experiments on a superconducting quantum processor, we systematically characterize the numerical accuracy, resource requirements and hardware execution limits of this operator framework. Furthermore, we integrate SMM into deep neural-network inference, enabling intermediate features to propagate coherently across layers without repeated measurement and re-encoding. These results establish a pathway from quantum circuit-level algorithm design to end-to-end coherent computation, providing a quantum computing framework for matrix-centric compute-intensive applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于量子核的量子矩阵乘法算法 QKMM，声称在明确计入幅度编码开销且不依赖 QRAM oracle 的条件下，达到 O(N^2 log2 N) 的基本门复杂度，渐近低于最优经典矩阵乘法。作者基于 QKMM 构建了从向量内积到顺序矩阵乘法的一族量子线性代数算子，并通过无噪声模拟、噪声建模和超导量子处理器实验验证；还将 SMM 集成到深度神经网络推理中，使中间特征跨层相干传播。
Motivation: 矩阵乘法是计算密集任务的基础运算，也是量子加速框架的关键组件，但最优经典矩阵乘法仍有较高的渐近复杂度。现有方案常依赖 QRAM 等假设，本文希望在更现实的模型下设计更低复杂度的量子矩阵乘法。
Method: 提出 QKMM 算法，完整计入幅度编码开销且不假设 QRAM oracle；在此基础上建立统一算子框架，包括量子向量内积 V2V、向量-矩阵乘 V2M、矩阵-矩阵乘 QKMM、一对多矩阵乘 O2M 和顺序矩阵乘 SMM。
Result: 摘要报告 QKMM 的基本门复杂度为 O(N^2 log2 N)，渐近低于已知最优经典矩阵乘法 O(N^{2.371339})；通过无噪声模拟、现实噪声建模及超导量子处理器实验刻画了算子框架的数值精度、资源需求和硬件执行边界。
Conclusion: 将 SMM 集成到深度神经网络推理中可实现中间特征跨层相干传播，避免反复测量和重编码；作者认为这些结果建立了从量子电路级设计到端到端相干计算的路径，为矩阵中心的计算密集应用提供量子计算框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Partition of Unity Neural Networks for Interpretable Classification with Explicit Class Regions
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \emph{Partition of Unity Neural Networks} (PUNNs), a neural-network architecture for multiclass classification based on the classical mathematical notion of a partition of unity. The starting point is the observation that the characteristic functions of ideal class regions form a partition of unity. PUNNs replace these discontinuous indicators by learned continuous functions \[ h_1,\ldots,h_C:\mathcal X\to[0,1] \] whose sum is identically one and whose values are interpreted directly as class probabilities. The partition functions are generated through a recursive family of input-dependent gates. This construction guarantees nonnegative class probabilities summing to one without a separate normalization layer such as softmax, while providing an explicit ordered factorization of each probability in terms of the gate values. The resulting gate trace gives an interpretable representation of how individual class probabilities are formed. The framework also allows multiple partition functions to represent a single class and admits both neural-network and geometry-informed realizations of the gates. We prove that PUNNs are dense in the space of continuous probability maps from compact subsets of $\mathbb R^d$ into the probability simplex. Thus, the recursive partition-of-unity structure retains universal approximation of continuous probabilistic classifiers, including maps whose components may vanish. Numerical experiments on synthetic datasets, MNIST, and CIFAR-100 illustrate the learned partitions, the effect of class ordering, and the use of multiple partition components per class. We also develop shape-informed gates that incorporate geometric information directly; when the chosen geometry is well matched to the class regions, these models achieve comparable accuracy with substantially fewer trainable parameters.
papers.comment: Revised version with expanded theoretical discussion, geometry-informed gate parameterizations, and updated numerical experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分片单位神经网络 (Partition of Unity Neural Networks, PUNNs)，基于经典数学中的单位分解概念设计多分类架构。作者将理想类别区域的示性函数替换为和为 1 的学习到的连续函数，并直接用这些函数值作为类别概率；该构造通过递归的输入相关门 (input-dependent gates) 生成，无需 softmax 等归一化层。论文证明了 PUNNs 在连续概率映射空间上的稠密性（即通用逼近性），并在合成数据、MNIST 和 CIFAR-100 上展示了学习到的划分、类别顺序效应以及每类多分量的用法。
Motivation: 传统分类器依赖 softmax 归一化层来得到概率，但该过程不透明，难以解释单个类别概率是如何形成的；而理想类别区域的示性函数本身构成单位分解，这为可解释分类提供了一个自然出发点。
Method: PUNNs 通过一族递归的输入相关门生成满足非负且和为 1 的划分函数，每个概率具有显式的有序因子分解，门轨迹 (gate trace) 提供可解释表示；框架允许多个划分函数表示同一类别，并支持神经网络实现和融合几何信息的形状相关门 (shape-informed gates)。
Result: 论文证明 PUNNs 在从 R^d 紧子集到概率单纯形的连续概率映射空间中是稠密的，因而保持连续概率分类器的通用逼近能力，包括分量可能取零的映射。数值实验表明，当所选几何与类别区域匹配时，形状相关门能以显著更少的可训练参数达到相近的准确率。
Conclusion: 作者强调递归的单位分解结构既能保持通用逼近性，又通过显式因子分解和门轨迹提供可解释性；几何信息与类别区域匹配时可在参数效率上获益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SwipeGen: Bridging the Execution Gap in GUI Agents via Human-like Swipe Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Despite numerous Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents claiming to automate user interaction tasks, to date, few achieve satisfactory interaction capability with human users in real-world scenarios. Through empirical analysis, this paper identifies the root cause of the limited interaction capability as the rigid swipe execution. In particular, unlike humans, who perform swipes with fine-grained control over trajectory, speed, and timing, existing agents can only conduct simplistic, deterministic swipe behaviors, leading to frequent failures on complicated user-like interaction tasks. Due to the lack of open-source human-like swipe training data, we propose SwipeGen, the first tool for synthesizing diverse and human-like swipe interactions, and SwipeBench, the first benchmark for evaluating agents' swipe interaction quality. Extensive experiments show that SwipeGen can improve the swipe execution success rate of existing agents by up to 2.46x. Our code, dataset, and model are available at https://github.com/TSKGHS17/SwipeGen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出GUI智能体在真实场景中交互能力不足的根因是刚性的滑动执行，并提出SwipeGen，第一个用于合成多样化、类人滑动交互的工具，以及SwipeBench，第一个用于评估智能体滑动交互质量的基准。实验表明SwipeGen可将现有智能体的滑动执行成功率提升至多2.46倍。代码、数据集和模型已开源。
Motivation: 现有GUI智能体只能进行简单、确定性的滑动行为，缺乏人类对轨迹、速度和时机的精细控制，导致复杂类人交互任务频繁失败；同时缺少开源的类人滑动训练数据。
Method: 提出SwipeGen工具用于合成多样且类人的滑动交互数据，并构建SwipeBench基准来评估智能体的滑动交互质量。
Result: 大规模实验显示，SwipeGen可将现有智能体的滑动执行成功率提升至多2.46倍。
Conclusion: SwipeGen与SwipeBench填补了类人滑动训练数据和评估基准的空白，并显著提升GUI智能体的滑动执行能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: UAV-Based Infrastructure Inspections: A Literature Review and Proposed Framework for AEC+FM
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are transforming infrastructure inspections in the Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Facility Management (AEC+FM) domain. By synthesizing insights from over 150 studies, this review paper highlights UAV-based methodologies for data acquisition, photogrammetric modeling, defect detection, and decision-making support. Key innovations include path optimization, thermal integration, and advanced machine learning (ML) models such as YOLO and Faster R-CNN for anomaly detection. UAVs have demonstrated value in structural health monitoring (SHM), disaster response, urban infrastructure management, energy efficiency evaluations, and cultural heritage preservation. Despite these advancements, challenges in real-time processing, multimodal data fusion, and generalizability remain. A proposed workflow framework, informed by literature and a case study, integrates RGB imagery, LiDAR, and thermal sensing with transformer-based architectures to improve accuracy and reliability in detecting structural defects, thermal anomalies, and geometric inconsistencies. The proposed framework ensures precise and actionable insights by fusing multimodal data and dynamically adapting path planning for complex environments, presented as a comprehensive step-by-step guide to address these challenges effectively. This paper concludes with future research directions emphasizing lightweight AI models, adaptive flight planning, synthetic datasets, and richer modality fusion to streamline modern infrastructure inspections.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the International Conference on Computing in Civil Engineering (i3CE 2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对 AEC+FM（建筑、工程、施工与设施管理）领域无人机（UAV）基础设施检测的文献综述，综合了 150 余项研究，梳理了数据采集、摄影测量建模、缺陷检测和决策支持等方法。摘要还提出一个整合 RGB 图像、LiDAR 与热成像传感，并采用基于 Transformer 架构与动态路径规划的工作流框架，以提升结构缺陷、热异常和几何不一致检测的准确性与可靠性。
Motivation: 无人机检测在实时处理、多模态数据融合和泛化能力方面仍存在挑战，该领域缺少系统性的综述和统一的、可指导实际应用的框架。
Method: 通过综合 150 余项研究的文献综述，并结合案例研究提出一个逐步工作流框架；该框架融合 RGB、LiDAR、热成像等多模态数据，结合 Transformer 架构并动态调整路径规划以应对复杂环境。
Result: 综述指出路径优化、热成像集成以及 YOLO、Faster R-CNN 等机器学习模型是主要创新；UAV 已在结构健康监测（SHM）、灾害响应、城市基础设施管理、能效评估和文化遗产保护中展现价值。提出的框架旨在通过多模态融合提高结构缺陷、热异常和几何不一致检测的准确性与可靠性。
Conclusion: 作者强调实时处理、多模态数据融合与泛化性问题仍然存在，未来研究方向包括轻量级 AI 模型、自适应飞行规划、合成数据集和更丰富的模态融合。

papers.title: Video Evidence to Reasoning Efficient Video Understanding via Explicit Evidence Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) face a fundamental dilemma in video reasoning: they are caught between the prohibitive computational costs of verbose reasoning and the hallucination risks of efficient, ungrounded approaches. To resolve this, we introduce the Chain of Evidence (CoE), a novel framework that architecturally decouples and co-optimizes perceptual grounding and reasoning efficiency. CoE incorporates two core innovations: (1) A lightweight Evidence Grounding Module (EGM) that acts as a query-guided filter, dynamically identifying and extracting a compact set of high-fidelity visual evidence; and (2) An Evidence-Anchoring Protocol optimized via Reinforcement Learning. Crucially, we design a composite reward mechanism that enforces process alignment, compelling the model to strictly reference identified temporal anchors during deduction, thereby mitigating hallucinations. To enable this, we construct CoE-Instruct, a large-scale dataset (164k samples) featuring a novel dual-annotation schema for separate perception and reasoning supervision. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks, including Video-MME, MVBench, and VSI-Bench, demonstrate that CoE-enhanced models establish a new state-of-the-art. They significantly outperform existing methods in accuracy, proving CoE to be a powerful and practical paradigm for reliable video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chain of Evidence (CoE) 框架，用于解决大型视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 在视频推理中面临的推理成本与幻觉风险之间的两难。CoE 架构上将感知接地 (perceptual grounding) 与推理效率解耦并联合优化，包含轻量级证据接地模块 (EGM) 和基于强化学习优化的证据锚定协议 (Evidence-Anchoring Protocol)。作者还构建了 164k 样本的 CoE-Instruct 数据集，并在 Video-MME、MVBench、VSI-Bench 等五个基准上取得新的最优结果。
Motivation: 现有视频推理方法要么依赖冗长推理导致计算成本过高，要么采用高效但缺乏依据的方式导致幻觉风险，两者之间存在根本性矛盾。
Method: 提出 CoE 框架，核心包括两个组件：一是作为查询引导过滤器 (query-guided filter) 的轻量级证据接地模块 EGM，动态筛选紧凑的高保真视觉证据；二是通过强化学习优化的证据锚定协议，并设计复合奖励机制强制执行过程对齐 (process alignment)，迫使模型在推理中严格引用识别出的时间锚点 (temporal anchors)。同时构建采用双标注模式 (dual-annotation schema) 的 CoE-Instruct 数据集，分别监督感知与推理。
Result: 在 Video-MME、MVBench、VSI-Bench 等五个基准上的大量实验表明，CoE 增强模型取得了新的 state-of-the-art 结果，在准确性上显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CoE 是可靠视频理解的一种有效且实用的范式，通过显式证据接地缓解幻觉并提升推理效率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Zoom-IQA: Image Quality Assessment with Reliable Region-Aware Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Image Quality Assessment (IQA) is a long-standing problem in computer vision. Previous methods typically focus on predicting numerical scores without explanation or providing low-level descriptions lacking precise scores. Recent reasoning-based vision language models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for IQA by jointly generating quality descriptions and scores. However, existing VLM-based IQA methods often suffer from unreliable reasoning due to their limited capability of integrating visual and textual cues. In this work, we introduce Zoom-IQA, a VLM-based IQA model to explicitly emulate key cognitive behaviors: uncertainty awareness, region reasoning, and iterative refinement. Specifically, we present a two-stage training pipeline: 1) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on our Grounded-Rationale-IQA (GR-IQA) dataset to teach the model to ground its assessments in key regions, and 2) reinforcement learning (RL) for dynamic policy exploration, stabilized by our KL-Coverage regularizer to prevent reasoning and scoring diversity collapse, with a Progressive Re-sampling Strategy for mitigating annotation bias. Extensive experiments show that Zoom-IQA achieves improved robustness, explainability, and generalization. The application to downstream tasks, such as image restoration, further demonstrates the effectiveness of Zoom-IQA.

Motivation: 已有 IQA 方法要么只预测数值分数而缺乏解释，要么提供低层描述却缺少精确分数；基于 VLM 的 IQA 方法在整合视觉与文本线索上能力有限，导致推理不可靠。
Method: 提出 Zoom-IQA，采用两阶段训练：1) 在 GR-IQA 数据集上执行监督微调，使模型将评估依据定位到关键区域；2) 通过强化学习进行动态策略探索，并用 KL-Coverage 正则化防止推理与评分多样性崩塌，配合渐进重采样策略缓解标注偏差。
Result: 大量实验表明 Zoom-IQA 在鲁棒性、可解释性和泛化性上获得改进，且在图像复原等下游任务上的应用进一步验证了其有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式模拟认知行为并结合区域定位与迭代细化的训练方式，可以提升 VLM 在图像质量评估中的可靠性与可解释性。

papers.title: Reliable conformal novelty detection at the decision boundary
papers.abstract_en: Novelty detection via conformal $p$-values and BH procedure provides distribution-free global false discovery rate (FDR) control. We present here fundamental limits of this approach by showing that it does not produce reliable detection at the decision boundary. We study boundary false discovery rate (bFDR), the probability that the least extreme reported novelty is in fact a null observation. We first show that the support line (SL) procedure, controlling the bFDR in the continuous independent framework, fails to control the bFDR in the conformal case. We then present several modifications of the SL procedure that restore reliability at the decision boundary, by controlling the bFDR, with specific improvements in situations where many novelties are expected (adaptive procedures) and when the calibration sample is too small with respect to the test sample (subsampled procedures). Numerical experiments with both synthetic and real data support our findings and show the relevance of the new proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于 conformal p-values 和 BH 过程的新颖性检测 (novelty detection) 在决策边界上的可靠性问题。作者证明该方法无法在边界处提供可靠检测，引入边界错误发现率 (bFDR) 并表明连续独立框架下控制 bFDR 的支持线 (SL) 程序在 conformal 情形下失效，随后提出多种改进以恢复可靠性。合成与真实数据实验支持新方法。
Motivation: 现有 conformity novelty detection 方法通过 conformal p-values 与 BH 过程实现无分布假设的全局错误发现率 (FDR) 控制，但作者指出这类方法在决策边界处不可靠：最不极端的被报告新颖性很可能实际上是零假设观测，即边界错误发现率 (bFDR) 未被控制。
Method: 形式化定义边界错误发现率 (bFDR) 并分析其特性；证明支持线 (SL) 程序在 conformal 情形下无法控制 bFDR；随后提出若干修改版本，包括自适应程序 (adaptive procedures) 用于预期大量新颖性的场景，以及子采样程序 (subsampled procedures) 用于校准样本过小的场景，以恢复边界可靠性。
Result: 数值实验（含合成数据和真实数据）表明所提出的改进方法能够控制 bFDR，并验证了自适应与子采样变体在相应场景下的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过控制 bFDR 可以恢复决策边界处的新颖性检测可靠性，自适应与子采样修改分别应对新颖性数量多和校准样本不足的情形；论文未给出除数值实验外的更广泛理论保证声明。
