papers.title: PhysSFI-Net: Physics-informed Geometric Learning of Skeletal and Facial Interactions for Orthognathic Surgical Outcome Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Orthognathic surgery repositions jaw bones to restore occlusion and enhance facial aesthetics. Accurate simulation of postoperative facial morphology is essential for preoperative planning. This study aims to develop and validate a physics-informed geometric deep learning framework named PhysSFI-Net for precise prediction of soft tissue deformation following orthognathic surgery. The model integrates a hierarchical feature extraction module with attention mechanisms to capture skeletal-facial interactions, an LSTM-based sequential predictor for incremental deformation, and a biomechanics-inspired reconstruction module for high-resolution facial modeling. The model was trained on 135 patients and externally validated on an independent cohort of 33 patients. Model performance was assessed using point cloud shape error, surface deviation error and landmark error between predicted facial shapes with corresponding ground truths. Quantitative analysis demonstrated that PhysSFI-Net achieved a global shape error of 1.070 +/- 0.088 mm, a surface deviation error of 1.296 +/- 0.349 mm and a landmark error of 2.445 +/- 1.326 mm. Comparative experiments indicated that PhysSFI-Net outperformed the state-of-the-art method ACMT-Net and baseline models. External validation further confirmed its robustness with a global HD of 1.431 +/- 0.087 mm and consistently lower subregional and mesh-based errors. In conclusion, PhysSFI-Net enables interpretable, high-resolution prediction of postoperative facial morphology, showing strong potential for clinical application in orthognathic surgical planning.
papers.journal_ref: Bao, J., Liu, H., Zhuang, Y. et al. PhysSFI-Net: physics-informed geometric learning of skeletal and facial interactions for orthognathic surgical outcome prediction. npj Digit. Med. (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为 PhysSFI-Net 的物理信息几何深度学习框架，用于正颌手术后面部软组织变形的术后形态预测。模型结合层次化特征提取与注意力机制、基于 LSTM 的增量变形序列预测器以及生物力学启发的重建模块，在 135 例患者上训练并在独立 33 例队列上外部验证。定量结果显示其全局形状误差为 1.070 ± 0.088 mm，优于 ACMT-Net 与基线模型，外部验证中全局 HD 为 1.431 ± 0.087 mm。作者认为该方法提供可解释、高分辨率的术后面部形态预测，具有临床应用潜力。
Motivation: 正颌手术通过重新定位颌骨来恢复咬合并改善面部美学，而准确模拟术后面部形态对术前规划至关重要；现有方法在该预测任务上的精度和鲁棒性仍有提升空间。
Method: 提出物理信息几何深度学习框架 PhysSFI-Net，包含层次化特征提取模块与注意力机制以捕捉骨骼与面部软组织间的交互，基于 LSTM 的序列预测器建模增量变形，以及生物力学启发的重建模块实现高分辨率面部建模。
Result: 模型在测试集上达到全局形状误差 1.070 ± 0.088 mm、表面偏差误差 1.296 ± 0.349 mm 和标志点误差 2.445 ± 1.326 mm；对比实验显示其优于 SOTA 方法 ACMT-Net 和基线模型。外部验证中全局 HD 为 1.431 ± 0.087 mm，且亚区域和网格误差一致更低。
Conclusion: 作者总结称 PhysSFI-Net 能够实现可解释、高分辨率的术后面部形态预测，在正颌外科手术规划中展现出较强的临床应用潜力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Better Call Graphs: A New Dataset of Function Call Graphs for Malware Classification
papers.abstract_en: Function call graphs (FCGs) have emerged as a powerful abstraction for malware detection, capturing the behavioral structure of applications beyond surface-level signatures. Their utility in traditional program analysis has been well established, enabling effective classification and analysis of malicious software. In the mobile domain, especially in the Android ecosystem, FCG-based malware classification is particularly critical due to the platform's widespread adoption and the complex, component-based structure of Android apps. However, progress in this direction is hindered by the lack of large-scale, high-quality Android-specific FCG datasets. Existing datasets are often outdated, dominated by small or redundant graphs resulting from app repackaging, and fail to reflect the diversity of real-world malware. These limitations lead to overfitting and unreliable evaluation of graph-based classification methods. To address this gap, we introduce Better Call Graphs (BCG), a comprehensive dataset of large and unique FCGs extracted from recent Android application packages (APKs). BCG includes both benign and malicious samples spanning various families and types, along with graph-level features for each APK. Through extensive experiments using baseline classifiers, we demonstrate the necessity and value of BCG compared to existing datasets. BCG is publicly available at https://erdemub.github.io/BCG-dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Better Call Graphs (BCG)，一个面向 Android 恶意软件分类的大规模、去重后的函数调用图 (function call graph, FCG) 数据集。BCG 从近期 Android APK 中提取大型且唯一的 FCG，包含良性与恶意样本，覆盖多种家族和类型，并提供每个 APK 的图级特征。基于基线分类器的实验表明，与现有数据集相比，BCG 能带来更可靠、更少过拟合的评估。
Motivation: 现有 Android 专用 FCG 数据集往往过时，且以小型或由应用重打包 (repackaging) 产生的冗余图为主，无法反映真实恶意软件的多样性，导致基于图的分类方法容易过拟合且评估不可靠。缺乏大规模、高质量的 Android 专用 FCG 数据集阻碍了该方向进展。
Method: 构建 BCG 数据集：从近期 Android 应用包 (APK) 中提取大规模且唯一的函数调用图，同时纳入良性样本和恶意样本，覆盖不同家族与类型，并为每个 APK 提供图级特征；随后使用基线分类器开展实验以验证数据集的价值。
Result: 摘要报告通过广泛的基线分类器实验，展示了 BCG 相比现有数据集的必要性和价值，但没有给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该数据集可公开获取，并旨在为基于图的 Android 恶意软件分类提供更新、更多样化且更可靠的数据基础。

papers.title: XDen-1K: A Density Field Dataset of Real-World Objects
papers.abstract_en: A deep understanding of the physical world is essential for robotic manipulation and physically realistic simulation. While current methods, including VLM-based and other learning-based approaches, have shown promise in physical property inference, their evaluation is often hindered by the lack of physically grounded reference data. To address this gap, we introduce XDen-1K, the first large-scale multimodal dataset that provides physically grounded density field for real-world objects. XDen-1K comprises 1,000 real-world objects spanning 137 categories, with comprehensive data for each object, including a high-resolution, carefully curated 3D geometric model with part-level annotations and paired real-world biplanar X-ray scans. In addition, XDen-1K includes high-fidelity volumetric density field reconstructed from sparse biplanar X-ray views via a novel optimization framework. XDen-1K also provides a benchmark for density estimation and enables X-ray-conditioned volumetric segmentation. Experiments further demonstrate that the center-of-mass prior derived by XDen-1K can improve robotic manipulation performance. By providing real-world X-ray scans and physics-consistent density field, XDen-1K establishes a foundation for advancing physical property inference and embodied AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XDen-1K，据称是首个面向真实世界物体的物理密度场多模态数据集，包含 1,000 个物体、137 个类别，以及带部件标注的高分辨率 3D 模型和配对的双平面 X 射线扫描。作者通过一种新颖的优化框架从稀疏双平面 X 射线视图重建高保真体积密度场，并提供密度估计基准和 X 射线条件下的体积分割能力；实验显示由该数据集导出的质心先验可提升机器人操作性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 VLM 或其他学习方法的物理属性推理常缺乏物理上有依据的参考数据，导致评估受限；需要提供真实世界物体具有物理一致性的密度场数据来弥补这一空白。
Method: 构建多模态数据集 XDen-1K，包含 1,000 个真实物体（137 类）的高分辨率 3D 几何模型、部件级标注和成对双平面 X 射线扫描，并采用新颖的优化框架从稀疏双平面 X 射线视图重建高保真体积密度场。
Result: 摘要报告该数据集提供了密度估计基准和 X 射线条件下的体积分割能力；基于 XDen-1K 得到的质心先验（center-of-mass prior）可改善机器人操作性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为 XDen-1K 通过提供真实世界 X 射线扫描和物理一致的密度场，为推进物理属性推理具身智能（embodied AI）建立了基础。

papers.title: Silhouette-based Gait Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Gait patterns play a critical role in human identification and healthcare analytics, yet current progress remains constrained by small, narrowly designed models that fail to scale or generalize. Building a unified gait foundation model requires addressing two longstanding barriers: (a) Scalability. Why have gait models historically failed to follow scaling laws? (b) Generalization. Can one model serve the diverse gait tasks that have traditionally been studied in isolation? We introduce FoundationGait, the first scalable, self-supervised pretraining framework for gait understanding. Its largest version has nearly 0.13 billion parameters and is pretrained on 12 public gait datasets comprising over 2 million walking sequences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FoundationGait, with or without fine-tuning, performs robustly across a wide spectrum of gait datasets, conditions, tasks (e.g., human identification, scoliosis screening, depression prediction, and attribute estimation), and even input modality. Notably, it achieves 48.0% zero-shot rank-1 accuracy on the challenging in-the-wild Gait3D dataset (1,000 test subjects) and 64.5% on the largest in-the-lab OU-MVLP dataset (5,000+ test subjects), setting a new milestone in robust gait recognition. Coming code and model: https://github.com/ShiqiYu/OpenGait.

papers.title: Towards Audio Token Compression in Large Audio Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) deliver strong performance across speech and audio tasks, but their audio encoders generate high-rate token sequences (e.g., 25 tokens/s), making attention computation costly and limiting scalability. In this paper, we explore techniques such as unsupervised segmentation, uniform average pooling, etc., to reduce the number of audio tokens before they are consumed by the LLM decoder. To mitigate potential performance degradation, we employ low-rank adapters during finetuning. We evaluate our proposed models on two tasks, automatic speech recognition and speech-to-speech translation tasks, that are dependent on effectively uncovering the underlying lexical content of the input signal, and study the effect of downsampling on these tasks. Experimental results show that compressed LALMs can achieve performance closer to frame-level LALMs while reducing the input audio token count up to three times before the LLM backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型音频语言模型（LALM）中的音频 token 压缩问题。音频编码器产生高帧率 token 序列（例如 25 tokens/s），导致注意力计算成本高并限制可扩展性；作者探索无监督分割、均匀平均池化等技术在送入 LLM 解码器之前减少音频 token 数量，并在微调时使用低秩适配器（low-rank adapters）缓解性能下降。实验表明，压缩后的 LALM 在自动语音识别和语音到语音翻译任务上能接近帧级 LALM 的性能，同时将输入音频 token 数减少至原来的三分之一。
Motivation: LALM 的音频编码器生成高帧率 token 序列，使注意力计算昂贵并限制模型可扩展性；此前缺乏对进入 LLM 主干前音频 token 压缩的系统研究。
Method: 采用无监督分割（unsupervised segmentation）、均匀平均池化（uniform average pooling）等技术在 LLM 解码器前减少音频 token；为缓解压缩带来的性能下降，在微调阶段引入低秩适配器（low-rank adapters）。
Result: 在依赖词法内容（lexical content）的自动语音识别和语音到语音翻译两个任务上评估；压缩后的 LALM 性能接近帧级 LALM，同时将输入音频 token 数量减少最多三倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过 token 压缩与低秩适配器微调，可以在 LLM 主干之前显著降低音频 token 数，并在词法内容依赖任务上保持接近帧级模型的性能。

papers.title: CarBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Neural Surrogates on High-Fidelity 3D Car Aerodynamics
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking has been the cornerstone of progress in computer vision, natural language processing, and the broader deep learning domain, driving algorithmic innovation through standardized datasets and reproducible evaluation protocols. The growing availability of large-scale Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) datasets has opened new opportunities for applying machine learning to aerodynamic and engineering design. Yet, despite this progress, there exists no standardized benchmark for large-scale numerical simulations in engineering design. In this work, we introduce CarBench, the first comprehensive benchmark dedicated to large-scale 3D car aerodynamics, performing a large-scale evaluation of state-of-the-art models on DrivAerNet++, the largest public dataset for automotive aerodynamics, containing over 8,000 high-fidelity car simulations. We assess eleven architectures spanning neural operator methods (e.g., Fourier Neural Operator), geometric deep learning (PointNet, RegDGCNN, PointMAE, PointTransformer), transformer-based neural solvers (Transolver, Transolver++, AB-UPT), and implicit field networks (TripNet). Beyond standard interpolation tasks, we perform cross-category experiments in which transformer-based solvers trained on a single car archetype are evaluated on unseen categories. Our analysis covers predictive accuracy, physical consistency, computational efficiency, and statistical uncertainty. To accelerate progress in data-driven engineering, we open-source the benchmark framework, including training pipelines, uncertainty estimation routines based on bootstrap resampling, and pretrained model weights, establishing the first reproducible foundation for large-scale learning from high-fidelity CFD simulations, available at https://github.com/Mohamedelrefaie/CarBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CarBench，一个针对大规模三维汽车空气动力学的神经代理模型（neural surrogate）基准，基于目前最大的公开汽车空气动力学数据集 DrivAerNet++（含超过 8000 个高保真仿真）对 11 种架构进行大规模评估。评估覆盖神经算子（如 Fourier Neural Operator）、几何深度学习（PointNet、RegDGCNN、PointMAE、PointTransformer）、Transformer 类神经求解器（Transolver、Transolver++、AB-UPT）以及隐式场网络（TripNet），并包含跨类别的泛化实验。作者开源了基准框架、训练流程、基于 bootstrap 重采样的不确定性估计例程和预训练权重。
Motivation: 尽管大规模 CFD 数据集的增长为机器学习在空气动力学和工程设计中的应用提供了机会，但工程设计中大规模数值仿真仍缺乏标准化的基准和可重复的评估协议。
Method: 构建 CarBench 基准，在 DrivAerNet++ 上对 11 种代表性架构进行统一评估；除标准插值任务外，还设计跨类别实验（在单一汽车原型上训练、在未见类别上评测），并同时分析预测精度、物理一致性、计算效率和统计不确定性。
Result: 摘要报告了在超过 8000 个高保真汽车仿真的最大公开数据集上的大规模评估结果，比较了 11 种模型，并给出了跨类别泛化实验以及不确定性、效率和物理一致性方面的分析。
Conclusion: 作者强调该基准框架及其开源资源为从高保真 CFD 仿真中进行大规模学习建立了首个可复现的基础。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Towards Formalizing Reinforcement Learning Theory: A Robbins-Siegmund Approach
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we formalize the almost sure convergence of $Q$-learning and linear temporal difference (TD) learning with Markovian samples using the Lean 4 theorem prover based on the Mathlib library. $Q$-learning and linear TD are among the earliest and most influential reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms. The investigation of their convergence properties is not only a major research topic during the early development of the RL field but also receives significant attention nowadays. This paper formally verifies their almost sure convergence in a unified framework based on the Robbins-Siegmund theorem. The framework developed in this work can potentially be extended to convergence rates and other modes of convergence. This work thus makes an important step towards fully formalizing convergent RL results. The code is available at https://github.com/ShangtongZhang/rl-theory-in-lean.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用 Lean 4 定理证明器和 Mathlib 库，形式化验证了 Q-learning 与线性时序差分 (TD) 学习在马尔可夫样本下的几乎必然收敛性，并统一基于 Robbins-Siegmund 定理构建证明框架。该框架有望扩展到收敛速率与其他收敛模式，被认为是向完全形式化收敛强化学习 (RL) 结果迈出的重要一步。代码已开源。
Motivation: Q-learning 和线性 TD 是强化学习中最具影响力的经典算法，其收敛性研究既在早期也受当代关注，但此前缺乏机器可验证的正式证明。本文用 Lean 4 对这些经典结果的几乎必然收敛进行形式化。
Method: 作者以 Lean 4 定理证明器和 Mathlib 库为基础，采用 Robbins-Siegmund 定理建立统一框架，对 Q-learning 和线性 TD 在马尔可夫采样下的几乎必然收敛给出机器可检查的证明。
Result: 摘要报告成功形式化了 Q-learning 和线性 TD 的几乎必然收敛，并指出该框架可扩展到收敛速率和其他收敛模式。
Conclusion: 该工作是向完全形式化收敛性 RL 结果迈出的一步，提供开源代码供复现与扩展。

papers.title: Object-aware graph matching network for cross-domain remote sensing image localization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain and cross-modal remote sensing image geo-localization remains challenging due to large appearance discrepancies and unstable semantic correspondence across heterogeneous sensors and platforms. Existing methods mainly rely on scene-level or global representations, which often struggle to achieve reliable alignment in complex environments, especially under severe modality gaps such as infrared-to-visible matching. To facilitate research in this setting, this study introduces IRVL328, a new infrared-visible remote sensing localization dataset designed to reflect challenging cross-modal variations. Meanwhile, this study proposes an object-aware graph matching framework that integrates object detection with dual-graph neural reasoning, where salient structural regions are represented as graph nodes and both inter-image correspondences and intra-image relations are jointly modeled; a training-only node alignment strategy is further introduced to enhance supervision without increasing inference complexity. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves competitive performance on SUES-200 and strong performance on IRVL328 and DenseUAV, particularly in challenging cross-modal settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨域跨模态遥感图像地理定位问题，提出IRVL328红外-可见光遥感定位数据集，并设计了一种对象感知图匹配框架。该框架将目标检测与双图神经网络推理结合，把显著结构区域表示为图节点，联合建模图像间对应关系与图像内关系，并引入仅训练时的节点对齐策略以增强监督而不增加推理复杂度。实验在SUES-200、IRVL328和DenseUAV上取得有竞争力或强劲的性能，尤其在红外-可见光等挑战性跨模态场景下。
Motivation: 现有方法主要依赖场景级或全局表示，在复杂环境和大模态差异下难以实现可靠对齐，跨域跨模态遥感图像地理定位仍具挑战。
Method: 提出对象感知图匹配框架，集成目标检测与双图神经网络推理，将显著结构区域作为图节点，同时建模图像间对应和图像内关系；另提出训练时使用的节点对齐策略，仅增强监督而不增加推理复杂度。
Result: 实验结果显示该方法在SUES-200上达到有竞争力的性能，在IRVL328和DenseUAV上表现强劲，尤其擅长挑战性的跨模态匹配场景。
Conclusion: 摘要强调新数据集IRVL328与对象感知图匹配框架能够改善跨模态遥感图像定位，未提及明显局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WaveVerif: Acoustic Side-Channel based Verification of Robotic Workflows
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present a framework that uses acoustic side-channel analysis (ASCA) to monitor and verify whether a robot correctly executes its intended commands. We develop and evaluate a machine-learning-based workflow verification system that uses acoustic emissions generated by robotic movements. The system can determine whether real-time behavior is consistent with expected commands. The evaluation takes into account movement speed, direction, and microphone distance. The results show that individual robot movements can be validated with over 80\% accuracy under baseline conditions using four different classifiers: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Deep Neural Network (DNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Additionally, workflows such as pick-and-place and packing could be verified with similarly high confidence. Our findings demonstrate that acoustic signals can support real-time, low-cost, passive verification in sensitive robotic environments without requiring hardware modifications.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, Corresponding Author: Zeynep Yasemin Erdogan (z.y.erdogan2@newcastle.ac.uk)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于声学侧信道分析 (ASCA) 的框架，用于监控和验证机器人是否正确执行预期指令。系统利用机器人运动产生的声学发射信号，通过机器学习分类器判断实时行为是否与预期命令一致，并评估了运动速度、方向和麦克风距离的影响。
Motivation: 在敏感机器人环境中，需要一种无需硬件修改的实时、低成本、被动式验证手段，以确认机器人工作流是否按指令正确执行。
Method: 开发并评估了一个基于机器学习的工作流验证系统，使用机器人运动产生的声学信号作为侧信道，采用 SVM、DNN、RNN 和 CNN 四种分类器，并考察运动速度、方向及麦克风距离等因素。
Result: 在基线条件下，单个机器人运动的验证准确率超过 80%；pick-and-place 和打包等工作流也能以类似的较高置信度得到验证。
Conclusion: 研究表明声学信号能够支持敏感机器人环境中实时、低成本、被动的行为验证，无需对硬件进行修改。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PACT: Phenotype-Aware Contrastive Team Representation for Multi-Phenotype Grouped Ad Hoc Teamwork
papers.abstract_en: Learning to collaborate with various unfamiliar teammates poses a great challenge in the domain of multi-agent systems. Existing ad hoc teamwork methods typically drive controlled agents to collaborate with a group of teammates exhibiting a single coordination phenotype shaped by the same reward function. However, in real-world applications, controlled agents should collaborate with unfamiliar teammates of diverse coordination phenotypes among groups that have never worked together. We formalize this as the Multi-Phenotype Grouped Ad Hoc Teamwork (MPG-AHT) problem, and propose Phenotype-Aware Contrastive Team Representation (PACT) to solve this problem. PACT is empowered with phenotype-aware contrastive learning and relational reasoning to accurately distinguish coordination phenotypes and capture inter-agent interactions. Extensive experiments on multi-phenotype collaboration tasks show that PACT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on average, achieving a mean 21.0% gain in out-of-distribution evaluation and a mean 36.5% gain in sample efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多表型分组临时团队合作（Multi-Phenotype Grouped Ad Hoc Teamwork, MPG-AHT）问题，并为此提出表型感知对比团队表征（PACT）。PACT 结合表型感知对比学习（phenotype-aware contrastive learning）与关系推理（relational reasoning），用于区分协调表型并捕捉智能体间交互。实验表明，在多表型协作任务上 PACT 平均优于现有最先进基线，分布外评估平均提升 21.0%，样本效率平均提升 36.5%。
Motivation: 现有 ad hoc teamwork 方法通常假设队友由同一奖励函数塑造为单一协调表型，而真实场景中受控智能体需要与从未合作过、群体内具有多种协调表型的陌生队友协作。作者将这一现实需求形式化为 MPG-AHT 问题。
Method: PACT 使用表型感知对比学习来准确区分不同的协调表型，并借助关系推理建模智能体之间的交互，从而为团队合作学习更好的表征。
Result: 在多表型协作任务上的大量实验中，PACT 在平均性能上超过 SOTA 基线，具体表现为分布外评估平均 21.0% 的提升和样本效率平均 36.5% 的提升。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 PACT 能够有效应对具有多种未知协调表型队友的团队协作场景，并通过对比学习和关系推理显著提升泛化与样本效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Navigating Through Turbulence: Charting Early Careers in Weather and Climate Science
papers.abstract_en: The field of weather and climate science is at a pivotal moment, defined by simultaneous forces of institutional disruption and unprecedented technological advancements. While a shifting research and employment landscape has created career uncertainty, prompting many scientists to consider or pursue opportunities in the private sector, it has simultaneously spurred an expansion of the ecosystem through the emergence of new computational tools and the growing role of industry innovators and stakeholders. This perspective paper argues that this new, expanded ecosystem presents extraordinary opportunities for students and early-career professionals. We outline the emerging scientific frontiers powered by high-resolution simulations and artificial intelligence, suggest a practical path for navigating a more fluid career landscape, and propose how education and training must evolve. We argue that these changes expand rather than diminish the reader's capacity to do what drew most of us to this field: helping people prepare for what the atmosphere is about to do.
papers.comment: Essay for Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society (BAMS). Invited submission to go through peer review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向 BAMS 的观点性文章 (perspective paper)，讨论天气与气候科学领域在机构性扰动和人工智能等新技术并行发展下的职业生态变化。作者认为，虽然研究与就业格局变化带来职业不确定性，但新的扩展生态为早期职业科学家创造了巨大机会，并给出利用高分辨率模拟与 AI 前沿、适应更灵活职业路径以及改革教育培训的建议。摘要强调这些变化不是削弱而是扩展了从业者服务公众天气预报的能力。
Motivation: 天气与气候科学正面临机构性扰动、研究就业格局变化以及私营部门机会增加带来的职业不确定性，许多科学家开始考虑离开学术界；作者希望为早期职业人员提供应对这种流动职业环境的思路。
Method: 采用观点性论述方式：先勾勒由高分辨率模拟 (high-resolution simulations) 和人工智能 (AI) 驱动的新兴科学前沿，再提出在更灵活的职业版图中导航的实践路径，并建议教育训练应如何演进。
Result: 本文不包含实证实验结果；其主要产出是一个论证性框架，主张新扩展的生态系统对早期职业科学家意味着更多而非更少的机会。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些变化会扩展而非削弱研究人员从事该领域的初衷，即帮助人们为大气即将发生的变化做好准备；为此，教育培训体系需要相应进化，以适应更流动的职业生态。
Relevance: 45

papers.title: A Physics-Informed Neural Network Approach for UAV Path Planning in Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) operating in dynamic wind fields must generate safe and energy-efficient trajectories under physical and environmental constraints. Traditional planners, such as A* and kinodynamic RRT*, often yield suboptimal or non-smooth paths due to discretization and sampling limitations. This paper presents a physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework that embeds UAV dynamics, wind disturbances, and obstacle avoidance directly into the learning process. Without requiring supervised data, the PINN learns dynamically feasible and collision-free trajectories by minimizing physical residuals and risk-aware objectives. Comparative simulations show that the proposed method outperforms A* and Kino-RRT* in control energy, smoothness, and safety margin, while maintaining similar flight efficiency. The results highlight the potential of physics-informed learning to unify model-based and data-driven planning, providing a scalable and physically consistent framework for UAV trajectory optimization.
papers.comment: Withdrawn due to a substantive methodological error that affects the main conclusions of the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理信息神经网络 (physics-informed neural network, PINN) 框架，用于动态风场中无人机的路径规划，将无人机动力学、风扰动和避障约束嵌入学习过程，无需监督数据即可学习动态可行且无碰撞的轨迹。仿真对比显示其在控制能量、平滑度和安全裕度上优于 A* 与 Kino-RRT*，并保持相近的飞行效率。需要指出的是，该论文因影响主要结论的实质性方法错误已被撤回 (withdrawn)。
Motivation: 传统规划器如 A* 和 kinodynamic RRT* 受离散化与采样限制，在动态风场中常产生次优或非光滑轨迹，难以在物理与环境约束下兼顾安全与能量效率。
Method: 构建 PINN 框架，将无人机动力学、风扰动和避障约束直接嵌入学习过程，通过最小化物理残差和风险感知目标函数训练网络，无需监督数据。
Result: 对比仿真表明，该方法在控制能量、平滑度和安全裕度上优于 A* 和 Kino-RRT*，同时保持相似的飞行效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调物理信息学习有望统一基于模型与数据驱动的规划方法，为无人机轨迹优化提供可扩展且物理一致的框架；但论文已被撤回，原因是存在影响主要结论的实质性方法错误。

papers.title: MambaX-Net: Dual-Input Mamba-Enhanced Cross-Attention Network for Longitudinal Prostate MRI Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Active Surveillance (AS) is a treatment option for managing low and intermediate-risk prostate cancer (PCa), aiming to avoid overtreatment while monitoring disease progression through serial MRI and clinical follow-up. Accurate prostate segmentation is an important preliminary step for automating this process, enabling automated detection and diagnosis of PCa. However, existing deep-learning segmentation models are often trained on single-time-point, expertly annotated datasets, making them unsuitable for longitudinal AS analysis, where multiple time points and a scarcity of expert labels hinder effective fine-tuning. To address these challenges, we propose MambaX-Net, a novel semi-supervised, dual-scan 3D segmentation architecture that computes the segmentation for time point t by leveraging the MRI and the corresponding segmentation mask from the previous time point. We introduce two new components: (i) a Mamba-enhanced Cross-Attention Module, which integrates the Mamba block into cross-attention to efficiently capture temporal evolution and long-range spatial dependencies, and (ii) a Shape Extractor Module that encodes the previous segmentation mask into a latent anatomical representation for refined zone delineation. Moreover, we use a semi-supervised self-training strategy that leverages pseudo-labels generated from a pre-trained nnU-Net, enabling effective learning without expert annotations. MambaX-Net was evaluated on a longitudinal AS dataset, and results showed that it significantly outperforms state-of-the-art U-Net and Transformer-based models, achieving superior prostate zone segmentation even when trained on limited and noisy data.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MambaX-Net，一种半监督、双输入（dual-scan）的 3D 分割架构，用于纵向前列腺 MRI 分割。网络利用前一时间点的 MRI 与对应分割掩码来计算当前时间点的分割，并引入 Mamba 增强的交叉注意力模块与形状提取器模块，同时采用基于预训练 nnU-Net 伪标签的半监督自训练策略。在纵向主动监测（AS）数据集上，该方法显著优于 U-Net 和 Transformer 类 SOTA 模型，即使训练数据有限且含噪声也能获得更好的前列腺分区分割。
Motivation: 现有深度学习分割模型通常基于单时间点、专家标注的数据集训练，难以适配纵向 AS 分析中多时间点与专家标签稀缺的实际情况，阻碍自动化监测流程的建立。
Method: 提出 MambaX-Net，包含两个新组件：Mamba 增强的交叉注意力模块（将 Mamba 块集成到交叉注意力中，以捕捉时间演变与长距离空间依赖）和形状提取器模块（将前一分割掩码编码为潜在解剖表示以细化分区）。训练采用半监督自训练，利用预训练 nnU-Net 生成的伪标签，避免依赖专家标注。
Result: 在纵向 AS 数据集上的评估显示，MambaX-Net 显著优于基于 U-Net 和 Transformer 的现有模型，即便在有限且有噪声的训练数据下仍能实现更优的前列腺分区分割。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，利用前一时间点信息的双输入机制、形状先验与半监督伪标签策略可以有效缓解专家标签稀缺问题，支撑纵向前列腺癌主动监测的自动化分析。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Bidding Games: Reinforcement Learning for MEV Extraction on Polygon Blockchain
papers.abstract_en: In blockchain networks, the strategic ordering of transactions within blocks has emerged as a significant source of profit extraction, known as Maximal Extractable Value (MEV). The transition from spam-based Priority Gas Auctions (PGA) to structured auction mechanisms like Polygon Atlas has transformed MEV extraction from public bidding wars into sealed-bid competitions under extreme time constraints. While this shift reduces network congestion, it introduces complex strategic challenges where searchers must make optimal bidding decisions within a sub-second window without knowledge of competitor behavior or presence. Traditional equilibrium-based game-theoretic models struggle in this high-frequency, partially observable environment. While auction theory provides equilibrium solutions for sealed-bid formats under incomplete information, these models typically assume known bidder value distributions and stationary competition--assumptions that are difficult to satisfy in dynamic, sub-second auctions where competitor presence and strategies evolve rapidly. We present a reinforcement learning framework for MEV extraction on Polygon Atlas and make three contributions: (1) A novel simulation environment that accurately models the stochastic arrival of arbitrage opportunities and probabilistic competition in Atlas auctions; (2) A PPO-based bidding agent optimized for real-time constraints, capable of adaptive strategy formulation in continuous action spaces while maintaining production-ready inference speeds; (3) Empirical validation demonstrating our history-conditioned agent achieves 49\% Maximum-Profit Capture when deployed alongside existing searchers and a 43\% relative profit improvement over the historical market leader in counterfactual replacement, significantly outperforming static bidding strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为 Polygon Atlas 上的最大可提取价值 (MEV) 提取提出一个强化学习 (reinforcement learning, RL) 框架。摘要报告了三项贡献：准确建模套利机会随机到达与竞争概率的模拟环境、面向实时约束的 PPO 出价智能体，以及历史条件化智能体的实证验证。结果表明该智能体与现有搜索者共同部署时可实现 49% 的最大利润捕获 (Maximum-Profit Capture)，在反事实替换中相对历史市场领导者提升 43% 的相对利润，显著优于静态出价策略。
Motivation: 从基于垃圾交易的 Priority Gas Auctions (PGA) 转向 Polygon Atlas 等密封拍卖后，搜索者必须在亚秒级窗口内、在无法获知竞争对手行为或是否存在的情况下做出最优出价。传统基于均衡的博弈论模型依赖已知估值分布与静态竞争假设，难以适用于这种高频、部分可观测的动态环境。
Method: 提出一个 RL 框架，包含三部分：(1) 模拟 Atlas 拍卖中套利机会随机到达与概率竞争的仿真环境；(2) 基于 PPO 的出价智能体，支持连续动作空间中的自适应策略，并保持生产级推理速度；(3) 历史条件化 (history-conditioned) 智能体设计。
Result: 摘要报告经验验证结果：历史条件化智能体在与现有搜索者共同部署时达到 49% 的最大利润捕获；在反事实替换场景中，相对利润比历史市场领导者提升 43%，并显著超越静态出价策略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RL 方法能够在亚秒级密封拍卖环境中形成自适应出价策略，从而有效提升 MEV 提取利润；该框架针对 Polygon Atlas 拍卖机制构建。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SUM-AgriVLN: Spatial Understanding Memory for Agricultural Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Agricultural robots are emerging as powerful assistants across a wide range of agricultural tasks, nevertheless, they are still heavily relying on manual operations or fixed railways for movement. The A2A benchmark and the AgriVLN method pioneeringly extended Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) to the agricultural domain, successfully navigating agricultural robots from starting points to target positions following natural language instructions, while we observed a limitation: In practical agricultural scenarios, users often give repetitive instructions, but AgriVLN treats every instruction as an independent episode, overlooking the potential to use past spatial memories to assist present episodes. To address this limitation, we propose the SUM module, which executes spatial understanding via 3D reconstructions and saves spatial memories via 2D representations from the past, thereby assisting the decision-maker to recall the spatial characteristics of the scenes in the present. We integrate it into the AgriVLN backbone to build the SUM-AgriVLN method. When evaluated on A2A, it effectively improves SR from 0.47 to 0.54 with only slight sacrifice on NE from 2.91 m to 2.93 m, demonstrating the state-of-the-art performance in the agricultural VLN domain. Code: https://github.com/AlexTraveling/SUM-AgriVLN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SUM-AgriVLN，将空间理解与记忆模块（SUM）集成到农业视觉-语言导航（VLN）框架 AgriVLN 中。SUM 通过 3D 重建执行空间理解，并以 2D 表征保存过去的空间记忆，辅助当前导航决策。在 A2A 基准上，SR 从 0.47 提升到 0.54，NE 从 2.91 m 微增至 2.93 m，达到农业 VLN 领域的当前最优性能。
Motivation: 在真实农业场景中，用户常给出重复指令，但现有 AgriVLN 方法将每条指令视为独立 episode，未利用过去场景的空间记忆来帮助当前导航。
Method: 提出 SUM 模块，通过 3D 重建实现空间理解，并将过去场景的空间特征以 2D 表征保存，从而让决策者在当前 episode 中回忆相关空间信息；该模块被集成到 AgriVLN 主干中构成 SUM-AgriVLN。
Result: 在 A2A 基准上，SR 从 0.47 提升至 0.54，NE 从 2.91 m 略微上升至 2.93 m，摘要称其为农业 VLN 领域的 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 作者认为跨 episode 的空间记忆能够有效改善农业场景下的 VLN 导航性能，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rényi Sharpness: A Novel Sharpness that Strongly Correlates with Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Sharpness (of the loss minima) is widely believed to be a good indicator of generalization of neural networks. Unfortunately, the correlation between existing sharpness measures and generalization is not as strong as expected, and sometimes even contradiction occurs. To address this problem, a key observation in this paper is: what really matters for generalization is the average spread (or unevenness) of the spectrum of loss Hessian $\mathbf{H}$. For this reason, conventional sharpness measures, such as trace sharpness $\operatorname{tr}(\mathbf{H})$, which cares about the average value of the spectrum, or max-eigenvalue sharpness $λ_{\max}(\mathbf{H})$, which concerns the maximum spread of the spectrum, are not sufficient to well predict generalization. To characterize the average spread of the Hessian spectrum, we leverage the notion of Rényi entropy in information theory, which captures the unevenness of a probability vector and can thus be extended to a general non-negative vector, such as the Hessian spectrum at loss minima. Specifically, we propose Rényi sharpness, defined as the negative of the Rényi entropy of loss Hessian $\mathbf{H}$. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Rényi sharpness exhibits strong and consistent correlation with generalization in various scenarios. Moreover, two generalization bounds with respect to Rényi sharpness are established by exploiting its desirable reparametrization invariance property. Finally, as an initial attempt to exploit Rényi sharpness for regularization, Rényi Sharpness Aware Minimization (RSAM) is proposed, where a variant of Rényi sharpness is used as the regularizer. RSAM is competitive with state-of-the-art SAM algorithms and far better than conventional SAM based on max-eigenvalue sharpness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Rényi sharpness，一种基于损失 Hessian 谱的 Rényi 熵来刻画谱平均分散程度的新锐度度量，用于预测神经网络泛化性能。实验显示该度量与泛化在多种场景下强相关，并建立了两个基于重参数化不变性的泛化界；进一步提出 Rényi Sharpness Aware Minimization (RSAM) 作为正则化方法，与现有 SAM 算法相比有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有锐度度量（如迹锐度 tr(H) 和最大特征值锐度 λmax(H)）分别只关注 Hessian 谱的平均值和最大展布，未能充分刻画影响泛化的谱平均不均匀性，导致与泛化相关性不强甚至出现矛盾。
Method: 利用信息论中的 Rényi 熵刻画 Hessian 谱在损失极小值处的不均匀性，将其取负定义为 Rényi sharpness；利用其重参数化不变性推导泛化界，并以此为规则化项提出 RSAM 优化算法。
Result: 大量实验表明 Rényi sharpness 在多种场景下与泛化呈现强且一致的关联；RSAM 与最先进的 SAM 算法相当，且明显优于基于最大特征值锐度的传统 SAM。
Conclusion: 摘要强调谱的平均分散程度才是与泛化更相关的锐度刻画，Rényi sharpness 为泛化预测与正则化提供了新工具；本文仅是将其用于正则化的初步尝试。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Merge Now, Regret Later: The Hidden Cost of Model Merging Is Adversarial Transferability
papers.abstract_en: Model Merging (MM) has proven to be an effective alternative to multi-task learning, where several fine-tuned models are merged, without access to the tasks' training data, into one model that retains performance across different tasks. Recent works have explored the security of MM, showing how MM can confer robustness against various adversarial attacks. However, none of them has sufficiently explored its impact on transfer attacks using transferable adversarial examples. In this work, we study the effect of MM on the transferability of adversarial examples. We perform comprehensive evaluations and statistical analysis consisting of eight MM methods, seven datasets, and six attack methods, sweeping over 336 distinct attack settings. Through it, we first challenge the prevailing notion of MM conferring free adversarial robustness, and show that MM cannot reliably defend against transfer attacks, with over 80% transfer rate. Moreover, we reveal two key insights for machine-learning practitioners regarding MM and transferability for a robust system design: (1) stronger MM methods increase vulnerability to transfer attacks and (2) mitigating representation bias increases vulnerability to transfer attacks. We also find weight averaging as an exception to (1), i.e., it is found to be the most vulnerable method to transfer attacks, despite being the weakest MM method. Finally, we analyze the underlying reasons for these findings, show how an adversary with limited information could launch an attack, and provide potential solutions. These findings offer actionable insights for deploying MM in security-sensitive machine-learning systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at The 29th International Symposium on Research in Attacks, Intrusions and Defenses (RAID 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究模型合并 (Model Merging, MM) 对对抗样本可迁移性 (adversarial example transferability) 的影响。作者在 8 种 MM 方法、7 个数据集、6 种攻击方法、共 336 种攻击设置下进行综合评估与统计分析，发现 MM 无法可靠防御迁移攻击，迁移率超过 80%。他们还揭示两个反直觉结论：更强的 MM 方法反而增加对迁移攻击的脆弱性，缓解表征偏差也会增加脆弱性；权重平均 (weight averaging) 是例外，尽管是最弱的 MM 方法，却最易受迁移攻击。
Motivation: 近期工作展示了 MM 能为模型带来对抗鲁棒性，但尚未充分探索 MM 对使用可迁移对抗样本的迁移攻击的影响。这一缺口关系到安全敏感机器学习系统中 MM 的可靠性，值得专门研究。
Method: 采用大规模交叉评估框架，覆盖 8 种 MM 方法、7 个数据集、6 种攻击方法，共 336 种攻击设置，并辅以统计分析；进一步分析了脆弱性背后的原因，构造有限信息条件下的攻击场景，并给出潜在解决方案。
Result: 摘要报告 MM 在超过 80% 的迁移率下无法可靠防御迁移攻击；更强的 MM 方法增加脆弱性，缓解表征偏差也增加脆弱性；权重平均是最弱的 MM 方法却最易受迁移攻击。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现为在安全敏感机器学习系统中部署 MM 提供了可操作的洞见。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GraphPFN: A Prior-Data Fitted Graph Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Graph foundation models face several fundamental challenges including transferability across diverse domains and data scarcity, which calls into question the very feasibility of creating such models. However, despite similar challenges, the tabular domain has recently witnessed the emergence of the first successful foundation models such as TabPFN. These models are based on the prior-data fitted networks (PFN) framework, in which models are pretrained on carefully designed synthetic datasets to make predictions in an in-context learning setting. Recently, G2T-FM, a framework that converts graph node-level tasks into tabular tasks, has made the first step towards adopting PFNs for graphs, yet it is limited to hand-crafted features and was never pretrained on graph data. In this work, we make the next step by proposing GraphPFN, a PFN-based model designed and pretrained specifically for graph node-level tasks. Following the PFN framework, we first design a prior distribution of synthetic attributed graphs by using a novel combination of multi-level stochastic block models and a preferential attachment process for structure generation and graph-aware structured causal models for attribute generation. Then, we augment the tabular foundation model LimiX with attention-based graph neighborhood aggregation layers and train it on millions of synthetic graphs sampled from our prior. On diverse real-world graph datasets with node-level tasks, GraphPFN achieves state-of-the-art results in both in-context learning and finetuning regimes, outperforming G2T-FM, prior GFMs, and task-specific GNNs trained from scratch. More broadly, GraphPFN shows the potential of PFN-based models for building graph foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GraphPFN，一种基于 prior-data fitted networks (PFN) 框架、专门针对图节点级任务设计和预训练的图基础模型。作者结合多水平随机块模型与优先连接过程生成图结构，并用图感知的结构因果模型生成属性，从而构造合成属性图的先验分布；随后将表格基础模型 LimiX 与基于注意力的图邻域聚合层结合，在数百万合成图上预训练。在多样真实图数据集的节点级任务上，GraphPFN 在 in-context learning 和 finetuning 两种设置下均取得最优结果，超过 G2T-FM、此前图基础模型以及从头训练的任务专用 GNN。
Motivation: 图基础模型面临跨领域迁移性和数据稀缺等根本挑战，其可行性本身受到质疑；此前 G2T-FM 将图节点任务转化为表格任务，但仅使用手工特征且从未在图数据上预训练。本文目标是朝 PFN 用于图的方向迈出下一步，直接为图节点级任务设计和预训练一个 PFN 模型。
Method: 遵循 PFN 框架，先设计合成属性图的先验分布：结构生成采用多水平随机块模型与优先连接过程的新组合，属性生成采用图感知的结构因果模型；再将表格基础模型 LimiX 扩展以注意力机制图邻域聚合层，并在从该先验采样的数百万合成图上预训练 GraphPFN。
Result: 在多个真实图数据集的节点级任务上，GraphPFN 在 in-context learning 与 finetuning 两种设置下均达到 state-of-the-art，优于 G2T-FM、此前的图基础模型以及从头训练的任务专用 GNN。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GraphPFN 表明基于 PFN 的模型有潜力用于构建图基础模型，其适用范围为图节点级任务。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在多个真实图数据集的节点级任务上，GraphPFN 在 in-context learning 与 finetuning 两种设置下均达到 state-of-the-art，优于 G2T-FM、此前的图基础模型以及从头训练的任务专用 GNN。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 GraphPFN 表明基于 PFN 的模型有潜力用于构建图基础模型，其适用范围为图节点级任务。

papers.title: Gen AI in Proof-based Math Courses: A Pilot Study
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid rise of generative AI in higher education, understanding how students use AI is increasingly important. This exploratory study examines student use and perceptions of generative AI across three proof-based undergraduate mathematics courses: a first-semester abstract algebra course, a topology course, and a second-semester abstract algebra course. In each case, course policy permitted some use of generative AI. Drawing on survey responses and student interviews, we analyze how students engaged with AI tools as well as their perceptions of generative AI's usefulness, accuracy and limitations.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, Revised Version. Comments welcome!
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: DiverValue-Bench: A Benchmark and Fine-Tuning Framework for Aligning Large Language Models with Diverse Human Values
papers.abstract_en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse human values is essential for safe and effective deployment, yet existing benchmarks often overlook cultural and demographic variation. We introduce DiverValue-Bench, a population-aware benchmark for evaluating multi-dimensional value alignment across 74 countries/regions. It contains 23,763 quality-controlled instances derived from PRISM user feedback and audited through large-scale human validation, with fine-grained value labels, personalized questions, contrastive reference answers, and rich demographic metadata. Using DiverValue-Bench, we evaluate representative LLMs and reveal substantial geographic and demographic disparities that are masked by aggregate performance. We further show that lightweight preference-based fine-tuning with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) substantially improves in-domain value alignment while yielding consistent out-of-domain gains. These results highlight the need for population-aware alignment evaluation and demonstrate the utility of DiverValue-Bench as a practical foundation for global alignment, personalized value modeling, and equitable AI development.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to IJCAI-ECAI 2026 (Human-Centred AI Special Track). v2: Updated to the camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiverValue-Bench，一个覆盖 74 个国家/地区的人群感知 (population-aware) 的 LLM 多维价值观对齐基准，包含 23,763 条源自 PRISM 用户反馈并经大规模人工验证的质量受控实例，带有细粒度价值标签、个性化问题、对比参考答案和丰富的人口统计元数据。作者用该基准评估代表性 LLM，发现聚合性能会掩盖显著的地理与人口差异；并证明基于 LoRA 和 DPO 的轻量偏好微调能大幅提升域内对齐，同时带来一致的域外 (out-of-domain) 增益。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 对齐基准往往忽视文化与人口统计差异，难以支撑安全有效且面向多样化人群的部署，因此需要能反映人群差异的对齐评估工具。
Method: 构建基于 PRISM 用户反馈、经大规模人工验证的基准 DiverValue-Bench，提供细粒度价值标签、个性化问题、对比参考答案与人口统计元数据；在此基础上评估代表性 LLM，并采用 LoRA + DPO 的轻量偏好微调方案检验对齐改进。
Result: 摘要报告发现显著的地理与人口层级差异被聚合性能指标掩盖；轻量偏好微调（LoRA 与 DPO）在域内价值对齐上取得实质性提升，并产生一致的域外增益。
Conclusion: 作者强调人群感知的对齐评估不可或缺，并认为 DiverValue-Bench 可作为全球对齐、个性化价值建模与公平 AI 发展的实用基础。

papers.title: Decoupling High and Low Frequencies for Faithful Image Generation with Fine Details
papers.abstract_en: Latent generative models compress images into learned embeddings prior to synthesis, and the generation quality critically depends on how faithfully these embeddings preserve visual detail. We observe that while such embeddings are effective at reconstructing low frequency structure, they struggle to recover sharp high frequency details that are essential for perceptual realism. Conventional reconstruction objectives implicitly prioritize coarse structural information over high frequency content, which can lead to overly smoothed outputs and degraded visual quality in textured regions. Motivated by this observation, we propose DeBaT, a Decoupled frequency Band Tokenizer that explicitly separates the learning of low and high frequency band embeddings. This decoupling enables accurate reconstruction of fine details while preserving global coherence. Integrated into a latent diffusion based generative model, DeBaT allows for sharper and more realistic samples than previous latent tokenizers, confirming that the explicit decoupling of high and low frequency bands eases the preservation of visual details in learned embedding spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文关注潜变量生成模型中嵌入表示对视觉细节的保真度问题，指出现有嵌入能较好重建低频结构但难以恢复对感知真实性至关重要的高频细节。作者提出 DeBaT（Decoupled frequency Band Tokenizer），显式分离低頻与高频频带嵌入的学习，并将其集成到基于潜变量扩散的生成模型中。摘要报告该方法相比之前的潜变量 tokenizer 能生成更锐利、更真实的样本。
Motivation: 潜变量生成模型在压缩图像时，常规重建目标隐式地偏向粗粒度结构信息，导致高频细节丢失，产生过度平滑的输出并降低纹理区域的视觉质量。
Method: 提出 DeBaT tokenizer，将低频和高频频带嵌入的学习显式解耦，使模型在保持全局一致性的同时准确重建细节，并集成到潜变量扩散生成模型中。
Result: 摘要报告集成 DeBaT 后的模型能生成比此前潜变量 tokenizer 更锐利、更真实的样本。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式解耦高頻与低頻频带能够降低在学得嵌入空间中保留视觉细节的难度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Why Can't I See My Clusters? A Precision-Recall Approach to Dimensionality Reduction Validation
authors: Diede P. M. van der Hoorn
papers.abstract_en: Dimensionality Reduction (DR) is widely used for visualizing high-dimensional data, often with the goal of revealing expected cluster structure. However, such a structure may not always appear in the projections. Existing DR quality metrics assess projection reliability (to some extent) or cluster structure quality, but do not explain why expected structures are missing. Visual Analytics solutions can help, but are often time-consuming due to the large hyperparameter space. This paper addresses this problem by leveraging a recent framework that divides the DR process into two phases: a relationship phase, where similarity relationships are modeled, and a mapping phase, where the data is projected accordingly. We introduce two supervised metrics, precision and recall, to evaluate the relationship phase. These metrics quantify how well the modeled relationships align with an expected cluster structure based on some set of labels representing this structure. We illustrate their application using t-SNE and UMAP, and validate the approach through various usage scenarios. Our approach can guide hyperparameter tuning, uncover projection artifacts, and determine if the expected structure is captured in the relationships, making the DR process faster and more reliable.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics (TVCG)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对降维 (Dimensionality Reduction, DR) 可视化中预期簇结构不出现的问题，基于将 DR 过程分为关系建模 (relationship phase) 和映射 (mapping phase) 两阶段的框架，提出两个有监督指标 precision 和 recall 来评估关系阶段。作者用 t-SNE 和 UMAP 示例说明，并通过多个使用场景验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有的 DR 质量指标要么评估投影可靠性，要么评估簇结构质量，但无法解释为什么预期的簇结构没有出现在投影中；视觉分析方案往往因超参数空间过大而耗时。
Method: 利用两阶段 DR 框架，引入有监督的 precision 和 recall 指标，量化关系阶段建模的相似关系与由标签表示的期望簇结构之间的对齐程度，并以此指导超参数调优。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 t-SNE 和 UMAP 上得到应用，并在多种使用场景中验证，能够指导超参数调优、揭示投影伪影 (projection artifacts)，并判断期望结构是否已在关系阶段被捕获。
Conclusion: 该方法使 DR 过程更快、更可靠，但摘要未报告具体量化数值或与传统指标的对比细节。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Computational Phenomenology of Borderline Personality Disorder: A Comparative Evaluation of LLM-Simulated Expert Personas and Human Clinical Experts
papers.abstract_en: Building on a human-led thematic analysis of clinical life-story interviews (> 150,000 words) with inpatients with Borderline Personality Disorder, this study examines the capacity of large language models (OpenAI's GPT, Google's Gemini, and Anthropic's Claude) to support qualitative clinical analysis. The models' interpretative potential was evaluated using a mixed-methods approach. Study A involved blinded and non-blinded judges in phenomenology and clinical psychology. The experts assessed the validity of AI-generated content using semantic congruence, Jaccard coefficients, and multidimensional validity ratings, including credibility, coherence, the substantiveness of results, and grounding in qualitative data. In Study B, neural methods were used to embed human- and model-generated theme descriptions in a multidimensional vector space. This approach provided an objectified computational measure of the difference between human and model semantics and linguistic style. In Study C, complementary non-expert evaluations were conducted (N=115) to examine the influence of thematic verbosity on the perception of human authorship and content validity. Overall, the results of AI analysis showed a highly variable overlap (0-58%) with the human interpretation, while all models identified themes originally omitted by human researchers, proving their capacity to mitigate human bias. At the thematic level, external evaluators were unable to reliably distinguish human-authored themes from those generated by AI. In terms of content validity assessed against raw data by high-level experts in the blinded mode, the performance of Gemini 2.5 Pro was indistinguishable from that of humans. The comparison of semantic vector embeddings showed that its style was also the closest to humans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估大语言模型（OpenAI GPT、Google Gemini、Anthropic Claude）在边缘型人格障碍（Borderline Personality Disorder）临床生活史访谈主题分析中的解释能力，以人类主导的主题分析（超过 15 万字）为基准，采用三个混合方法研究进行比较。结果发现 AI 分析与人解释的重叠变化很大（0-58%），但所有模型都识别出人类研究者遗漏的主题；外部评估者无法可靠区分人类与 AI 生成的主题；在盲评模式下，Gemini 2.5 Pro 的内容效度与人类无差异，且其语义向量嵌入风格最接近人类。
Motivation: 定性临床分析高度依赖人工且存在研究者主观偏见的风险，需要验证 LLM 能否可靠地支持此类分析，并厘清模型输出与人类专家解释在语义和风格上的差异。
Method: 采用混合方法：研究 A 由现象学和临床心理学专家在盲法和非盲法条件下评估 AI 生成内容的有效性，使用语义一致性（semantic congruence）、Jaccard 系数和多维有效性评分（可信度、连贯性、结果实质性、数据基础）；研究 B 用神经嵌入方法将人类和模型生成的主题描述映射到多维向量空间，以客观计算语义和语言风格差异；研究 C 用 115 名非专家评估者检验主题冗长程度对人类作者感知和内容有效性的影响。
Result: AI 分析结果与人类解释的重叠率为 0-58%；所有模型均能识别出人类遗漏的主题；外部评估者无法可靠区分人类与 AI 生成的主题；盲评内容效度上 Gemini 2.5 Pro 与人类表现不可区分，且其语义嵌入风格最接近人类。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 LLM 在定性临床分析中具有辅助能力并能缓解人类偏见，但各模型表现差异大，仅部分模型在特定指标上达到与人类无差异的水平。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明 LLM 在定性临床分析中具有辅助能力并能缓解人类偏见，但各模型表现差异大，仅部分模型在特定指标上达到与人类无差异的水平。

papers.title: GridCodex: A RAG-Driven AI Framework for Power Grid Code Reasoning and Compliance
papers.abstract_en: The global shift towards renewable energy presents unprecedented challenges for the electricity industry, making regulatory reasoning and compliance increasingly vital. Grid codes, the regulations governing grid operations, are complex and often lack automated interpretation solutions, which hinders industry expansion and undermines profitability for electricity companies. We introduce GridCodex, an end to end framework for grid code reasoning and compliance that leverages large language models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Our framework advances conventional RAG workflows through multi stage query refinement and enhanced retrieval with RAPTOR. We validate the effectiveness of GridCodex with comprehensive benchmarks, including automated answer assessment across multiple dimensions and regulatory agencies. Experimental results showcase a 26.4% improvement in answer quality and more than a 10 fold increase in recall rate. An ablation study further examines the impact of base model selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GridCodex，一个面向电网规范推理与合规的端到端框架，基于大语言模型 (LLM) 与检索增强生成 (RAG)。该框架在传统 RAG 流程上引入多阶段查询精化 (multi-stage query refinement) 和基于 RAPTOR 的增强检索。摘要报告在面向多个监管机构的自动化答案评估基准上，答案质量提升 26.4%，召回率提升超过 10 倍，并包含基座模型选择的消融研究。
Motivation: 全球能源转型使电网规范推理与合规日益重要，而电网规范 (grid codes) 复杂且缺乏自动化解释方案，阻碍电力行业扩张并影响电力公司盈利能力。
Method: 提出 GridCodex 端到端框架，利用 LLM 和 RAG，并通过多阶段查询精化与 RAPTOR 增强检索来改进传统 RAG 工作流。
Result: 在包含多个评估维度和多个监管机构的自动化答案评估基准上，答案质量提升 26.4%，召回率提升超过 10 倍；消融研究进一步分析基座模型选择的影响。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GridCodex 能有效提升电网规范推理与合规任务的答案质量和召回率；具体局限未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: On the limits of Taylor hypothesis in forest clearcut flow: Effects of random sweeping and an elliptic model analysis
papers.abstract_en: Taylor's hypothesis (TH) converts temporal observations to spatial information of the flow while carrying out measurements on a micrometeorological tower. Other than TH, there exists a more general elliptic model, which converts time to space by focusing on the geometry of the space-time correlation function. In elliptic model, TH is recovered when the space-time correlation functions are straight lines and when TH is invalid, they are approximated as elliptic curves. To test whether TH or an elliptic model was appropriate for a highly heterogeneous forest clearcut flow, we examined the geometry of the space-time correlation function of temperature by using an extensive distributed temperature sensing (DTS) dataset collected during daytime convective conditions at a height of 3.1 m above the clearing. This was complemented with an eddy covariance (EC) dataset that measured the turbulence characteristics. When the mean wind was parallel to a nearby forest edge, the DTS-derived space-time correlation function of temperature fluctuations resembled elliptic curves, rather than straight lines as predicted by TH. Due to large turbulence intensities, the curvatures in the space-time correlation contours were caused by the random sweeping events associated with large-scale eddies that invalidated the frozen turbulence assumption in TH. The velocity scale of these sweeping events correlated with the turbulence kinetic energy of the clearcut flow, thereby lending support to the random sweeping hypothesis. Upon converting time to space through an elliptic and TH-based scaling, our results demonstrated that both temporal DTS and EC temperature measurements were impacted by the random sweeping events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究森林采伐迹地（forest clearcut）高度非均匀流动中 Taylor 假设（TH）的适用性，利用分布式温度传感（DTS）和涡度相关（EC）数据检验空间-时间相关函数的几何形状。摘要表明，当平均风平行于林缘时，温度起伏的空间-时间相关函数呈椭圆曲线而非 TH 预测的直线，大尺度涡旋引起的随机扫掠事件（random sweeping）使冻结湍流假设失效，扫掠速度尺度与流动的湍流动能相关。
Motivation: Taylor 假设通常用于将单点时间观测转换为空间信息，但在森林采伐迹地这类高度异质、湍流强度大的流动中可能失效；因此需要检验更一般的椭圆模型（elliptic model）是否更恰当地描述空间-时间相关结构。
Method: 作者在采伐迹地上方 3.1 m 高度、白天对流条件下，利用大规模分布式温度传感（DTS）数据集测量温度的空间-时间相关函数几何形状，并以涡度相关（EC）数据补充湍流特征；比较 Taylor 假设与椭圆模型两种时间-空间转换框架。
Result: 当平均风平行于附近林缘时，DTS 导出的温度起伏空间-时间相关函数呈现椭圆曲线而非直线；随机扫掠事件的流速尺度与采伐迹地流动的湍流动能相关，支持随机扫掠假设；基于椭圆模型和 TH 的缩放均显示 DTS 与 EC 温度测量受随机扫掠事件影响。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在强湍流、非均匀的采伐迹地流动中，Taylor 假设因冻结湍流假设失效而受限，椭圆模型更适合描述该流动的时间-空间转换。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: CKAA: Cross-subspace Knowledge Alignment and Aggregation for Robust Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual Learning (CL) empowers AI models to continuously learn from sequential task streams. Recently, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT)-based CL methods have garnered increasing attention due to their superior performance. They typically allocate a unique sub-module for learning each task, with a task recognizer to select the appropriate sub-modules for testing images. However, due to the feature subspace misalignment from independently trained sub-modules, these methods tend to produce ambiguous decisions under misleading task-ids. To address this, we propose Cross-subspace Knowledge Alignment and Aggregation (CKAA), a novel framework that enhances model robustness against misleading task-ids through two key innovations: (1) Dual-level Knowledge Alignment (DKA): By aligning intra-class feature distributions across different subspaces and learning a robust global classifier through a feature simulation process, DKA enables the model to distinguish features from both correct and incorrect subspaces during training. (2) Task-Confidence-guided Mixture of Adapters (TC-MoA): A robust inference scheme that adaptively aggregates task-specific knowledge from relevant sub-modules based on task-confidence scores, avoiding overconfidence in misleading task-id predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CKAA outperforms existing PEFT-based CL methods. Code is available at https://github.com/HHHLF/CKAA_TIP2026.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing (TIP), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 PEFT 类持续学习 (Continual Learning) 方法在误导性任务 ID 下决策模糊的问题，提出 CKAA 框架。其核心是通过双层次知识对齐 (DKA) 对齐不同子空间中的类内特征分布，并借助特征模拟过程学习鲁棒全局分类器；同时提出任务置信度引导的适配器混合 (TC-MoA)，在推理时根据任务置信度分数自适应聚合相关子模块的知识。实验表明 CKAA 优于现有 PEFT-based CL 方法，代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有 PEFT-based CL 方法通常为每个任务分配独立子模块，并依赖任务识别器选择测试图像对应的子模块；但由于各子模块独立训练导致特征子空间不对齐，这些方法在误导性任务 ID 下会产生模糊决策，影响鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 CKAA 框架，包含两项创新：(1) 双层次知识对齐 (Dual-level Knowledge Alignment, DKA)，对齐不同子空间内同类特征分布，并通过特征模拟过程学习鲁棒全局分类器，使模型在训练中能区分来自正确与错误子空间的特征；(2) 任务置信度引导的适配器混合 (Task-Confidence-guided Mixture of Adapters, TC-MoA)，一种推理方案，基于任务置信度分数自适应地聚合相关子模块的任务特定知识，避免对误导性任务 ID 预测过度自信。
Result: 大量实验表明，CKAA 在性能上超过现有 PEFT-based 持续学习方法；具体数值和基准细节在摘要中未给出。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过跨子空间的知识对齐与聚合可以增强模型对误导性任务 ID 的鲁棒性，并注明代码可在 GitHub 获取。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PrefixAgent: An LLM-Powered Design Framework for Efficient Prefix Adder Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Prefix adders are fundamental arithmetic circuits, but their design space grows exponentially with bit-width, posing significant optimization challenges. Previous works face limitations in performance, generalization, and scalability. To address these challenges, we propose PrefixAgent, an LLM-powered framework that enables efficient prefix adder optimization. Firstly, we reformulate the problem into two subtasks, namely backbone synthesis and structure refinement, which effectively reduce the search space. The LLM performs these two phases of optimization by invoking tools through function calls, enabling it to iteratively construct the backbone and refine local structures based on reasoning and EDA feedback. Secondly, this new design perspective allows us to systematically collect large-scale, high-quality supervision data. We leverage the rewriting and equality saturation capabilities of e-graphs to comprehensively explore the prefix adder solution space. In addition, the explainability of e-graphs enables us to extract fine-grained rewrite trajectories, which serve as interpretable and effective training data. PrefixAgent is then fine-tuned on this dataset, significantly enhancing its optimization ability and reasoning generalization. Experimental results show that PrefixAgent synthesizes prefix adders with smaller areas than baseline methods in nearly all configurations, with the advantage growing at larger bit-widths, and it remains effective under a commercial EDA flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrefixAgent 是一个基于 LLM 的前缀加法器（prefix adder）优化框架，把指数级增长的设计空间问题拆解为骨干综合（backbone synthesis）与结构精化（structure refinement）两个子任务，并通过函数调用让 LLM 依据推理和 EDA 反馈迭代优化。作者利用 e-graph 的改写与等式饱和（equality saturation）能力系统收集大规模高质量数据，并借助其可解释性提取细粒度改写轨迹作为训练数据。实验表明，PrefixAgent 在几乎所有配置下合成的前缀加法器面积都小于基线方法，位宽越大优势越明显，且在商业 EDA 流程下仍然有效。
Motivation: 前缀加法器是基础算术电路，但设计空间随位宽指数增长，现有方法在性能、泛化性和可扩展性上存在局限。
Method: 将优化问题重新建模为骨干综合与结构精化两个子任务，由 LLM 通过函数调用调用工具，基于推理与 EDA 反馈迭代构建骨干并精化局部结构；同时利用 e-graph 的改写与等式饱和能力收集大规模监督数据，并利用其可解释性提取细粒度改写轨迹用于微调 PrefixAgent。
Result: 实验结果显示，PrefixAgent 在几乎所有配置下都比基线方法综合出更小面积的前缀加法器，且优势随位宽增大而扩大，在商业 EDA 流程下保持有效。
Conclusion: 本文提出用 LLM 驱动的两阶段框架结合 e-graph 生成的可解释训练数据，以提升前缀加法器优化的能力与推理泛化性。

papers.title: The Thousand Brains Theory 2.0: An Extension for the Long-Range Connections of the Neocortical Heterarchy
papers.abstract_en: Vernon Mountcastle hypothesized that the basis for intelligence in mammals is the replication of a general computational unit, the cortical column. The Thousand Brains Theory proposed that each column is a sensorimotor system, capable of learning structured models of objects by integrating sensory input over multiple movements. Previous papers on the Thousand Brains Theory focused on the computations that occur within individual cortical columns, and how columns can use long-range connections to rapidly reach a consensus. However, several prominent long-range connection types in the neocortex were not addressed by the theory. These include hierarchical feedforward and feedback connections, as well as those that go through the thalamus. In addition, several theoretical requirements were not addressed. These include how the cortex learns compositional objects, and how information is converted from the egocentric perspective of sensors to the allocentric perspective of models in the cortex. In this paper, we extend the Thousand Brains Theory to address these issues. We begin by reviewing the anatomy of long-range neocortical connections, arguing that they form a heterarchy, rather than hierarchy, which has made their functions challenging to understand through existing theoretical models. We then propose specific roles for each of these connections. First, the thalamus converts the orientation of features and movement information from an egocentric perspective to the allocentric perspective of learned models. Second, hierarchical feedforward, feedback, and cortico-thalamo-cortical projections enable columns to learn compositional models. We discuss the relationship of our proposals to experimental findings at the levels of anatomy, neurophysiology, and behavior, along with testable predictions for future experimental work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展千脑理论 (Thousand Brains Theory)，把大脑皮层中各类长程连接纳入统一框架。作者先梳理新皮层长程连接的解剖结构，并论证它们构成异质结构 (heterarchy) 而非传统层级 (hierarchy)；随后为丘脑连接以及层级前馈/反馈连接提出具体计算角色。摘要中没有给出实验数据或量化结果，属于理论性工作。
Motivation: 既有千脑理论主要关注单个皮层柱内部的传感器-运动计算以及柱之间通过长程连接达成共识，但未解释皮层如何学习组合对象 (compositional objects)、感受器的自我中心 (egocentric) 视角如何转换为模型的异我中心 (allocentric) 视角，也没有涵盖层级前馈/反馈连接和经丘脑的连接。
Method: 通过回顾新皮层长程连接的解剖学证据，论证其整体结构为异质结构而非层级结构，并提出两类具体机制：丘脑将特征朝向与运动信息的自我中心表示转换为异我中心模型表示；层级前馈、反馈及皮层-丘脑-皮层投射使皮层柱能够学习组合模型。
Result: 摘要没有报告具体数值或实验基准，主要贡献在于给出上述两类连接功能的理论假设，并在解剖、神经生理和行为层面讨论其与实验发现的关系，同时提出可供未来实验检验的预测。
Conclusion: 作者认为这一扩展补齐了千脑理论在长程连接、组合学习和参考系转换方面的空白，并把理论预测与多个层面的实验证据对接，以指导后续实验验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DeepConvContext: A Multi-Scale Approach to Timeseries Classification in Human Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Despite recognized limitations in modeling long-range temporal dependencies, Human Activity Recognition (HAR) has traditionally relied on a sliding window approach to segment labeled datasets. Deep learning models like the DeepConvLSTM typically classify each window independently, restricting learnable temporal context to within-window information and producing fragmented, temporally incoherent activity timelines. To address this constraint, we propose DeepConvContext, a multi-scale time series classification framework for HAR. Drawing inspiration from the vision-based Temporal Action Localization community, DeepConvContext models both intra- and inter-window temporal patterns separately by processing sequences of time-ordered windows. Across six widely-used HAR benchmarks, DeepConvContext achieves an average 5% improvement in F1-score and up to 18-point improvement in mAP over related approaches, while achieving latency and throughput comparable to prior methods that extend temporal context through hidden state propagation across batches. Our quantitative and qualitative analysis underline the importance of inter-window learning and show how it produces more coherent activity segments even in online prediction scenarios. Code to reproduce our experiments is publicly available via www.github.com/mariusbock/deepconvcontext.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepConvContext，一个面向人类活动识别（HAR）的多尺度时间序列分类框架，借鉴视觉领域时序动作定位（Temporal Action Localization）的思路，分别建模窗口内和窗口间的时间模式。传统滑动窗口方法对每个窗口独立分类，限制可学习上下文在窗口内部并产生时间上不连贯的活动片段，该方法通过处理时间有序的窗口序列来缓解这一问题。
Motivation: HAR 长期依赖滑动窗口分割数据集并独立分类每个窗口，导致可学习的时序上下文仅限于窗口内信息，产生碎片化且时间上不连贯的活动时间线，无法有效建模长程时间依赖。
Method: DeepConvContext 将时间序列分类建模为对时间有序窗口序列的处理，同时学习窗口内（intra-window）与窗口间（inter-window）的时间模式，以多尺度方式扩展时域上下文。
Result: 在六个广泛使用的 HAR 基准上，该方法平均 F1-score 提升约 5%，mAP 最高提升 18 个百分点，同时延迟和吞吐量与通过跨 batch 隐状态传播扩展时间上下文的既有方法相当。
Conclusion: 定量与定性分析表明窗口间学习对生成更连贯活动片段的重要性，且该方法在在线预测场景下同样有效；复现代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FermatSyn: SAM2-Enhanced Bidirectional Mamba with Isotropic Spiral Scanning for Multi-Modal Medical Image Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal medical image synthesis is pivotal for alleviating clinical data scarcity, yet existing methods fail to reconcile global anatomical consistency with high-fidelity local detail. We propose FermatSyn, which addresses three persistent limitations: (1) SAM2-based Prior Encoder that injects domain-aware anatomical knowledge via LoRA$^{+}$ efficient fine-tuning of a frozen SAM2 Vision Transformer; (2) Hierarchical Residual Downsampling Module (HRDM) coupled with a Cross-scale Integration Network (CIN) that preserves high-frequency lesion details and adaptively fuses global--local representations; and (3) continuity constrained Fermat Spiral Scanning strategy within a Bidirectional Fermat Scan Mamba (BFS-Mamba), constructing an approximately isotropic receptive field that substantially reduces the directional bias of raster or spiral serialization. Experiments on SynthRAD2023, BraTS2019, BraTS-MEN, and BraTS-MET show FermatSyn surpasses state-of-the-art methods in PSNR, SSIM, FID, and 3D structural consistency. Downstream segmentation on synthesized images yields no significant difference from real-image training ($p{>}0.05$), confirming clinical utility. Code is available at https://github.com/gatina-yone/FermatSyn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FermatSyn，一种面向多模态医学图像合成的方法，旨在同时保证全局解剖一致性与局部高保真细节。方法结合基于 SAM2 的先验编码器、分层残差下采样模块（HRDM）与跨尺度融合网络（CIN），并引入连续约束的费马螺旋扫描策略构造 Bidirectional Fermat Scan Mamba（BFS-Mamba），以近似各向同性感受野并降低序列化方向偏差。实验显示在 SynthRAD2023、BraTS2019、BraTS-MEN 与 BraTS-MET 上超过现有方法，且合成图像的后续分割与真实图像训练无显著差异。
Motivation: 现有多模态医学图像合成方法难以同时兼顾全局解剖一致性与高保真局部细节，且传统光栅或螺旋序列化方式存在方向性偏差。
Method: 提出 FermatSyn，包含三个关键组件：基于冻结 SAM2 Vision Transformer 并采用 LoRA+ 高效微调的先验编码器以注入领域感知解剖知识；HRDM 与 CIN 用于保留高频病灶细节并自适应融合全局-局部表示；以及受连续性约束的费马螺旋扫描策略配合 BFS-Mamba，构造近似各向同性感受野。
Result: 在 SynthRAD2023、BraTS2019、BraTS-MEN 和 BraTS-MET 上，FermatSyn 在 PSNR、SSIM、FID 和 3D 结构一致性上均超越现有方法；下游分割实验显示合成图像训练与真实图像训练无显著差异（p>0.05）。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 FermatSyn 能同时改善全局一致性与局部细节，并通过下游分割验证了临床可用性。

papers.title: ReynoldsFlow: Physics-Inspired Spatiotemporal Flow Representation for Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Video understanding has largely relied on deep spatiotemporal architectures, including 3D convolutional networks and optical flow (OF) based models. While effective, these methods are often computationally expensive and depend on heuristic motion representations that are sensitive to illumination, scale, and structural changes. To address these limitations, we propose ReynoldsFlow, a physics-inspired representation grounded in the Reynolds transport theorem (RTT) and Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition (HHD). ReynoldsFlow decomposes motion into curl-free (CF) and divergence-free (DF) components, providing a principled and interpretable characterization of scene dynamics. By coupling intensity information with decomposed motion cues, it produces dynamics-aware, texture-preserving features that boost downstream tasks such as pose estimation, action recognition, and tiny object detection. Lightweight and modular, ReynoldsFlow can be readily integrated into existing architectures. Experiments across diverse benchmarks show that ReynoldsFlow consistently matches or surpasses existing approaches, offering improved generalizability and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReynoldsFlow，一种受物理学启发的时空运动表示，基于雷诺输运定理 (RTT) 与亥姆霍兹-霍奇分解 (HHD)，将视频运动分解为无旋 (curl-free) 与无散 (divergence-free) 分量，并与强度信息耦合以生成兼顾动态与纹理的特征。该方法轻量、模块化，可嵌入现有架构，在姿态估计、动作识别、小目标检测等下游任务上匹配或超越现有方法，并据摘要称提升泛化性与计算效率。
Motivation: 现有视频理解方法依赖 3D 卷积和光流 (optical flow) 等表示，计算开销大，且启发式运动特征对光照、尺度和结构变化敏感，需要更高效、可解释且稳健的运动表示。
Method: 基于 RTT 与 HHD 构造 ReynoldsFlow，将运动分解为 curl-free 与 divergence-free 两个分量，再将强度信息与分解后的运动线索耦合，生成 dynamics-aware、texture-preserving 的特征；该表示轻量模块化，可方便地集成进现有架构。
Result: 在多个基准上的实验显示，ReynoldsFlow 一致地匹配或超过现有方法，并带来更好的泛化性和计算效率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该物理启发的表示为场景动态提供有原则、可解释的刻画，是一种轻量且模块化的视频理解增强方案，可作为现有架构的即插即用组件。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: HiFi-KPI: A Dataset for Hierarchical KPI Extraction from Earnings Filings
papers.abstract_en: Accurate tagging of earnings reports can yield significant short-term returns for stakeholders. The machine-readable inline eXtensible Business Reporting Language (iXBRL) is mandated for public financial filings. Yet, its complex, fine-grained taxonomy limits the cross-company transferability of tagged Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). To address this, we introduce the Hierarchical Financial Key Performance Indicator (HiFi-KPI) dataset, a large-scale corpus of 1.65M paragraphs and 198k unique, hierarchically organized labels linked to iXBRL taxonomies. HiFi-KPI supports multiple tasks and we evaluate three: KPI classification, KPI extraction, and structured KPI extraction. For rapid evaluation, we also release HiFi-KPI-Lite, a manually curated 8K paragraph subset. Baselines on HiFi-KPI-Lite show that encoder-based models achieve over 0.906 macro-F1 on classification, while Large Language Models (LLMs) reach 0.440 F1 on structured extraction. Finally, a qualitative analysis reveals that extraction errors primarily relate to dates. We open-source all code and data at https://github.com/aaunlp/HiFi-KPI.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2026), pages 441-455, Palma, Mallorca, Spain. ELRA, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层级金融关键绩效指标 (HiFi-KPI) 数据集，包含 165 万段文本和 19.8 万个与 iXBRL 分类体系关联的层级标签，支持 KPI 分类、KPI 抽取和结构化 KPI 抽取三个任务。作者同时发布人工整理的 8K 段子集 HiFi-KPI-Lite，基线结果显示编码器模型在分类任务上 macro-F1 超过 0.906，而大语言模型 (LLM) 在结构化抽取上达到 0.440 F1；定性分析表明抽取错误主要与日期有关。代码和数据已开源。
Motivation: 监管要求上市公司使用机器可读的 inline eXtensible Business Reporting Language (iXBRL) 披露财务报告，但其复杂且细粒度的分类体系限制了关键绩效指标 (KPI) 跨公司标注的可迁移性，现有资源难以支持可靠的 KPI 自动标注。
Method: 构建大规模层级 KPI 数据集 HiFi-KPI，将文本段落与 iXBRL 分类体系中的层级标签对齐，并定义 KPI 分类、KPI 抽取和结构化 KPI 抽取三个任务；另提供人工整理的小规模子集 HiFi-KPI-Lite 以支持快速评测。
Result: 在 HiFi-KPI-Lite 上，基于编码器的模型在 KPI 分类任务上 macro-F1 超过 0.906；LLM 在结构化 KPI 抽取任务上 F1 为 0.440；定性分析发现抽取错误主要集中于日期。
Conclusion: HiFi-KPI 提供了规模大、层级结构清晰的 KPI 标注资源，可支撑多个下游任务，并指出日期相关错误是当前抽取模型的主要短板。

papers.title: Mitigating GenAI-Powered Evidence Pollution for Out-Of-Context Misinformation Detection
papers.abstract_en: While generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) models have achieved significant success, their misuse for generating deceptive content raises growing concerns about online information security. Out-of-context (OOC) multimodal misinformation detection systems typically rely on Web-retrieved evidence to identify images repurposed in false contexts, but they are increasingly challenged by the presence of GenAI-polluted evidence. Existing work mainly focuses on verifying claims that have undergone stylistic rewriting at the claim level and assume a clean evidence corpus. In this work, we remove this assumption and systematically study the impact of GenAI-driven evidence pollution threat on OOC detection. We show that polluted evidence can degrade the performance of state-of-the-art detectors by more than 9 percentage points. We propose two mitigating strategies, cross-modal evidence reranking and cross-modal claim-evidence reasoning, to address the challenge posed by polluted evidence. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approaches effectively enhance the robustness of existing OOC detectors amidst polluted evidence. The source code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/YanZehong/GenAI-Evidence-Pollution.

papers.title: Regressor-Guided Image Editing Shifts Emotion and Disengagement Timing in Social Media
papers.abstract_en: Internet overuse is a widespread phenomenon in today's digital society. Existing interventions, such as time limits or grayscaling, often rely on restrictive controls that provoke psychological reactance and are frequently circumvented. Building on prior work showing that emotional responses mediate the relationship between content consumption and online engagement, we investigate whether regulating the emotional impact of images can reduce online use in a non-coercive manner. We introduce and systematically analyze three regressor-guided image-editing approaches, spanning low-level attribute optimization, latent style-space optimization, and diffusion-based editing. While the first two modify low-level visual features (e.g., contrast, color), the diffusion-based method enables higher-level changes (e.g., adjusting clothing, facial features). A controlled image-rating study shows that only the diffusion-based approach shifts perceived emotion toward a neutral reference without reducing perceived quality. In a follow-up social media experiment, edited images were associated with earlier disengagement among users who left the feed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究是否可以通过调节图片的情绪影响来非强制性地减少社交媒体使用。作者提出并系统比较了三种回归器引导的图像编辑方法：低层属性优化、潜在风格空间优化和基于扩散的编辑。受控图像评分实验表明，只有基于扩散的方法能在不降低感知质量的情况下将感知情绪移向中性参考；后续社交媒体实验显示，编辑后的图片与用户更早离开信息流相关。
Motivation: 网络过度使用普遍存在，现有的时间限制、灰度化等干预手段依赖强制性控制，容易引发心理抗拒且常被绕过。作者希望基于情绪反应调节内容消费与在线参与的关系，探索非强制性的干预途径。
Method: 提出并系统分析三种回归器引导的图像编辑方法：低层属性优化（如对比度、色彩）、潜在风格空间优化，以及基于扩散模型的编辑。扩散方法能够实现更高层的修改（如调整服装、面部特征），其余两种只修改低层视觉特征。
Result: 受控图像评分实验显示，仅扩散方法能将感知情绪移向中性参考而不降低感知质量；后续社交媒体实验中，编辑后的图片与用户更早离开信息流有关。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过扩散编辑调节图片情绪影响可以作为一种非强制性的干预手段来减少在线使用；但结论限定于离开信息流的用户群体。

papers.title: Improving Requirements Classification with SMOTE-Tomek Preprocessing
papers.abstract_en: This study emphasizes the domain of requirements engineering by applying the SMOTE-Tomek preprocessing technique, combined with stratified K-fold cross-validation, to address class imbalance in the PROMISE dataset. This dataset comprises 969 categorized requirements, classified into functional and non-functional types. The proposed approach enhances the representation of minority classes while maintaining the integrity of validation folds, leading to a notable improvement in classification accuracy. Logistic regression achieved 76.16%, significantly surpassing the baseline of 59.85%. These results highlight the applicability and efficiency of machine learning models as scalable and interpretable solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对需求工程 (requirements engineering) 中功能与非功能需求分类的类别不平衡问题，在 PROMISE 数据集上结合 SMOTE-Tomek 预处理与分层 K 折交叉验证 (stratified K-fold cross-validation)。摘要报告逻辑回归 (Logistic regression) 的准确率达到 76.16%，明显超过 59.85% 的基线。作者认为机器学习模型可作为可扩展且可解释的需求分类方案。
Motivation: PROMISE 数据集中的 969 条需求在功能和非功能类型上存在类别不平衡，影响分类准确率；该研究旨在通过预处理手段增强少数类表示并保持验证折的完整性。
Method: 提出在分类流程中应用 SMOTE-Tomek 预处理，并结合分层 K 折交叉验证，以改善少数类样本表示；随后使用逻辑回归等机器学习模型进行分类。
Result: 摘要报告逻辑回归在该任务上达到 76.16% 的分类准确率，明显超过 59.85% 的基线水平。
Conclusion: 结果表明 SMOTE-Tomek 预处理结合分层交叉验证能够有效提升需求分类准确率，并强调机器学习模型是兼具可扩展性与可解释性的解决方案。

papers.title: Table2Image: Lightweight Tabular Learning with Generated Proxy Representations and Reliability Diagnostics
papers.abstract_en: Deep tabular models should ideally balance predictive performance, parameter efficiency, and robustness to imperfect learning signals---properties that are rarely considered jointly. We present Table2Image, a lightweight tabular learning model built around a learned generation pathway that maps tabular inputs into intermediate, structured proxy representations. We additionally examine a variant with variance inflation factor (VIF)-informed initialization, which downweights highly collinear features at the start of training. Across datasets from OpenML-CC18 and TabZilla, Table2Image achieves competitive clean predictive performance while remaining compact relative to several large-scale neural baselines. We further introduce a unified, severity-controlled evaluation protocol under three imperfect learning conditions---irrelevant inputs, corrupted supervision, and unstable shortcut associations---that combines performance-based robustness measures with realization-level instability diagnostics for reliability characterization. Table2Image maintains a favorable balance of performance, robustness, and compactness. Controlled ablations indicate that the learned generation pathway is a key driver of the observed gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Table2Image，一种轻量级表格学习模型，核心是学习一条生成通路 (learned generation pathway)，将表格输入映射为结构化的中间代理表示 (proxy representations)。在 OpenML-CC18 和 TabZilla 数据集上，Table2Image 在保持紧凑参数规模的同时达到有竞争力的干净性能，并在多种不完美学习条件下呈现较好的鲁棒性。作者还引入一种带严重度控制的统一评估协议，用于刻画可靠性。
Motivation: 深度表格模型很少被同时考虑预测性能、参数效率和面对不完美学习信号（如无关输入、损坏监督、不稳定捷径关联）的鲁棒性，这三点通常被分开研究。
Method: Table2Image 通过可学习的生成通路将表格输入转换为结构化的中间代理表示；另外考察一个用方差膨胀因子 (variance inflation factor, VIF) 初始化的变体，在训练初期降低高共线性特征的权重。作者还提出一个严重度可控的统一评估协议，把基于性能的鲁棒性度量与实现层面的不稳定性诊断结合起来。
Result: 在 OpenML-CC18 和 TabZilla 数据集上，Table2Image 的干净预测性能有竞争力，同时比多个大规模神经基线更紧凑；消融实验表明，学习到的生成通路是性能提升的关键来源。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 Table2Image 在性能、鲁棒性和紧凑性之间取得有利平衡，并强调生成通路是实现这些收益的核心组件。

papers.title: ReAugment: Model Zoo-Guided RL for Few-Shot Time Series Augmentation and Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting, particularly in few-shot learning scenarios, is challenging due to the limited availability of high-quality training data. To address this, we present a pilot study on using reinforcement learning (RL) for time series data augmentation. Our method, ReAugment, tackles three critical questions: which parts of the training set should be augmented, how the augmentation should be performed, and what advantages RL brings to the process. Specifically, our approach maintains a forecasting model zoo, and by measuring prediction diversity across the models, we identify samples with higher probabilities for overfitting and use them as the anchor points for augmentation. Leveraging RL, our method adaptively transforms the overfit-prone samples into new data that not only enhances training set diversity but also directs the augmented data to target regions where the forecasting models are prone to overfitting. We validate the effectiveness of ReAugment across a wide range of base models, showing its advantages in both standard time series forecasting and few-shot learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReAugment，一个用强化学习 (RL) 做时间序列数据增强的框架，面向少样本时间序列预测。方法维护一个预测模型库 (model zoo)，通过测量各模型预测之间的多样性来识别更可能过拟合的样本，再用 RL 自适应地把这些样本转换为新数据，使增强数据落在模型易过拟合的目标区域。作者在多种基础模型上验证了该方法在标准时间序列预测和少样本学习任务中的有效性。
Motivation: 少样本时间序列预测因高质量训练数据有限而困难，现有工作对数据增强的选取与生成方式缺乏系统性研究。作者提出初步研究 (pilot study)，聚焦三个问题：训练集哪些部分应被增强、如何增强、RL 在此过程中带来什么优势。
Method: ReAugment 维护一个预测模型库，通过跨模型预测多样性识别具有更高过拟合概率的样本，并将其作为增强锚点。利用 RL，方法自适应地将易过拟合样本变换为新数据，既提升训练集多样性，又将增强数据导向模型容易过拟合的目标区域。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在多种基础模型上均有效，在标准时间序列预测和少样本学习任务中均展现出优势；未给出具体数值或基准细节。
Conclusion: 摘要将此工作定位为用 RL 进行时间序列数据增强的初步研究，强调其跨多种基础模型的泛化能力。

papers.title: Your Turn: At Home Turning Angle Estimation for Parkinson's Disease Severity Assessment
papers.abstract_en: People with Parkinson's Disease (PD) often experience progressively worsening gait, including changes in how they turn around, as the disease progresses. Existing clinical rating tools are not capable of capturing hour-by-hour variations of PD symptoms, as they are confined to brief assessments within clinic settings. Measuring gait turning angles continuously and passively is a component step towards using gait characteristics as sensitive indicators of disease progression in PD. This paper presents a deep learning-based approach to automatically quantify turning angles by extracting 3D skeletons from videos and calculating the rotation of hip and knee joints. We utilise state-of-the-art human pose estimation models, Fastpose and Strided Transformer, on a total of 1386 turning video clips from 24 subjects (12 people with PD and 12 healthy control volunteers), trimmed from a PD dataset of unscripted free-living videos in a home-like setting (Turn-REMAP). We also curate a turning video dataset, Turn-H3.6M, from the public Human3.6M human pose benchmark with 3D ground truth, to further validate our method. Previous gait research has primarily taken place in clinics or laboratories evaluating scripted gait outcomes, but this work focuses on free-living home settings where complexities exist, such as baggy clothing and poor lighting. Due to difficulties in obtaining accurate ground truth data in a free-living setting, we quantise the angle into the nearest bin $45^\circ$ based on the manual labelling of expert clinicians. Our method achieves a turning calculation accuracy of 41.6%, a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 34.7°, and a weighted precision WPrec of 68.3% for Turn-REMAP. This is the first work to explore the use of single monocular camera data to quantify turns by PD patients in a home setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的居家场景转身角度量化方法，从单目视频中提取 3D 骨架并计算髋关节和膝关节的旋转角度，用于帕金森病 (PD) 严重程度评估。作者在 Turn-REMAP 自由生活视频数据集（24 名受试者、1386 段转身片段）上使用 Fastpose 和 Strided Transformer 姿态估计模型，并构建带 3D 真值的 Turn-H3.6M 数据集进行验证。方法在 Turn-REMAP 上达到转身计算准确率 41.6%、平均绝对误差 (MAE) 34.7°、加权精确度 WPrec 68.3%，是首个利用单目摄像头在居家环境量化 PD 患者转身的研究。
Motivation: 现有临床评估工具只能在诊所内进行短暂评估，无法捕捉 PD 症状逐小时的变化；持续被动地测量转身角度是使用步态特征作为 PD 疾病进展敏感指标的重要一步。过往步态研究多在诊所或实验室进行脚本化评估，而本文关注存在宽松衣物、光线差等复杂性的居家自由生活环境。
Method: 使用人体姿态估计模型 Fastpose 和 Strided Transformer 从视频中提取 3D 骨架，通过计算髋关节和膝关节的旋转来量化转身角度。由于自由生活场景难以获得准确地面真值，作者基于临床专家的人工标注将角度量化为最近的 45° 分箱；另从公共 Human3.6M 基准数据集中整理出带 3D 真值的转身视频数据集 Turn-H3.6M 用于进一步验证。
Result: 在 Turn-REMAP 上，方法取得转身计算准确率 41.6%、MAE 34.7°、加权精确度 WPrec 68.3%。这是首次探索用单个单目摄像头数据在居家环境中量化 PD 患者转身角度的研究。
Conclusion: 本文表明基于单目视频的居家转身角度自动量化在 PD 监测中是可行的；面对自由生活场景中地面真值获取困难的问题，采用专家标注的 45° 分箱量化仍能获得可用性能，为步态特征作为 PD 进展敏感指标提供了居家场景的验证基础。
