papers.title: Towards Efficient Pareto Set Approximation via Mixture of Experts Based Model Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Solving multi-objective optimization problems for large deep neural networks is a challenging task due to the complexity of the loss landscape and the expensive computational cost of training and evaluating models. Efficient Pareto front approximation of large models enables multi-objective optimization for various tasks such as multi-task learning and trade-off analysis. Existing algorithms for learning Pareto set, including (1) evolutionary, hypernetworks, and hypervolume-maximization methods, are computationally expensive and have restricted scalability to large models; (2) Scalarization algorithms, where a separate model is trained for each objective ray, which is inefficient for learning the entire Pareto set and fails to capture the objective trade-offs effectively. Inspired by the recent success of model merging, we propose a practical and scalable approach to Pareto set learning problem via mixture of experts (MoE) based model fusion. By ensembling the weights of specialized single-task models, the MoE module can effectively capture the trade-offs between multiple objectives and closely approximate the entire Pareto set of large neural networks. Once the routers are learned and a preference vector is set, the MoE module can be unloaded, thus no additional computational cost is introduced during inference. We conduct extensive experiments on vision and language tasks using large-scale models such as CLIP-ViT and GPT-2. The experimental results demonstrate that our method efficiently approximates the entire Pareto front of large models. Using only hundreds of trainable parameters of the MoE routers, our method even has lower memory usage compared to linear scalarization and algorithms that learn a single Pareto optimal solution, and are scalable to both the number of objectives and the size of the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于混合专家 (MoE) 模型融合的帕累托集近似方法，用于大规模深度神经网络的多目标优化。通过集成多个单任务模型的权重并学习路由器，该方法能够捕获目标间的权衡并近似整个帕累托前沿；路由器学习完成后可卸载，推理阶段不引入额外计算开销。在 CLIP-ViT 和 GPT-2 等大规模模型上的视觉与语言任务实验显示，仅用数百个可训练的路由器参数即可高效逼近整个帕累托前沿。
Motivation: 现有帕累托集学习方法（进化算法、超网络、超体积最大化）在大模型上计算昂贵且可扩展性受限，而标量化方法需要为每个目标射线单独训练模型，难以高效学习完整帕累托集并捕获目标间权衡。
Method: 受模型合并 (model merging) 启发，将 MoE 模块用于基于权重的模型融合：集成专用单任务模型的权重，学习路由器以对应偏好向量，从而近似大神经网络的帕累托集；一旦路由器训练完成即可卸载，推理时无额外成本。
Result: 在视觉与语言任务上使用 CLIP-ViT 和 GPT-2 的实验表明，该方法能高效逼近大规模模型的整个帕累托前沿；仅用数百个 MoE 路由器可训练参数，内存占用甚至低于线性标量化和学习单一帕累托最优解的方法，并且可扩展到目标数量与模型规模。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法是基于模型融合的实用且可扩展的帕累托集学习方法，能够以极低参数开销逼近大模型的帕累托集，且不影响推理效率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Teacher-free Latent Self-distillation and Class-separable Representations for Lightweight IoT Attack Detection
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) has been widely used to improve lightweight AI models by transferring soft-label knowledge from a large teacher model to a student model. However, existing KD methods are primarily designed for the image domain rather than lightweight IoT devices, and they often struggle to maintain well-separated feature representations for different attack types, especially as the number of classes increases and attack behaviors become more diverse. This paper proposes a novel \textit{teacher-free latent self-distillation framework based on a Twin Autoencoder (TAE)}. Instead of relying on an external teacher, TAE self-learns intrinsic class-wise latent representations, which act as soft labels, similar to KD, but without requiring a teacher model. The decoder then projects the input back into soft labels, enforcing class separation in the decoder output. The resulting decoder representations are used for classification, improving the discrimination between benign and malicious traffic while maintaining a lightweight design suitable for IoT deployment. We theoretically derive conditions for perfect class separation and show that lower empirical risk yields better representations, identifying regimes where TAE achieves strictly lower empirical risk than models using fixed class centers. Extensive experiments on 13 cybersecurity datasets, covering IoT botnets, network intrusion detection, malware, cloud DDoS, and synthetic multi-class data, show that TAE achieves up to 96.1% average accuracy for IoT attack detection and 98.7% for cloud intrusion detection. With a compact model size (1 MB) and ultra-fast inference (0.26 μs per sample), TAE offers a practical and scalable solution for real-world cybersecurity and IoT systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于双自编码器 (Twin Autoencoder, TAE) 的无教师潜在自蒸馏框架，用于轻量级 IoT 攻击检测。TAE 不依赖外部教师模型，而是通过自学习类内潜在表示作为软标签，并利用解码器输出增强类别分离，从而区分良性流量与恶意流量。作者推导了完美类别分离的理论条件，并在 13 个网络安全数据集上验证了方法在精度、模型大小和推理速度上的优势。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏 (KD) 方法主要为图像域设计，在轻量级 IoT 设备上难以保持不同攻击类型之间良好分离的特征表示，且随着类别增多、攻击行为多样化，性能下降。
Method: 提出无教师潜在自蒸馏框架 TAE：用双自编码器自学习类别相关的潜在表示充当软标签，解码器将输入投影回软标签空间并在解码器输出中强制类别分离，最终用解码器表示进行分类。
Result: 在 13 个网络安全数据集（涵盖 IoT 僵尸网络、网络入侵检测、恶意软件、云 DDoS 和合成多类数据）上，TAE 在 IoT 攻击检测中达到最高 96.1% 平均准确率，云入侵检测中达 98.7%；模型大小仅 1 MB，推理速度 0.26 微秒/样本。
Conclusion: 作者强调 TAE 无需外部教师、保持轻量设计，并提供理论条件表明其经验风险可低于使用固定类中心的模型，适合实际网络安全与 IoT 系统部署。

papers.title: Learning-Based Speed Estimation from Accelerometer-Only Inertial Sensing
papers.abstract_en: The proposed model, CarSpeedNet, estimates scalar vehicle speed from a window of three-axis smartphone acceleration, without gyroscope, wheel-odometry, vehicle-bus, or positioning input at inference. The reported experiment comprises 13.2 hours of on-road driving. Beyond the network comparison, a finite-context analysis treats window length as part of the sensing problem. For nested histories, the minimum Bayes mean-square error is non-increasing with context; a complementary cue-coverage relation links the same window to the amount of speed-dependent vibration presented to the network and to the observation horizon. At a 1-s input, CarSpeedNet is compared with five temporal-network alternatives; the effect of temporal context is then measured over six window lengths. On the 0.5-hour holdout, a 4-s window yielded a root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 1.8 m/s and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.72 m/s, compared with 2.9 and 1.3 m/s at 1 s. The 178,169-parameter network requires about 0.68 MiB for 32-bit weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CarSpeedNet，一个仅使用三轴智能手机加速度计窗口来估计车辆标量速度的模型，推理时不需要陀螺仪、轮速计、车载总线或定位输入。报告实验包含 13.2 小时真实道路驾驶；在 0.5 小时留出集上，4 秒窗口的 RMSE 为 1.8 m/s、MAE 为 0.72 m/s，优于 1 秒窗口的 2.9 m/s 和 1.3 m/s。作者还把窗口长度当作感知问题的一部分，给出了嵌套历史下最小贝叶斯均方误差随上下文不减等有限上下文分析。
Motivation: 现有车辆速度估计通常依赖 GPS、陀螺仪、轮速计或车辆总线等额外输入；本文的目标是仅靠加速度计感知来估计车速，从而降低推理时的传感器依赖。
Method: 提出 CarSpeedNet 网络，以三轴加速度窗口为输入输出标量速度；同时将窗口长度作为感知问题的一部分进行分析，证明嵌套历史下最小贝叶斯均方误差随上下文长度不减，并建立线索覆盖关系（cue-coverage relation）把窗口长度与网络可获得的速度相关振动量及观测视界联系起来。
Result: 在 13.2 小时道路驾驶数据上的 0.5 小时留出集中，4 秒窗口得到 RMSE 1.8 m/s、MAE 0.72 m/s，而 1 秒窗口为 RMSE 2.9 m/s、MAE 1.3 m/s；作者在 1 秒输入下与五种时序网络基线比较，并用六种窗口长度测量时间上下文的影响。模型参数为 178,169 个，32 位权重约需 0.68 MiB。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是仅靠加速度计并在足够的时间窗口下可以获得合理的车速估计，且时间上下文长度是影响误差表现的关键因素。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Asymptotic Theory for IV-Based Reinforcement Learning with Potential Endogeneity
papers.abstract_en: In the standard data analysis framework, data is collected (once and for all), and then data analysis is carried out. However, with the advancement of digital technology, decision-makers constantly analyze past data and generate new data through their decisions. We model this as a Markov decision process and show that the dynamic interaction between data generation and data analysis leads to a new type of bias -- reinforcement bias -- that exacerbates the endogeneity problem in standard data analysis. We propose a class of instrument variable (IV)-based reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms to correct for the bias and establish their theoretical properties by incorporating them into a stochastic approximation (SA) framework. Our analysis accommodates iterate-dependent Markovian structures and, therefore, can be used to study RL algorithms with policy improvement. We also provide formulas for inference on optimal policies of the IV-RL algorithms. These formulas highlight how intertemporal dependency of the Markovian environment affects the inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于工具变量 (instrument variable, IV) 的强化学习 (RL) 算法的渐近理论。作者将数据生成与分析之间的动态交互建模为马尔可夫决策过程，指出这种交互会产生一种新的“强化偏差”(reinforcement bias)，加剧标准数据分析中的内生性问题，并提出一类 IV-RL 算法加以修正。作者将这些算法纳入随机逼近 (stochastic approximation, SA) 框架建立理论性质，该框架允许迭代相关的马尔可夫结构，因而可涵盖带策略改进 (policy improvement) 的 RL 算法。
Motivation: 标准数据分析通常假设数据一次性收集完毕后再进行分析，但现实中决策者会不断依据历史数据做决策并生成新数据；这种动态交互产生了新的强化偏差，加剧了内生性问题，需要新的估计与推断框架来应对。
Method: 将动态交互建模为马尔可夫决策过程，提出一类基于工具变量 (IV) 的强化学习算法以纠正强化偏差，并将这些算法纳入随机逼近 (SA) 框架进行理论分析；该框架容纳迭代相关的马尔可夫结构，因此可用于研究带有策略改进步骤的 RL 算法。
Result: 摘要报告了 IV-RL 算法的理论性质，并给出了关于最优策略的推断公式；这些公式刻画了马尔可夫环境的跨期依赖如何影响推断结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 IV-RL 算法能在存在潜在内生性的动态决策环境中纠正强化偏差，并为最优策略的统计推断提供理论基础，其分析框架特别适用于带策略改进的 RL 算法。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Graph Interaction for Multi-Graph Convolution Network in Urban Spatiotemporal Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Graph convolution network based approaches have been recently used to model region-wise relationships in region-level prediction problems in urban computing. Each relationship represents a kind of spatial dependency, like region-wise distance or functional similarity. To incorporate multiple relationships into spatial feature extraction, we define the problem as a multi-modal machine learning problem on multi-graph convolution networks. Leveraging the advantage of multi-modal machine learning, we propose to develop modality interaction mechanisms for this problem, in order to reduce generalization error by reinforcing the learning of multimodal coordinated representations. In this work, we propose two interaction techniques for handling features in lower layers and higher layers respectively. In lower layers, we propose grouped GCN to combine the graph connectivity from different modalities for more complete spatial feature extraction. In higher layers, we adapt multi-linear relationship networks to GCN by exploring the dimension transformation and freezing part of the covariance structure. The adapted approach, called multi-linear relationship GCN, learns more generalized features to overcome the train-test divergence induced by time shifting. We evaluated our model on ridehailing demand forecasting problem using two real-world datasets. The proposed technique outperforms state-of-the art baselines in terms of prediction accuracy, training efficiency, interpretability and model robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究城市时空预测中多图卷积网络（multi-graph convolution network）上的多模态学习问题，提出两种模态交互机制：低层使用 grouped GCN 融合不同图连接，高层将多线性关系网络适配到 GCN（multi-linear relationship GCN），以学习更泛化的特征并缓解时间平移带来的训练-测试分布差异。作者在两个真实网约车需求预测数据集上验证，称所提方法在预测精度、训练效率、可解释性和模型鲁棒性上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 区域级城市预测中，每个区域关系代表一种空间依赖（如距离或功能相似性），需要把多种关系同时纳入空间特征提取；现有方法缺少对多模态关系的显式交互，导致泛化误差偏高。
Method: 将多关系图卷积网络形式化为多模态机器学习问题，并分别设计低层和高层的交互机制：低层用 grouped GCN 组合不同模态的图连通性，高层通过维度变换并冻结部分协方差结构，把多线性关系网络适配为 multi-linear relationship GCN。
Result: 在基于两个真实数据集的网约车需求预测实验中，所提技术相对 state-of-the-art 基线提升了预测精度、训练效率、可解释性和模型鲁棒性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为分层的多模态交互与部分协方差冻结有助于学习更泛化的多图卷积特征，适用于城市时空预测中的多关系建模；摘要未涉及其在天气或降水场景下的表现。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Evaluating Neural Cartographic Relief Shading for Urban Environments: A Downtown Calgary Study Using High-Resolution DEM and DSM Data
papers.abstract_en: This article explores the performance of analytical and neural-based hillshading methods in a dense urban environment using high-resolution digital elevation model (DEM) and digital surface model (DSM) data for downtown Calgary. The study compares single-direction and multi-direction analytical hillshading with relief shading generated in Eduard, a machine-learning system originally developed to emulate Swiss-style shaded relief trained primarily on mountainous landscapes. Because Eduard was not designed for buildings, bridges, streets, trees, and other urban infrastructures, the central question is not whether it perfectly reproduces urban morphology, but whether parameter tuning can nevertheless produce visually strong, cartographically useful, and in some cases superior results when compared with conventional analytical methods. The analysis focuses especially on terrain type, micro and macro generalization, and flat-area detail parameters, while keeping the large-scale shading style constant throughout the neural experiments. The article is structured as an exploratory comparison rather than a benchmark of universal best practice. It aims to identify where analytical hillshading remains more reliable, where Eduard offers unexpected strengths, and where neural shading fails because of its training bias toward alpine terrain. The study contributes to current work on terrain representation by testing whether a neural approach designed for natural landforms can be adapted to a highly built urban setting, and it concludes by arguing for future model training and evaluation specifically targeted at urban relief shading.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在加拿大卡尔加里市中心的高密度城市环境中，使用高分辨率数字高程模型（DEM）和数字表面模型（DSM）数据，对比了分析式山体阴影（含单方向和多方位的分析 hillshading）与基于机器学习的 Eduard 系统生成的浮雕阴影。Eduard 原先面向瑞士风格山地景观训练，并未针对建筑、桥梁、街道和树木设计，因此作者关注参数调整能否产生视觉上稳健且制图上有用的结果。文章定位为探索性比较而非通用最佳实践基准，并指出神经网络方法在哪些情形下优于或劣于传统解析方法。
Motivation: 现有神经浮雕阴影方法主要针对自然山地地物训练，对高度人工化的城市环境适配性未知；作者希望检验这类为自然地形设计的神经方法能否通过参数调整迁移到密集建成区，以补充当前地形表达研究的空白。
Method: 采用对比实验设计：将单方向和多方向分析式 hillshading 与 Eduard 神经浮雕阴影进行比较；神经实验中重点调整地形类型、宏观/微观综合（macro and micro generalization）以及平坦区域细节参数，同时保持大尺度阴影风格不变。
Result: 摘要未报告定量指标，仅给出定性结论：在某些情形下分析式 hillshading 仍更可靠，Eduard 在部分方面表现出预期之外的优点，而在另外一些情形下因训练偏向高山地形而失效。
Conclusion: 作者把本文定位为探索性比较而非普适基准，并据此主张未来应针对城市浮雕阴影进行专门的模型训练与评估，以改进神经方法在建成环境中的适应性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A Plug-in Interpretation of Conditioning in Score-Based Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a conditioning mechanism for diffusion models based on multi-speed joint diffusion of the target and the condition. The mechanism learns an unconditional joint score network and enforces conditioning at inference via a plug-in correction term. The plug-in term separates the conditioning contribution from the learned unconditional dynamics, offering a transparent view of how the condition steers generation of the target distribution. Building on this, we derive explicit conditional reverse-time SDEs and approximate probability-flow ODEs, enabling principled and directly comparable conditional samplers. To reduce the induced ODE--SDE discrepancy, we introduce a log-Fokker--Planck residual regularization that improves ODE sampling quality. Experiments on conditional image generation tasks demonstrate competitive performance and support the effectiveness of the plug-in conditioning view. Additional ODE--SDE comparison experiments show that the log-Fokker--Planck residual regularization improves deterministic ODE sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多速联合扩散 (multi-speed joint diffusion) 的条件生成机制，用于得分扩散模型 (score-based diffusion models)。该方法学习目标与条件的无条件联合得分网络，并在推理时通过一个插件式 (plug-in) 修正项施加条件约束，从而将条件引导作用与无条件动力学分离。作者推导了显式的条件反向 SDE 与近似概率流 ODE，并引入 log-Fokker-Planck 残差正则化以减小 ODE-SDE 差距。在条件图像生成任务上的实验显示竞争性表现，并验证了该正则化对确定性 ODE 采样的改进。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型的条件生成机制往往将条件信息直接混入学习过程，难以清晰解释条件如何引导目标分布生成。本文希望提供一种可解释、可与无条件动力学分离的条件化视角，并给出原理上可比较的条件采样器。
Method: 提出多速联合扩散的目标与条件联合建模，学习无条件联合得分网络；在推理阶段通过插件式修正项施加条件，从而分离条件贡献。基于此推导条件反向 SDE 和近似概率流 ODE，并引入 log-Fokker-Planck 残差正则化来缓解 ODE 采样与 SDE 采样之间的差异。
Result: 条件图像生成实验表明该方法具有竞争性表现；额外的 ODE-SDE 对比实验显示 log-Fokker-Planck 残差正则化能提升确定性 ODE 采样质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调插件式条件化视角能够清晰解释条件如何引导目标分布生成，且所提出的正则化有助于提高 ODE 采样的确定性质量。实验范围限于条件图像生成，未涉及其它领域。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A Causal Inference Approach for Evaluating Diagnostic Tests and AI-Enabled Medical Devices: From Effect Modification to Information-Augmented Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Diagnostic medical tests and devices provide useful information for evaluating the potential benefits and risks of therapeutic treatments. However, unlike treatments, their impact on health outcomes is generally indirect because measuring diagnostic information typically does not itself affect patient outcomes, which complicates evaluation of their effectiveness. In this work, we develop a causal inference approach for evaluating diagnostic tests by distinguishing explanatory and pragmatic effectiveness. Explanatory effectiveness evaluates whether a diagnostic test result provides treatment-relevant information beyond baseline covariates by explaining additional treatment-effect heterogeneity, which we characterize using a variance-based treatment-effect variable importance measure. Pragmatic effectiveness evaluates whether incorporating this information into personalized treatment decisions improves expected outcomes, a question central to decision-making for patients, clinicians, and other health care stakeholders. We formalize pragmatic effectiveness as a contrast between expected outcomes under optimal personalized treatment rules defined with and without access to the diagnostic test result. We establish identification of the proposed estimand and provide Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation (TMLE) and cross-validated TMLE procedures for nonparametric estimation and inference. Simulation studies and a synthetic colorectal cancer application illustrate the proposed estimands and estimation performance. More broadly, this approach provides a causal inference perspective for evaluating AI-enabled devices by distinguishing their dual roles as information-enrichment and personalized decision-optimization tools, clarifying whether AI improves outcomes by expanding information for downstream decisions, improving the decision rule used to act on that information, or through both pathways.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于评估诊断检测与 AI 医疗设备的因果推断框架，区分解释性有效性 (explanatory effectiveness) 与实用性有效性 (pragmatic effectiveness)。解释性有效性通过基于方差的 treatment-effect variable importance 度量检测结果在基线协变量之外解释的治疗效应异质性；实用性有效性则比较在有无检测结果时的最优个性化治疗规则下的期望结局。作者给出估计目标的识别性，并提供 TMLE 与交叉验证 TMLE 的非参数估计和推断程序，通过模拟研究和合成结直肠癌应用说明其性能。
Motivation: 诊断检测与设备不像治疗那样直接作用于健康结局，其影响通常是间接的，因此评估其对患者结局的贡献存在困难；现有方法难以区分检测信息本身的价值与利用该信息进行决策的价值。
Method: 提出两类有效性估计目标：用基于方差的 treatment-effect variable importance measure 刻画解释性有效性；将实用性有效性形式化为有无诊断检测结果时最优个性化治疗规则下期望结局的对比，并给出识别条件及 TMLE、交叉验证 TMLE 估计与推断程序。
Result: 摘要报告了提议估计目标的识别性，并通过模拟研究与合成结直肠癌应用展示估计性能；未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该框架为评估 AI-enabled 设备提供因果推断视角，区分其作为信息增强工具与个性化决策优化工具的双重角色，有助于判断 AI 是通过扩充下游决策信息、改进决策规则、还是两条路径共同作用来改善结局。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告了提议估计目标的识别性，并通过模拟研究与合成结直肠癌应用展示估计性能；未提供具体数值结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为评估 AI-enabled 设备提供因果推断视角，区分其作为信息增强工具与个性化决策优化工具的双重角色，有助于判断 AI 是通过扩充下游决策信息、改进决策规则、还是两条路径共同作用来改善结局。

papers.title: Empirical Characterization of Learning Geometry in Hybrid Quantum Forecasting Models
papers.abstract_en: We characterize the learning dynamics of a compact hybrid quantum forecasting model through comparison with a structurally aligned classical baseline. Using stationary harmonic-mixture and nonstationary chirp benchmarks with controlled spectral complexity and data availability, we analyze empirical Neural Tangent Kernel dynamics through kernel-target alignment, kernel drift, spectral concentration, and training loss. The classical model exhibits stronger early target alignment, whereas the hybrid model generally develops a less concentrated kernel spectrum and smaller kernel drift. Despite these distinct optimization geometries, both architectures attain similar held-out performance across the evaluated regimes. Notably, the hybrid model uses 125 trainable parameters compared with 281 for the classical baseline and reaches its validation-selected checkpoint earlier in 15 of 18 frequency conditions. A Fourier-augmented classical baseline does not reproduce the observed training behavior, while a controlled re-uploading ablation shows that repeated encoding systematically modifies both optimization and kernel geometry. These results demonstrate that comparable generalization can emerge from substantially different learning trajectories and that individual NTK diagnostics do not provide monotonic predictors of validation convergence. Rather than claiming a general quantum advantage, the study identifies architecture-dependent learning behavior that is masked by endpoint accuracy alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过结构对齐的经典基线对比，刻画紧凑混合量子预测模型的学习动力学。作者使用平稳谐波混合与非平稳 chirp 基准，分析神经正切核 (NTK) 的核-目标对齐、核漂移、谱集中度和训练损失，发现经典模型早期目标对齐更强，而混合模型核谱更分散且漂移更小；尽管优化几何不同，两者在评估区间上性能相近，混合模型仅用 125 个可训练参数（基线 281 个），并在 18 个频率条件中的 15 个更早达到验证选择的检查点。
Motivation: 现有研究常以端点精度比较量子与经典模型，掩盖了训练过程中的架构相关学习行为；作者想刻画混合量子预测模型与经典基线在学习几何上的差异。
Method: 构建结构对齐的混合量子预测模型与经典基线，采用带可控谱复杂度和数据量的平稳谐波混合与非平稳 chirp 基准，通过核-目标对齐、核漂移、谱集中度与训练损失分析经验 NTK 动力学；并做傅里叶增强经典基线与受控重上传 (re-uploading) 消融。
Result: 摘要报告经典模型早期目标对齐更强，混合模型核谱集中度更低、核漂移更小；两者保持相近泛化性能，混合模型用 125 个参数对比 281 个参数，并在 18 个频率条件中的 15 个更早到达验证检查点；傅里叶增强不能复现该行为，重上传消融表明重复编码系统性改变优化与核几何。
Conclusion: 作者认为可比较的泛化可能来自显著不同的学习轨迹，单个 NTK 诊断指标不能单调预测验证收敛；不主张普遍量子优势，而是指出架构依赖的学习行为被端点精度掩盖。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Multimodal Alignment: Certifying Physical Language through Response Substitution and Ordered Execution
papers.abstract_en: World models increasingly treat compact multimodal representations as interfaces between perception and physical interaction, yet existing probes do not establish whether different sensors carry the same executable meaning or whether that meaning survives a new action composition. We introduce an operational capability hierarchy and the Disjoint-Bridge Operator-Substitution Certificate (DBOSC), which asks whether independently trained modality compilers enter a frozen response chart interchangeably on evidence outside their training panels. On Cluster Haptic, audio and acceleration representations of the same unseen surface are 4.5x closer in response space than wrong-surface pairings, with the gap holding for all 19 held-out surfaces; unsealing withheld responses confirms that every branch predicts the physics better than the population chart. We then test ordered execution in a controlled elastoplastic system with complementary modality blind spots. At the pre-registered budget, the prerequisite refuses the stack because the frozen executor cannot advance even an exact chart coordinate through a held-out program. At a converged budget, the same rank-three chart executes those programs (oracle NMSE 0.18), fusion improves on both modalities, and 14 of 16 registered checks pass; the two failures arise because a diagonal restriction of the fused information matrix performs as well as the full one. Clearing the gate is a property of the executor, not the chart: an executor emitting whole programs instead of shared per-step dynamics is 38x worse than an entity-blind predictor on the same chart. A matching non-identifiability result explains why compression and fusion alone cannot determine an unseen composition law. These results separate attribute access, response substitution, fusion closure, and ordered execution into distinct, separately testable achievements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可操作能力层级（operational capability hierarchy）与 Disjoint-Bridge Operator-Substitution Certificate (DBOSC)，用以检验独立训练的模态编译器能否在训练面板之外的证据上互换地进入冻结响应图。在 Cluster Haptic 上，同一未见表面的音频与加速度表示在响应空间中比错误表面配对近 4.5 倍，该差距在全部 19 个留出表面上保持；随后在受控弹塑性系统中测试有序执行，并给出执行器属性而非图表属性的门控结论以及非可辨识性结果。
Motivation: 现有探针未确认不同传感器是否携带相同的可执行含义，也不确认该含义在新型动作组合下是否存活，因此需要将属性访问、响应替换、融合闭包和有序执行区分为可单独测试的能力。
Method: 作者提出 DBOSC 证书，询问独立训练的模态编译器在训练面板之外的证据上是否可互换地进入冻结响应图；同时设计受控弹塑性系统实验，在预注册预算与收敛预算下检验有序执行与融合。
Result: 摘要报告：同一未见表面上的音频与加速度表示在响应空间中比错误表面配对近 4.5 倍，且 19 个留出表面均保持该差距；收敛预算下秩三图表可执行程序（oracle NMSE 0.18），融合优于单模态，16 项注册检查中 14 项通过，两项失败源于融合信息矩阵的对角限制与完整版表现相当；输出整程序而非共享逐步动力学的执行器比实体盲预测器差 38 倍。
Conclusion: 这些结果将属性访问、响应替换、融合闭包和有序执行分离为不同且可分别测试的成就；非可辨识性结果说明仅靠压缩与融合无法确定未见的组合律。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: DeltaMomentum: A Key-Value based Anisotropic Momentum Update via Delta Rule
papers.abstract_en: Most modern optimizers form their momentum as an exponential moving average (EMA) of past gradients, forgetting every direction at one fixed rate. However, the inputs a deep network sees during training can be highly anisotropic, with a few directions queried frequently while most are seen rarely. Recent methods address this anisotropy by wrapping extra processing around this buffer, leaving the momentum update itself unchanged. We propose DeltaMomentum, which builds direction-awareness into the momentum update rule. The main observation is that the gradient of a linear layer splits into an input that acts as a key and an output-side error that acts as a value. Exploiting the key-value structure, DeltaMomentum updates the momentum buffer by the canonical delta rule, so each direction is forgotten at a rate set by how often it appears. We prove that it is a valid momentum, that it applies the input-side curvature correction without matrix inversion, and that it clears stale directions faster than EMA under both a fixed and a drifting optimum. It is a drop-in replacement for the momentum buffer of any optimizer, its coefficient transfers across widths under $μ$P, and its extra compute stays between $22.2\%$ and $25.0\%$ of a gated-MLP block's linear cost with no persistent memory. In FineWeb-Edu pretraining, AdamW with DeltaMomentum (DeltaAdamW) reaches AdamW's validation loss in up to $46.39 \pm 4.32\%$ fewer steps at 67M and $22.12 \pm 0.80\%$ at 370M over three seeds, and the gain persists at 1B on a Chinchilla-optimal budget. A Muon baseline tuned under the same protocol sits above DeltaAdamW at both language-model scales, and the gain holds for SGD, ResNet-18, and ViT-Tiny on CIFAR-10. Training-time diagnostics confirm the predicted mechanism, better gradient tracking and healthier input directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeltaMomentum，一种基于键值结构（key-value structure）和 delta rule 的各向异性动量更新方法。它把线性层的梯度分解为作为 key 的输入和作为 value 的输出侧误差，用 delta rule 更新动量缓冲，使每个方向的遗忘速率取决于其出现频率。作者证明这是有效的动量更新，无需矩阵求逆即可施加输入侧曲率校正，并在固定和漂移最优下比 EMA 更快清除陈旧方向。在 FineWeb-Edu 预训练中，DeltaAdamW 在多个规模下以更少步数达到 AdamW 的验证损失。
Motivation: 大多数优化器把动量当作过去梯度的指数移动平均（EMA），以固定速率遗忘所有方向，但深度网络训练输入具有高度各向异性：少数方向被频繁查询，多数方向很少出现。现有方法通过在外围包装额外处理来应对，但动量更新本身保持不变。
Method: 提出 DeltaMomentum：将动量缓冲更新改为基于 delta rule 的键值式更新，梯度中的输入作为 key、输出侧误差作为 value，每个方向按出现频率被遗忘。它可作为任何优化器动量缓冲的 drop-in 替换，系数在 μP 下可跨宽度迁移，额外计算量约为 gated-MLP 块线性成本的 22.2% 到 25.0%，且无持久内存。
Result: 在 FineWeb-Edu 预训练中，DeltaAdamW 在 67M 规模下以最多 46.39±4.32% 更少步数达到 AdamW 的验证损失，370M 下为 22.12±0.80%（三个种子）；1B 在 Chinchilla 最优预算下增益持续。相同协议调参的 Muon 基线在两个语言模型规模上均位于 DeltaAdamW 之上；增益在 SGD、ResNet-18、ViT-Tiny 和 CIFAR-10 上保持。训练时诊断确认了预测的机制、更好的梯度跟踪和更健康的输入方向。
Conclusion: 论文表明，基于 delta rule 的键值式动量更新能将方向感知能力构建进动量规则本身，无需矩阵求逆；作为优化器动量缓冲的通用替换，它能提升多种优化器和模型规模的样本效率。摘要中未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fine-Tuning VLAs with Self-Demonstrated Generative Control for Multi-Task Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ exhibit strong semantic understanding, instruction following and task behavior. However, when deployed on new robots, even minor mismatches in hardware configuration relative to pretraining can cause severe performance drops. Finetuning the VLA on in-domain expert data from the new embodiment improves performance on the expert task but leads to a loss in its original instruction following and behavioral priors. In this paper, we propose a self-supervised method that generates online interaction rollouts from the zero-shot VLA as additional training data for finetuning. Our experiments show this finetuning scheme yields strong multi-task policies that, on the target robot, (1) inherit prior tasks distilled from the zero-shot model, (2) enable generalist instruction following, while (3) learning new skills from expert data with improved sample efficiency. We demonstrate the success of our approach across test sets probing generalization on a real ALOHA robot and a new simulation benchmark in RoboTwin. Video results are available at https://self-supervised-control.pages.dev/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督微调方案，针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在新机器人硬件上部署时因硬件配置轻微不匹配导致的性能下降问题。方法利用零样本 VLA 生成在线交互轨迹（online interaction rollouts）作为额外训练数据，并配合专家数据微调，使模型在目标机器人上继承零样本模型的先验任务、保持通用指令跟随，同时以更高样本效率学习新技能。实验在真实 ALOHA 机器人和 RoboTwin 新仿真基准上验证了泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型（如 π0.5）在语义理解与指令跟随上表现强，但部署到新机器人时，即使硬件配置与预训练仅有轻微不匹配，也会造成严重性能下降；仅用目标机器人的专家数据微调会提升专家任务表现，却损失原有指令跟随和行为先验。
Method: 提出一种自监督方法：从零样本 VLA 生成在线交互轨迹，将其作为额外训练数据与专家数据一起用于微调，从而无需额外标注即可改善目标任务性能并保留预训练行为先验。
Result: 实验表明该微调方案在目标机器人上得到强多任务策略，既能继承零样本模型蒸馏出的先前任务，又能保持通用指令跟随，同时从专家数据学习新技能且样本效率更高；验证覆盖真实 ALOHA 机器人和 RoboTwin 仿真基准的泛化测试集。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将零样本 VLA 自生成的在线数据纳入微调，可以在保留原有指令跟随与行为先验的同时，提升新技能学习的样本效率。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出一种自监督方法：从零样本 VLA 生成在线交互轨迹，将其作为额外训练数据与专家数据一起用于微调，从而无需额外标注即可改善目标任务性能并保留预训练行为先验。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明该微调方案在目标机器人上得到强多任务策略，既能继承零样本模型蒸馏出的先前任务，又能保持通用指令跟随，同时从专家数据学习新技能且样本效率更高；验证覆盖真实 ALOHA 机器人和 RoboTwin 仿真基准的泛化测试集。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调将零样本 VLA 自生成的在线数据纳入微调，可以在保留原有指令跟随与行为先验的同时，提升新技能学习的样本效率。

papers.title: When to Retrain: An Empirical Study of Retraining Policies for Streaming ML Under Concept Drift, Budget, and Latency Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Production machine learning systems degrade under concept drift, yet practitioners have little principled guidance on when to retrain. Retraining is costly, retraining budgets are finite, and a retrained model does not take effect instantly: training and deployment latency leave a stale model serving predictions while the data continues to move. We present a controlled empirical study of three practical model-refresh policies (periodic retraining, error-threshold triggering, and statistical drift-triggered retraining with ADWIN) against a no-retrain baseline, evaluated under a unified system model that makes retraining budgets and training-plus-deployment latency explicit. Across 3,933 experiment runs spanning three drift regimes, three budget levels, up to five latency levels, three datasets, and two learning modes, we find that the single most consequential design decision is not the retraining policy but whether the deployed model learns incrementally. With per-sample incremental updates, and for the linear online learner with immediate labels studied here, no policy differs from the no-retrain baseline by a practically significant margin in any of 54 paired comparisons, even at extreme latency. Without incremental updates, policy choice separates outcomes by 15-55 percentage points of post-drift accuracy, and simple periodic retraining significantly outperforms both reactive policies under abrupt and gradual drift, while reactive policies retain an advantage only under recurring drift. We document systematic failure modes of reactive policies and a latency-budget queueing interaction that silently halves effective retraining budgets, and release the full simulator, dataset pipelines, and per-run artifacts for reproducibility.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/sa1dasari/Study-of-Drift-Triggered-Retraining-Policies-Under-Budget-and-Latency-Constraints
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验研究流式机器学习在概念漂移、有限重训预算和训练/部署延迟约束下应当何时重训。作者对比三种实际的模型刷新策略（周期重训、错误阈值触发、基于 ADWIN 的统计漂移触发重训）与不确定不重训的基线，构建了一个显式刻画重训预算和训练加部署延迟的统一系统模型。基于 3,933 次实验运行，核心发现是最具决定性的设计选择不是重训策略本身，而是部署模型是否进行增量学习（incremental learning）。
Motivation: 生产机器学习系统在概念漂移下会性能退化，但实践者对何时重训缺乏有原则的指导；重训成本高、预算有限，且重训模型不能立即生效，训练和部署延迟会导致旧模型在数据继续变化时持续服务。
Method: 提出统一系统模型，将重训预算和训练加部署延迟显式纳入评估框架，并在三种漂移场景、三种预算水平、最多五种延迟水平、三个数据集和两种学习模式下运行 3,933 次实验，比较周期重训、错误阈值触发和 ADWIN 漂移触发三种策略与不重训基线。
Result: 对带即刻标签的线性在线学习器，当启用逐样本增量更新时，54 组配对比较中没有任何策略与不重训基线存在实际显著差异，即使延迟极值下也是如此；若没有增量更新，策略选择使漂移后准确率相差 15-55 个百分点，周期重训在突变和渐变漂移下显著优于两种反应式策略，而反应式策略仅在循环漂移下保持优势。
Conclusion: 摘要强调增量学习是比重训策略更关键的系统设计决策；同时记录了反应式策略的系统性失败模式以及延迟-预算排队交互会静默地将有效重训预算减半，并公开完整模拟器、数据集流程和逐次运行的工件以支持复现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Accelerated Genetic Programming Hyper-Heuristics for Simulation-Based Scheduling via Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Python is widely used in scientific research because it enables rapid development and provides rich ecosystems for data analysis, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning. However, customized research code can become prohibitively slow as experiments scale. This challenge is particularly acute in discrete-event project-scheduling simulations, where sequential state updates, nested loops, conditional evaluations, and object-oriented structures limit the benefits of compiled numerical and GPU-accelerated libraries. Addressing these bottlenecks typically requires iterative profiling, refactoring, testing, and validation, yet researchers may lack the time or specialized software-engineering expertise for low-level optimization. This paper presents a systematic refactoring approach using Claude agentic AI on real-world project-scheduling workloads in a high-performance computing (HPC) environment. Guided by representative benchmarks and correctness checks, the agent identifies bottlenecks, implements targeted optimizations, and evaluates their effects, while the researcher retains final control. Testing runtime reduced from 1,298 seconds to under 200 seconds without changing outputs, saving four million core-hours (NZ\$320,000) annually.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用 Claude agentic AI 对真实项目调度负载中的 Python 代码进行系统性重构加速。agent 以代表性基准和正确性检查为引导，识别瓶颈、实施定向优化并评估效果，研究员保留最终控制；测试运行时间从 1298 秒降至 200 秒以内，输出不变，每年节省四百万核心小时（NZ$320,000）。
Motivation: Python 便于科研开发，但定制研究代码在实验规模化时可能极慢；离散事件项目调度仿真中的顺序状态更新、嵌套循环、条件判断和面向对象结构限制了编译数值库与 GPU 加速库的收益，而研究者往往缺乏时间或软件工程专长进行底层优化。
Method: 在 HPC 环境中使用 Claude agentic AI 对真实项目调度工作负载进行系统性重构：由代表性基准和正确性检查引导，agent 自动识别瓶颈、实施定向优化并评估效果，最终决策权保留给研究员。
Result: 摘要报告测试运行时间从 1298 秒降低到 200 秒以下，且不改变输出结果；每年可节省四百万核心小时，折合约 NZ$320,000。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该 agentic 重构方法在真实调度负载上的加速效果与输出一致性，并指出研究员保留最终控制权。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VideoRun2D Demo: Markerless Body Tracking for Biomechanical Analysis of Running
papers.abstract_en: Human pose estimation has advanced significantly due to the development of deep learning models, increased data availability, and improved computing resources. These developments have led to highly accurate body tracking systems with direct applications in sports analysis and performance evaluation. The VideoRun2D Demo performs a biomechanical analysis during sprints using different human pose estimators. The proposed framework was evaluated using human pose trackers and expert manual annotations. The tested framework uses 314 sprints from 44 professional runners, focusing on two key joint angles in sprint biomechanics: 1) hip flexion/extension and 2) knee flexion/extension. The framework also includes a post-processing module for outlier detection. The tested results demonstrate that the average root-mean-square errors range from 11.46° to 5.83° for the best trackers. When integrated with the post-processing modules, these errors can be reduced to 9.87° and 5.30°, respectively. The VideoRun2D Demo findings suggest that human pose-tracking approaches can be valuable resources for the biomechanical analysis of running.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. IEEE/CVF Conf. on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops (CVPRW), 2026 (1st PhysHuman Workshop: Physically Grounded Human Perception and Modeling)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 VideoRun2D Demo，一个基于无标记人体姿态估计 (markerless body tracking) 的短跑生物力学分析框架。该框架使用不同的人体姿态估计器，在 44 名专业跑者的 314 次短跑数据上，聚焦髋关节与膝关节的屈伸角，并与专家人工标注对比。测试结果显示最佳跟踪器的平均均方根误差在 11.46° 到 5.83° 之间，加入后处理模块后可降至 9.87° 和 5.30°。作者认为人体姿态跟踪方法可为跑步生物力学分析提供有价值的工具。
Motivation: 人体姿态估计的快速发展为运动分析和表现评估带来了直接应用，但需要验证其在短跑生物力学分析中的实际精度与可用性。
Method: 提出的框架整合多种人体姿态估计器，并包含一个用于异常值检测的后处理模块；评估集中于短跑生物力学中的两个关键关节角度，即髋关节屈伸和膝关节屈伸。
Result: 在专业跑者数据上，最佳跟踪器的平均均方根误差范围为 11.46° 至 5.83°；结合后处理模块后，误差分别降低到 9.87° 和 5.30°。
Conclusion: 摘要指出人体姿态跟踪方法可以作为跑步生物力学分析的有效资源，但其适用范围限于论文所测试的短跑场景和评估设置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring What a Specification Determines: A Formal Semantic-Block Model and an Execution-Judged Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces a formal semantic-block model for specifications and an execution-judged benchmark for evaluating specification quality independently of model capability. A specification is represented as a structure comprising semantic blocks, dependency relations, block-owned rules, decision points, and explicitly open questions, subject to four machine-checkable well-formedness conditions: acyclicity, single ownership, constraint domination, and totality or ambiguity-stop. Determinacy is defined model-theoretically as agreement among all conforming implementations and is estimated empirically through convergence across independent implementers. The model is instantiated on an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration specification containing 18 blocks and 19 dependency edges. Computational validation shows that the five-layer decomposition reduces mean per-task context by approximately 71% through dependency closures, covers 85.5% of the study-defined Oracle construct taxonomy with all identified gaps triaged, is not Pareto-dominated by the tested alternative partitions, and is recovered at the 99.9th percentile from citation-derived edges not used to define the original structure. The benchmark keeps the implementer panel fixed, includes a mandatory no-specification control arm, and uses PostgreSQL 16 and a live Oracle instance as deterministic execution judges. Six designed studies, including three pre-registered manipulations and three diagnostic analyses, further examine specification effects. Repeated runs on a 25-unit subsample reveal an empirical variability floor with a median arm-delta spread of 14.4 percentage points. The results support determinacy as a formal concept but not as a standalone empirical quality metric for the evaluated contemporary LLM implementers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种正式的语义块（semantic-block）模型来表示软件规格说明，并配套一个以执行为评判标准的基准，用于在不依赖模型能力的情况下评估规格质量。规格被结构化表示为语义块、依赖关系、块内规则、决策点和显式开放问题，并满足四个可机检的良构条件。作者将该模型实例化到 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 迁移规格上（18 个块、19 条依赖边），并通过收敛性、覆盖率和恢复率等计算验证，以及六项设计好的实现者研究来检验规格的确定性（determinacy）。
Motivation: 现有规格质量评估往往与实现该规格的模型能力纠缠在一起，难以单独衡量规格本身的好坏。作者希望建立一种与具体实现者能力无关的规格表示与评估方式，从而在模型能力持续变化的背景下可靠地度量和比较规格。
Method: 定义形式化的语义块模型：规格由语义块、依赖关系、块内规则、决策点和显式开放问题构成，并受四个可机检条件约束（无环、单一所有权、约束支配、全称性或歧义停止）。确定性（determinacy）在模型论上定义为所有符合实现的共识，并在经验上通过独立实现者之间的收敛性来估计。基准固定实现者面板、设置无规格对照组，并以 PostgreSQL 16 和在线 Oracle 实例作为确定性执行裁判。
Result: 计算验证显示：五层分解通过依赖闭包将每任务平均上下文减少约 71%，覆盖 85.5% 的 Oracle 构造分类且所有缺口已分流，未被测试的替代划分帕累托支配，并能从非用于定义原结构的引文派生边在 99.9 百分位恢复。25 单元子样本的重复运行显示经验变异下限，中位数组间差为 14.4 个百分点。结果支持确定性（determinacy）作为形式概念，但不足以作为所评估当代 LLM 实现者的独立经验质量指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作支持确定性作为形式概念，但同时也指出，对于所评估的当代 LLM 实现者，确定性不能单独作为经验质量指标。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 计算验证显示：五层分解通过依赖闭包将每任务平均上下文减少约 71%，覆盖 85.5% 的 Oracle 构造分类且所有缺口已分流，未被测试的替代划分帕累托支配，并能从非用于定义原结构的引文派生边在 99.9 百分位恢复。25 单元子样本的重复运行显示经验变异下限，中位数组间差为 14.4 个百分点。结果支持确定性（determinacy）作为形式概念，但不足以作为所评估当代 LLM 实现者的独立经验质量指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该工作支持确定性作为形式概念，但同时也指出，对于所评估的当代 LLM 实现者，确定性不能单独作为经验质量指标。

papers.title: Coupled multiscale paleoclimate reconstruction with four-dimensional variational data assimilation
papers.abstract_en: Paleoclimate archives extend climate knowledge beyond the instrumental era, registering different seasons, variables, time averages, and memory lengths. A longstanding problem is to integrate these heterogeneous sources of information within a unified methodology. Here we present a new data-assimilation framework, Last Millennium Reanalysis 4D-Var (LMR4D-Var), which reconstructs climate trajectories from these heterogeneous datasets while balancing errors in the model, observations, and initial conditions. We compare results using LMR4D-Var to assimilate proxies from PAGES2k, Temp12k, and borehole temperature profiles without treating them as instantaneous equivalents. Instrumental verification shows that LMR4D-Var achieves the highest skill compared with previous reconstructions. Borehole assimilation preserves skill against withheld annually resolved records, increases agreement between reconstructed 300--2000-m ocean heat content and independent estimates, and yields a cooler reconstructed Little Ice Age ocean. Results for Temp12k demonstrate assimilation of decadal-to-millennial records and the potential for Holocene and deeper-time applications with suitable emulators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个新的数据同化框架 LMR4D-Var（Last Millennium Reanalysis 4D-Var），用于从异质的古气候代用资料（PAGES2k、Temp12k、钻孔温度剖面）重建气候轨迹，同时平衡模型、观测和初始条件的误差，不再把这些资料当作瞬时等效观测。仪器期验证显示其技巧高于以往重建；钻孔同化在留出年分辨率记录上保持技巧，提高了 300–2000 m 海洋热含量重建与独立估计的一致性，并得到更冷的小冰期海洋。Temp12k 结果展示了十至千年尺度记录的 assimilation 能力，以及借助合适模拟器扩展到全新世和更深时间的潜力。
Motivation: 古气候档案记录了不同的季节、变量、时间平均和记忆长度，长期存在的问题是如何在统一方法中整合这些异质信息源。
Method: 提出 LMR4D-Var 数据同化框架，通过同时平衡模型误差、观测误差和初始条件误差，直接同化不同时间尺度的代用资料而非将其视为瞬时等效观测。
Result: 仪器期验证表明 LMR4D-Var 的技巧优于以往重建；钻孔同化在留出年分辨率记录上保持技巧，提升 300–2000 m 海洋热含量与独立估计的一致性，并得到更冷的小冰期海洋。
Conclusion: Temp12k 结果表明该方法可同化十年到千年尺度的记录，并具备借助合适模拟器推广到全新世及更深时段的潜力。

papers.title: LLM as Detector: An In-context Learning Approach for Tabular Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection in tabular data is challenging because abnormal samples often arise as violations of cross-feature dependencies rather than simple marginal deviations. Existing detectors rely on geometric or reconstruction signals, while prior LLM-based approaches mainly fine-tune LLMs with normal samples or generate synthetic anomalies. We propose LLM-Detector, a framework that utilizes the in-context learning capacity of LLMs for structured, prompt-conditioned scoring synthesis, enabling LLMs to derive anomaly detection logic from structured normal-state knowledge. Specifically, normal training data are converted into statistical summaries, causal dependencies, and distilled prototypes that are organized into a prompt for code generation. The resulting scoring engine evaluates statistical deviation, structural inconsistency, and density-based abnormality then computes an anomaly score for each test sample. We evaluate LLM-Detector on 24 tabular datasets, comparing against 15 SOTA baselines. Results show consistent improvements across both mixed-type and continuous-only settings. Moreover, this design eliminates the need for LLM fine-tuning or neural network training, reducing computational cost and enabling practical anomaly detection in real-world tabular systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM-Detector，利用大语言模型的上下文学习 (in-context learning) 能力进行表格数据异常检测。正常训练数据被转换为统计摘要、因果依赖和蒸馏原型，并以提示词形式引导 LLM 生成评分引擎代码，从而对每个测试样本计算异常分数。该方法在 24 个表格数据集上对比 15 个 SOTA 基线，在混合类型和连续型数据上都取得一致改进，且无需 LLM 微调或神经网络训练。
Motivation: 表格数据中的异常常常表现为跨特征依赖关系的违反，而非简单的边际偏离，现有检测器主要依赖几何或重构信号；此前基于 LLM 的方法需要微调或生成合成异常，存在局限。
Method: LLM-Detector 将正常训练数据转化为统计摘要、因果依赖和蒸馏原型，组织成提示词驱动 LLM 生成代码，得到一个综合评估统计偏差、结构不一致和基于密度的异常性的评分引擎。
Result: 在 24 个表格数据集上对比 15 个 SOTA 基线，该方法在混合类型和纯连续型设置下均取得一致改进；同时去除 LLM 微调和神经网络训练，降低了计算成本。
Conclusion: 该设计无需 LLM 微调或神经网络训练，能够在实际表格系统中实现低成本的异常检测。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quantifying Event Impacts on Time Series via Multiscale Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Shocks that spread through the web, such as cybersecurity breach disclosures, can abruptly disrupt financial time series and cause substantial abnormal losses. While these events are disclosed as discrete records through news reports, regulatory filings, or public databases, their consequences unfold through continuous market dynamics. This creates an event-conditioned impact prediction problem: given pre-event market history and limited event metadata, the goal is to estimate short-term post-disclosure abnormal loss rather than reconstruct the full post-event trajectory. However, most time-series forecasting models focus on endogenous regularities such as trend, seasonality, and autocorrelation, and thus struggle with rare and heterogeneous external events. The challenge is further amplified by sparse high-impact events and background market noise. We introduce EventTime, a multi-resolution framework that combines long-horizon market context, short-horizon pre-event dynamics, and event metadata. It incorporates an event fusion module that couples temporal representations with event attributes to identify relevant recent market patterns. To mitigate sparse supervision, EventTime further introduces a dynamic contrastive objective that constructs event- and time-series-aware positive and negative pairs during training. We also construct SECURE, a real-world dataset aligning cybersecurity incidents with stock-market time series and structured and LLM-derived semantic features. Experiments show that EventTime consistently outperforms state-of-the-art time-series and event-aware baselines in estimating post-event financial losses. Further analyses demonstrate more event-sensitive representations, greater robustness to incomplete metadata, and more interpretable estimates of short-term market impact following cybersecurity disclosures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EventTime，一个用于事件条件影响预测的多分辨率框架，针对网络安全事件披露后金融时间序列的短期异常损失估计。该方法结合长期市场上下文、短期事件前动态与事件元数据，并引入动态对比学习目标以缓解稀疏监督。作者还构建了 SECURE 数据集，将网络安全事件与股票市场时间序列及其结构化/LLM 衍生语义特征对齐。实验表明 EventTime 在估计事件后金融损失上持续优于现有时间序列与事件感知基线。
Motivation: 标准时间序列预测模型主要刻画趋势、季节性和自相关性等内生规律，难以应对罕见且异质的外部事件；网络安全披露等冲击以离散记录出现，但其后果在连续市场动态中展开，形成事件条件影响预测问题。
Method: EventTime 采用多分辨率框架，融合长期市场上下文、短期事件前动态和事件元数据；事件融合模块将时间表示与事件属性耦合以识别相关近期市场模式；动态对比学习目标在训练中构造事件与时间序列感知的正负样本对，缓解高影响事件稀疏和背景噪声问题。
Result: 实验显示 EventTime 在估计事件后金融损失上一致优于最新时间序列与事件感知基线；进一步分析表明其表征对事件更敏感、对不完整元数据更稳健，并能给出网络安全披露后短期市场影响的更具可解释性的估计。
Conclusion: 作者强调 EventTime 为网络安全披露后的短期市场影响提供了可解释的估计，并构建了 SECURE 数据集以支持该方向研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Are LLMs becoming similarly creative? Evidence from three years of models
papers.abstract_en: Many benchmarks track Large Language Model (LLM) performance on tasks with verifiable answers, but less is known about how LLM performance is evolving on open-ended tasks, where creativity, originality and diversity may matter as much as quality. As LLMs increasingly support human ideation and creative work, understanding trends in LLM performance on open-ended tasks is critical. This paper presents a preliminary analysis of LLM creative outputs spanning three years of model releases, examining model responses to Infinity-Chat100, a real-world collection of open-ended user queries, and the Alternate Uses Task, an established psychometric creativity assessment. Using sentence-embedding similarity, we examine trends in LLM responses to these prompts. Our findings show a statistically significant decrease in model output diversity over time, suggesting that LLM outputs may be converging in creative substance across models. If this trend persists, LLM-driven homogenization may progressively diminish human agency in human-AI co-creative work, demanding careful consideration of LLMs' role in the human creative process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对三年间多个 LLM 版本在开放式任务上的创造性输出进行初步分析，使用 Infinity-Chat100 真实用户查询和 Alternate Uses Task 心理测量任务，通过句子嵌入相似度衡量模型输出的多样性。摘要报告了模型输出多样性随时间呈现统计显著的下降，提示不同模型的输出可能在创造性内容上趋于收敛。作者担心若该趋势持续，LLM 驱动的同质化可能逐步削弱人机共创中的人类能动性。
Motivation: 现有基准大多追踪有可验证答案的 LLM 任务表现，但对开放式任务中创造性、原创性和多样性如何随模型演化知之甚少；由于 LLM 越来越多地支持人类构思和创造性工作，理解这一趋势变得关键。
Method: 收集三年来多个模型对 Infinity-Chat100（真实世界开放式用户查询集合）和 Alternate Uses Task（既有心理测量创造力评估）的响应，使用句子嵌入相似度 (sentence-embedding similarity) 分析模型输出随时间的变化趋势。
Result: 摘要报告发现模型输出多样性随时间呈统计显著下降，说明 LLM 输出在创造性内容上可能正在跨模型收敛。
Conclusion: 如果这种同质化趋势持续，LLM 驱动的输出趋同可能逐步削弱人类在人机共创工作中的能动性，需要审慎考虑 LLM 在人类创造过程中的角色。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Longitudinal Bayesian Learning of Continuous Disease Position across the Alzheimer's Disease Continuum
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) progresses as a continuous biological process, whereas most existing neuroimaging-based artificial intelligence methods remain limited to discrete diagnosis or clinical score prediction from cross-sectional imaging. In this work, we propose Disease Continuum Positioning (DCP), a longitudinal Bayesian Learning framework that continuously estimates disease severity from longitudinal diffusion tensor imaging (DTI). Specifically, DCP models disease severity as a low-dimensional probabilistic latent variable by jointly integrating longitudinal observations with weak clinical supervision, from which the proposed Disease Continuum Score (DCS) is derived to quantify an individual's position along the Alzheimer's disease continuum together with its associated uncertainty. Extensive experiments on the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort demonstrate that DCP consistently outperforms representative disease progression methods. More importantly, comprehensive validation analyses show that DCS accurately characterizes disease severity, exhibits strong clinical relevance, preserves longitudinal disease evolution, and predicts future disease conversion. These results suggest that DCS provides a quantitative imaging-derived representation for continuous assessment of Alzheimer's disease progression beyond conventional diagnostic labels and clinical scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出疾病连续体定位 (Disease Continuum Positioning, DCP)，一种纵向贝叶斯学习框架，用于从纵向扩散张量成像 (DTI) 中连续估计阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 的疾病严重程度。DCP 将疾病严重程度建模为低维概率潜变量，并结合弱临床监督，由此导出疾病连续体评分 (Disease Continuum Score, DCS) 及其不确定性。在 ADNI 队列上的实验表明 DCP 优于代表性的疾病进展方法，且 DCS 能刻画疾病严重程度、保持纵向演化并预测未来转化。
Motivation: AD 本质上是连续生物学过程，但现有基于神经影像的 AI 方法大多局限于横断面影像的离散诊断或临床评分预测，缺乏对疾病连续进展的建模能力。
Method: DCP 通过纵向贝叶斯学习将疾病严重程度建模为低维概率潜变量，联合整合纵向观测与弱临床监督，并据此导出带不确定性的疾病连续体评分 DCS。
Result: 在 ADNI 队列上的大量实验显示，DCP 一致优于代表性的疾病进展方法；验证分析表明 DCS 能准确刻画疾病严重程度、具有较强临床相关性、保持纵向疾病演化信息，并可预测未来疾病转化。
Conclusion: DCS 提供了超越传统诊断标签和临床评分的定量影像衍生表征，支持对 AD 进展进行连续评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SCAPE: Scenario-Conditioned Simulation-Augmented Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable performance evaluation is a central bottleneck for deploying robot-learning policies in real-world conditions. Real-world testing is faithful but costly and difficult to scale, whereas simulation-based testing scales easily but is inevitably biased by the sim-to-real gap. Existing simulation-augmented methods combine limited real-world rollouts with abundant simulation proxies, but focus on performance averaged over initial conditions and deployment settings. Such population-level averages obscure scenario-specific variation and provide limited guidance about when and where a policy can be safely deployed. We propose SCAPE, a scenario-conditioned simulation-augmented policy evaluation framework that predicts scenario-conditioned real-world policy performance using limited paired sim-and-real samples and large-scale simulation rollouts. SCAPE corrects sim-to-real bias in simulation labels before training the prediction model and calibrates prediction uncertainty through conformal prediction. We validate SCAPE on autonomous driving and quadruped velocity tracking. In sim-to-sim studies, SCAPE reduces scenario-level prediction error by 4.9%/34.7% (driving) and 14.5%/27.7% (quadruped) relative to scene-conditioned neural and aggregate statistical baselines on average. We further evaluate a velocity-tracking policy deployed on a physical Unitree Go2. SCAPE also improves testing sample efficiency, produces narrower calibrated prediction intervals, generalizes better to out-of-distribution scenarios, and enables fine-grained deployment strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCAPE，一种场景条件化的仿真增强策略评估框架 (scenario-conditioned simulation-augmented policy evaluation)，用少量配对仿真-真实样本与大规模仿真 rollout 预测策略在真实世界中的场景条件化性能。框架在训练预测模型前先校正仿真标签中的 sim-to-real 偏差，并用 conformal prediction 校准不确定性。作者在自动驾驶与四足速度跟踪任务上验证，并在物理 Unitree Go2 机器人上评估部署策略。
Motivation: 真实世界测试可靠但成本高、难扩展，仿真测试易扩展但存在 sim-to-real 偏差；现有仿真增强方法只关注初始条件和部署设置上的平均性能，掩盖了场景层面的差异，难以指导策略在何时何地可安全部署。
Method: SCAPE 使用有限的配对仿真-真实样本和大规模仿真 rollout 来学习场景条件化的真实世界性能预测；先对仿真标签做 sim-to-real 偏差校正，再训练预测模型，并通过 conformal prediction 校准预测不确定性。
Result: 在 sim-to-sim 研究中，SCAPE 相比场景条件化神经网络基线和聚合统计基线，将自动驾驶场景级预测误差平均降低 4.9%/34.7%，四足任务降低 14.5%/27.7%；在物理 Unitree Go2 上评估速度跟踪策略时，SCAPE 还提升了测试样本效率、产生更窄的校准预测区间、对分布外场景泛化更好，并支持细粒度部署策略。
Conclusion: 摘要认为场景条件化的性能预测与不确定性校准可以减少仿真增强评估中的偏差，支持更细粒度的安全部署决策。

papers.title: Microlensify: a Transformer Based Machine Learning Classifier for Microlensing Events Trained on TESS Light Curves
papers.abstract_en: Microlensing can reveal populations of faint compact objects that are otherwise difficult to detect. Depending on their design, all-sky surveys have the potential to search for these objects across the sky. The Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), primarily designed to detect transiting exoplanets, also provides near all-sky coverage with high cadence. In this work, we use TESS data to search for microlensing candidates using both traditional and machine-learning methods and to identify associated false positives in high-cadence surveys. Microlensify is a physics-informed, transformer-based variational autoencoder trained on simulated single-lens microlensing light curves and real TESS Sector 12 data. The model classifies events, reconstructs light curves, and estimates microlensing event durations. Applied to $\sim 5.6$ million TESS light curves, it identified between $0.036\%$ and $1.89\%$ as microlensing candidates across different TESS pipelines. After applying microlensing detection metrics and cross-matching with SIMBAD, we obtained a final list of candidates and identified false positives including long-period variables, Mira variables, cataclysmic variables, red giants, and transients. We also found Gaussian-like peaks caused by asteroid crossings, a potential source of false positives in high-cadence microlensing surveys. The model also predicts event duration with an accuracy of $R^2 = 0.97$. The model was further tested on published events from different ground-based microlensing surveys, confirming 92.7% as microlensing, demonstrating its applicability across surveys with different cadences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Microlensify，一个基于Transformer的物理信息变分自编码器，用于从TESS光变曲线中识别微引力透镜事件。模型在模拟单透镜微引力透镜光变曲线和真实TESS Sector 12数据上训练，可执行事件分类、光变曲线重建和事件持续时间估计。应用于约560万条TESS光变曲线后，识别出0.036%到1.89%的候选体，并识别了长周期变星、Mira变星、灾变变星、红巨星、瞬变源以及小行星穿越产生的高斯状峰等假阳性来源。模型对事件持续时间的预测准确率R²=0.97，在来自不同地面微引力透镜巡天的已发表事件上测试，确认92.7%为微引力透镜。
Motivation: 微引力透镜可以揭示难以探测的暗弱致密天体群体，全天巡天有潜力搜索这些天体。TESS虽主要设计用于探测凌星行星，但提供近全天覆盖和高节奏数据，本文旨在利用TESS数据结合传统和机器学习方法搜索微引力透镜候选体，并识别高节奏巡天中的假阳性。
Method: 提出Microlensify，一个物理信息、基于Transformer的变分自编码器（VAE），在模拟单透镜微引力透镜光变曲线和真实TESS Sector 12数据上训练。模型执行事件分类、光变曲线重建和微引力透镜事件持续时间估计，并应用微引力透镜检测指标及与SIMBAD的交叉匹配来筛选最终候选列表。
Result: 应用于约560万条TESS光变曲线，在不同TESS管线中识别出0.036%到1.89%的微引力透镜候选体；持续时间预测R²=0.97；在来自不同地面巡天的已发表事件上测试，确认92.7%为微引力透镜。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该模型在跨不同节奏巡天中的适用性，并指出小行星穿越产生的高斯状峰是高节奏微引力透镜巡天中潜在的假阳性来源。摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: Beyond Imitation: Filtering On-Policy Distillation by Reasoning Progress
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective framework for post-training language models by pairing student-generated trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a teacher. However, OPD implicitly assumes that teacher-derived rewards are an appropriate proxy for reasoning progress, and therefore treats all teacher feedback equally during policy optimization. While in practice, this assumption does not always hold. We observe that teacher-derived rewards often conflict with genuine reasoning progress, as reasoning steps with clear reasoning advancement may still receive lower distillation rewards, simply due to deviation from teacher's outputs. To address this mismatch, we propose Reasoning-Progress-Aware Reward Filtering for On-Policy Distillation (R2-OPD), which constructs two within-trajectory rankings of reasoning spans, one from teacher-derived rewards and the other from independently estimated progress reward. Distillation rewards are selectively suppressed whenever the two rankings disagree, reducing supervision that conflicts with reasoning progress while preserving effective teacher guidance. Our approach shows consistent improvement over standard OPD especially regarding reasoning performances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出基于策略的蒸馏 (on-policy distillation, OPD) 隐含假设教师奖励能代理推理进展 (reasoning progress)，但实践中教师奖励常因偏离教师输出而与真实推理进展冲突。作者提出 R2-OPD，通过构造轨迹内推理片段的两组排序（教师奖励排序与独立估计的进展奖励排序）并抑制两者不一致时的蒸馏奖励，从而在保留有效教师监督的同时减少冲突监督，并在推理性能上相对标准 OPD 取得一致提升。
Motivation: 标准 OPD 在策略优化时对所有教师反馈一视同仁，但教师奖励与真实推理进展可能不一致：清晰推进推理的步骤可能因偏离教师输出而得到较低蒸馏奖励，导致次优监督。
Method: R2-OPD 在每个轨迹内分别依据教师奖励和独立估计的进展奖励对推理片段构建两组排序，当两组排序不一致时选择性抑制蒸馏奖励，降低与推理进展冲突的监督信号。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在推理性能上相对标准 OPD 有一致改进 (consistent improvement)，尤其体现在推理表现方面。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式感知推理进展并过滤冲突的教师奖励可以缓解 OPD 中教师奖励与真实进步之间的错配，从而提升后训练效果。

papers.title: HiRA-CAM: Preserving Fine-Grained Spatial Relevance in Gradient-Based Visual Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Deep Learning models can include billions of parameters or more, making it difficult to explain their internal transformations and outputs. However, explainability is increasing in importance due to the use of AI in crucial applications. This paper focuses on the interpretability of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Building on the popular gradient based method LayerCAM for extracting internal features in CNNs, we propose an improved method named HiRA-CAM, and show that it outperforms both LayerCAM and Grad-CAM on creating useful saliency maps for object classification. The main feature of HiRA-CAM is its adaptive use of activation maps from all the layers of the CNN to arrive at a more focused saliency map.
papers.comment: IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence, Maastricht, Netherlands, June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiRA-CAM，一种基于梯度的 CNN 可解释性方法，在 LayerCAM 基础上自适应地利用 CNN 所有层的激活图来生成更聚焦的显著性图 (saliency map)。作者在目标分类任务上比较了 HiRA-CAM、LayerCAM 和 Grad-CAM，声称 HiRA-CAM 能生成更有用的显著性图。
Motivation: 深度模型可能包含数十亿甚至更多参数，内部变换和输出难以解释，而可解释性在关键 AI 应用中日益重要。现有梯度基方法如 LayerCAM 和 Grad-CAM 生成的显著性图仍有改进空间。
Method: 提出 HiRA-CAM，其核心特征是自适应地使用 CNN 所有层的激活图，以得到更聚焦的显著性图，而不仅是像 LayerCAM 那样利用特定层的信息。
Result: 摘要报告 HiRA-CAM 在目标分类任务上生成有用显著性图方面优于 LayerCAM 和 Grad-CAM，但未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用 CNN 所有层的激活图可以改进梯度基可视化方法，使显著性图更加聚焦。

papers.title: HYDRA: A Heterogeneous Chiplet DSE Framework for Serving Dynamic Hybrid LLM Workloads
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid Transformer-Mamba large language models (LLMs) enhance long-context efficiency, but their heterogeneous computation and communication patterns complicate efficient hardware acceleration. Chiplet-based architectures offer a scalable solution by integrating specialized compute and memory units. However, the design space spanning static architectural configurations and dynamic runtime policies is prohibitively large to explore exhaustively. To address this challenge, we present HYDRA, a comprehensive design space exploration framework for hybrid LLM serving on heterogeneous chiplet systems. HYDRA jointly explores chiplet composition, placement, inter-chiplet bandwidth provisioning, dynamic batching, and runtime scheduling. It integrates communication-aware placement, dynamic batching, elastic task scheduling, and a fast Markov-based performance estimator that captures multi-tenant runtime dynamics for efficient and accurate exploration. Across all workloads, HYDRA delivers 1.55x the throughput and 43.7 percent lower time-to-first-token on average, with throughput gains reaching up to 2.3x compared to state-of-the-art baselines. These results highlight that co-designing architecture and runtime policies is critical for efficient large-scale LLM serving on heterogeneous chiplet systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE/ACM ESWEEK (CASES) 2026; the official version will be available in IEEE TCAD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HYDRA，一个用于异构 chiplet 系统上服务混合 Transformer-Mamba LLM 工作负载的设计空间探索框架。它联合探索 chiplet 组成、布局、片间带宽供给、动态批处理和运行时调度，并集成通信感知布局、动态批处理、弹性任务调度及基于 Markov 的快速性能估计器。实验显示相比 SOTA 基线平均吞吐量提升 1.55 倍、首 token 延迟降低 43.7%，吞吐量提升最高达 2.3 倍。
Motivation: 混合 Transformer-Mamba LLM 具有异构计算和通信模式，传统硬件加速方案难以高效适配；chiplet 架构虽可扩展，但其设计空间同时涵盖静态架构配置与动态运行时策略，规模过大难以穷举搜索。
Method: 提出 HYDRA 框架，联合探索 chiplet 组成、放置、片间带宽供给、动态批处理与运行时调度。框架集成通信感知放置、动态批处理、弹性任务调度，并引入快速 Markov 性能估计器以捕捉多租户运行时动态，实现高效且准确的探索。
Result: 所有工作负载上，HYDRA 相比 SOTA 基线平均提升 1.55 倍吞吐量，平均降低 43.7% 的首 token 延迟，吞吐量提升最高达 2.3 倍。
Conclusion: 结果表明，架构与运行时策略的协同设计（co-design）对异构 chiplet 系统上大规模 LLM 高效服务至关重要。

papers.title: Deep-MKV-TS: Path-Dependent McKean--Vlasov Control for Financial Time Series Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Deep-MKV-TS, a path-dependent McKean-Vlasov framework for financial scenario generation. The stochastic dynamics are chosen by matching selected path and volatility features of generated scenarios to those observed in the data. Starting from an interpretable reference model, Deep-MKV-TS preserves the reference drift and adjusts its volatility, while a regularization penalty limits unnecessary departures from the calibrated dynamics. We solve the resulting control problem using a neural, sample-based implementation of the stochastic maximum principle. We validate the method against an exactly computable oracle. On Heston and Heston-mixture models, Deep-MKV-TS substantially reduces path-dependent and volatility-related deficiencies of the reference model. In delayed-volatility experiments, the correction remains effective as the forecasting horizon increases, while direct training becomes less reliable. On held-out intraday equity-index futures, the corrected model improves conditional forecasts relative to the reference and reaches a level of performance comparable to flexible generative and historical baselines. The resulting scenarios also support greater exposure than the reference under a fixed drawdown-risk target. These results show that path-dependent McKean-Vlasov control can enrich an interpretable reference model without replacing it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Deep-MKV-TS，一个路径依赖的 McKean-Vlasov 控制框架，用于金融场景生成。方法通过匹配生成场景与数据中观测到的路径与波动率特征来选择随机动态，保留可解释参考模型的漂移项并调整其波动率，同时加入正则惩罚避免过度偏离校准动力学。作者使用随机最大值原理的神经样本实现求解该控制问题，并在 Heston、Heston-mixture 模型及留出的权益指数期货数据上验证了效果。
Motivation: 金融场景生成中，可解释的参考模型在路径依赖和波动率相关特征上存在缺陷，但直接替换为灵活生成模型会损失可解释性；需要一种能在保留参考模型结构的同时修正其路径与波动率不足的方法。
Method: 将场景生成建模为路径依赖的 McKean-Vlasov 控制问题：在保留参考模型漂移的前提下调整波动率，使选中特征与观测数据匹配，并加入正则化惩罚限制对校准动态的不必要偏离；采用基于神经网络的样本化随机最大值原理实现求解。
Result: 在精确可计算的 oracle 上验证了方法；在 Heston 和 Heston-mixture 模型上大幅减少参考模型的路径依赖与波动率相关缺陷；延迟波动率实验中，随预测期限增加修正依然有效，而直接训练可靠度下降；在留出的股指期货数据上改善了条件预测，并达到与灵活生成基线和历史基线相当的水平；在固定回撤风险目标下支持比参考模型更大的暴露。
Conclusion: 结果表明路径依赖的 McKean-Vlasov 控制可以在不替换可解释参考模型的情况下丰富其表现，为金融时间序列生成提供一种保留解释性的校正路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Concentrated Liquidity Provision: a Reinforcement Learning Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Automated market makers (AMMs) are a cornerstone of decentralised finance (DeFi). Constant product markets with concentrated liquidity, such as UniswapV3, are now a well-established design. In these markets, liquidity providers (LPs) face a sequential decision problem: they must decide when to rebalance their positions and which price ranges to allocate capital to as market conditions evolve. We formulate dynamic liquidity provision as a stochastic impulse control problem and use reinforcement learning (RL) to solve it, focusing on providing interpretable solutions. We show that learned policies exhibit rich state-dependent behaviour, allocating liquidity according to mispricing, rebalancing costs, uncertainty, inventory exposure, and heterogeneous risk preferences. These behaviours help compress the left tail of the Profit and Loss (PnL) distribution and avoid catastrophic outcomes under high uncertainty. Finally, we benchmark the RL agents against baseline and sophisticated agents from the AMM microstructure literature and analyse their performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将 Uniswap V3 等常数乘积集中流动性 AMM 中的动态流动性提供建模为随机脉冲控制问题，并用强化学习 (RL) 求解，强调策略的可解释性。学习到的策略根据错误定价、再平衡成本、不确定性、库存暴露和异质风险偏好呈现丰富的状态依赖行为，能够压缩 PnL 分布的左尾并在高不确定性下避免灾难性结果。作者还将 RL agent 与 AMM 微观结构文献中的基线和更复杂的 agent 进行了基准比较。
Motivation: 在 Uniswap V3 这类集中流动性市场中，流动性提供者面临序列决策问题：需要随着市场条件演化决定何时再平衡头寸以及将资金分配到哪些价格区间。现有方法对这一动态决策问题缺乏系统性的可解释求解方案。
Method: 将动态流动性提供形式化为随机脉冲控制问题，并使用强化学习来求解；方法重点在于生成可解释的策略，而非仅追求收益最大化。
Result: 摘要表明学习到的策略能将流动性分配与错误定价、再平衡成本、不确定性、库存暴露及风险偏好相关联；这些策略压缩 PnL 分布左尾，并在高不确定性下避免灾难性损失；同时与 AMM 微观结构文献中的基线及复杂 agent 进行了性能对比分析。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RL 可以产生可解释且状态依赖的集中流动性管理策略，并在不确定市场条件下带来风险层面的改善。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Recognition: Compact Multi-Domain Arabic Manuscript HTR with Candidate-Selection Analysis and Evidence-Preserving Review
papers.abstract_en: Historical Arabic manuscript transcription is not only a recognition problem. A usable scholarly system must cope with shifting hands and layouts, preserve uncertain readings, distinguish visual evidence from linguistic plausibility, and record the researcher's final decision. We present Phoenix, a 4.99-million-parameter CNN-BiLSTM-CTC recognizer, and Athar, an evidence-aware review workflow built around it. Phoenix is adapted across archival, Maghrebi, and historical manuscript domains using document-aware replay, an expanded 81-symbol codec, and forgetting guards that reject checkpoints that improve a new domain at unacceptable cost to previous domains. In a pre-specified held-out comparison against the preceding checkpoint, frozen before evaluation and scored with greedy decoding and raw references, Phoenix reduced CER from 22.12% to 17.86% on 10,594 Agapet lines and from 17.72% to 11.84% on 11,684 Omar lines, while regressing from 10.39% to 10.72% on 164 TariMa lines. Across the two large held-out sets, character-weighted CER fell from 19.98% to 14.93%, a 25.3% relative error reduction. A separate same-protocol development diagnostic found the lowest CER for Phoenix on four of four comparable domains (9.59% unweighted macro CER). An N-best diagnostic revealed a 2.15-point oracle gap between beam decoding and Oracle@25, while neural text rerankers, consensus MBR, CTC-posterior quality estimation, and local pre-CTC hidden-state quality estimation recovered less than 4% of this gap. Athar therefore preserves the visual reading, exposes bounded alternatives, uses local language models conservatively, retrieves source parallels with unique, ambiguous, or abstain states, and exports auditable TEI and PAGE-XML records. The results support evaluating manuscript HTR as auditable evidence management rather than silent text replacement.

TL;DR: 本文提出面向多领域阿拉伯文历史手稿的紧凑识别系统 Phoenix（4.99M 参数的 CNN-BiLSTM-CTC）以及配套的、保留证据的审阅工作流 Athar。Phoenix 通过文档感知回放、扩展的 81 符号编码表和遗忘守卫（forgetting guards）适应档案体、马格里布体等历史手稿领域；在预留的 held-out 对比中，使 Agapet 行的 CER 从 22.12% 降至 17.86%、Omar 行从 17.72% 降至 11.84%，TariMa 行略有回退（10.39% 升至 10.72%），两个大规模 held-out 集上的字符加权 CER 从 19.98% 降至 14.93%（相对错误率降低 25.3%）。开发诊断发现 beam 解码与 Oracle@25 之间存在 2.15 点的 oracle 差距，而多种重排与质量估计方法仅能恢复其中不到 4%。Athar 保留视觉读取、展示受限候选、谨慎使用局部语言模型，并以可审计的 TEI 与 PAGE-XML 记录输出。
Motivation: 历史阿拉伯文手稿转写不仅是识别问题，可用的学术系统必须应对书写风格与版面的变化、保留不确定的读法、区分视觉证据与语言合理性，并记录研究者的最终决策。
Method: 提出紧凑的 Phoenix 识别器（CNN-BiLSTM-CTC，4.99M 参数），利用文档感知回放（document-aware replay）、81 符号编码表和遗忘守卫进行跨档案、马格里布及历史手稿领域的适应；并构建 Athar 证据感知审阅工作流，包含 N-best 诊断、受限候选、保守的局部语言模型、源文本平行检索以及 TEI/PAGE-XML 可审计导出。
Result: 摘要报告 Phoenix 在 10,594 行 Agapet 上 CER 从 22.12% 降至 17.86%，在 11,684 行 Omar 上从 17.72% 降至 11.84%，在 164 行 TariMa 上从 10.39% 回退至 10.72%；两个大 held-out 集字符加权 CER 从 19.98% 降至 14.93%（相对降低 25.3%）。beam 解码与 Oracle@25 的 oracle 差距为 2.15 点，神经文本重排器、共识 MBR、CTC 后验质量估计及局部 pre-CTC 隐状态质量估计恢复的差距不足 4%。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果支持将手稿 HTR 视为可审计的证据管理而非静默的文本替换。

papers.title: Causal Generalization of Continuous Treatment Effects under Covariate Shift
papers.abstract_en: Average dose-response functions are widely used to summarize causal effects of continuous treatments, but most existing methods assume that the observed sample represents the target population. We study a covariate-shift setting in which covariates, treatment, and outcome are observed in a labelled source sample, while only covariates are observed in the target sample. We develop a two-sample local polynomial regression framework based on pseudo-outcomes that use source outcomes to address confounding and target covariates to define the population of interest. We further propose a source-to-target extension of distance covariance optimal weighting (DCOW), designed to remove treatment-covariate dependence in the source sample while aligning the weighted source covariate distribution with the target population. A central theoretical contribution is a weight-level analysis of this optimization-based procedure: we show that the population criterion identifies the oracle source-to-target weights and that approximate empirical minimizers, including exact minimizers as a special case, converge uniformly to these weights under regularity conditions. We also establish consistency and asymptotic normality of the resulting estimator. Simulations show that the proposed method improves target dose-response estimation relative to DCOW, generalized-propensity-score weighting, entropy balancing, and unweighted alternatives. We illustrate the method in a county-level analysis of PM2.5 exposure and subsequent heart-disease mortality using a source-target validation design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究协变量偏移 (covariate shift) 下连续处理变量 (continuous treatment) 的平均剂量反应函数 (average dose-response function) 的因果估计问题。作者提出基于伪结果 (pseudo-outcome) 的两样本局部多项式回归框架，并给出距离协方差最优加权 (DCOW) 的源到目标扩展，同时提供权重层面的理论分析。模拟和PM2.5与心脏病死亡率的县域数据示例表明方法有效。
Motivation: 现有连续处理因果效应方法大多假设观测样本即目标总体，当目标总体仅提供协变量而源样本提供协变量、处理与结果时，直接估计会产生偏误。论文针对这一协变量偏移场景，目标是把源样本的因果信息迁移到仅有协变量的目标总体。
Method: 提出基于伪结果的两样本局部多项式回归框架，用源样本结果处理混杂、用目标协变量定义目标总体；并设计 DCOW 的源到目标扩展，在去除源样本中处理-协变量依赖的同时，使加权后的源协变量分布与目标总体对齐。理论上证明总体准则可识别 oracle 源到目标权重，且近似经验最小化子在正则条件下一致收敛于该权重。
Result: 理论部分建立了权重估计的一致性、估计量的相合性与渐近正态性；模拟显示所提方法在目标剂量反应估计上优于 DCOW、广义倾向得分加权、熵平衡以及不加权的备选方法。县域层面 PM2.5 暴露与心脏病死亡率的源-目标验证分析也展示了实用性。
Conclusion: 论文强调该优化式加权框架能从仅有协变量的目标总体出发改进连续处理效果的迁移估计，理论贡献集中在权重层面的可识别性与收敛性。摘要未提及明显局限，适用范围限于两样本协变量偏移设定。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fairness-Aware Network Embeddings: Methods, Applications, and Challenges
papers.abstract_en: Network embedding methods learn low-dimensional representations of graph-structured data to support downstream tasks such as node classification, link prediction, and influence maximization. However, real-world networks often reflect structural inequalities arising from demographic imbalances, homophily, and other societal biases, which fairness-agnostic embedding methods can encode and amplify. To address this issue, numerous fairness-aware network embedding methods have been proposed to mitigate bias while preserving embedding utility. This survey presents a comprehensive overview of fairness-aware network embeddings for complex networks. We propose a taxonomy that categorizes existing methods along three main complementary dimensions: underlying embedding approach (spectral, random walk, graph neural network, Bayesian, and method-agnostic), fairness intervention strategy (pre-processing, in-processing, and post-processing), and fairness objective criterion (embedding- or task-level). We further compare methods with respect to group versus individual fairness and assumptions regarding sensitive attributes. Finally, we discuss current limitations and highlight promising future research directions. This survey provides a unified perspective on fairness-aware network embedding and serves as a reference for developing fair and trustworthy network representation learning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于公平感知网络嵌入 (fairness-aware network embedding) 的综述，系统总结了面向复杂网络、在保持嵌入效用的同时缓解偏差的现有方法。作者提出一个三维分类体系，分别从底层嵌入方法、公平干预策略和公平性目标准则来组织已有工作，并比较了群体公平与个体公平以及对敏感属性的假设。文章最后讨论了当前局限并指出未来研究方向。
Motivation: 真实世界网络常因人口统计失衡、同质性 (homophily) 等社会偏差而带有结构性不平等，而忽略公平性的网络嵌入方法会编码并放大这些偏差，影响节点分类、链接预测等下游任务，因此需要系统梳理公平感知的嵌入方法。
Method: 提出一个三维互补的分类法：底层嵌入方法 (谱方法、随机游走、图神经网络、贝叶斯、方法无关)、公平干预策略 (预处理、处理中、后处理) 和公平目标准则 (嵌入级或任务级)；并额外从群体公平与个体公平、敏感属性假设两个角度对方法进行比较。
Result: 作为综述，本文给出全面的方法分类与比较框架，未报告具体实验数值；其核心产出是该三维分类体系以及对现有方法统一视角的梳理。
Conclusion: 作者总结当前公平感知网络嵌入的局限性，提出有前景的未来研究方向，并将该综述定位为开发公平可信网络表示学习方法的参考。

papers.title: CAViAR: A Causal Video Dataset for Fine-Grained Accident Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: While modern autonomous driving systems excel at perception tasks such as object detection and trajectory prediction, they lack the high-level causal reasoning required to interpret traffic accidents. In particular, determining responsibility, such as identifying who is at fault and which traffic rule was violated, remains largely unexplored in current benchmarks. To this end, we introduce CAViAR (Causal Accident Video and Incident Analysis Repository), a human-annotated dashcam benchmark comprising 2,249 real-world accident videos collected from CarCrashDataset (CCD) and Nexar. Each video is annotated with structured labels spanning environmental conditions, accident type, causal explanation, apparent At-Fault Agent, affected agent, and apparent rule-violation category. We benchmark state-of-the-art vision-language models (VLMs), including Cosmos-Reason2, Qwen3-VL, and InternVL3. Once class imbalance is accounted for with majority/random baselines and balanced metrics, perceptual competence is uneven--lighting is nearly solved, whereas weather and road-condition accuracy fall at or below the majority-class baseline---and all models degrade sharply on accident type and responsibility reasoning. Overall, CAViAR exposes a practical Perception--Reasoning Gap: current VLMs may recognize salient context, but do not reliably map visible agent actions to annotated rule-relevant responsibility categories in safety-critical driving scenarios. Code, annotation schema, prompts, and evaluation scripts are available at: https://github.com/nec-labs-ma/CAViAR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAViAR（Causal Accident Video and Incident Analysis Repository），一个包含 2,249 个真实行车记录仪事故视频的人工标注基准，每个视频标注了环境条件、事故类型、因果解释、过错方、受影响方和违规类别。作者评测了 Cosmos-Reason2、Qwen3-VL 和 InternVL3 等视觉语言模型（VLM），发现模型在光照识别上接近饱和，但天气和路况识别表现低于或等于多数类基线，且在事故类型和责任推理上大幅退化，由此揭示当前的 Perception–Reasoning Gap。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶系统擅长目标检测和轨迹预测等感知任务，但缺乏解释交通事故所需的高层因果推理能力；确定责任归属（谁有过错、违反了什么交通规则）在现有基准中基本未被探索。
Method: 作者从 CarCrashDataset（CCD）和 Nexar 收集事故视频并人工标注结构化标签，涵盖环境条件、事故类型、因果解释、过错方、受影响方和违规类别；随后用多数类/随机基线平衡评估多个 VLM，并公开代码、标注模式、提示词和评测脚本。
Result: 在考虑类别不平衡并使用平衡指标后，感知能力表现不均衡：光照条件几乎被解决，而天气和道路状况的准确率低于或等于多数类基线；所有模型在事故类型和责任推理上表现急剧下降，无法可靠地将可见的驾驶动作映射到规则相关的责任类别。
Conclusion: CAViAR 暴露了当前 VLM 在安全关键驾驶场景中存在系统的感知–推理差距，即模型能识别显著上下文，却难以完成责任相关的因果推理；作者强调该数据集可作为评估和推进事故级视觉推理能力的资源。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Heteroscedastic Neural Surrogate Modeling for Robust and Rapid Bayesian Inference in Fusion Plasma Diagnostics
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian inference via Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) provides effective parameter estimation, but its real-time application in complex physical systems is hindered by heavy computational bottlenecks and extreme sensitivity to statistical noise. We address this by proposing a neural-network-based probabilistic surrogate framework for rapid and robust MCMC inference. Using fusion plasma Thomson scattering diagnostics as a challenging, noise-dominated testbed, our approach employs a dual-head architecture to simultaneously estimate the expected physical emission spectrum and the channel-wise intrinsic measurement noise variance. By optimizing a Gaussian Negative Log-Likelihood (GNLL) objective, the learned aleatoric uncertainty dynamically buffers the sampler against pathological shot noise. Evaluations demonstrate that this surrogate framework achieves > 1500x acceleration over exact physical forward models, while simultaneously reducing inference error (RMSE) by >20% compared to standard homoscedastic neural baselines, offering a highly promising paradigm for real-time physical analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经网络的概率代理 (probabilistic surrogate) 框架，用于快速且稳健的 MCMC 贝叶斯推断，并以聚变等离子体 Thomson 散射诊断这一高噪声场景作为测试平台。框架采用双头架构同时估计期望物理发射谱与逐通道本征测量噪声方差，并通过高斯负对数似然 (GNLL) 目标训练，使学习到的 aleatoric uncertainty 帮助采样器应对散粒噪声。评估显示该方法相对精确物理正演模型提速超过 1500 倍，同时比标准同方差 (homoscedastic) 神经基线降低超过 20% 的 RMSE。
Motivation: 基于 MCMC 的贝叶斯推断在复杂物理系统中因计算瓶颈和对统计噪声的极端敏感而难以实时应用，这成为参数估计在实际诊断场景中的主要障碍。
Method: 提出双头神经网络代理模型，同时输出期望物理发射谱和逐通道测量噪声方差；通过优化高斯负对数似然 (GNLL) 目标，将 aleatoric uncertainty 引入采样过程以缓冲病态散粒噪声的影响。
Result: 在融合等离子体 Thomson 散射诊断上，该代理框架相比精确物理正演模型实现超过 1500 倍加速，相比标准同方差神经基线将推断误差 (RMSE) 降低超过 20%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架为实时物理分析提供了一种有前景的范式，尤其适用于噪声主导的复杂物理诊断场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Does Marginal Coverage Guarantee Class-Conditional Safety for Zero-Shot VLMs Under Shift?
papers.abstract_en: Split-conformal prediction provides marginal coverage under exchangeability and is increasingly used as an abstention layer for zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs). We audit this practice under deployment shift for CLIP, OpenCLIP, and SigLIP across ImageNet and non-ImageNet settings. Marginal coverage can remain relatively high while class-conditional tail coverage collapses: on ImageNet-Sketch, worst-class coverage falls to $\approx 0$ and 10-12% of classes lie below a finite-sample null floor, despite marginal coverage of about 0.86. The failure is aligned with target-domain class accuracy but is not predicted by the source-domain diagnostics we test. Source-side Mondrian calibration improves the in-distribution tail but does not transfer, while clustered conformal and Conf-OT improve marginal or average metrics without recovering the worst-class tail. Target-side class calibration substantially lifts the tail, but requires labels for every class and remains set-size-intensive. We further identify a 2-3$\times$ cross-family efficiency gap and show that native SigLIP sigmoid scores remove APS's probability-mass interpretation. The findings persist across the tested model scale, pretraining corpus, prompt, miscoverage level $α$, and shifted non-ImageNet settings. Marginal conformal coverage should therefore be treated as an average reliability statistic, not as a safety guarantee for the class tail.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Uncertainty Quantification for Computer Vision (UNCV). 34 pages (16 main + 18 supplementary), 10 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对零样本视觉-语言模型（VLM）在部署分布偏移下使用分裂共形预测（split-conformal prediction）作为弃权层（abstention layer）的做法进行审计，覆盖 CLIP、OpenCLIP 和 SigLIP，并同时考察 ImageNet 与非 ImageNet 设定。主要发现是边际覆盖率可能保持较高，而类条件尾部覆盖率却会崩溃：在 ImageNet-Sketch 上最差类的覆盖率降至约 0，且 10–12% 的类低于有限样本零假设下限，尽管边际覆盖率约为 0.86。作者由此认为边际共形覆盖率应被视为平均可靠性统计量，而非类尾部的安全保障。
Motivation: 分裂共形预测在可交换性假设下提供边际覆盖率，并越来越多地被用作零样本 VLM 的弃权层；但在部署偏移下，安全性需要类条件覆盖保证，而现有实践是否满足这一要求尚未得到充分审计。
Method: 作者在 CLIP、OpenCLIP、SigLIP 上，跨 ImageNet 及非 ImageNet 设置系统审计共形预测的行为，检验源域诊断指标，并对比源端 Mondrian 校准、聚类共形（clustered conformal）以及 Conf-OT 等方法；同时分析跨模型族的效率差距和 SigLIP 原生 sigmoid 分数对 APS 概率质量解释的影响。
Result: 摘要报告在 ImageNet-Sketch 上最差类覆盖降至约 0，10–12% 的类低于有限样本零假设下限，而边际覆盖率约为 0.86；该失败与目标域类准确率一致，但无法由所测试的源域诊断指标预测。源端 Mondrian 校准能改善分布内尾部但不迁移；目标端类校准显著提升尾部，但需要每个类的标签且集大小开销大；还存在 2–3 倍的跨模型族效率差距。
Conclusion: 边际共形覆盖率应被当作平均可靠性统计量，而不是类尾部的安全保障；上述现象在模型规模、预训练语料、提示词、误覆盖水平 α 以及偏移的非 ImageNet 设定下均持续存在。
Relevance: 3
