papers.title: Data-Driven Time-Varying Control Barrier Functions for Adaptive Safe-Set Learning with Online Decremental Support Vector Machines
papers.abstract_en: Mission-critical intelligent systems often operate under time-varying limitations that reduce control authority and change the admissible safe operating envelope. In such settings, a safety certificate learned under nominal conditions may become invalid as system capability changes. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a degradation-aware, data-driven safety-filtering framework that learns a safe set from data, updates it online, and enforces the resulting learned barrier through a time-varying control barrier function (CBF). A nominal safe envelope is first learned from operational data using a radial basis function (RBF)-kernel support vector machine (SVM), whose decision function serves as the initial CBF candidate. To capture capability-induced safe-set contraction, a continuous-time decremental SVM update law is developed so that selected support-vector coefficients are reduced according to a degradation signal. A homotopy-smoothed SVM-CBF is then introduced to avoid discontinuous changes in the learned barrier during active-set transitions. The resulting time-varying learned barrier is enforced using a quadratic-program-based safety filter under degraded input constraints. Forward invariance of the learned time-varying safe set and recursive feasibility of the safety filter are established. Simulation results on a vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) model show that the proposed method maintains safety under reduced control authority and avoids abrupt barrier-switching effects during safe-set contraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对任务关键系统在时变能力约束下安全证书失效的问题，提出一种退化感知的数据驱动安全过滤框架：先用RBF核SVM从运行数据学习名义安全包络，再通过连续时间递减SVM更新律按退化信号收缩安全集，并用同伦平滑的SVM-CBF避免切换时的非连续跳变，最终由二次规划安全过滤器在退化输入约束下强制执行时变障碍函数。作者在VTOL模型仿真中验证了该方法在控制权限下降时仍能维持安全，并避免安全集收缩过程中的屏障切换冲击。
Motivation: 关键系统常面临时变限制，导致控制权限下降并改变可用安全包络；此时在标称条件下学习的安全证书可能失效，需要能随系统能力变化在线更新的安全集。
Method: 提出数据驱动的安全过滤框架：用RBF核SVM学习初始CBF候选；设计连续时间递减SVM更新律，使选中的支持向量系数按退化信号减小；引入同伦平滑SVM-CBF处理活动集切换时的非连续问题；最后用二次规划（QP）安全过滤器在退化输入约束下强制执行时变屏障。
Result: 摘要报告在垂直起降（VTOL）模型上的仿真显示，该方法在控制权限降低时保持安全性，并避免安全集收缩期间出现突发的屏障切换效应。
Conclusion: 作者建立了学习得到的时变安全集的前向不变性（forward invariance）和安全过滤器的递归可行性（recursive feasibility），表明该框架可在能力退化场景下提供可靠的安全保证。

papers.title: GRACE: Grounded Reasoning via Adapter Composition and Evidence-Aware Calibration for Educational Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Educational visual question answering, or VQA, requires models to solve curriculum-oriented multiple-choice questions using both language and visual evidence. Compared with conventional open-ended VQA, educational examples often include structured assessment metadata, diagrams or image contexts, and semantically close answer options, creating strong opportunities for question-option shortcuts. We develop and evaluate a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for a frozen multimodal large language model in this setting. We introduce GRACE, Grounded Reasoning via Adapter Composition and Evidence-Aware Calibration, a framework that uses the pedagogical state of each question to specialize lightweight language and vision adaptation. The state combines inference-visible subject, grouped skill, grade, visual-context, question-intent, and option-structure cues. GRACE uses factor-specific prompts and lightweight visual adapters, then applies evidence-aware option calibration to score all candidates under a shared multimodal context. On ScienceQA, GRACE improves a shared-adapter baseline from 90.5 percent to 93.1 percent overall accuracy and from 88.7 percent to 91.2 percent on image-context questions. Removing pedagogical composition, option calibration, or the visual adapter reduces overall accuracy by 1.4, 1.0, and 1.5 points, respectively. These controlled results show that structured educational state is an effective routing signal for parameter-efficient multimodal adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对教育场景中的视觉问答 (educational VQA) 提出参数高效的微调框架 GRACE，基于冻结的多模态大语言模型，利用问题附带的教学状态 (pedagogical state) 来路由轻量级语言和视觉适配器。摘要报告在 ScienceQA 上整体准确率从共享适配器基线的 90.5% 提升到 93.1%，图片上下文问题准确率从 88.7% 提升到 91.2%。
Motivation: 教育类多项选择 VQA 与开放式 VQA 不同，常包含结构化评估元数据、图示或图片上下文以及语义相近的选项，容易形成问题-选项捷径 (question-option shortcuts)，需要更专门的多模态适配方法。
Method: GRACE 将每个问题的教学状态（科目、技能分组、年级、视觉上下文、问题意图、选项结构等）作为路由信号，使用因子特定提示 (factor-specific prompts) 和轻量视觉适配器，再通过证据感知的选项校准 (evidence-aware option calibration) 在共享多模态上下文下对所有候选选项评分。
Result: 在 ScienceQA 上，GRACE 相比共享适配器基线将整体准确率从 90.5% 提升到 93.1%，图片上下文问题准确率从 88.7% 提升到 91.2%；移除教学组成、选项校准或视觉适配器分别使整体准确率下降 1.4、1.0 和 1.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 受控实验表明，结构化的教学状态可以作为参数高效多模态适配的有效路由信号。

papers.title: Uncovering the Limits of Proof Sharing for Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Robustness verification of neural networks is increasingly important, due to their use in many critical domains. In certain scenarios, proof sharing has been shown to accelerate incomplete verification techniques by reusing intermediate-layer abstract states, or templates, across queries. However, questions remain as to the robustness of template-based acceleration across varying network architectures, properties, datasets, and training methods. In this work, we perform a systematic study of the effectiveness of template-based acceleration and its limits. Our study shows that template subsumption rates can vary widely across scenarios. We present a novel metric of jointly stable neurons to explain this variation, showing that in some cases template-based techniques are very unlikely to provide any speedup. Then, we present FastCert, a novel technique for automatically distributing templates across neural network layers to increase performance impact, eschewing templates entirely if they are unlikely to produce a speedup. Across a large set of covering-design based $L_0$-verification tasks, FastCert achieved an average speedup of 1.13x over an extant template-based reuse technique.
papers.comment: To appear at the 33rd Static Analysis Symposium (SAS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究神经网络鲁棒性验证中基于模板的证明共享（template-based proof sharing）技术的有效性与局限性。作者发现模板包含率（template subsumption rate）在不同网络架构、属性、数据集与训练方法下差异很大，并提出联合稳定神经元（jointly stable neurons）这一新指标来解释差异；随后提出 FastCert 技术，自动在神经网络各层分配模板，并在模板不太可能带来加速时完全弃用模板。在一组基于覆盖设计（covering-design）的 L0 验证任务上，FastCert 相比现有模板复用技术获得平均 1.13 倍加速。
Motivation: 模板重用（proof sharing）虽已在某些场景下通过复用中间层抽象状态加速不完备验证，但其在不同网络架构、属性、数据集和训练方法下的稳健性仍不清楚，需要明确这类加速技术的适用范围和边界。
Method: 首先对模板加速效果进行系统性实验研究，提出联合稳定神经元指标以解释模板包含率的变化；然后提出 FastCert 技术，自动在神经网络层间分配模板，并在预测无法产生加速时完全跳过模板，从而提升整体性能。
Result: 实验表明模板包含率在不同场景下波动很大，联合稳定神经元指标可用于预测哪些场景下模板技术几乎不可能带来加速；在大量基于覆盖设计的 L0 验证任务上，FastCert 相对现有模板复用技术取得平均 1.13 倍加速。
Conclusion: 作者强调模板加速存在明确局限，联合稳定神经元指标有助于识别这些局限，而 FastCert 通过自适应模板分配与弃用机制提升鲁棒性验证性能，其评估聚焦于 L0 验证任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mechanistic Tomography: Designed Measurement for Control-Oriented Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability seeks quantities that models do not expose directly: represented states, component effects, interactions, and responses to interventions. Patching, gradients, Hessian-vector products, and subset interventions provide different measurements under different access assumptions and may target different quantities. We formulate their shared measurement structure as mechanistic tomography: designed measurement for recovering internal mechanisms and intervention effects. For a chosen basis and intervention family, measurements take the form y = Ax + w, where A describes the interventions, x is the target map, and w contains nonlinear response, sampling error, and basis misspecification. This language gives a practical procedure: start with the least costly measurements, test on held-out interventions at the intended scale, calibrate simple mismatch, and expand the measurement family when structured residuals remain. Control provides a demanding validation setting because an estimate that guides an intervention acts as an observer. In a two-HMM model, control error rises with observer error, while target improvement can hide nuisance-state movement. Under forward-only access, sparse aggregate measurements recover a finite-effect map with fewer interventions than coordinate patching. With gradient access, finite probes improve a local attribution map. Lifted measurements and Hessian-vector products recover interactions missed by first-order maps, while Tracr shows that the required family depends on the basis. On GPT-2-small IOI, the Name Mover-Negative Name Mover interaction is the largest held-out predictive term among three tested cross-group pairs. On Qwen-2.5-7B, finite calibration makes an additive refusal-response map adequate, so held-out error does not support pairwise lifting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“机制断层扫描”(mechanistic tomography) 的框架，把因果修补 (patching)、梯度、Hessian-vector product 和子集干预等机制可解释性测量统一为 y = Ax + w 的线性测量形式，其中 A 由干预族决定，x 是目标映射，w 包含非线性响应、采样误差与基失配。作者给出一个实用流程：从代价最低的测量开始，在目标尺度的留出干预上检验、校准简单失配，并在存在结构化残差时扩展测量族。控制任务被用作严格验证场景，因为引导干预的估计扮演观测器角色；实验覆盖两状态 HMM、GPT-2-small 的 IOI 任务和 Qwen-2.5-7B 上的拒绝响应映射。
Motivation: 机制可解释性需要恢复模型未直接暴露的量，如表示状态、组件效应、交互和干预响应，但不同测量方法基于不同的访问假设并针对不同目标，缺少统一的结构化描述。
Method: 将共享测量结构形式化为 mechanistic tomography：对选定基和干预族，测量写作 y = Ax + w；据此提出由廉到贵的测量流程，并用控制场景作为估计质量的验证器（observer 视角）。
Result: 在两状态 HMM 中，控制误差随观测器误差上升，目标改进可能掩盖干扰态移动；仅前向访问下，稀疏聚合测量比坐标修补用更少干预恢复有限效应映射；梯度访问下有限探针改进局部归因映射；提升测量和 HVP 能恢复一阶映射遗漏的交互；GPT-2-small IOI 上 Name Mover-Negative Name Mover 交互是三个跨组对中最大的留出预测项；Qwen-2.5-7B 上有限校准使加性拒绝响应映射足够，留出误差不支持成对提升。
Conclusion: 测量族的选择取决于基表示，结构化残差指示何时扩展测量族；控制导向的验证表明估计作为观测器时其误差会传导为控制误差，因此留出干预测试是校准解释模型的关键。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出“机制断层扫描”(mechanistic tomography) 的框架，把因果修补 (patching)、梯度、Hessian-vector product 和子集干预等机制可解释性测量统一为 y = Ax + w 的线性测量形式，其中 A 由干预族决定，x 是目标映射，w 包含非线性响应、采样误差与基失配。作者给出一个实用流程：从代价最低的测量开始，在目标尺度的留出干预上检验、校准简单失配，并在存在结构化残差时扩展测量族。控制任务被用作严格验证场景，因为引导干预的估计扮演观测器角色；实验覆盖两状态 HMM、GPT-2-small 的 IOI 任务和 Qwen-2.5-7B 上的拒绝响应映射。
summary_sections.motivation: 机制可解释性需要恢复模型未直接暴露的量，如表示状态、组件效应、交互和干预响应，但不同测量方法基于不同的访问假设并针对不同目标，缺少统一的结构化描述。
summary_sections.method: 将共享测量结构形式化为 mechanistic tomography：对选定基和干预族，测量写作 y = Ax + w；据此提出由廉到贵的测量流程，并用控制场景作为估计质量的验证器（observer 视角）。

papers.title: Deep neural networks as lattice gauge theories
papers.abstract_en: We modify the NN/QFT duality [1] to incorporate the layerwise permutation symmetry of the network, resulting in a $(0\!+\!1)$-dimensional lattice gauge theory, in which each layer of $N$ neurons acts as an $N$-component lattice site, and the weight matrices play the role of gauge fields living on the links. In this framework, we compute the tree-level neuron-neuron propagator which describes the evolution of layer variance in the network, and develop the Feynman diagram machinery to compute interactions in the perturbative expansion in $1/N$. In particular, we obtain a recursive expression for all corrections to the exact propagator at $O(1)$, representing statistical fluctuations in the ensemble of networks, including infinitely-many loop diagrams mediating the interactions from previous layers. We also present a preliminary analysis of neuron scattering amplitudes that contribute order-by-order in $1/N$, which provides a field-theoretic framework for studying higher-point correlations, and by extension information propagation, in deep networks. We remark on some interesting directions for future work at the intersection of neural networks and quantum field theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过引入网络逐层置换对称性，将 NN/QFT 对偶修改为 (0+1) 维格点规范理论 (lattice gauge theory)，其中每层 N 个神经元作为 N 分量格点，权重矩阵作为链接上的规范场。作者计算了树级神经元-神经元传播子，刻画层方差的演化，并发展 1/N 展开的费曼图机制，包括 O(1) 阶精确传播子所有修正的递归表达式，以及神经元散射振幅的逐阶分析，用于研究深度网络中的高阶关联与信息传播。
Motivation: 现有 NN/QFT 对偶未纳入网络的逐层置换对称性；作者希望把这一对称性整合进框架，从而为深度网络中层方差演化、高阶统计关联和信息传播提供场论化的描述工具。
Method: 修改 NN/QFT 对偶以引入逐层置换对称性，构造 (0+1) 维格点规范理论；计算树级传播子并发展 1/N 微扰展开的费曼图机制，给出精确传播子 O(1) 修正的递归表达式，并初步分析逐阶 1/N 的神经元散射振幅。
Result: 摘要报告的是理论结果：得到 O(1) 阶包含无穷多环图参与的传播子修正的递归表达，代表网络系综中的统计涨落，并建立神经元散射振幅的 1/N 逐阶框架；未提及数值实验。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架为研究深度网络中的高阶关联与信息传播提供了场论工具，并展望了神经网络与量子场论交叉方向的未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improved Confidence Estimates for Black-Box Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for the safe deployment of large language models (LLMs). Existing methods, from verbalized confidence to ones requiring multiple generations, are often zero-shot and produce scores quantifying uncertainty without the need for labelled data. Nonetheless, in practice one must always evaluate their performance on a dataset of interest before deployment. In this work we show that, by leveraging this dataset, we consistently outperform these existing scores. Specifically, we build simple classifiers that predict LLM response correctness by using these scores and the correctness of similar queries as features. Our method produces minimal computational overhead, making it a cheap and straightforward enhancement for UQ in LLMs for real-world applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究黑盒大语言模型（LLM）的不确定性量化（UQ）问题，指出现有零样本分数（如口头化置信度或多生成方法）在实际部署前仍需在目标数据集上评估。作者提出利用该评估数据集训练简单分类器，以现有 UQ 分数和相似查询的正确性作为特征来预测模型回答是否正确，从而一致优于现有分数。方法计算开销极小，可作为现实应用中 LLM 不确定性量化的低成本增强手段。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法大多是零样本的，仅输出置信度分数而无标注数据参与，但实际部署前总需要在感兴趣的数据集上评估其性能；本文试图利用这一评估过程本身来进一步提升 UQ 效果。
Method: 构建简单分类器预测 LLM 回答的正确性，特征包括现有 UQ 分数以及相似查询的正确性标签，从而在部署前借助目标数据集学习校准。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在利用评估数据集后一致优于现有 UQ 分数，且只带来极小的计算开销。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是一种廉价且直接的 UQ 增强方案，适合真实应用中为 LLM 提供更好的不确定性估计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Gaussian processes for prediction of channel observations
papers.abstract_en: Given a set of input states, we consider the task of predicting the expectation value of a Pauli observable at the output of an unknown quantum evolution, using only a limited number of measurements. Recently, quantum Gaussian process (QGP) regression was introduced for this task across various classes of unitary evolution. Here, we extend the QGP framework beyond unitary dynamics. In particular, we prove convergence of the channel's outputs to a QGP and derive the associated closed-form kernel under a uniform (Lebesgue measure) prior over quantum channels. The kernel's dimensional factor, however, dictates the required observation precision. While manageable when the channel and observable are restricted to small subsystems, exponential suppression precludes learning when the subsystem grows extensively with the system size. Since the Lebesgue prior is overly broad for many applications, we propose an empirical Bayes heuristic that replaces the dimensional factor with a learnable scale parameter while retaining the kernel's state-overlap correlation structure. In numerical simulations of up to 64 qubits, channel QGP regression with the Lebesgue kernel exhibits a strong inductive bias for local channels, enabling faithful extrapolation. For global 64-qubit channels, the rescaled kernel restores learnability, with predictions improving systematically with the shot budget. Results from a noisy quantum computer further demonstrate the robustness of QGP regression under experimental conditions. Beyond regression, we validate QGPs as Bayesian-optimization surrogates for state preparation under noisy XXZ dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把量子高斯过程 (QGP) 回归从酉演化推广到一般量子信道，任务是仅用有限测量预测未知量子演化输出的 Pauli 可观测量期望值。作者证明信道输出在量子信道上的均匀 (Lebesgue 测度) 先验下收敛到 QGP，并推导出闭式核；针对该核维度因子导致的大系统指数抑制问题，提出经验 Bayes 启发式，用可学习尺度参数替换维度因子。64 比特数值模拟显示 Lebesgue 核对局部信道有强归纳偏置，重标定核可恢复全局信道的可学习性，且在含噪量子计算机上表现稳健。
Motivation: QGP 回归此前仅针对各类酉演化，本文旨在把该框架扩展到更一般的非酉量子动力学，以在测量预算受限时预测未知量子信道输出的可观测量期望值。
Method: 在信道集合上以 Lebesgue 先验推导输出收敛到 QGP 的闭式核；该核的维度因子决定所需观测精度。为避免先验过宽导致的指数抑制，提出经验 Bayes 启发式，保留核的状态重叠相关结构，同时将维度因子替换为可学习的尺度参数。
Result: 在多达 64 比特的数值模拟中，使用 Lebesgue 核的信道 QGP 回归对局部信道展现出强归纳偏置并支持外推；对全局 64 比特信道，重标定核恢复可学习性，预测质量随测量预算 (shot budget) 系统改善。含噪量子计算机实验验证了其稳健性，并验证了 QGP 可作为含噪 XXZ 动力学下态制备的贝叶斯优化代理模型。
Conclusion: 当信道与可观测量限制在小子系统上时 Lebesgue 核可行，但子系统随系统规模扩展时指数抑制会阻碍学习；经验 Bayes 重标定可缓解过宽先验带来的问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Kernel Estimation for the Discovery of Early Lung Cancer Detection
papers.abstract_en: Lung cancer screening with low-dose chest computed tomography reduces mortality, but its impact is limited by uptake, adherence, and management challenges. Blood-based cell-free DNA (cfDNA) biomarkers offer a complementary approach, although early detection remains difficult because of lung cancer heterogeneity and high-dimensional, nonlinear molecular signals. We evaluated quantum-classical hybrid machine learning for lung cancer detection using DNA fragmentomics and DNA methylation. After feature selection, models were trained using 20- and 40-feature subsets. Features were encoded into quantum Hilbert space using angle and dense-angle feature maps with multiple entanglement strategies. Fidelity-based quantum kernels were computed with exact statevector simulation and integrated with precomputed-kernel SVM and kernel-PCA logistic regression and compared with an SVM model trained on the original features. This framework enabled systematic evaluation of how encoding and entanglement design affect classification. Across repeated held-out evaluations, quantum-kernel models achieved competitive performance on both datasets. For fragmentomics, several 20-feature configurations improved AUC relative to a classical SVM baseline, suggesting effective capture of nonlinear cfDNA fragmentation structure. For methylation, the classical SVM achieved the highest AUC, although selected quantum models remained competitive and improved specificity in some cases. Increasing features from 20 to 40 did not consistently improve performance and often increased variability. Overall, these results support quantum kernel methods as a promising approach for cfDNA-based lung cancer detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估量子-经典混合机器学习用于基于cfDNA的肺癌检测，使用DNA片段组学和DNA甲基化数据。特征被编码到量子希尔伯特空间，以保真度量子核（fidelity-based quantum kernels）搭配预计算核SVM和核PCA逻辑回归，并与经典SVM基线比较。结果显示片段组学上多个20特征量子配置的AUC超过经典SVM，甲基化上经典SVM最高但部分量子模型仍有竞争力并提升了特异性。
Motivation: 低剂量CT肺癌筛查受依从性、坚持和后续管理限制，cfDNA生物标志物提供补充途径，但肺癌异质性和高维非线性分子信号使早期检测仍然困难。
Method: 在特征选择后使用20和40特征子集，通过角度（angle）和密集角度（dense-angle）特征图配合多种纠缠策略将特征编码到量子希尔伯特空间，用精确态矢量模拟（exact statevector simulation）计算保真度量子核，并集成到预计算核SVM和核PCA逻辑回归中，与在原始特征上训练的SVM比较。
Result: 在片段组学数据集上，多个20特征量子核配置相比经典SVM基线提升了AUC；在甲基化数据集上经典SVM取得最高AUC，但部分量子模型仍具竞争力并在某些情况下提升特异性。将特征从20增加到40未一致改善性能，且常增加变异性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为量子核方法是cfDNA肺癌检测的有前景方向，但指出甲基化数据上经典SVM仍最优，且增加特征数量并不总是有益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Outcome Monitors: Recovery Affordances for Silent Tool Failures
papers.abstract_en: When a tool call times out, the agent sees the failure and can route around it. A cached error page or negative price can instead arrive in the expected format and be consumed as fact. We introduce Outcome Monitors, which detect violations of outcome contracts mined from task-disjoint traces or derived from public schemas. On a violation, the monitor preserves the result and issues a nonbinding receipt naming the violated property and public recovery tools. In frozen, prespecified evaluations with injected failures, Outcome Monitors raise ToolMaze completion from 10.9% to 28.1% across four models in two provider families and replicate in a third. In tau-bench retail, completion improves by 14.0 and 12.0 points on two tiers. In separate ToolMaze controls, removing the recovery-tool list eliminates the measured gain and restoring it recovers the effect; diagnostic detail and timing produce no detectable differences. Gains concentrate where the fault blocks completion. On a suite transcribed from a published incident taxonomy, detection outside the mined vocabulary falls to 46%, though delivery continues and completion is unchanged. Recovery tools are the active receipt content in these controls; extending detection beyond the contract vocabulary remains open.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工具调用中'静默失败'（silent tool failures）问题提出 Outcome Monitors：通过从任务不相交轨迹中挖掘或从公共 schema 推导 outcome contracts，在违规发生时保留结果并发出非约束性 receipt，其中列出被违反的性质和公共恢复工具。在冻结的预指定评估中，注入失败后 ToolMaze 完成率从 10.9% 提升至 28.1%，并在 tau-bench retail 两个 tier 上分别提升 14.0 和 12.0 个点。消融控制表明恢复工具列表是产生收益的关键内容，而超出已挖掘词汇的检测率降至 46%。
Motivation: 工具调用超时可见并能绕行，但缓存错误页或负价格等失败会以预期格式返回并被当作事实消费，构成静默失败。现有方法缺少对这种违规的系统检测与恢复机制，本文目标是补上这一缺口。
Method: 提出 Outcome Monitors，从任务不相交轨迹中挖掘或从公共 schema 推导结局契约；检测到违规时保留结果并发出非约束性 receipt，receipt 指明被违反的性质与可用的公开恢复工具，供代理据此恢复。
Result: 在注入失败的冻结评估中，ToolMaze 完成率从 10.9% 提高到 28.1%（覆盖两个 provider 家族的四个模型，并在第三个家族中复现）；tau-bench retail 两档分别提升 14.0 和 12.0 点。移除恢复工具列表会消除收益，恢复后效应回归；诊断细节与时机无显著差异。在基于已发布事故分类法转写的测试集上，超出已挖掘词汇的检测率降至 46%。
Conclusion: 作者将收益定位在 receipt 中的恢复工具内容，而非诊断细节或时机；将检测能力扩展到契约词汇之外仍是未解决的问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Air Traffic Control Using Large Language Models: Prompt Engineering, Architecture, and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Air traffic control (ATC) communication is a safety-critical dialogue that remains largely human-driven even as other parts of air traffic management have been semi-automated. In this article, we experimentally evaluate whether large language models (LLMs) can generate operationally realistic ATC transmissions. An experimental general-aviation flight flying over the San Francisco "Bay Tour" route is hand-transcribed and used as ground truth (P0). Through a pilot-in-the-loop process we design five prompt structures (P1-P5) of increasing constraint and embed them in a stateful multi-turn pipeline, where the model plays ATC to a fixed pilot transcript while conditioning on the accumulating dialogue history. Across nine open- and closed-source LLMs we vary the prompt, the presence of a worked transcript from a different experimental flight as an in-context example, and whether the model conditions on its own prior replies or on injected ground-truth history. Turns are scored with lexical, structural, and semantic similarity metrics and by an LLM-as-judge (GPT-5.5) validated against human expert annotation. Supplying a worked example improves similarity, but tightening the prompt does not: the lightest prompts perform best and the most heavily scripted one collapses as its own errors accumulate through the dialogue, which injecting correct history repairs. These results outline a concrete path and its current limits toward LLM-assisted ATC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实验评估大语言模型（LLM）能否生成具有操作真实性的空中交通管制（ATC）通话。作者以旧金山 Bay Tour 航线的一次实验性通航飞行为基准（P0），通过 pilot-in-the-loop 流程设计五种约束逐渐增强的提示结构（P1-P5），并将其嵌入有状态的多轮对话管线中，让模型扮演管制员并对固定飞行员转写文本作出反应。摘要报告称，提供示例转写会提升相似度，但收紧提示并不奏效，最轻量的提示表现最好，而脚本化最强的提示会因自身错误累积而崩溃。
Motivation: 空中交通管制通信是安全关键的对话，即使空中交通管理的其他部分已半自动化，该通信仍主要由人类驱动。作者希望检验 LLM 是否能够生成操作上逼真的 ATC 传输，从而探索 LLM 辅助 ATC 的可行路径。
Method: 采用有状态的多轮对话管线，固定飞行员转写文本，模型根据累积对话历史生成管制员回应。通过 pilot-in-the-loop 设计五种提示结构（P1-P5），并在九种开源与闭源 LLM 上改变提示类型、是否提供另一实验航班的转写作为上下文示例，以及模型是基于自身先前回复还是注入的真实历史进行生成。评分使用词汇、结构和语义相似度指标，并用经人类专家标注验证的 LLM-as-judge（GPT-5.5）评估。
Result: 摘要报告称，提供工作示例（worked example）能改善相似度，但更严格的提示并不会改善性能；最轻量的提示表现最佳，而最重度脚本化的提示会因对话中自身错误累积而失败，注入正确的历史可以修复这一问题。
Conclusion: 这些结果勾勒出 LLM 辅助空中交通管制的具体路径及其当前局限，表明虽然 LLM 能部分生成操作逼真的 ATC 通话，但提示约束过多反而会损害多轮一致性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SceneGTMM: A Conformal Mapping-based Scene-Aware Transferable GNN-Transformer Dual-Graph Interaction Framework for Map Matching
papers.abstract_en: Map matching is a key technology connecting positioning data with high precision road networks, but it faces challenges in noise robustness, cross regional transfer, and interpretability. To addr ess the limitations of existing methods in local global fusion, dynamic road network adaptation, and reliance on black box mod els, this paper proposes SceneGTMM, a transferable GNN Transformer dual graph interaction map matching framework based on a conformal mapping based scene relative strategy. 1) Conformal mapping based scene relative strategy: constructs trajectory centric local coordinate systems to reduce dependence on the training road network, supporting cross regional transfer and dynamic road network updates; 2) GNN Transformer dual graph interaction architecture: a GNN modeled road graph captures local topological constraints, while a Transformer modeled trajectory graph captures global temporal dependencies, and cross graph attention achieves noise suppression and semantic alignment; 3) CRF enhanced structured prediction: combines the global context of the Transformer with the topological transition constraints of CRF to improve path connectivity and robustness. Experiments show that SceneGTM achieves over 80% accuracy on multi source trajectories with positioning errors of 16 50 meters, representing a 5.3% improvement over HMM. In cross city transfer scenarios, it outperforms MTrajRec, GraphMM, and TMM, and enhances interpretability through attention and relative coordinate visualization. This study provides a new paradigm for high precision, transferable map matching for real time traffic perception and autonomous driving path planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SceneGTMM，一种基于保角映射场景相对策略的可迁移 GNN-Transformer 双图交互地图匹配框架。其核心包括：用保角映射构建以轨迹为中心的局部坐标系以支持跨区域迁移和动态路网更新；GNN 建模路网图捕获局部拓扑约束，Transformer 建模轨迹图捕获全局时间依赖，并通过跨图注意力实现噪声抑制和语义对齐；CRF 增强结构化预测以改进路径连通性和鲁棒性。实验表明在定位误差 16-50 米的多源轨迹上准确率超过 80%，比 HMM 提升 5.3%，跨城市迁移场景中优于 MTrajRec、GraphMM 和 TMM。
Motivation: 现有地图匹配方法在局部-全局融合、动态路网自适应和可解释性方面存在局限，依赖黑盒模型，难以应对噪声鲁棒性和跨区域迁移问题。
Method: 提出保角映射场景相对策略，构建轨迹中心局部坐标系以减少对训练路网的依赖；采用 GNN-Transformer 双图交互架构，GNN 建模路网图捕获局部拓扑约束，Transformer 建模轨迹图捕获全局时间依赖，跨图注意力实现噪声抑制和语义对齐；并用 CRF 增强结构化预测，结合 Transformer 全局上下文与 CRF 拓扑转移约束。
Result: 在定位误差 16-50 米的多源轨迹上准确率超过 80%，较 HMM 提升 5.3%；跨城市迁移场景中优于 MTrajRec、GraphMM 和 TMM；通过注意力和相对坐标可视化增强可解释性。
Conclusion: 该研究为实时交通感知和自动驾驶路径规划提供了一种高精度、可迁移的地图匹配新范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Holtercare-Bench: A Multimodal Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Dynamic ECG Analysis
papers.abstract_en: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel in medical applications, most of them favor static images or short-term signals. In the critical field of dynamic electrocardiograms (ECG), models struggle with complex temporal reasoning and diagnostic report generation due to a lack of high-quality datasets and benchmarks. To address this, we introduce (i) Holtercare-23K, a large-scale multimodal dynamic ECG dataset comprising 22,980 QA pairs derived from 788 clinical Holter records and featuring a novel signal-video-text tri-modal alignment. Based on this dataset, we present (ii) Holtercare-Bench, a multimodal benchmark that evaluates models on temporal localization, clinical diagnosis, and global summarization. Zero-shot evaluations of leading MLLMs reveal a significant performance gap in processing ultra-long pathological sequences. However, fine-tuning representative models yields substantial improvements. This work illuminates the limitations of current MLLMs in electrophysiology and provides a foundational benchmark for long-term medical MLLMs. Our project is available at https://github.com/ZJU4HealthCare/Holtercare-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Holtercare-23K 大规模多模态动态心电图数据集和 Holtercare-Bench 基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在长时动态心电图分析中的表现。数据集包含来自 788 份临床 Holter 记录的 22,980 个 QA 对，采用信号-视频-文本三模态对齐。零样本评估显示领先 MLLM 在处理超长病理序列时存在显著性能差距，而微调代表性模型可带来实质性提升。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在医学应用中大多偏向静态图像或短时信号，在动态心电图这一关键领域缺乏高质量数据集和基准，导致模型难以进行复杂的时间推理和诊断报告生成。
Method: 构建 Holtercare-23K 数据集，基于临床 Holter 记录生成大规模 QA 对，并设计信号-视频-文本三模态对齐；在此基础上提出 Holtercare-Bench 多模态基准，评估时间定位、临床诊断和全局总结三类任务。
Result: 对领先 MLLM 的零样本评估揭示了其在超长病理序列上的显著性能不足；对代表性模型进行微调后性能获得大幅提升。
Conclusion: 该工作指出当前 MLLM 在心电生理学分析上的局限，并为面向长期医学信号的多模态大模型提供了基础性基准资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Clustering and Token Denoising for Faster and More Robust VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent Visual-Language Models (VLMs) have enhanced the capabilities of pre-trained LLMs by adding vision tokens alongside text, with approaches like LLaVA showing impressive results. However, the computational burden of processing up to 576 or 729 visual tokens makes edge deployment challenging. While various token pruning techniques require retraining, some are training-free and thus can easily adapt to architecture changes. We introduce ClustRS, a two-part, training-free algorithm for robust token pruning. Its first component is an attention-weighted, clustering algorithm that selects representative tokens from each semantic cluster. The second component, Residual Shrinkage, is a one-pass denoising step on the selected tokens. These training-free lightweight steps make LLaVA ready for real-world data, improving robustness to a wide range of image-noise types and intensities. Experimental results on the ScienceQA-IMG and MM-VET benchmarks show our method outperforms attention- and diversity-based methods by up to 20\% under extreme noise and token conditions (reducing tokens by 97\%, down to 16 tokens) on LLaVA 1.5 7b and achieves exceptional results on LLaVA-OneVision, where we match baseline performance with fewer than one-third of their tokens under mild noise conditions. Our study demonstrates a simple yet powerful alternative to both score-only and diversity-only pruning rules, paving the way for compute-efficient and noise-resilient VLM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ClustRS，一种无需训练 (training-free) 的视觉语言模型 (VLM) token 剪枝算法，用于降低视觉 token 带来的计算开销并提升对图像噪声的鲁棒性。算法由两部分组成：基于注意力加权的聚类选择每个语义簇中的代表 token，以及称为 Residual Shrinkage 的单遍去噪步骤。在 ScienceQA-IMG 和 MM-VET 基准上，该方法在 LLaVA 1.5 7b 上优于基于注意力和多样性的方法，并在 LLaVA-OneVision 上以更少 token 匹配基线性能。
Motivation: VLM 需要处理多达 576 或 729 个视觉 token，计算负担使边缘部署困难；现有 token 剪枝技术中，不少需要重新训练，难以适应架构变化，因此需要无需训练的鲁棒剪枝方案。
Method: ClustRS 包含两个轻量级组件：一是注意力加权的聚类算法，从每个语义簇中选取代表性 token；二是 Residual Shrinkage，对所选 token 执行单遍去噪。两个步骤均无需训练，可直接适配现有模型。
Result: 在 ScienceQA-IMG 和 MM-VET 上，ClustRS 在极端噪声和 token 条件下（token 减少 97%，降至 16 个）比注意力和多样性基线方法最高提升 20%；在 LLaVA-OneVision 上，轻噪声条件下用不到三分之一的 token 即可匹配基线性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为仅依赖评分和仅依赖多样性的剪枝规则提供了一种简单而有效的替代方案，有助于实现计算高效且对噪声鲁棒的 VLM 部署。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ClustRS，一种无需训练 (training-free) 的视觉语言模型 (VLM) token 剪枝算法，用于降低视觉 token 带来的计算开销并提升对图像噪声的鲁棒性。算法由两部分组成：基于注意力加权的聚类选择每个语义簇中的代表 token，以及称为 Residual Shrinkage 的单遍去噪步骤。在 ScienceQA-IMG 和 MM-VET 基准上，该方法在 LLaVA 1.5 7b 上优于基于注意力和多样性的方法，并在 LLaVA-OneVision 上以更少 token 匹配基线性能。
summary_sections.motivation: VLM 需要处理多达 576 或 729 个视觉 token，计算负担使边缘部署困难；现有 token 剪枝技术中，不少需要重新训练，难以适应架构变化，因此需要无需训练的鲁棒剪枝方案。
summary_sections.method: ClustRS 包含两个轻量级组件：一是注意力加权的聚类算法，从每个语义簇中选取代表性 token；二是 Residual Shrinkage，对所选 token 执行单遍去噪。两个步骤均无需训练，可直接适配现有模型。
summary_sections.result: 在 ScienceQA-IMG 和 MM-VET 上，ClustRS 在极端噪声和 token 条件下（token 减少 97%，降至 16 个）比注意力和多样性基线方法最高提升 20%；在 LLaVA-OneVision 上，轻噪声条件下用不到三分之一的 token 即可匹配基线性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该工作为仅依赖评分和仅依赖多样性的剪枝规则提供了一种简单而有效的替代方案，有助于实现计算高效且对噪声鲁棒的 VLM 部署。

papers.title: Recovering Nonlinear Functions of Latent Variables: A Plausible-Value Neural Network Framework
papers.abstract_en: When factor scores replace true latent scores in nonlinear prediction, measurement error attenuates the recoverable variance of any $k$th-order component of the regression function by $ρ^k$ -- the $k$th power of the score's coefficient of determination -- for any linear score type. This study derives the bound via Hermite polynomial expansion and proposes PV-ANN -- plausible values (posterior draws preserving latent variance) combined with artificial neural networks (learning functional form without prespecification). The bound governs recovery of the latent-scale function, not prediction of the outcome from observed indicators, for which factor scores are already sufficient; the two metrics are therefore predicted to dissociate. An 18-condition simulation supports both predictions: in the nonlinear low-reliability conditions PV-ANN closes about four fifths of the function-shape recovery gap between a factor-score learner and one given the true latent values, and the margin widens as reliability falls, while predictive accuracy is not improved, as the theory requires. A Big Five application illustrates the intended exploratory workflow and delineates boundary conditions under weak signal and measurement model misspecification.
papers.comment: 51 pages, 4 figures, 24 tables. Data, materials, and code: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/KD61HA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上推导，当用因子得分 (factor scores) 替代真实潜变量进行非线性预测时，测量误差会使回归函数 k 阶分量的可恢复方差按 ρ^k 衰减（ρ 为得分的决定系数）。作者提出 PV-ANN 框架：用结合人工神经网络的可信值 (plausible values) 来学习潜变量尺度上的函数形式。18 条件下的模拟验证了理论预测：在非线性低信度条件下，PV-ANN 可补回因子得分学习器与给定真实潜变量学习器之间约五分之四的函数形状恢复差距，且差距随信度下降而扩大。
Motivation: 因子得分替代真实潜变量做非线性预测时存在测量误差衰减，摘要指出任何线性得分类型的 k 阶回归分量的可恢复方差以 ρ^k 衰减，这限制了从观测指标恢复潜变量尺度上非线性函数的能力。
Method: 通过 Hermite 多项式展开推导衰减上界，并提出 PV-ANN：可信值 (后验抽样，保留潜变量方差) 结合人工神经网络 (无需预设函数形式)。摘要强调该上界约束的是潜变量尺度函数恢复，而非从观测指标预测结果——后者用因子得分已充分，因此两种指标理论上应解耦。
Result: 18 条件模拟同时支持两个预测：非线性低信度条件下 PV-ANN 补回函数形状恢复差距的约五分之四，且优势随信度降低而扩大；预测精度没有提升，符合理论要求。Big Five 应用展示了所设想的探索性工作流，并刻画了弱信号与测量模型误设下的边界条件。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 PV-ANN 适用于需要恢复潜变量尺度函数而非提升预测精度的场景；其边界条件包括弱信号和测量模型误设，模拟结果与理论预期的功能-预测解耦一致。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: VQC-ZTI: Variational Quantum Control for Zero Trust Protection of the Tactile Internet
papers.abstract_en: Tactile Internet services couple cyber events directly to physical actuation, so security decisions must improve risk discrimination without perturbing the control path. This paper presents VQC-ZTI, a split-plane Variational Quantum Classifier framework for zero-trust protection of Tactile Internet services, in which an off-path VQC analyzes encrypted-flow telemetry while an on-path policy engine applies cached deterministic grant, restrict, step-up, and deny actions. By decoupling anomaly scoring from enforcement, VQC-ZTI preserves predictable control behavior and allows detector sensitivity and policy aggressiveness to be tuned independently. We evaluate the framework on CESNET-derived aggregated traffic using random, entity-group, and temporal holdouts with a hybrid PyTorch-PennyLane implementation. The full-hybrid Quantum Neural Network achieves mean areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.9981, 0.9974, and 0.9941 and reduces the false-positive rate relative to ExtraTrees by 44.6%, 49.6%, and 67.9%, respectively. A representative component-timing decomposition further illustrates that batched VQC scoring remains in the asynchronous evidence path rather than the immediate enforcement path.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VQC-ZTI，一种用于触觉互联网零信任保护的双平面变分量子分类器（Variational Quantum Classifier）框架：离路径（off-path）VQC 分析加密流遥测，在路径（on-path）策略引擎应用缓存的 grant、restrict、step-up 与 deny 动作。作者在 CESNET 衍生的聚合流量上使用随机、实体分组与时间划分（holdouts），以混合 PyTorch-PennyLane 实现评估；全混合量子神经网络的平均 ROC AUC 为 0.9981、0.9974 与 0.9941，相对于 ExtraTrees 将假阳性率分别降低 44.6%、49.6% 与 67.9%。组件时序分解表明批量化 VQC 评分停留在异步证据路径中，而非即时执行路径。
Motivation: 触觉互联网服务将网络事件直接关联到物理执行，因此安全决策必须提升风险判别能力而不能扰动控制路径。论文针对该场景下零信任保护的需求，提出将异常评分与执行分离的框架。
Method: 提出分离控制面的 VQC-ZTI：离路径 VQC 负责基于加密流遥测的异常评分，在路径策略引擎执行缓存的确定性动作；通过解耦，检测器灵敏度与策略激进程度可独立调节。实现采用混合 PyTorch-PennyLane，并在 CESNET 衍生聚合流量上用随机、实体分组与时间三种 holdout 进行评估。
Result: 全混合量子神经网络在三种划分下分别取得 0.9981、0.9974、0.9941 的平均 ROC AUC，假阳性率相对 ExtraTrees 降低 44.6%、49.6% 与 67.9%；代表性组件时序分解显示批量 VQC 评分保持在异步证据路径而非即时执行路径。
Conclusion: 作者认为将异常评分与执行解耦可保持可预测的控制行为，并允许独立调节检测灵敏度与策略强度；框架在 CESNET 派生数据上的实验支持其有效性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Too Sure to Be Safe: Model Calibration for Reliable Log Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Online log anomaly detection is critical for maintaining the reliability of large-scale computing systems. Although recent language model-based log anomaly detectors achieve strong detection performance, their confidence estimates remain poorly calibrated. We show that these detectors frequently assign excessive confidence to incorrect predictions, particularly for anomalous logs under severe class imbalance. Moreover, confidence on erroneous predictions remains persistently high even when conventional calibration metrics indicate good calibration, creating a critical reliability gap for operational monitoring systems. To address this issue, we propose Log Reconstruction and Distance (LoRD), a lightweight post-hoc calibration framework for reliable log anomaly detection. LoRD learns prediction-route-specific reliability models from latent representations of correctly classified validation samples and estimates prediction reliability through route-wise reconstruction distances. Based on the estimated reliability, LoRD selectively recalibrates high-risk predictions to suppress overconfident errors while preserving reliable predictions. Extensive experiments on four large-scale log benchmark datasets and multiple language model-based detectors demonstrate that LoRD consistently improves confidence reliability and substantially reduces overconfident anomaly-related errors without sacrificing anomaly detection performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于语言模型的日志异常检测器的置信度校准问题。摘要指出这些检测器会对错误预测过度自信，尤其在类别不平衡的异常日志上。作者提出 LoRD，一个轻量级事后校准框架，利用正确分类验证样本的潜在表示学习预测路径特定的可靠性模型，并通过路径重构距离估计可靠性，选择性重新校准高风险预测。在四个大规模日志基准和多个检测器上，LoRD 持续提升置信度可靠性并减少过度自信的异常相关错误，同时不牺牲异常检测性能。
Motivation: 现有日志异常检测器虽检测性能强，但置信度估计校准不良，且在常规校准指标良好时，错误预测的置信度仍持续偏高，给运维监控系统造成可靠性缺口。
Method: 提出 Log Reconstruction and Distance (LoRD)，一个轻量级事后校准框架：从正确分类的验证样本的潜在表示中学习预测路径特异性可靠性模型，通过路径重构距离估计预测可靠性，并据此仅对高风险预测进行选择性重校准。
Result: 在四个大规模日志基准数据集和多个基于语言模型的检测器上，LoRD 一致提升置信度可靠性，显著减少过度自信的异常相关错误，且不降低异常检测性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LoRD 通过选择性抑制过度自信错误并保留可靠预测，为运维监控中的日志异常检测提供更可靠的置信度信号。

papers.title: PTXBench: Benchmark and Adapt LLMs for GPU Kernel Optimization with Architecture-specific PTX
papers.abstract_en: We introduce PTXBench, a benchmark for evaluating and adapting large language models (LLMs) to use architecture-specific PTX for GPU kernel optimization. PTXBench measures functional correctness, whether selected target instructions execute at runtime, and speedup over frontier libraries across GEMM and attention workloads on H100 and B200 GPUs. Our evaluation shows that architecture-specific PTX capability remains uneven: success rates fall substantially on complex attention backward workloads, and executing the target instructions does not necessarily translate into competitive performance. No evaluated model consistently matches frontier libraries across the suite. We further adapt Qwen3.6-27B using supervised fine-tuning. Repair-conditioned training improves several tasks, but generalization remains uneven; data coverage, balance, and the quality of the reasoning teacher matter in addition to dataset size. PTXBench provides an auditable testbed for measuring and improving LLMs' ability to exploit evolving GPU architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PTXBench，一个用于评测和适配大语言模型 (LLM) 在 GPU kernel 优化中使用架构特定 PTX 指令的基准。基准在 H100 和 B200 上，针对 GEMM 和 attention 工作负载，测量功能正确性、目标指令是否在运行时被执行，以及相对前沿库的加速比。评测显示各模型的架构特定 PTX 能力参差不齐：复杂 attention 反向工作负载上成功率明显下降，且执行了目标指令并不必然带来有竞争力的性能，没有任何被评测模型能稳定匹敌前沿库。作者进一步用监督微调适配 Qwen3.6-27B，修复条件训练 (repair-conditioned training) 能改善部分任务，但泛化仍不均衡。
Motivation: LLM 缺乏面向架构特定 PTX 的系统化评测与适配手段，难以度量它们利用不断演进的 GPU 架构的能力，也阻碍了将 LLM 应用于底层 kernel 优化这一方向的发展。
Method: 构建 PTXBench 基准，从功能正确性、目标指令运行时执行情况以及与前沿库相比的加速比三个维度评测 LLM 生成的 PTX；随后采用监督微调适配 Qwen3.6-27B，并引入修复条件训练。
Result: 评测表明架构特定 PTX 能力不均衡，复杂 attention 反向任务成功率显著下降，且执行目标指令不等于获得竞争性性能，尚无模型能稳定匹配前沿库；修复条件训练提升部分任务，但泛化不均，数据覆盖、平衡和推理教师质量与数据集规模同样重要。
Conclusion: PTXBench 为衡量和改进 LLM 利用演进 GPU 架构的能力提供了一个可审计的测试平台。

summary_sections.conclusion: PTXBench 为衡量和改进 LLM 利用演进 GPU 架构的能力提供了一个可审计的测试平台。

papers.title: Geometric and Behavioral Stratification in Transformer Residual Streams
papers.abstract_en: Trained transformer models develop privileged bases: coordinate axes whose statistics differ from the rest of the residual stream. But what kind of direction does such a basis select? We investigate the prediction direction, the unembedding direction of the token a model currently predicts, and find that it functions as a content-defined privileged anchor. Measured with respect to this anchor, residual-stream variation is geometrically and behaviorally stratified by proximity to the prediction. The stratification holds in all eighteen models tested (dense and mixture-of-experts, 7B-120B, base and instruction-tuned). A narrow, scale-invariant prediction interface concentrates readout-relevant structure, while the vast prediction-distal complement expands with model scale. Because the prediction direction sits nearly orthogonal to the principal variance axes, variance-based analyses recover this organization only partly, and the shortfall grows with prompt heterogeneity. Anchoring reveals a steep geometric gradient: prediction-proximal regions are highly structured and cluster related prompts, while the complement is flatter and anti-discriminates among prompt groups. The interface is a narrow slice but functionally decisive. Disrupting the variance directions closest to the prediction causes immediate divergence and frequent task-frame shifts; disrupting the next level down delays divergence and preserves framing. The complement is weakly readout-aligned per direction yet causally and temporally load-bearing, and behavior is driven by direction rather than magnitude. These results establish the prediction direction as a privileged anchor distinct from previously described coordinate axes, and give a geometric account of how high-dimensional computation coexists with linear readout.
papers.comment: 63 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/nelsonguda/pdsf-residual-geometry
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Transformer 残差流 (residual stream) 中特权基 (privileged bases) 的方向选择问题，提出将预测方向 (prediction direction，即当前预测 token 的 unembedding 方向) 作为内容定义的锚点。作者发现，以该锚点为参照，残差流的变化在几何和行为上都按与预测的接近程度分层，且这一分层在 18 个模型（稠密与 MoE，7B-120B，base 与指令微调）中一致成立。预测近端区域集中了与读出相关的结构，而远端互补区域随规模扩大；因果扰动实验显示近端方差方向被破坏会立即导致发散和任务框架切换，而下一层只延迟发散。
Motivation: 已有工作知道训练好的 Transformer 会形成统计上特殊的坐标轴 (privileged bases)，但不清楚这种基到底选择了什么方向；传统基于方差的分析可能只恢复部分组织，并且随着提示异质性增加而遗漏更多结构。
Method: 以预测方向 (prediction direction) 为内容定义的锚点，测量残差流变化相对于该锚点的几何分层；结合行为层面的提示聚类分析，并对按与预测距离排序的方差方向做因果扰动实验来区分不同层级的因果作用。
Result: 分层在全部 18 个测试模型中都成立；预测方向几乎与主方差轴正交，基于方差的分析只能部分恢复该组织且缺口随提示异质性增大。预测近端区域高度结构化并能聚类相关提示，远端区域更平坦且对提示组反区分；扰动近端方差方向立即导致发散和任务框架切换，扰动下一层只延迟发散，远端方向单独看与读出对齐弱但在因果和时间上都承担负荷。
Conclusion: 预测方向是一种不同于此前描述坐标轴的特权锚点，为高维计算与线性读出 (linear readout) 共存提供了几何解释；摘要未讨论方法在超出所测模型规模与任务范围时的推广限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Socioduality: A Relational Process Framework for Human-AI Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Human-AI research often evaluates individual capabilities, joint performance, or final outputs, but these approaches can lose the interaction process that produced the result. This article introduces socioduality: a sequential, reciprocal, and history-carrying process in which one party's response becomes part of the observable conditions shaping the other party's next contribution, judgement, decision, or action. For human-AI dyads, the framework identifies moves, candidate episodes, confirmed episodes, and maximal pathways. A minimum episode A1 -> B1 -> A2 requires evidence that B1 responds to A1 and that B1 then enters the formation of A2; candidates are classified as confirmed, non-sociodual, or indeterminate. A frozen coding protocol was calibrated on three natural human-AI records using two separate model-based evaluator series. A supplementary exploratory analysis then compared frozen Sociodual pathways with blind developmental/task-process segmentations. Across six examined interactions, the two representations were empirically non-equivalent: task-stage changes could occur within a continuing Sociodual pathway, while formal pathway breaks could occur within a continuing task context. This distinction persisted under fine-grained re-segmentation and record-format checks and was reproduced in all three prospectively selected unseen records using a fresh model-based Sociodual coding line. Socioduality therefore offers a bounded process-level framework for studying how human and AI contributions become relationally linked across time, preserving information that task-stage and endpoint-centred analyses do not uniquely recover.
papers.comment: 50 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Revised version adds a Supplementary Exploratory Analysis comparing Sociodual pathways with blind developmental/task-process segmentation, with granularity and record-format checks and an unseen-case extension. Main construct specification unchanged; minor editorial and terminology refinements
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 socioduality 这一关系过程框架，用于分析人机二元交互中双方贡献如何在时间上相互塑造。框架定义 moves、候选 episode、确认 episode 和 maximal pathways，并给出最小 episode A1 -> B1 -> A2 的证据要求；作者在六段自然人机交互记录上比较了冻结的 Sociodual 路径与盲式任务阶段分割，发现二者经验上不等价，并在三个未见记录上复现。
Motivation: 现有 HAI 研究常聚焦个体能力、联合表现或最终输出，容易丢失产生结果的过程信息。作者认为需要一种能够保留交互过程中关系性联结的框架。
Method: 提出 socioduality：一种顺序、互惠且携带历史的过程框架，将一方回应视为塑造另一方下一步贡献的可观察条件。开发冻结编码协议，用两个独立的基于模型的评估器系列在三个人机交互记录上校准；随后进行补充探索性分析，将冻结的 Sociodual 路径与盲式发展性/任务过程分割进行比较，并做细粒度重分割、记录格式检查及未见案例扩展。
Result: 在六个交互中，Sociodual 路径与任务阶段分割在经验上不等价：任务阶段变化可能发生在持续 Sociodual 路径内部，正式路径断裂也可能发生在持续任务上下文内部；该区分在细粒度重分割和记录格式检查下保持，并在三个前瞻性选择的未见记录中用新的模型编码线复现。
Conclusion: Socioduality 提供了一个有边界的过程级框架，用于研究人机贡献如何在时间上形成关系性联结，保留了任务阶段和端点中心分析无法独特恢复的信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph Machine: Exploring Edge Mechanisms as an Inductive Bias
papers.abstract_en: Transformers provide a powerful architecture for global content-based matching, but reasoning problems may benefit from a stronger inductive bias toward iterative traversal of latent relations. We introduce Graph Machine, an architecture with two explicit edge-based mechanisms: Edge-augmented attention, in which edges modulate attention between nodes, and edge-centric referral, in which nodes exchange addresses to update their edges. Conceptually, this enables the model to dynamically and differentiably construct and revise relational graphs across layers. We study this inductive bias using Sudoku under controlled settings and find that Graph Machine outperforms Transformer baselines, with ablation studies and mechanistic analysis attributing the gains to the edge mechanisms. Surprisingly, we found that the model discovers a compact edge-based construction for Sudoku geometry. Our results support explicit edge mechanisms as a promising architectural design, motivating broader evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Graph Machine 架构，引入两种显式的边机制：边增强注意力 (edge-augmented attention) 与以边为中心的引用机制 (edge-centric referral)，使模型能够在层间动态且可微地构造并修正关系图。作者在受控的 Sudoku 设置下研究这种归纳偏置，发现 Graph Machine 优于 Transformer 基线，消融与机理分析将增益归因于边机制，并观察到模型发现了 Sudoku 几何结构的紧凑边表示。
Motivation: Transformer 擅长全局基于内容的匹配，但推理问题可能受益于更强的、指向潜在关系迭代遍历的归纳偏置，现有架构缺少对这种显式边机制的探索。
Method: 提出 Graph Machine 架构：Edge-augmented attention 让边调节节点间的注意力，edge-centric referral 让节点通过交换地址来更新边，从而在不同层中动态构造与修订关系图。
Result: 在受控 Sudoku 实验中，Graph Machine 优于 Transformer 基线；消融与机理分析表明性能提升来自两种边机制，且模型自发发现了 Sudoku 几何的紧凑边表示。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式边机制是一种有前景的架构设计，并呼吁在更广泛的任务上进行评估。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Estimating SSIM from MSE for DCT-Based Compressed Images via Modeling Local Error Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Efficient and perceptually meaningful quality assessment is a fundamental requirement for image and video processing, compression, and streaming systems. This article shows that, in the context of Discrete Cosine Transform ( DCT)-based compressed images, Structural Similarity Index ( SSIM ) can be approximated from global Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) or Mean Square Error ( MSE) using local statistics derived only from the reference image. While prior work assumes access to local MSE, we propose two approaches to approximate local MSE by redistributing the global MSE using variance or standard-deviation-based weighting. Experiments on the Kodak and Xiph Subset1 datasets across a range of JPEG quality levels demonstrate that both approaches provide accurate and robust SSIM approximations, substantially outperforming the global MSE baseline. The proposed framework is designed to extend naturally to video, where reference-derived statistics can be amortized across multiple encodes of the same content.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 18th International Conference on Quality of Multimedia Experience (QoMEX)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于离散余弦变换（DCT）的压缩图像，提出仅利用参考图像导出的局部统计量，从全局 PSNR/MSE 近似 SSIM 的方法。作者提出两种途径，通过方差或标准差加权将全局 MSE 重分布为局部 MSE，从而估算 SSIM。实验在 Kodak 与 Xiph Subset1 数据集及多个 JPEG 质量等级下表明，两种方法都能得到准确且鲁棒的 SSIM 近似，并显著优于全局 MSE 基线。该框架设计为可自然扩展到视频。
Motivation: 图像与视频处理、压缩和流媒体系统需要高效且具感知意义的质量评估；现有工作通常假设可以得到局部 MSE，但实际压缩场景中往往只有全局 PSNR/MSE，缺少局部误差信息。
Method: 提出两种近似局部 MSE 的策略，分别是基于方差加权和基于标准差加权，将全局 MSE 重新分配到局部区域，再结合仅从参考图像提取的局部统计量来估计 SSIM。
Result: 在 Kodak 和 Xiph Subset1 数据集上、涵盖多个 JPEG 质量等级的实验中，两种提出的方法都能准确且鲁棒地近似 SSIM，并且明显优于使用全局 MSE 的基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在 DCT 压缩图像场景下，仅用全局 MSE 和参考图像局部统计量即可可靠估计 SSIM；框架可扩展到视频，参考图像统计量可在同一内容的多次编码之间摊销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anatomy Contextualized Adaptation of CT Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: CT vision-language foundation models have demonstrated promising performance across downstream tasks, but are typically trained with whole-volume representations that dilute fine-grained anatomical signals. Fine-grained vision-language pre-training addresses this by aligning anatomy-level visual features with anatomy-specific text, but in doing so discards the global context that whole-volume models provide. Furthermore, existing fine-grained approaches train from scratch, making them computationally expensive. We introduce Anatomy Contextualized Adaptation (ACA), a lightweight framework that adapts frozen CT foundation model representations for anatomy-level vision-language alignment while enhancing global contextualization. ACA uses TotalSegmentator to decompose CT volumes into anatomy-level embeddings, which are refined via a transformer that captures cross-anatomy relationships, and aligned to both per-anatomy and scan-level text extracted from radiology reports. Evaluated on Merlin and CT-RATE, ACA consistently outperforms both the frozen foundation model baselines and existing fine-grained methods in zero-shot finding classification, while requiring less than one hour of training once embeddings are cached. The attention weights learned by ACA's inter-anatomy transformer additionally indicate plausible cross-anatomy context routing. Altogether, these results support ACA as a lightweight approach for adapting CT foundation models to anatomically grounded vision-language alignment while preserving and enhancing global anatomical context.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 MedFM-Bench Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Anatomy Contextualized Adaptation (ACA)，一种轻量级框架，在保持 CT 基础模型冻结特征的同时进行解剖级视觉-语言对齐。该方法用 TotalSegmentator 将 CT 体积分解为解剖级嵌入，经跨解剖 transformer 增强全局上下文，并与影像报告中的解剖级和扫描级文本对齐。在 Merlin 和 CT-RATE 上，ACA 的零样本发现分类 (zero-shot finding classification) 一致优于冻结基础模型和现有细粒度方法，嵌入缓存后训练不到一小时。
Motivation: 现有 CT 视觉-语言基础模型通常用整体体积表示训练，稀释了细粒度解剖信号；而细粒度预训练从零开始且丢弃全局上下文，计算昂贵。
Method: ACA 使用 TotalSegmentator 将 CT 体积分解为解剖级嵌入，通过捕捉跨解剖关系的 transformer 进行精炼，并将表示对齐到从放射报告提取的逐解剖级和扫描级文本；基础模型权重保持冻结。

papers.title: A Distributional Robustness Margin For Pathology Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models encode non-biological variation introduced by tissue preparation, staining and scanning, enabling shortcut learning that undermines generalisation across institutions. The Robustness Index (RI) was proposed to assess whether local representation geometry is dominated by biological or non-biological variation. However, its construction suffers from structural limitations that make cross-model comparison unreliable, calling for a more principled metric. We introduce the Cross-confounder Robustness Margin (CRoMa), a signed, per-sample margin that measures whether samples sharing the same biology but not different confounder lie closer than samples sharing the same confounder but different biology. It is defined for every sample, allowing models to be compared on the same cohort and robustness to be analysed as a distribution rather than reduced to a single pooled score. We evaluated CRoMa across 20 tile-level encoders on three benchmarks. Rankings by median CRoMa were highly consistent across benchmarks (Spearman rho ~ 0.90), yet every encoder retained confounder-dominated samples, whose prevalence and severity varied markedly. Similar patterns emerged for four slide-level encoders evaluated on a separate benchmark, extending the analysis beyond tile-level representations. Higher median CRoMa was associated with smaller shortcut-induced performance losses in downstream linear probes, supporting its use as a representation-level indicator of shortcut susceptibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对病理基础模型 (pathology foundation models) 中因组织制备、染色和扫描引入的非生物变异导致的捷径学习 (shortcut learning) 问题，提出跨混杂因子鲁棒性边际 (Cross-confounder Robustness Margin, CRoMa)。该指标是一个有符号的逐样本边际，可衡量共享同一生物学但混杂因子不同的样本，是否比共享同一混杂因子但生物学不同的样本在表示空间中更近。作者在 3 个基准上对 20 个 tile 级编码器进行评估，发现按中位 CRoMa 的排名在各基准间高度一致 (Spearman rho 约 0.90)，但每个编码器仍保留混杂因子主导的样本，且其比例和严重程度差异明显。更高的中位 CRoMa 与下游线性探针中更小的捷径诱导性能损失相关，表明该指标可作为表示层面的捷径易感性指标。
Motivation: 已有的鲁棒性指数 (Robustness Index, RI) 在构造上存在结构性局限，导致跨模型比较不可靠；需要一种更有原则的度量来判断局部表示几何是由生物变异还是非生物变异主导。
Method: 提出 Cross-confounder Robustness Margin (CRoMa)，这是一个有符号的逐样本边际，比较共享相同生物学但不同混杂因子的样本对与共享相同混杂因子但不同生物学的样本对在表示空间中的距离。该指标对每个样本都有定义，因而可以把鲁棒性当作一个分布来分析，而不是压缩为单一的合并分数。
Result: 在 3 个基准的 20 个 tile 级编码器上，按中位 CRoMa 的排名高度一致 (Spearman rho 约 0.90)，但所有编码器都存在混杂因子主导的样本，其普遍性和严重程度差异明显；4 个 slide 级编码器在独立基准上也出现类似模式。更高的中位 CRoMa 与下游线性探针中更小的捷径诱导性能损失相关。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CRoMa 可以作为表示层面的捷径易感性指标，支持在同一队列上对模型进行跨模型比较，并将鲁棒性分析扩展到分布层面而非单一分数；摘要也隐含了该方法目前聚焦于病理图像编码器评估这一适用范围。

papers.title: ID-V2V: Identity-Preserving Video Restylization
papers.abstract_en: In visual storytelling, human performances are central to creative intent and narrative meaning. However, preserving human identity and performance while enabling flexible visual edits remains challenging for generative video models. We formalize this challenge as identity-preserving video restylization, which propagates scene, lighting, and style changes specified by an edited keyframe across a source video, while preserving facial likeness and performance, including expressions, eye gaze, and lip synchronization. A key obstacle is the absence of paired training data, as identity-preserving restylized video pairs are rare in real-world settings. To address this, we propose a decoupling of source-grounded identity preservation and edit-driven video synthesis. Our key insight is that facial appearance and expression should remain invariant, with illumination being the primary permissible variation. We therefore cast identity preservation as a video relighting problem, while modeling visual edit propagation as controlled video synthesis guided by the edited keyframe. Building on this formulation, we introduce ID-V2V, a video-to-video generative framework integrating complementary control signals: relit facial regions and facial normal maps tightly constrain facial likeness and performance, while edited keyframes and depth sequences enable flexible and temporally coherent generation. This design enables constructing training pairs from a single video, eliminating the need for scarce paired data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ID-V2V significantly outperforms existing methods in preserving facial likeness and fine-grained facial performance, supports both single- and multi-subject scenarios, and delivers high visual quality, highlighting its potential as a human-centric tool for real-world content production. The code is available at: https://github.com/Eyeline-Labs/ID-V2V.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ID-V2V，一个保持身份的视频重风格化 (identity-preserving video restylization) 视频到视频生成框架，将由编辑关键帧指定的场景、光照和风格变化传播到整个源视频，同时保持面部相似度与精细表演（表情、注视、唇形同步）。作者将身份保持建模为视频重光照 (video relighting) 问题，将视觉编辑传播建模为由编辑关键帧引导的受控视频合成，并利用重光照面部区域、面部法线图、编辑关键帧与深度序列作为互补控制信号。摘要报告该方法在面部相似度和精细面部表演保持上显著优于现有方法，支持单人和多人场景，并提供代码。
Motivation: 生成式视频模型在允许灵活视觉编辑的同时难以保持人物身份和表演，而身份保持的重风格化视频对在真实世界中稀缺，缺少配对训练数据是主要障碍。
Method: 提出源图像身份保持与编辑驱动视频合成的解耦：把身份保持建模为视频重光照问题（认为面部外观和表情应保持不变，光照是主要允许变化），把编辑传播建模为受控视频合成；由此可用单个视频构建训练对，无需配对数据。框架整合重光照面部区域、面部法线图、编辑关键帧和深度序列作为控制信号。
Result: 大量实验表明 ID-V2V 在保持面部相似度和精细面部表演上显著优于现有方法，支持单人与多人主体场景，并能提供高质量视觉效果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法作为面向真实世界内容制作的人物中心工具具有潜力，代码已公开在 GitHub。

papers.title: SoftVTBench: A Safety-Aware Visuo-Tactile Benchmark for Physically Constrained Robotic Manipulation of Deformable Objects (Early Version)
papers.abstract_en: Deformable object manipulation poses challenges beyond task completion: successful execution must also maintain safe physical interaction, holding the object stably without slip or drop while avoiding excessive deformation. However, existing manipulation benchmarks are predominantly success-oriented and rarely evaluate whether a policy remains physically safe throughout execution. We present SoftVTBench, a safety-aware visuo-tactile benchmark for physically constrained deformable object manipulation. Built in Isaac Sim with finite-element-simulated deformable objects, SoftVTBench provides multi-view RGB observations, RGB tactile sensing with marker motion, proprioception, and language instructions, and defines four matched task suites over object type (deformable vs. rigid) and variation axis (object vs. spatial). It separately reports Goal Success and Safety Success; the latter additionally requires no drop and peak deformation below a calibrated object-specific threshold, measured from policy-hidden privileged Finite Element Method (FEM) states. We implement pi0.5-based baselines under this protocol. Experiments show that success-only evaluation substantially overstates policy performance, as a large fraction of goal-completing rollouts still violate physical safety. Furthermore, incorporating tactile sensing improves Safety Success (e.g., from 21.4% to 35.6% on object-centric deformable tasks) and reduces object deformation during execution, while maintaining comparable Goal Success. SoftVTBench provides a reproducible benchmark for studying visuo-tactile deformable manipulation under physical interaction constraints.
papers.comment: Early version of SoftVTBench, Accepted by ECCVW
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SoftVTBench，一个面向物理约束可变形物体操纵的安全感知视觉触觉基准。它基于Isaac Sim与有限元模拟构建，提供多视图RGB、RGB触觉传感、本体感觉和语言指令，并定义四个任务套件。基准分别报告Goal Success与Safety Success，实验发现仅以成功评估会高估策略性能，而加入触觉传感可显著提升安全成功率并减小物体变形。
Motivation: 现有可变形物体操纵基准主要面向任务完成，很少评估执行过程中的物理安全性，如物体不打滑、不跌落且不过度变形，导致策略可能在达成目标的同时违反安全约束。
Method: SoftVTBench在Isaac Sim中用有限元模拟可变形物体，提供多视图RGB观测、带标记运动的RGB触觉传感、本体感觉和语言指令，并按物体类型与变化轴定义四个匹配任务套件。它分别报告Goal Success和Safety Success，后者要求无跌落且峰值变形低于校准的物体特定阈值，基于策略隐藏的特权有限元状态测量，同时实现了pi0.5基线。
Result: 实验显示仅以目标成功评估会大幅高估策略性能，因为大量完成目标的rollout仍违反物理安全；在object-centric变形任务上，加入触觉传感使Safety Success从21.4%提升至35.6%，并减少执行中的物体变形，同时保持相当的Goal Success。
Conclusion: SoftVTBench提供了一个可复现的基准，用于研究物理交互约束下的视觉触觉可变形物体操纵，强调将安全成功与目标成功分开报告。

papers.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly of Markov Boundary for Tabular Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Under standard graphical assumptions, the Markov boundary of a target variable is the smallest set of features that renders every other feature redundant. Once the boundary is observed, the target is conditionally independent of the rest of the table. This is a tempting object for tabular prediction, since it names exactly the columns a model should need. Yet modern regressors are still trained on the full feature set. We ask whether the Markov boundary is genuinely useful for prediction on SCM3K, a 3,450-task synthetic SCM benchmark with feature counts from 40 to 1000 and six SCM families, evaluated with six regressors. The answer is more nuanced than the theory suggests. Restricting a regressor to the oracle boundary often improves prediction substantially, and the improvement grows as the feature space becomes larger and sparser. But the natural pipeline of recovering the boundary with causal discovery and training on the recovered mask does not deliver. Existing estimators exhaust the compute budget before reaching the regime where the boundary helps most, and even where they run they rarely beat the full feature set. We trace this to three causes. Discovery optimizes structural recovery rather than prediction. False negatives and false positives carry sharply asymmetric predictive cost. The exact boundary is only one of many feature sets that beat all features. We then develop what these facts imply for prediction-aligned feature selection and for tabular models that learn to use causal structure.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at CIKM 2026 (35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM '26), November 7-11, 2026, Rome, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 SCM3K（3,450 个任务的合成 SCM 基准，特征数 40 到 1000，六个 SCM 家族）上系统考察马尔可夫边界 (Markov boundary) 对表格预测是否有实际价值。摘要发现，将回归器限制在 oracle 边界上通常能显著提升预测性能，且特征空间越大越稀疏时收益越大；但通过因果发现恢复边界再训练的常规流程却几乎无法打败全特征集。作者将失败归因于三个原因，并据此讨论了面向预测的特征选择与可学习因果结构的表格模型。
Motivation: 在标准图假设下，目标变量的马尔可夫边界是最小冗余特征集，理论上恰好给出模型所需的列；然而现代回归器仍用全特征训练，马尔可夫边界对预测的真实效用缺少实证检验。
Method: 使用 SCM3K 基准，搭配六个回归器，比较三种设定：全特征训练、限制在 oracle 边界上训练、以及先用因果发现恢复掩码再训练的常规流程；并进一步分析发现过程对预测而非结构恢复的错位、误报/漏报的不对称代价，以及超越全特征的多个候选特征集。
Result: oracle 边界能大幅改善预测，且改善幅度随特征空间变大、变稀疏而增加；但基于因果发现恢复边界的自然流程在多数情况下无法超过全特征集，现有估计器在到达边界最有帮助的区间前就耗尽计算预算，且很少能击败全特征。

papers.title: Beyond Recall: Behavioral Specification as an Interpretive Layer for AI Personalization
papers.abstract_en: If an AI agent makes decisions on a person's behalf, those decisions must align with its user. We introduce representational accuracy to measure how faithfully a system captures a person's interpretation. An interpretive layer is operationalized as a Behavioral Specification. Our reference implementation aggressively compresses a person's data into interpretive patterns, served as context to a language model. We evaluate the Specification on a prototype benchmark of held-out behavioral predictions scored by a calibrated 5-judge LLM panel. We test it independently and in composition with a range of context conditions: full raw corpus, full extracted facts, and four commercial memory systems (Mem0, Letta, Supermemory, Zep). Across 14 public-domain autobiographical corpora, the Specification lifts representational accuracy in aggregate and nearly eliminates model hedging. It recovers most of what the raw corpus delivers, at ~25x less context cost. The Specification lifts subjects toward a common predictive level regardless of pretraining baseline; the lift in absolute points is therefore largest where the baseline is lowest, suggesting the population of relevance is anyone not adequately represented in pretraining. Lift is greatest on interpretation-required questions, where providing an interpretive layer enables model behavior that extracted facts or raw corpus do not. Conversely, on recall-required questions, this layer can interfere rather than help. We conclude that representational accuracy is distinct from recall and that human-AI alignment is dependent on how accurately the user is represented. Representational accuracy makes that alignment testable.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 代理代表用户做决策时的对齐问题，提出“表征准确性”(representational accuracy) 这一度量，并将其操作化为一种“行为规范”(Behavioral Specification) 作为解释层。参考实现将用户数据压缩为解释性模式并作为语言模型的上下文，在包含 14 个公共领域自传语料的原型基准上，由校准的 5 评委 LLM 面板评分。结果显示该规范能在约 1/25 的上下文成本下恢复原始语料的大部分表征准确性，并几乎消除模型 hedging。
Motivation: 当 AI 代理替人做决策时，决策必须与用户对齐；现有方法缺少对系统在多大程度上捕捉用户“解释”的忠实性的度量。作者认为回忆 (recall) 并不等于准确表征用户，需要一种可测试的度量来评估人类与 AI 的对齐程度。
Method: 将解释层 (interpretive layer) 操作化为行为规范 (Behavioral Specification)：把用户数据激进压缩为解释性模式，作为上下文提供给语言模型。评估时将该规范独立使用，并与完整原始语料、完整抽取事实以及四种商业记忆系统 (Mem0, Letta, Supermemory, Zep) 组合使用，用校准的 5 评委 LLM 面板对留出式行为预测进行打分。
Result: 在 14 个自传语料上，行为规范在总体上提升表征准确性并几乎消除模型 hedging；以约 1/25 的上下文成本恢复了原始语料的大部分效果。提升幅度在预训练基线最低的对象上最大，且主要出现在需要解释的问题上；在仅需回忆的问题上，该层反而可能造成干扰。
Conclusion: 作者认为表征准确性不同于回忆能力，人类与 AI 的对齐依赖于用户被表征的准确程度，而表征准确性使这种对齐变得可测试。

papers.title: Geometric Evolution Maps: Extracting Stable Concept Probes from Transformer Residual Streams
papers.abstract_en: A concept probe is only as reliable as the layer it is taken from. Probing at a fixed late layer, or at the peak of a separation curve, ignores a structural feature of how concepts form: the probe direction rotates substantially during assembly and does not settle until after the Concept Allocation Zone (CAZ) in which it forms. We introduce Geometric Evolution Maps (GEMs). A GEM records a concept's directional trajectory across one CAZ segment, takes the settled direction at that segment's final layer, and locates the handoff layer immediately beyond it - the first layer at which that direction can be evaluated outside the window it was estimated on. The handoff layer is derived from the segment boundary, not detected by a rotation criterion. A concept typically occupies several segments; we call that set its atlas. This rotation is substantial and consistent across architectures and concept types - a property of the representation, not an estimation artifact. The extracted direction is causal: ablating it suppresses far more separation than ablating a random direction, though no single site carries the effect alone. Probing after rotation completes is more precise than probing during it; a depth-matched control shows this advantage comes from probing at greater depth, not any privilege specific to the handoff boundary. A small number of structured exceptions are documented rather than left unaccounted for. A concept's atlas - its full set of GEMs, not any single one of them - is therefore the unit this method delivers for downstream use. GEM provides the ablation-targeting methodology used by the CAZ Validation paper in this program.
papers.comment: Comment: v2: substantial revision. Corpus grown from 23 to 29 base models. Several v1 claims withdrawn, most notably the MHA/GQA cohort split and the sub-500M scale-floor account. The depth-matched settling control is replaced by a corrected version that reverses its conclusion. See Appendix E for the full changelist
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对概念探针 (concept probe) 所在层的选择问题，提出几何演化图 (Geometric Evolution Maps, GEMs)：记录概念在概念分配区 (Concept Allocation Zone, CAZ) 一个片段内的方向轨迹，取该片段末层的稳定方向，并定位其外侧的 handoff 层。摘要称该方向旋转在多种架构和概念类型中显著且一致，属于表示本身的属性而非估计伪影；提取的方向具有因果性，消融它比消融随机方向压制更多分离，但没有任何单一位置独立承载该效应。旋转完成后的探针比旋转中的更精确，但深度匹配对照表明该优势来自更大的深度，而非 handoff 边界的特殊特权。
Motivation: 在固定深层或分离曲线峰值处取探针，会忽略概念形成的结构特征：探针方向在组装过程中大幅旋转，且直到概念分配区 (CAZ) 之后才稳定，因此探针的可靠性取决于其所在的层。
Method: GEM 记录概念在一个 CAZ 片段上的方向轨迹，取该片段末层的稳定方向，并定位紧邻其后的 handoff 层，即该方向可在此片段之外被评估的第一层；handoff 层由片段边界推导，而非由旋转判据检测。一个概念通常占据多个片段，该集合被称为其 atlas。
Result: 摘要报告该方向旋转显著且跨架构、跨概念类型一致，消融提取方向比消融随机方向压制更多分离，但无单一位置单独承担该效应；旋转完成后探针更精确，深度匹配对照显示优势来自更大深度而非 handoff 边界；另有少量结构化例外被记录。
Conclusion: 摘要强调本方法交付给下游使用的单元是概念的 atlas（全部 GEM 的集合）而非任一单个 GEM，并指出 GEM 提供了 CAZ Validation 论文所使用的消融目标定位 (ablation-targeting) 方法论。

papers.title: The Concept Allocation Zone: Tracking How Concepts Form Across Transformer Depth
papers.abstract_en: Concept formation in transformer language models is a depth-extended process, not a single-layer event: a concept becomes separable across one or more contiguous regions of the residual stream - its Concept Allocation Zone (CAZ). A CAZ is not a concept but the depth segment where the model organizes its geometry to make one separable - concepts may share a CAZ, and typically span multiple across depth; the companion GEM paper shows the separating direction continues to rotate within a CAZ before stabilizing past its boundary. We formalize the CAZ through three layer-wise metrics - Separation, Concept Coherence, and Concept Velocity - with automated boundary detection that applies no significance threshold to CAZ membership (every segment is a CAZ; "strong" vs. "gentle" is score, never a binary cut). Empirical validation across 35 models, 8 architectural families, and 7 concepts shows the separation curve S(l) is frequently multimodal, and scored detection surfaces a further category of subtle allocation regions ("gentle CAZes") invisible to standard peak detection. The framework generates seven testable predictions; its contribution is the instrument and the phenomena it surfaces - the scored detector, the three metrics, and the multimodal/gentle-CAZ findings - not the predictions themselves. Released as the open-source rosetta_tools library (v1.3.1).
papers.comment: v2: substantial revision. Cross-architecture ordering statistic and MHA/GQA cohort-split claim retracted per recomputation; corpus and companion-paper citations refreshed. See paper's "Changes from Version 1" section for the full list of superseded values
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Concept Allocation Zone (CAZ) 框架，将 transformer 语言模型中的概念形成描述为跨深度的连续区域过程，而非单层事件。作者定义三个逐层指标（Separation、Concept Coherence、Concept Velocity）并实现无显著性阈值的自动边界检测，在 35 个模型、8 个架构族、7 个概念上验证了分离曲线 S(l) 的多峰性，并发现标准峰值检测无法识别的“gentle CAZes”。框架生成七个可测试预测，并发布开源库 rosetta_tools（v1.3.1）。
Motivation: 现有研究常将概念形成视为单层或局部事件，而作者认为概念形成是跨深度的延展过程，需要量化工具来定位残差流中概念变得可分离的深度区段。
Method: 通过三个逐层指标（Separation、Concept Coherence、Concept Velocity）形式化 CAZ，并采用无显著性阈值的自动边界检测，使得每个区段都是 CAZ，“强/弱”仅表现为分数差异而非二值划分。
Result: 在 35 个模型、8 个架构族和 7 个概念上的验证表明分离曲线 S(l) 经常是多峰的，评分检测还发现了标准峰值检测无法看到的“gentle CAZes”这类细微分配区域。
Conclusion: 本文的贡献在于检测工具及其揭示的现象（评分检测器、三个指标、多峰与 gentle-CAZ 发现），而非预测本身；v2 修订撤销了关于跨架构排序统计量和 MHA/GQA cohort-split 的声明。

papers.title: Can Predicted Dynamics Exist in the Physical World?
papers.abstract_en: Can learned state-action proposals exist in the physical world? To filter infeasible commands before execution, policies are often wrapped in a runtime monitor. However, aggregating diverse diagnostic signals obscures whether a proposal violates dynamic transitions or merely departs from recorded behavior. We formalize this prediction-control interface and prove that the all-pairs displacement term is redundant within a max-aggregated composite. We evaluate these monitors on 700 nominal and 5,250 synthetically perturbed 32-transition PushT windows, monitoring only planar pusher positions and goals. A simple transition-RMSE baseline (AUC 0.982) outperforms a heterogeneous max-aggregated monitor (AUC 0.957). We conclude that physical transition checks must be strictly separated from empirical logs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究物理世界中的预测动力学问题，形式化“预测-控制接口”(prediction-control interface)，用于在执行前过滤不可行命令的运行时监控器。作者证明在 max 聚合的复合信号中，all-pairs displacement 项是冗余的，并在 PushT 基准上对比了简单 transition-RMSE 基线与异构 max 聚合监控器。结果表明 transition-RMSE 基线 (AUC 0.982) 优于异构监控器 (AUC 0.957)，因此物理转移检查应与经验日志严格分离。
Motivation: 策略在部署前通常需要运行时监控器过滤不可行的状态-动作提议，但聚合多种诊断信号会掩盖问题是违反动态转移还是偏离已记录行为，这一区分对安全执行至关重要。
Method: 形式化该预测-控制接口，并证明在 max 聚合的复合监控信号中 all-pairs displacement 项是冗余的；随后在只监控平面推杆位置与目标的 PushT 窗口上评估监控器，比较 transition-RMSE 基线与异构 max 聚合监控器。
Result: 在 700 个名义和 5,250 个合成扰动的 32 转移 PushT 窗口上，简单 transition-RMSE 基线取得 AUC 0.982，优于异构 max 聚合监控器的 AUC 0.957。
Conclusion: 作者认为物理转移检查必须与经验日志严格分离，这是从实验结果中得出的主要结论。

papers.title: RequestRouter: Request-Boundary Routing for Efficient Single-GPU LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: RequestRouter is a lightweight request-boundary controller for reducing the latency and energy cost of single-GPU large language model inference. Rather than serving all requests with one static configuration, the system uses cheap request-level features to select one fixed inference mode per request, including FP16, quantized inference, speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, and hybrid modes such as GPTQ plus prefix caching and INT8 plus continuous batching. We evaluate RequestRouter using an 8B instruction-tuned language model served through vLLM on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. Across the full-scale A100 evaluation--26,500 fixed-mode evaluations followed by 3,500 online-controller evaluations, for 30,000 measured inference executions in total--the controller achieves a 2.10x mean latency speedup over FP16 and a 0.48x energy ratio on deployment-style workloads. A smaller matched evaluation with repeated measurements provides a controlled statistical check of this result: RequestRouter retains a 1.93x latency speedup (95% CI: 1.88--1.98x) and a 0.523 energy ratio (95% CI: 0.506--0.540), showing that the gains persist under a more tightly controlled protocol. On a separate expanded automatic benchmark evaluation, the routed policy retains 99.6% of FP16 macro accuracy. A 100,000-call CPU microbenchmark measures only 0.00475 ms mean routing overhead (0.00532 ms p99). Thus, simple request-aware routing can recover substantial serving efficiency without retraining or modifying the underlying LLM.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 2nd International Workshop on Low Carbon Computing (LOCO 2026), Lancaster University, United Kingdom, 10-11 September 2026. Part of the LOCO 2026 proceedings, arXiv:2608.02072
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RequestRouter 是一个轻量级请求边界控制器，用于降低单 GPU 大语言模型推理的延迟与能耗。它利用廉价的请求级特征为每个请求选择一种固定的推理模式，包括 FP16、量化推理、投机解码 (speculative decoding)、前缀缓存 (prefix caching)、连续批处理 (continuous batching) 以及混合模式。在通过 vLLM 在 NVIDIA A100 上服务的 8B 指令微调模型评估中，控制器在部署风格工作负载上相对 FP16 实现 2.10 倍平均延迟加速和 0.48 能量比；受控统计检查中仍保持 1.93 倍延迟加速与 0.523 能量比，且路由策略在自动基准评估中保留 99.6% 的 FP16 宏精度。
Motivation: 现有单 GPU 推理服务通常对所有请求使用单一静态配置，无法适应请求间差异，导致延迟和能量开销较高。作者希望在不重训练或不修改底层 LLM 的前提下恢复服务效率。
Method: 使用廉价请求级特征（如请求属性）作为输入，由轻量级控制器为每个请求选择一种推理模式，模式集合包括 FP16、量化推理、投机解码、前缀缓存、连续批处理及其混合组合（如 GPTQ 加前缀缓存、INT8 加连续批处理）。评估通过 vLLM 在 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上进行。
Result: 全规模评估包含 26,500 次固定模式评估和 3,500 次在线控制器评估，共 30,000 次推理执行，控制器相对 FP16 实现 2.10x 平均延迟加速和 0.48x 能量比。重复测量的受控评估给出 1.93x（95% CI: 1.88–1.98x）延迟加速与 0.523（95% CI: 0.506–0.540）能量比；扩展自动基准评估中保留 99.6% 的 FP16 宏精度；10 万次 CPU 微基准测得平均路由开销 0.00475 ms（p99 为 0.00532 ms）。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，简单的请求感知路由可以在不重训练或修改底层 LLM 的情况下大幅提升服务效率，且路由开销极低。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Functionalization via Structure Completion and Motion Rectification
papers.abstract_en: Acquisition and creation of 3D assets have been largely view- or appearance-driven. As a result, existing digital 3D models often lack the requisite structural components to function as intended, such as joints, supports, interiors, or interaction elements. At the same time, even human-annotated motions are frequently error-prone, leading to physically implausible behavior. We introduce object functionalization, a novel task aimed at transforming visually plausible but non-functional 3D models into functional and physically operable ones. We formulate functionalization as a graph completion problem over a new functional graph representation, where labeled nodes represent object parts, labeled edges encode functional and contact relations, and movable nodes carry motion attributes, so that structural functional deficiencies manifest as missing nodes or incorrect edges. We develop a neural Graph Functionalizer (GraFu) to complete an incomplete graph representing a non-functional 3D object. The completed graph then drives a geometry realization stage that instantiates predicted connectors and structural elements in 3D, with the compelling side effect of rectifying erroneous human-annotated and predicted motions. To support training and evaluation, focusing on furniture as a rich and challenging target category, we introduce FurFun-233, a dataset of 233 paired non-functional and functionalized furniture models. On PartNet-Mobility ("zero-shot") and HSSD test sets, our method matches state-of-the-art methods in motion prediction accuracy while substantially improving functionality in terms of collision and connectivity. Project page: https://mingrui-zhao.github.io/Functionalization/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 3D 物体功能化 (object functionalization) 任务，将视觉上合理但缺少关节、支撑、内部结构或交互元素等组件的 3D 模型，转化为功能可用且可物理操作的模型。作者把该问题形式化为基于功能图表示 (functional graph representation) 的图补全问题，并开发神经网络 Graph Functionalizer (GraFu) 完成缺失节点与错误边，再由几何实现阶段在 3D 中实例化预测的连接件和结构元素，同时矫正人工标注或预测的运动。作者还引入家具数据集 FurFun-233，并在 PartNet-Mobility（零样本）和 HSSD 上验证了方法。
Motivation: 现有 3D 资产获取和创建主要受视角或外观驱动，导致数字模型常缺少实现预期功能所必需的结构部件；同时即使是人工标注的运动也常出错，产生物理上不合理的表现。
Method: 将功能化表述为图补全：节点表示物体部件，边表示功能与接触关系，可动节点带有运动属性，功能缺陷对应缺失节点或错误边；GraFu 补全图后，几何实现阶段实例化连接件和结构元素，并顺带矫正错误的运动。
Result: 在 PartNet-Mobility（零样本）和 HSSD 测试集上，该方法在运动预测准确率上匹配现有最先进方法，同时在碰撞和连通性方面显著提升功能性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将功能化作为图补全问题来处理，可以系统地把外观合理但非功能的 3D 模型改造为可操作对象，并修正错误运动；当前聚焦于家具这一丰富且有挑战性的类别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 4DLoG: Generative Modeling of Neurodegenerative Brain Anatomy with 4D Longitudinal Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Modeling and predicting neurodegenerative disease progression from medical images remains a major challenge in medical AI, with significant implications for early diagnosis, disease monitoring, and treatment planning. However, most longitudinal neuroimaging datasets are temporally sparse, with substantial gaps and missing follow-up scans for individual subjects. This makes it difficult to learn and accurately capture the continuous anatomical changes associated with disease progression at the level of individual subjects. To address this problem, we propose a novel model named 4DLoG, a full 4D (3DxT) Longitudinal Generative framework that effectively models and synthesizes follow-up brain anatomy over time, conditioned on available clinical and demographic variables. In contrast to previous approaches, our 4DLoG features two main contributions. First, it introduces a full 4D generative diffusion framework that jointly models spatial and temporal dependencies across complete longitudinal sequences through dedicated spatiotemporal attention, with robust spatial patch extraction and temporal alignment. Second, it explicitly learns the distribution of topology-preserving spatiotemporal deformations, which captures realistic geometric changes in brain structures over time. These new components enable a better generation of anatomically plausible future states from an imaging scan at any time point, providing greater flexibility for modeling individual longitudinal brain trajectories. We validate our model through both synthetic sequence generation and downstream longitudinal disease classification, as well as brain segmentation. Experiments on two large-scale longitudinal neuroimage datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in generating anatomically accurate, temporally consistent, and clinically meaningful brain trajectories. Our code is available on Github
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 4DLoG，一个全 4D（3D×T）纵向生成扩散模型，用于建模和合成随时间变化的脑解剖结构，并以临床和人口统计学变量为条件。其核心创新是联合建模空间与时间依赖的时空注意力机制，以及显式学习拓扑保持的时空形变分布。作者在两个大规模纵向神经影像数据集上验证，称该方法在生成解剖准确、时间一致且临床有意义的脑轨迹方面优于现有基线。
Motivation: 大多数纵向神经影像数据集在时间上稀疏，个体受试者存在大量间隔和缺失的随访扫描，使得难以在个体层面准确学习和捕捉与疾病进展相关的连续解剖变化。
Method: 提出 4DLoG 框架，包含完整的 4D 生成扩散模型，通过专用的时空注意力、鲁棒的空间 patch 提取和时间对齐来联合建模跨完整纵向序列的空间和时间依赖；同时显式学习拓扑保持的时空形变分布，以捕捉真实的脑结构几何变化。
Result: 摘要报告在合成序列生成、下游纵向疾病分类及脑分割任务上验证了模型，并在两个大规模纵向神经影像数据集上优于最先进基线，生成解剖准确、时间一致且有临床意义的脑轨迹。
Conclusion: 该方法可从任意时间点的影像扫描生成解剖上合理的未来脑状态，为建模个体纵向脑轨迹提供灵活性；代码已公开在 Github。
