papers.title: Transformer See, Transformer Do: Copying as an Intermediate Step in Learning Analogical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Analogical reasoning is a hallmark of human intelligence, enabling us to solve new problems by transferring knowledge from one situation to another. Yet, developing artificial intelligence systems capable of robust human-like analogical reasoning has proven difficult. In this work, we train transformers using Meta-Learning for Compositionality (MLC) on an analogical reasoning task (letter-string analogies) and assess their generalization capabilities. We find that letter-string analogies become learnable when guiding the models to attend to the most informative problem elements, induced by including copy tasks in the training data. Furthermore, generalization to new alphabets improves when models are trained with more heterogeneous datasets. For the best training run, our 3-layer encoder-decoder model performs on par with frontier models on our letter-string analogy datasets. The MLC approach also enables some generalization to compositions of trained transformations, but not to completely novel transformations. To understand how the model solves the analogies, we identify an algorithm for one analogy task that approximates the model's computations. We verify this using interpretability analyses and show that head-level attention weights causally affect model output, allowing steering between different analogy tasks. We discuss the implications of our findings for generalization capabilities of larger models and the parallels to human analogical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用Transformer学习字母串类比推理 (letter-string analogies)，发现通过在训练数据中加入复制任务 (copy tasks) 引导模型关注最有效的问题元素，可以使类比任务变得可学习；用Meta-Learning for Compositionality (MLC) 训练的3层编码器-解码器模型在自建字母串类比数据集上达到与前沿模型相当的表现，但只能泛化到已训练变换的组合，无法泛化到全新变换。作者还通过可解释性分析识别出模型求解类比的一种近似算法，并证明头级注意力权重对输出有因果影响。
Motivation: 类比推理是人类智能的标志，但构建能进行稳健类人类比推理的人工智能系统很困难；现有Transformer在该任务上的泛化能力不足，需要探索使其可学习的训练方式。
Method: 使用MLC方法训练Transformer，在训练数据中引入复制任务作为中间步骤，并采用更异构的数据集来提升对新字母表的泛化；通过可解释性分析识别近似算法，并用因果干预验证注意力头的作用。
Result: 加入复制任务后字母串类比任务变得可学习；异构数据集改善对新字母表的泛化；最优训练的3层编码器-解码器模型在字母串类比数据集上与前沿模型表现相当；MLC支持对已训练变换组合的泛化，但不支持完全新颖的变换。
Conclusion: 作者讨论了这些发现对更大模型泛化能力的启示以及与人类类比推理的相似性。

papers.title: UrbanVGGT: Scalable Sidewalk Width Estimation from Street View Images
papers.abstract_en: Sidewalk width is an important indicator of pedestrian accessibility, comfort, and network quality, yet large-scale width data remain scarce in most cities. Existing approaches typically rely on costly field surveys, high-resolution overhead imagery, or simplified geometric assumptions that limit scalability or introduce systematic error. To address this gap, we present UrbanVGGT, a measurement pipeline for estimating metric sidewalk width from a single street-view image. The method combines semantic segmentation, feed-forward 3D reconstruction, adaptive ground-plane fitting, camera-height-based scale calibration, and directional width measurement on the recovered plane. On a ground-truth benchmark from Washington, D.C., UrbanVGGT achieves a mean absolute error of 0.252 m, with 95.5% of estimates within 0.50 m of the reference width. Ablation experiments show that metric scale calibration is the most critical component, and controlled comparisons with alternative geometry backbones support the effectiveness of the overall design. The results indicate that street-view imagery can support scalable generation of candidate sidewalk-width attributes, while broader cross-city validation and local ground-truth auditing remain necessary before deployment as authoritative planning data.

papers.title: Qworld: Question-Specific Evaluation Criteria for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on open-ended questions is difficult because response quality depends on the question's context. Binary scores and static rubrics fail to capture these context-dependent requirements. Existing methods define criteria at the dataset level or generate them in a single pass, which limits their ability to explore the evaluation space implied by each question. We introduce One-Question-One-World (Qworld), a method that generates question-specific evaluation criteria using a recursive expansion tree. Given a question, Qworld decomposes it into scenarios, perspectives, and fine-grained binary criteria through hierarchical and horizontal expansion. The resulting criteria specify what a high-quality answer must address for that question. On HealthBench, Qworld covers 89% of expert-authored criteria and generates 79% novel criteria validated by human experts. Experts rate Qworld criteria higher in insight and granularity than those produced by prior methods. When applied to 11 frontier LLMs on HealthBench and Humanity's Last Exam, Qworld reveals capability differences in dimensions such as long-term impact, equity, error handling, and interdisciplinary reasoning that coarse rubrics do not capture. By generating evaluation criteria for each question, Qworld enables assessment of LLM responses that is tailored to the question rather than based on fixed task-level criteria.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 One-Question-One-World (Qworld) 方法，通过递归扩展树为每个开放性问题生成问题特异的评估标准，而非使用固定任务级标准。在 HealthBench 上，Qworld 覆盖了 89% 的专家标准并生成了 79% 经专家验证的新标准；应用于 11 个前沿 LLM 时，它能揭示粗粒度评分无法捕捉的能力差异。
Motivation: 开放式问答的评估困难在于回答质量依赖问题上下文，二元评分和静态标准无法捕捉这些依赖；现有方法在数据集层面定义标准或单次生成标准，限制了探索每个问题隐含评估空间的能力。
Method: Qworld 使用递归扩展树，将问题通过层次和水平扩展分解为场景 (scenarios)、视角 (perspectives) 和细粒度二元标准 (binary criteria)，从而为每个问题生成明确的高质量回答所需覆盖的标准。
Result: 在 HealthBench 上，Qworld 覆盖 89% 的专家标准并生成 79% 的新标准且通过人类专家验证；专家认为其标准在洞察力和粒度上优于先前方法。在 HealthBench 和 Humanity's Last Exam 上对 11 个前沿 LLM 的评估中，Qworld 揭示出长期影响、公平性、错误处理和跨学科推理等维度的能力差异。
Conclusion: Qworld 通过为每个问题单独生成评估标准，实现了基于问题本身而非固定任务级标准的 LLM 回答评估。

papers.title: Guided Diffusion by Optimized Loss Functions on Relaxed Parameters for Inverse Material Design
papers.abstract_en: Inverse design problems are common in engineering and materials science. The forward direction, i.e., computing output quantities from design parameters, typically requires running a numerical simulation, such as a FEM, as an intermediate step, which is an optimization problem by itself. In many scenarios, several design parameters can lead to the same or similar output values. For such cases, multi-modal probabilistic approaches are advantageous to obtain diverse solutions. A major difficulty in inverse design stems from the structure of the design space, since discrete parameters or further constraints disallow the direct use of gradient-based optimization. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel inverse design method based on diffusion models. Our approach relaxes the original design space into a continuous grid representation, where gradients can be computed by implicit differentiation in the forward simulation. A diffusion model is trained on this relaxed parameter space in order to serve as a prior for plausible relaxed designs. Parameters are sampled by guided diffusion using gradients that are propagated from an objective function specified at inference time through the differentiable simulation. A design sample is obtained by backprojection into the original parameter space. We develop our approach for a composite material design problem where the forward process is modeled as a linear FEM problem. We evaluate the performance of our approach in finding designs that match a specified bulk modulus. We demonstrate that our method can propose multiple diverse designs within 1% relative error margin from medium to high target bulk moduli in 2D and 3D settings. We also demonstrate that the material density of generated samples can be minimized simultaneously by using a multi-objective loss function.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型 (diffusion model) 的逆向材料设计方法。作者将原始设计空间松弛为连续网格表示，借助前向有限元仿真中的隐式微分计算梯度，并用扩散模型作为松弛参数空间上的先验；推理时通过可微仿真传播目标函数的梯度来引导采样，最后将样本反投影回原始参数空间。在复合材料设计任务中，该方法能在 2D 和 3D 设置下为中等至较高的目标体积模量 (bulk modulus) 生成多个多样化的设计方案，相对误差在 1% 以内，并可用多目标损失同时最小化材料密度。
Motivation: 工程与材料科学中的逆向设计常因设计空间存在离散参数或额外约束而无法直接使用基于梯度的优化；同时多个设计参数可能对应相同或相近的输出，需要多模态概率方法以得到多样化解。
Method: 将原始设计空间松弛为连续网格表示，使梯度可通过前向仿真的隐式微分计算；在该松弛空间上训练扩散模型作为可行设计先验；推理时通过可微仿真将推理期目标函数的梯度传播到采样过程，实现引导扩散 (guided diffusion)，最后把样本反投影回原始参数空间。
Result: 针对以线性有限元 (FEM) 建模的复合材料设计问题，该方法在 2D 和 3D 场景中能够为中等至高的目标体积模量找到多个多样化设计，且相对误差在 1% 以内；采用多目标损失函数还可同时最小化生成样本的材料密度。
Conclusion: 作者表明所提出的基于扩散模型与可微仿真的逆向设计方法在复合材料设计任务上有效，能够处理离散或约束性设计空间并提供多模态解。摘要未提及超出线性 FEM 前向模型之外的应用范围或局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Extended to Reality: Prompt Injection in 3D Environments
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced the capabilities to interpret and act on visual input in 3D environments, empowering diverse applications such as robotics and situated conversational agents. When MLLMs reason over camera-captured views of the physical world, a new attack surface emerges: an attacker can place text-bearing physical objects in the environment to override MLLMs' intended task. While prior work has studied prompt injection in the text domain and through digitally edited 2D images, limited attention has been paid to how these attacks function in 3D environments. To bridge the gap, we introduce PI3D, a prompt injection attack against MLLMs in 3D environments, realized through text-bearing object placement rather than digital image edits. We formulate and solve the problem of identifying an effective pose (position and orientation) for a 3D object with injected text, where the attacker's goal is to induce the MLLM to perform the injected task while ensuring that the object placement remains physically plausible. Experiment results demonstrate that PI3D is an effective attack against multiple MLLMs under diverse camera trajectories. We further evaluate a range of defenses and show that they are not sufficient to reliably defend against PI3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PI3D，一种针对 3D 环境中多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的提示注入 (prompt injection) 攻击，通过在物理环境中放置带文本的 3D 物体而非编辑数字图像来实施攻击。作者将攻击形式化为寻找注入文本物体的有效位姿（位置与朝向）的问题，使 MLLM 执行注入任务，同时保证放置的物理合理性。实验表明 PI3D 在多种相机轨迹下对多个 MLLM 有效，且现有防御手段不足以可靠抵御该攻击。
Motivation: 现有提示注入研究主要集中于文本域和数字编辑的 2D 图像，对 3D 物理环境中通过物理物体放置进行的攻击关注不足，构成了新的攻击面。
Method: 提出 PI3D 攻击方法，将文本注入物体的位姿（位置与朝向）选择建模为优化问题，目标是在保持物体放置物理可行性的同时诱导 MLLM 执行注入任务。
Result: 实验表明 PI3D 在多种相机轨迹下对多个 MLLM 构成有效攻击；对多种防御方法的进一步评估显示它们不足以可靠防御 PI3D。
Conclusion: 摘要强调现有防御无法可靠抵御 3D 环境中的提示注入攻击，表明面向物理世界放置型攻击的安全防护仍是开放挑战。

papers.title: Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the method of choice for training models in setups where the objective function can only be evaluated by sampling from the model. Our key observation is that when the feedback is terminal and binary, models implicitly induce a likelihood over correct rollouts. Maximum likelihood would be the natural framework in such settings, but RL is used instead as a workaround to the non-differentiability. We prove that the standard, expected-reward RL formulation is only a first-order approximation of the likelihood. To remedy this mismatch, we introduce Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (MaxRL), a compute-indexed family of sample-based objectives that interpolate between expected-reward RL and maximum likelihood as sampling compute is scaled. The resulting objective is a one-line change to standard RL implementations. MaxRL Pareto-dominates existing methods in all tested models and tasks, achieves up to $20\times$ gains in test-time scaling efficiency over GRPO, and scales more favorably with additional training data and compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个关键观察：当强化学习 (RL) 的反馈是终止性的二元信号时，模型隐式地对正确轨迹 (correct rollouts) 诱导了一个似然函数，因此极大似然 (maximum likelihood) 本应是自然框架，但实践中因不可微性而改用 RL。作者证明标准的期望奖励 RL 目标只是似然的一阶近似，并提出 MaxRL——一个随采样计算量扩展、在期望奖励 RL 与极大似然之间插值的计算索引族目标，且对现有 RL 实现只需一行修改。摘要报告 MaxRL 在所有测试模型和任务上帕累托优于现有方法，并对 GRPO 获得最高 20 倍的测试时扩展效率提升。
Motivation: 在目标函数只能通过从模型采样来评估的场景中，RL 是首选训练方法；但当反馈是终止性二元信号时，极大似然才是更自然的框架，RL 只是对不可微性的临时替代。作者指出这种替代存在根本失配：标准期望奖励 RL 公式仅是一阶近似，导致其与似然目标不一致。
Method: 引入 Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (MaxRL)，一种按计算量索引的样本化目标族，通过缩放采样计算在期望奖励 RL 与极大似然之间插值。该目标是对标准 RL 实现的一行改动，无需改变整体训练架构。
Result: 摘要报告 MaxRL 在所有测试模型和任务上帕累托支配现有方法，在测试时扩展效率上相对 GRPO 最高提升 20 倍，并且随训练数据与计算量增加表现出更有利的扩展趋势。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过这种计算索引的插值目标，可以修正期望奖励 RL 与似然目标之间的失配，同时保持 RL 实现的简单性。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 MaxRL 在所有测试模型和任务上帕累托支配现有方法，在测试时扩展效率上相对 GRPO 最高提升 20 倍，并且随训练数据与计算量增加表现出更有利的扩展趋势。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为通过这种计算索引的插值目标，可以修正期望奖励 RL 与似然目标之间的失配，同时保持 RL 实现的简单性。

papers.title: YolovN-CBi: A Lightweight and Efficient Architecture for Real-Time Detection of Small UAVs
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, commonly known as, drones pose increasing risks in civilian and defense settings, demanding accurate and real-time drone detection systems. However, detecting drones is challenging because of their small size, rapid movement, and low visual contrast. A modified architecture of YolovN called the YolovN-CBi is proposed that incorporates the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) and the Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN) to improve sensitivity to small object detections. A curated training dataset consisting of 28K images is created with various flying objects and a local test dataset is collected with 2500 images consisting of very small drone objects. The proposed architecture is evaluated on four benchmark datasets, along with the local test dataset. The baseline Yolov5 and the proposed Yolov5-CBi architecture outperform newer Yolo versions, including Yolov8 and Yolov12, in the speed-accuracy trade-off for small object detection. Four other variants of the proposed CBi architecture are also proposed and evaluated, which vary in the placement and usage of CBAM and BiFPN. These variants are further distilled using knowledge distillation techniques for edge deployment, using a Yolov5m-CBi teacher and a Yolov5n-CBi student. The distilled model achieved a mA@P0.5:0.9 of 0.6573, representing a 6.51% improvement over the teacher's score of 0.6171, highlighting the effectiveness of the distillation process. The distilled model is 82.9% faster than the baseline model, making it more suitable for real-time drone detection. These findings highlight the effectiveness of the proposed CBi architecture, together with the distilled lightweight models in advancing efficient and accurate real-time detection of small UAVs.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been submitted to the journal Computer Optics and is currently under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向小型无人机实时检测的轻量级架构 YolovN-CBi，在 YolovN 中引入卷积块注意力模块 (CBAM) 和双向特征金字塔网络 (BiFPN) 以提升小目标检测灵敏度。作者构建了 28K 图像的训练集和 2500 张含极小无人机目标的本地测试集，并在四个基准数据集上评估。结果显示基线 Yolov5 与 Yolov5-CBi 在小目标检测的速度-精度权衡上优于 Yolov8 和 Yolov12，且经知识蒸馏后的轻量模型比教师模型 mA@P0.5:0.9 提升 6.51%，推理速度提升 82.9%。
Motivation: 无人机在民用和国防场景中带来日益增加的风险，需要准确且实时的检测系统；但无人机体积小、运动快、视觉对比度低，使得检测具有挑战性。
Method: 提出 YolovN-CBi 架构，将 CBAM 与 BiFPN 集成到 YolovN 中；构建含多种飞行物体的 28K 图像训练数据和含极小无人机的 2500 张本地测试集；提出四种 CBAM/BiFPN 放置方式不同的变体，并使用 Yolov5m-CBi 教师模型对 Yolov5n-CBi 学生模型进行知识蒸馏以实现边缘部署。
Result: 在四个基准数据集和本地测试集上，基线 Yolov5 与 Yolov5-CBi 在速度-精度权衡上超过 Yolov8 和 Yolov12；蒸馏后模型 mA@P0.5:0.9 达到 0.6573，较教师模型的 0.6171 提升 6.51%，且比基线模型快 82.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提出的 CBi 架构结合蒸馏轻量模型能有效提升小型无人机实时检测的准确性与效率；该稿件已投稿至 Computer Optics 期刊并处于评审中。

papers.title: TS-Reasoner: Aligning Time Series Foundation Models with LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Time series reasoning is crucial to decision-making in diverse domains, including finance, energy, and scientific discovery. While existing time series foundation models (TSFMs) can capture low-level dynamic patterns and provide accurate forecasting, further analysis usually requires additional background knowledge and sophisticated reasoning, which are lacking in most TSFMs but can be achieved through Large Language Models (LLMs). On the other hand, without expensive post-training, LLMs often struggle with the numerical understanding of time series data. Although it is intuitive to integrate the two types of models, developing effective training recipes that align the two modalities for reasoning tasks is still an open challenge. To this end, we propose TS-Reasoner that aligns the latent representations of TSFMs with the textual inputs of LLMs for downstream understanding/reasoning tasks. Specifically, we propose a simple yet effective method to curate diverse, synthetic pairs of time series and textual captions for alignment training. We then develop a two-stage training recipe that applies instruction fine-tuning after the alignment pretraining. Unlike existing works that train an LLM to take time series as inputs, we leverage a pretrained TSFM and freeze it during training. Experiments on several benchmarks demonstrate that TS-Reasoner not only outperforms a wide range of open-source LLMs, Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and Time Series LLMs of comparable scale, but also does so with remarkable data efficiency, e.g., using less than half the training data.
papers.comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TS-Reasoner，将时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的潜在表征与 LLM 的文本输入对齐，用于时间序列的下游理解/推理任务。作者提出一种简单有效的合成时间序列-文本标题配对数据构造方法，并采用对齐预训练加指令微调的两阶段训练方案，训练期间冻结预训练 TSFM。多个基准实验显示，TS-Reasoner 在相当规模下优于多种开源 LLM、VLM 和时间序列 LLM，且只用不到一半的训练数据。
Motivation: 时间序列推理对金融、能源和科学发现等领域的决策至关重要，但现有 TSFM 只能捕捉低层动态模式并进行预测，缺乏推理所需的背景知识与复杂推理能力；而 LLM 若不经过昂贵的后训练，又难以理解时间序列数据的数值含义。如何设计有效的训练策略来对齐这两种模态仍是一个开放问题。
Method: 提出 TS-Reasoner，将对齐 TSFM 潜在表征与 LLM 文本输入作为核心思路。具体方法包括：用简单有效的流程构造多样化的合成时间序列-文本描述配对数据用于对齐训练；随后采用两阶段训练方案，即先进行对齐预训练（alignment pretraining），再进行指令微调（instruction fine-tuning）。与已有工作不同，模型利用预训练 TSFM 并在训练中将其冻结。
Result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，TS-Reasoner 在相当规模下胜过多种开源 LLM、视觉-语言模型（VLM）和时间序列 LLM，并展现出显著的数据效率，例如仅使用不到一半的训练数据即可达到更好效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过冻结预训练 TSFM 并采用对齐预训练加指令微调的训练方案，可以有效弥合时间序列与文本之间的模态差距，实现数据高效的时间序列推理。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$: Lazy Wavefront Search for Dynamic Replanning
papers.abstract_en: FMT$^{*}$ plans efficiently in static worlds by expanding a cost-ordered wavefront and collision-checking lazily, but its single-pass unvisited rule cannot revise paths when obstacles change. We present FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$, an anytime, asymptotically optimal generalization of that wavefront for dynamic replanning. A cost-improvement test replaces the unvisited set, allowing a node to be revisited for best-parent selection whenever a lower-cost potential connection is found. This induces implicit rewiring within the wavefront while preserving lazy collision checking. FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$ retains the online densification of RRT$^{*}$ but defers its eager neighborhood rewiring to the cost-ordered wavefront, so a node is revisited only when the expansion reaches it. Obstacle updates orphan the affected subtree and reseed the wavefront. A direct cost push from each parent to its children propagates cost improvements through validated tree edges, thereby preserving descendant cost consistency, a property not guaranteed by implicit rewiring alone. We compare a fixed-graph batch variant, Dynamic FMT$^{*}$ (D-FMT$^{*}$), with D$^{*}$ Lite on identical PRM$^{*}$ graphs, and FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$ with eager RRT$^{\mathrm{X}}$ and path-centric LLPT$^{*}$ in geometric and kinodynamic scenes, including partial observability. D-FMT$^{*}$ stays close on path quality at far fewer collision checks. FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$ lies between LLPT$^{*}$ and RRT$^{\mathrm{X}}$ on repair effort while tracking the reliability and trajectory quality of eager RRT$^{\mathrm{X}}$. The study shows that collision-checking policy affects median repair latency, repair-time tails, and executed trajectory quality.
papers.comment: 52 pages, 15 figures. Substantially revised version with strengthened asymptotic-optimality analysis, revised complexity analysis, expanded dynamic-replanning experiments, and updated presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$，将静态环境下的 FMT$^{*}$ 波前搜索推广为支持动态重规划的 anytime、渐近最优算法。其核心是用代价改进测试替代单次访问的 unvisited 规则，使节点在发现更低代价连接时可被重新访问，从而在波前内实现隐式重接 (implicit rewiring)，同时保留惰性碰撞检测。实验对比了固定图批处理变体 D-FMT$^{*}$ 与 D$^{*}$ Lite，以及 FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$ 与 RRT$^{\mathrm{X}}$、LLPT$^{*}$。
Motivation: FMT$^{*}$ 在静态世界中高效，但其单次通过的 unvisited 规则在障碍变化时无法修订路径，缺乏应对动态环境的机制。
Method: 用代价改进测试决定节点重访以选择最佳父节点，通过代价有序波前延迟邻域重接；障碍更新时使受影响子树失效并重新播种波前；父节点向子节点的直接代价推送沿已验证树边传播代价改进，保持后代代价一致性。
Result: D-FMT$^{*}$ 在路径质量上与 D$^{*}$ Lite 接近，但碰撞检查次数大幅减少；FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$ 的修复开销介于 LLPT$^{*}$ 和 RRT$^{\mathrm{X}}$ 之间，同时保持与 eager RRT$^{\mathrm{X}}$ 相当的可靠性和轨迹质量。碰撞检测策略影响中位修复延迟、修复时间尾部分布以及实际执行轨迹质量。
Conclusion: 研究表明碰撞检测策略显著影响动态重规划的修复延迟、尾部延迟和执行轨迹质量；修订版增强了渐近最优性分析，并扩展了动态重规划实验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Basic B*** Effect: The Use of LLM-based Agents Reduces the Distinctiveness and Diversity of People's Choices
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act on people's behalf: they write emails, buy groceries, and book restaurants. While the outsourcing of human decision-making to AI can be convenient, it raises a fundamental question: how does delegating identity-defining choices to AI shape who people become? Across a large field study and a controlled experiment, we study the impact of agentic LLMs on two identity-relevant outcomes: interpersonal distinctiveness - how unique a person's choices are relative to others - and intrapersonal diversity - the breadth of a single person's choices over time. Study 1 uses 110,000 real choices drawn from social media behavior of 1,000 U.S. users to compare generic and personalized agents to a human baseline. Both agents shift people's choices toward more popular options, reducing the distinctiveness of their preferences. While the use of personalized agents tempers this homogenization (compared to generic agents), it also more strongly compresses the diversity of people's preference portfolios by narrowing their exploration across topics and psychological affinities. Study 2 replicates these patterns in an online experiment which mimics common real-world scenarios (e.g., choosing movies) and allows us to directly compare the AI agent's choices to those made by 348 participants (12,097 human choices). The findings also suggest that the flattening effects of AI agents are amplified when choices are made sequentially (vs. batch), and when agents rely on domain-specific user information for personalization. Understanding how AI agents compress human experience (and the trade-offs involved) is critical for designing systems that augment human agency and safeguard diversity in thought, taste, and expression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一项大规模实地研究和一项受控实验，考察基于LLM的代理（agentic LLM）在替人做选择时如何影响两种身份相关的结果：人际独特性（interpersonal distinctiveness）和个体内多样性（intrapersonal diversity）。研究发现代理会把人的选择推向更流行的选项，降低独特性；个性化代理虽比通用代理缓解同质化，却更强地压缩个人偏好组合的主题与心理亲和力多样性。
Motivation: LLM越来越常代表人们行事（写邮件、购物、订餐厅），将身份定义型选择外包给AI会如何影响人的身份与选择空间，是一个基本且未被充分实证的问题。
Method: 研究结合了Study 1（基于1,000名美国用户社交媒体行为中的110,000个真实选择，比较通用代理、个性化代理与人类基线）和Study 2（348名参与者、12,097个人类选择的在线实验，模仿电影选择等常见场景），并操纵顺序vs批量选择及个性化所依赖的用户信息类型。
Result: 两类研究一致显示，代理使人们的选择趋向更流行的选项，降低人际独特性；个性化代理相比通用代理缓解了同质化，但更强地压缩了偏好组合的多样性；顺序选择（相对于批量选择）和依赖领域特定用户信息进行个性化会放大这些扁平化效应。
Conclusion: 作者强调，理解AI代理如何压缩人类体验及其权衡，对设计能够增强人类能动性并保护思想、品味和表达多样性的系统至关重要。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，理解AI代理如何压缩人类体验及其权衡，对设计能够增强人类能动性并保护思想、品味和表达多样性的系统至关重要。

papers.title: ProteinZero: Self-Improving Protein Generation via Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Protein generative models have shown remarkable promise in protein design, yet their success rates remain constrained by reliance on curated sequence-structure datasets and by misalignment between supervised objectives and real design goals. We present ProteinZero, an online reinforcement learning framework for inverse folding models that enables scalable, automated, and continuous self-improvement with computationally efficient feedback. ProteinZero employs a reward pipeline that combines structural guidance from ESMFold with a novel self-derived ddG predictor, providing stable multi-objective signals while avoiding the prohibitive cost of physics-based methods. To ensure robustness in online RL, we further introduce a novel embedding-level diversity regularizer that mitigates mode collapse and promotes functionally meaningful sequence variation. Within a general RL formulation balancing multi-reward optimization, KL-divergence from a reference model, and diversity regularization, ProteinZero achieves robust improvements across designability, stability, recovery, and diversity. On the CATH-4.3 benchmark, it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines including ProteinMPNN, ESM-IF, and InstructPLM, reducing design failure rates by 36-48% and achieving success rates above 90% across diverse folds. Importantly, a complete RL run can be executed on a single 8 X GPU node within three days, including reward computation and data generation. These results indicate that efficient online RL fine-tuning can complement supervised pretraining by allowing protein generative models to evolve continuously from their own outputs and optimize multiple design objectives without labeled data, opening new possibilities for exploring the vast protein design space. Full source code and model checkpoints will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProteinZero，一个用于逆折叠模型的在线强化学习框架，通过ESMFold结构反馈和自研ddG预测器构成奖励管道，并引入嵌入级多样性正则化，使模型无需标注数据即可从自身输出持续自我改进。在CATH-4.3基准上，它稳定优于ProteinMPNN、ESM-IF和InstructPLM等基线，设计失败率降低36-48%，成功率超过90%，且整个RL流程可在单个8×GPU节点上三天内完成。
Motivation: 蛋白质生成模型依赖人工整理的序列-结构数据集，且监督目标与真实设计目标存在错位，导致成功率受限。需要一种可扩展、自动化且无需标注数据的在线优化方式，让模型持续演进并同时优化多个设计目标。
Method: 提出在线RL框架ProteinZero，奖励管道结合ESMFold的结构指导与新颖的自推导ddG预测器，提供稳定的多目标信号并避免物理方法的高昂成本；同时引入嵌入级多样性正则化以缓解模式坍缩，并在统一RL公式中平衡多奖励优化、相对参考模型的KL散度与多样性正则化。
Result: 在CATH-4.3上，ProteinZero一致优于ProteinMPNN、ESM-IF和InstructPLM等基线，将设计失败率降低36-48%，并在多种折叠上取得超过90%的成功率；包含奖励计算和数据生成的完整RL训练可在单个8×GPU节点上三天内完成。
Conclusion: 摘要表明高效在线RL微调可以补充监督预训练，使蛋白质生成模型从自身输出中持续演化，无需标注数据即可优化多个设计目标，为探索蛋白质设计空间提供新途径。

papers.title: Toward Greater Autonomy in Materials Discovery Agents: Unifying Planning, Physics, and Scientists
papers.abstract_en: We aim at designing language agents with greater autonomy for crystal materials discovery. While most of existing studies restrict the agents to perform specific tasks within predefined workflows, we aim to automate workflow planning given high-level goals and scientist intuition. To this end, we propose Materials Agent unifying Planning, Physics, and Scientists, known as MAPPS. MAPPS consists of a Workflow Planner, a Tool Code Generator, and a Scientific Mediator. The Workflow Planner uses large language models (LLMs) to generate structured and multi-step workflows. The Tool Code Generator synthesizes executable Python code for various tasks, including invoking a force field foundation model that encodes physics. The Scientific Mediator coordinates communications, facilitates scientist feedback, and ensures robustness through error reflection and recovery. By unifying planning, physics, and scientists, MAPPS enables flexible and reliable materials discovery with greater autonomy, achieving a five-fold improvement in stability, uniqueness, and novelty rates compared with prior generative models when evaluated on the MP-20 data. We provide extensive experiments across diverse tasks to show that MAPPS is a promising framework for autonomous materials discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAPPS（Materials Agent unifying Planning, Physics, and Scientists），一个面向晶体材料发现的语言智能体框架，由 Workflow Planner、Tool Code Generator 和 Scientific Mediator 三个组件构成，旨在根据高层目标和科学家直觉自动规划多步工作流，而不再局限于预定义流程。在 MP-20 数据上，相比先前生成模型，其稳定性、唯一性和新颖性率获得五倍提升。
Motivation: 现有材料发现智能体大多只能执行预定义工作流内的特定任务，缺少根据高层目标和科学家直觉自动进行工作流规划的能力，限制了智能体的自主性。
Method: MAPPS 包含三个组件：Workflow Planner 使用大语言模型生成结构化多步工作流；Tool Code Generator 合成可执行的 Python 代码，包括调用编码物理知识的力场基础模型（force field foundation model）；Scientific Mediator 负责协调通信、引入科学家反馈，并通过错误反思与恢复机制保证鲁棒性。
Result: 在 MP-20 数据上，MAPPS 相比先前生成模型在稳定性、唯一性和新颖性率上取得五倍提升；作者还通过覆盖多种任务的实验表明该框架在自主材料发现方面具有前景。
Conclusion: 摘要认为统一规划、物理建模与科学家反馈可以带来更灵活可靠、自主性更高的材料发现流程，并将 MAPPS 定位为面向自主材料发现的 promising framework。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning-Augmented Power System Operations: A Unified Optimization View
papers.abstract_en: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy and inverter-based resources, traditional physics-based power-system operation faces growing challenges in maintaining economic efficiency, security, and robustness. Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a powerful tool for modeling complex system dynamics and uncertainty. However, standalone ML pipelines, including model selection, training, and validation, are often designed separately from the downstream optimization problems they influence, which can lead to suboptimal system-level decisions. To address this gap, this paper proposes \emph{Learning-Augmented Power System Operations} (LAPSO), a unified optimization-centered framework that treats ML as an explicit component of power-system operational decision-making. First, LAPSO provides generalized mathematical template covering both decision-independent predictors that parameterize downstream optimization and decision-dependent learned surrogates that enter optimization as auxiliary constraints. Second, it designs ML pipelines using optimization-aware criteria, including solution-quality, computational tractability, constraint satisfaction, and economic performance. We instantiate LAPSO on both stability-constrained optimization (SCO) and objective-based forecasting (OBF), and show how the framework provides actionable guidance for selecting learned components. We further extend the framework to a hybrid forecast--operation--control chain and use it to organize heterogeneous uncertainty sources. Finally, we release an open-source Python package, \texttt{lapso}, for modularly augmenting existing power-system optimization models with ML components. Code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/xuwkk/lapso_exp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出学习增强电力系统运行（Learning-Augmented Power System Operations, LAPSO）的统一优化视角框架，将机器学习视为电力系统运行决策中的显式组件。框架提供广义数学模板，涵盖决策无关预测器与决策依赖的学习代理，并以优化感知标准设计ML管道，在稳定性约束优化和基于目标的预测上实例化，还扩展到混合预测-运行-控制链，并发布开源Python包lapso。
Motivation: 随着可再生能源和逆变器资源渗透率提高，传统基于物理的电力系统运行在维持经济性、安全性和鲁棒性上面临挑战；独立设计的ML流程与所影响的下游优化问题脱节，可能导致系统级决策次优。
Method: 提出LAPSO统一框架：给出可参数化下游优化的决策无关预测器和以辅助约束形式进入优化的决策依赖学习代理的通用数学模板；采用优化感知准则（解质量、计算可解性、约束满足、经济性能）设计ML流程；并在稳定性约束优化（SCO）和基于目标的预测（OBF）上实例化，进一步扩展为混合预测-运行-控制链以组织异质不确定性源。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但表明该框架能为选择学习组件提供可操作的指导，并发布了开源Python包lapso及配套代码和数据集。
Conclusion: 摘要强调LAPSO提供了一种统一的优化视角，可模块化地为现有电力系统优化模型增强ML组件；其适用范围和实证验证细节在摘要中未展开。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Ultra-High-Definition Restoration Transformers with Correlation Matching Transformation
papers.abstract_en: We propose UHDformer++, a general Transformer-based framework to solve numerous Ultra-High-Definition (UHD) image restoration tasks. UHDformer++ operates across $4$ coordinated learning spaces: 1) a high-resolution space (HR) for multi-level feature extraction, 2) a low-resolution space (LR) for learning compact, representative features, 3) a super-resolution space (SR) for upsampling low-resolution features from SR, and 4) a low-high fusion and reconstruction space (LHFR) for final image restoration. Specifically, HR extracts multi-scale high-resolution features and fuses them with low-resolution cues to produce residual images, while LR distills complementary representations from HR to improve restoration quality. To supply LHFR with richer features, SR super-resolves LR outputs before fusion. We further introduce two modules to bridge the high- and low-resolution spaces. The Feature-Refined Correlation Matching Transformation (FR-CMT) module selects the top $C/r~(C~\text{denotes the number of channels;~}r\geq1~\text{controls the squeezing level})$, from the fusion between max- and mean-pooled high-resolution features to replace less informative channels in the low-resolution Transformer. The Adaptive Channel Modulator (ACM) adaptively recalibrates multi-scale high-resolution features, ensuring that only task-relevant information propagates to LR. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UHDformer++ reduces model parameters by at least 86\% compared with recent state-of-the-art methods while achieving substantial performance gains across $5$ UHD restoration tasks, including low-light image enhancement, dehazing, deblurring, deraining, and desnowing. Code will be released at https://github.com/supersupercong/uhdformerplus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UHDformer++，一个面向多种超高清 (UHD) 图像复原任务的通用 Transformer 框架，在四个协调的学习空间中运作：高分辨率空间 (HR)、低分辨率空间 (LR)、超分辨率空间 (SR) 以及低-高融合与重建空间 (LHFR)。作者引入 Feature-Refined Correlation Matching Transformation (FR-CMT) 与 Adaptive Channel Modulator (ACM) 两个模块来桥接高、低分辨率特征。摘要报告该方法相比近期最先进方法至少减少 86% 的模型参数，同时在这 5 个 UHD 复原任务（低光照增强、去雾、去模糊、去雨、去雪）上取得显著性能提升。
Motivation: 超高清图像复原任务种类繁多，现有方法通常参数量大且难以在多个任务上统一取得良好效果，需要更高效、通用的框架来同时处理低光照增强、去雾、去模糊、去雨、去雪等问题。
Method: UHDformer++ 在 HR 中提取多尺度高分辨率特征并与低分辨率线索融合生成残差图；LR 从 HR 蒸馏互补表示；SR 在对 LR 输出融合前执行超分辨率以丰富 LHFR 特征。FR-CMT 从最大池化与均值池化的高分辨率特征融合结果中选取前 C/r 个通道，替换低分辨率 Transformer 中信息量较少的通道；ACM 自适应地重新校准多尺度高分辨率特征，只将任务相关信息传播到 LR。
Result: 摘要报告 UHDformer++ 在模型参数上比近期最先进方法至少减少 86%，并在低光照增强、去雾、去模糊、去雨、去雪这 5 项 UHD 复原任务上均获得实质性性能提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种多空间协调设计与特征相关匹配变换机制能够在显著降低参数量的同时提升多项 UHD 复原任务的性能，并计划公开代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mapping General-Purpose AI Governance in Twenty AI Middle-Power Jurisdictions
papers.abstract_en: The most capable general-purpose AI (GPAI) models are mostly built in two jurisdictions, the United States and China, but the risks they carry land globally. Regionally advanced economies hosting no frontier developer, which we call AI middle-powers, are writing their own rules to govern GPAI. This paper investigates which GPAI-relevant provisions these AI middle-powers have enacted, mapping twenty jurisdictions including the European Union at the level of the individual provision, across four governance areas that trace the accountability chain for the model layer: systemic risk assessment, evaluation and verification, prohibitions with monitoring and detection, and serious incident reporting. Confirmed absence is recorded as data alongside positive provision. We find that jurisdictions converge on form, but diverge on force. Sixteen engage in at least three of the four governance areas, yet only about one in five provisions sit in binding law, and three-quarters of the instruments that do bind do so without defining GPAI. The institutional infrastructure shows the same shape: four in five of the mapped governance actors hold mandates that predate GPAI, and obligations attach wherever the inherited regime already reached, which is the application layer rather than the model. Where these states engage the model layer, they build capacity to observe it rather than impose duties on those who build it, and almost every evaluation body was constituted without the power to act on what it finds. Nominal coverage of the full accountability chain reaches eleven jurisdictions, but only five hold more than one provision in every area and, outside the EU, no jurisdiction imposes a binding evaluation duty on a model developer. The dataset gives researchers and policymakers a provision-level basis for identifying where regimes could align, and where coordination would have to start from scratch.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对二十个“AI 中等强国”司法辖区（含欧盟）在通用人工智能（GPAI, general-purpose AI）治理上的立法与制度安排进行条款级（provision-level）系统梳理，覆盖系统性风险评估、评估与验证、带监测与检测的禁止性规定、严重事件报告四个沿模型层问责链展开的治理领域。摘要的核心发现是各辖区在形式上趋同但在约束力上分化：仅约五分之一的条款落入有约束力的法律，四分之三的有约束力文书未对 GPAI 给出定义，约五分之四的治理机构授权先于 GPAI 存在，义务大多落在应用层而非模型层。
Motivation: 能力最强的 GPAI 模型主要在美国和中国开发，但其风险是全球性的；不设前沿模型开发商但区域经济先进的“AI 中等强国”正在自行制定 GPAI 治理规则，而现有研究缺乏在单个条款粒度上对这些规则的系统比较。
Method: 作者构建了一个条款级数据集，对二十个司法辖区（含欧盟）在四个治理领域中的 GPAI 相关条款进行映射，并将“确认不存在”的情况与正面条款一并记录为数据，从而给出治理问责链的完整覆盖视图。
Result: 摘要报告：十六个辖区在四个治理领域中至少涉及三个，但仅约五分之一的条款位于有约束力的法律中；四分之三的有约束力文书未定义 GPAI；五分之四的治理机构职责先于 GPAI 存在。名义上完整覆盖问责链的辖区有十一个，但仅五个在每个领域都不止一项条款；欧盟之外没有任何辖区对模型开发商施加有约束力的评估义务。
Conclusion: 作者认为各辖区在治理形式上趋同但在约束力上分化，倾向于建立观察模型层的能力而非对模型构建者施加义务。该数据集可为研究者和政策制定者提供条款级基础，用以识别哪些制度可以对齐、哪些协调需要从零开始。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Incident-Data Robustness Analysis of the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2026): How a Community-Expert Ranking Holds Up Against a Large-Scale LLM Incident Corpus
papers.abstract_en: The OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications ranks the risks that a community of security practitioners judges most important. We ask a narrower question: checked against the record of real incidents, does that expert ranking agree with the data? We assembled a large-scale corpus of LLM-security incidents (7,714 snapshotted and 6,639 labeled against the 20-entry taxonomy) drawn from CVE, GHSA, OSV, and AIAAIC, and derived an incident-based ranking with a Bayesian measurement-error model that corrects each category's count for classifier precision and recall. The 2026 candidate list blends the two signals at fixed weights, 0.75 on the expert vote and 0.25 on the data, so the corpus corrects the consensus without overturning it. The agreement between the two rankings is weak: Cohen's $κ\approx 0.20$, with a 90% interval that crosses zero. The expert ranking is nonetheless robust. A pre-registered bake-off of four frontier classifiers returns no winner. None beats the incidence floor's balanced accuracy of 0.863. A ground-truth check leaves the floor's ordering (Spearman $ρ= 0.918$ against held-out truth) in place. This is an exploratory analysis by two working-group members, not the official OWASP release, and it does not supersede the official list or process.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 19 figures. Exploratory incident-data analysis by two members of the OWASP GenAI Security Project Top 10 for LLM Applications working group. Analysis predates the official OWASP GenAI LLM Top 10 2026 (published August 2026). Not an official OWASP release and does not supersede the official list or process. Code and data: https://github.com/rocklambros/incident-rank-validation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文由 OWASP GenAI Security Project Top 10 for LLM Applications 工作组成员撰写，将 OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026 候选列表中的专家排名与大规模真实 LLM 安全事件语料进行对照。作者从 CVE、GHSA、OSV、AIAAIC 汇总事件，构建了 7,714 个快照、6,639 个按 20 类 taxonomy 标注的语料，用贝叶斯测量误差模型校正分类器精确率/召回率后导出事件排名，并以 0.75 专家投票、0.25 数据权重混合成候选列表。结果显示两个排名一致性弱（Cohen's κ≈0.20），但专家排名在多个前沿分类器的 bake-off 中依然稳健。
Motivation: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 依据安全从业者社群的判断对风险排序，但缺乏与真实事件记录的系统性对照。作者希望检验该专家共识排名是否与大规模 LLM 安全事件语料一致，并让数据在不推翻共识的前提下校正共识。
Method: 构建来自 CVE、GHSA、OSV、AIAAIC 的 LLM 安全事件语料，共 7,714 个快照、6,639 个按 20 类 taxonomy 标注的样本；使用贝叶斯测量误差模型对每类事件计数进行分类器精确率和召回率校正，得到基于事件的排名；以固定权重 0.75（专家投票）和 0.25（数据）混合成 2026 候选列表；并预注册了四个前沿分类器的 bake-off 与 ground-truth 检验。
Result: 专家排名与事件排名的一致性弱：Cohen's κ≈0.20，90% 区间跨越零。预注册的四个前沿分类器 bake-off 没有赢家，且没有一个超过发生率下限 (incidence floor) 的平衡准确率 0.863；ground-truth 检验维持发生率下限的排序，对保留真值的 Spearman ρ=0.918。
Conclusion: 作者认为专家排名虽然与事件数据一致性弱，但依然稳健；本文是两位工作组成员的探索性事件数据分析，早于官方 OWASP GenAI LLM Top 10 2026 发布，并非官方发布，不取代官方列表或流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Virtual Sensing to Enable Real-Time Monitoring of Inaccessible Locations & Unmeasurable Parameters
papers.abstract_en: Real-time monitoring of safety-critical interior states is an open problem across energy, environmental and industrial systems where direct instrumentation is infeasible. Approaches based on governing equations, discrete state vectors or fixed sensor locations cannot deliver mesh-independent, field-level reconstruction at arbitrary interior coordinates in real time. Here we introduce neural operator-based virtual sensing, a framework for recovering inaccessible interior fields from sparse boundary measurements, instantiated with MIMONet, a multi-input, multi-output neural operator that fuses heterogeneous inputs and decodes coupled fields through a shared latent representation. Across three engineering-grade evaluations of escalating complexity - confined recirculating flow, pressurized water reactor subchannels and compact power-system heat exchangers - MIMONet attains relative reconstruction error below 5% with sub-millisecond inference, with calibrated uncertainty and noise resilience. We validate the framework on three independent real-world datasets spanning electrochemical energy, atmospheric science and physical oceanography: current-density mapping in a hydrogen fuel cell, wind-speed profiling on meteorological towers, and North Atlantic ocean state from a global reanalysis. MIMONet improves on classical virtual-sensing baselines by 72-84%, including 84% for fuel-cell internal fields recovered from 10% sensor coverage and 83% for hub-height wind speed recovered from lower-level tower sensors. Most notably, it recovers sea-surface height, a field with no direct sensors, from its learned coupling to observed temperature and salinity at 4.1x lower error than the best classical predictor. These results establish operator-based virtual sensing as a practical route to real-time field observability in systems where the states that matter most cannot be measured directly.
papers.comment: New analysis and results are added
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于神经算子 (neural operator) 的虚拟传感框架，用于从稀疏边界测量实时重建不可达区域的内场，并实例化为多输入多输出神经算子 MIMONet。框架在受限回流、压水堆子通道和紧凑型电力系统换热器三类工程评估中达到低于 5% 的相对重建误差与亚毫秒级推理；在氢燃料电池电流密度、气象塔风速剖面和北大西洋海洋状态三个真实数据集上相对经典基线改进 72-84%，并可从温盐观测耦合重建无直接传感器的海面高度，误差较最佳经典预测器低 4.1 倍。
Motivation: 能源、环境和工业系统中许多安全关键的内部状态因无法直接布设仪器而难以实时监测，而基于控制方程、离散状态向量或固定传感器位置的方法无法在任意内部坐标上实现网格无关的、场级实时重建。
Method: 引入基于神经算子的虚拟传感框架，通过共享隐表示融合异构输入并解码耦合场；具体实例为 MIMONet，一个多输入多输出神经算子，从稀疏边界测量恢复不可达内场，并给出校准的不确定性与噪声鲁棒性。
Result: 在三个工程级评估（受限回流、压水堆子通道、紧凑式换热器）中相对重建误差低于 5%，推理时间亚毫秒；在氢燃料电池内场（10% 传感器覆盖）、轮毂高度风速（由低层塔传感器恢复）和北大西洋海洋状态等真实数据上，较经典虚拟传感基线改进 72-84%，其中海面高度恢复误差比最佳经典预测器低 4.1 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为算子式虚拟传感为那些最关键状态无法直接测量的系统提供了一条通往实时场观测性的实用路径，并强调其跨工程与地球物理领域的泛化能力。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: On the convergence of optimistic policy iteration for stochastic shortest path problem
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we prove some convergence results of a special case of optimistic policy iteration algorithm for stochastic shortest path problem. We consider both Monte Carlo and $TD(λ)$ methods for the policy evaluation step under the condition that the termination state will eventually be reached almost surely.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机最短路问题（stochastic shortest path problem）中乐观策略迭代（optimistic policy iteration）算法一个特例的收敛性。作者在终止状态几乎必然可达的条件下，分别针对策略评估步骤采用 Monte Carlo 和 TD(λ) 方法证明了收敛结果。
Motivation: 随机最短路问题中策略迭代算法的收敛性分析，特别是乐观策略迭代这类在策略评估尚未完全收敛时就提前更新策略的变体，需要严格的收敛保证。
Method: 针对乐观策略迭代的一个特例，在终止状态几乎必然可达的假设下，对策略评估步骤使用 Monte Carlo 与 TD(λ) 两种方法，并从理论上证明相应算法过程的收敛性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，核心成果是给出了该算法在所述条件下的收敛性证明。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些收敛结果适用于终止状态几乎必然可达的一类随机最短路问题，未提及其他范围的扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Demons on a Budget: Adaptive Measurement Placement at the Entanglement Phase Transition
papers.abstract_en: Monitored quantum circuits exhibit a measurement-induced phase transition between volume-law and area-law entanglement as a function of the measurement rate $p$. Prior work places measurements at random locations and treats the rate as the control parameter. We instead fix the measurement budget and vary the placement process, comparing random placement against hand-designed and learned policies in brickwork random Clifford circuits at matched budget. First, placement geometry matters more than placement information. A deterministic contiguous sweep cuts the half-cut entropy by a factor of 3.4 relative to random placement, while equal-coverage unstructured placement and a greedy policy with full state access do far worse. The effect is carried by spatial order alone: measuring the $k$ least recently measured sites gives $4.14 \pm 0.06$ bits with random tie-breaking and $1.29 \pm 0.04$ bits with position-ordered tie-breaking. Second, the sweep eliminates the transition rather than shifting it. Tripartite mutual information crossings recede as $p^* \propto 1/L$, the steady-state entropy saturates at an $L$-independent ceiling near $0.46/p$, and data for $64 \le L \le 512$ collapse onto the form $S = p^{-1} f(pL)$ predicted by a ballistic regrowth argument. Third, in stabilizer dynamics every outcome is deterministic or a fair coin flip, so the record's Shannon entropy is exactly countable; the sweep dominates the entropy-versus-record-cost frontier while paying the same roughly one bit per measurement as random placement. Policies trained by cross-entropy and proximal policy optimization do not find the sweep: score-based policies parameterize which sites to measure, not the order in which degenerate scores are resolved, and the effect lives in that order. The phase diagram of monitored dynamics is a property of the placement process, not only of the measurement rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在固定测量预算下研究受监测量子电路 (monitored quantum circuits) 中测量位置放置策略对纠缠相变的影响，对比随机放置、手设计策略、贪心策略与学习策略。作者发现确定性连续扫描 (contiguous sweep) 能将半割熵相对随机放置降低 3.4 倍，且消除而非移动相变；同时证明效果由空间顺序本身承载，而基于分数的学习策略因无法处理简并分数的打破顺序而失效。
Motivation: 以往工作把测量率 p 作为控制参数并在随机位置放置测量，忽略了固定测量预算下放置过程本身的影响。作者希望弄清纠缠相变的相图究竟由测量率还是由放置策略决定。
Method: 在匹配预算的砖墙随机 Clifford 电路 (brickwork random Clifford circuits) 中，固定测量预算并改变放置过程，比较随机放置、连续扫描、等覆盖非结构化放置、带完整态访问的贪心策略，以及基于交叉熵和 PPO 训练的策略；并用稳定子动力学中记录的 Shannon 熵精确计数和标度塌缩分析来刻画行为。
Result: 连续扫描将半割熵相对随机放置降低 3.4 倍；测量最近最少被测量的 k 个位置时，随机打破平局给出 4.14±0.06 bits，而按位置排序打破平局给出 1.29±0.04 bits。扫描使三重互信息交叉点以 p* ∝ 1/L 退缩，稳态熵饱和于与 L 无关的上限约 0.46/p，且 64≤L≤512 的数据塌缩到 S = p^{-1} f(pL) 形式；扫描在与随机放置支付相同约每位测量 1 bit 代价时主导熵-记录成本前沿。
Conclusion: 作者认为受监测动力学的相图是放置过程的性质，而不仅是测量率的性质；交叉熵和 PPO 训练的策略未能找到扫描策略，因为效应存在于简并分数如何被顺序消解中，而基于分数的策略只参数化了测量哪些位置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spiking Local Interaction and Adaptive Complementary Fusion for Spiking Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Transformers model token interactions primarily through spiking self-attention (SSA). However, binary query and key representations map continuous similarities to sparse and discrete relation responses, which may suppress weak relations and limit the propagation of local spatial context. To address this limitation, we introduce Spiking Local Interaction (SLI) and Adaptive Complementary Fusion (ACF). SLI establishes an attention-independent pathway for direct information exchange among neighboring spiking tokens using lightweight depthwise--pointwise transformations. ACF integrates SSA and SLI through layer-specific, channel-wise coefficients that adaptively balance their contributions at different network depths. The proposed design preserves the original attention formulation and can be incorporated into different Spiking Transformer architectures with modest parameter overhead. Experiments on ImageNet-1K, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, CIFAR10-DVS, and ADE20K show consistent improvements across image classification, event-based recognition, and semantic segmentation. In particular, QKFormer with SLI and ACF achieves $84.37\%$ Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K and $37.5\%$ mIoU on ADE20K, where the segmentation model is trained without ImageNet pretraining. Ablation studies and qualitative analyses further indicate that SSA and SLI capture complementary interaction patterns and that learnable fusion consistently outperforms fixed weighting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Spiking Transformer 中脉冲自注意力 (SSA) 的二进制 query/key 将连续相似度映射为稀疏离散关系、可能抑制弱关系并限制局部空间上下文传播的问题，提出 Spiking Local Interaction (SLI) 与 Adaptive Complementary Fusion (ACF)。SLI 用轻量级 depthwise-pointwise 变换建立注意力无关的邻近 token 直接交互路径，ACF 通过逐层逐通道系数自适应融合 SSA 与 SLI。在 ImageNet-1K、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、CIFAR10-DVS 和 ADE20K 上均取得一致改进，QKFormer 结合 SLI 与 ACF 达到 ImageNet-1K 84.37% Top-1 和 ADE20K 37.5% mIoU。
Motivation: 现有 Spiking Transformer 主要通过脉冲自注意力建模 token 交互，但二进制 query 和 key 表示会把连续相似度映射为稀疏离散的关系响应，可能抑制弱关系并限制局部空间上下文的传播。
Method: 提出 SLI，利用轻量级 depthwise-pointwise 变换在相邻脉冲 token 之间建立不依赖注意力的直接信息交换通道；提出 ACF，通过逐层、逐通道的可学习系数在神经网络不同深度自适应平衡 SSA 与 SLI 的贡献。设计保留原始注意力公式，可嵌入不同 Spiking Transformer 架构且仅引入适度参数开销。
Result: 在图像分类、事件相机识别和语义分割任务上均显示一致性改进；QKFormer 加 SLI 与 ACF 在 ImageNet-1K 取得 84.37% Top-1 准确率，在无 ImageNet 预训练的 ADE20K 上取得 37.5% mIoU。消融与定性分析表明 SSA 与 SLI 捕获互补的交互模式，且可学习融合持续优于固定权重。
Conclusion: 作者强调该设计既能保留原始注意力形式，又能以较小参数开销融入不同 Spiking Transformer 架构；局部交互路径与注意力路径互补，自适应可学习融合比固定权重更有效。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance
papers.abstract_en: Decision-making in complex systems often involves dealing with imprecise or uncertain information, frequently represented using fuzzy sets, particularly Triangular Fuzzy Numbers (TFNs). A crucial aspect of many fuzzy methods is the quantification of distance between TFNs. Many distance measures assume that all values are in the same scale, requiring a preliminary normalization stage when applied to heterogeneous attributes with different scales or units. This paper proposes the Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance (d_{TR}), a metric designed to address this challenge. The d_{TR} uniquely integrates Linear Rescaling (LRE) directly into the distance calculation, ensuring normalization during the comparison of fuzzy numbers. We formally prove that d_{TR} satisfies the properties of a metric, including non-negativity, identity, symmetry, and the triangle inequality. Furthermore, we demonstrate that d_{TR} is bounded, scale-invariant, and origin-invariant. These properties, combined with a weighting vector for prioritizing dimensions, make d_{TR} suitable for applications involving heterogeneous fuzzy data, such as the construction of synthetic indicators, distance-based machine learning algorithms or multicriteria-decision aiding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的三角模糊数距离度量 d_{TR}，将线性重缩放 (Linear Rescaling, LRE) 直接整合进距离计算中，从而在比较模糊数时自动完成归一化。作者形式化证明 d_{TR} 满足度量性质（非负性、同一性、对称性、三角不等式），并说明其有界、尺度不变和原点不变，适合处理异构模糊数据。
Motivation: 许多模糊数距离度量假设所有值在同一尺度上，当处理具有不同尺度或单位的异构属性时需要单独的归一化预处理步骤，这限制了距离度量在真实复杂决策系统中的直接应用。
Method: 提出 Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance (d_{TR})，将线性重缩放 (LRE) 融入三角模糊数 (TFN) 之间的距离计算过程，并引入权重向量以对不同维度进行优先级排序。
Result: 形式化证明 d_{TR} 满足度量公理（非负性、同一性、对称性、三角不等式），并具有有界性、尺度不变性和原点不变性。
Conclusion: d_{TR} 可作为异构模糊数据场景下的距离度量，适用于合成指标构建、基于距离的机器学习算法和多准则决策辅助。

papers.title: Active Spiking Perception: The Membrane Potential as a Belief State for Anytime 3D Point Cloud Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Spiking point cloud networks usually scan space in a fixed, input-agnostic order, which leaves the most distinctive resource of spiking computation, the temporal evolution of the membrane potential, unused as a locus of decision-making. Active Spiking Perception (ASP) recasts 3D recognition as an iterative decision process in which the network's own leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) membrane potential, read as a running belief over the class, selects the next chunk to observe and triggers confidence-margin early exit. A lightweight Slice-Selection Policy scores unvisited farthest-point-sampled chunks from the membrane state and precomputed geometric descriptors, trains end-to-end through a straight-through Gumbel-Softmax, reduces to an argmax at inference, and adds about 2% of backbone parameters. We prove that leaky integration is the recursive log-posterior update of a Bayesian filter, that the exit rule attains distribution-free selective risk with no multiple-testing penalty at the stopping time, and that streaming state carry-forward is exactly equivalent to prefix recomputation with bounded finite-precision drift. ASP reaches 90.62% and 93.28% on ModelNet40 and ModelNet10, 1.7 points below the strongest spiking baseline at a larger backbone, while adding a certified anytime interface no baseline offers. The mechanism transfers unchanged to dense prediction, giving 83.21 instance mIoU on ShapeNetPart and 48.50 mIoU on S3DIS Area 5, to our knowledge the first spiking results on S3DIS Area 5, and, fixation replacing chunk selection, to a foveated non-spiking transformer, so the policy is not tied to spiking backbones: cost is exactly linear in observations and the threshold is a measured compute dial spanning 2.8x to 1.35x less energy. One limitation is concrete: one S3DIS class is unidentifiable at the crop size we use, and we give the prediction that would fix it.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables. Supplementary material included as appendices A-J
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Active Spiking Perception (ASP)，将 3D 点云识别重构为迭代决策过程：用网络自身 leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) 膜电位作为类别的运行信念 (belief)，据此选择下一个待观察的切块并触发基于置信度边际的提前退出。作者给出了膜电位漏积分等价于贝叶斯滤波器递归 log-posterior 更新、提前退出在停止时刻无多重检验惩罚的分布无关选择性风险，以及流式状态前向传播与前缀重计算等价等理论保证。实验显示 ASP 在 ModelNet40/ModelNet10 上达到 90.62%/93.28%，比最强脉冲基线低 1.7 点但提供了可认证的 anytime 接口，并首次报告 S3DIS Area 5 上的脉冲识别结果。
Motivation: 现有脉冲点云网络通常以固定的、与输入无关的顺序扫描空间，使得脉冲计算最具特色的资源——膜电位的时序演化——未被用作决策场所，造成计算浪费并缺乏随时可中断的识别能力。
Method: ASP 将识别看作迭代决策过程：轻量 Slice-Selection Policy 依据膜状态和预计算的几何描述符，对未访问的最远点采样 (farthest-point sampling) 切块打分，通过 straight-through Gumbel-Softmax 端到端训练，推理时退化为 argmax，只增加约 2% 的骨干参数；同时用置信度边际规则实现提前退出。
Result: 摘要报告 ASP 在 ModelNet40 和 ModelNet10 上分别达到 90.62% 和 93.28%，比使用更大骨干的最强脉冲基线低 1.7 点；在 ShapeNetPart 上达到 83.21 实例 mIoU，在 S3DIS Area 5 上达到 48.50 mIoU（据作者称是首个脉冲结果）；能耗在测量计算旋钮下可降低 2.8x 到 1.35x。
Conclusion: 作者强调该策略可无修改迁移到稠密预测，也可将切块选择替换为注视点选择后应用于非脉冲的中央凹 Transformer，说明策略并不局限于脉冲骨干；代价随观测次数线性增长，阈值充当可调的计算旋钮。局限性是一个 S3DIS 类别在当前 crop 尺寸下无法识别，作者给出了修复该问题的预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TorchDCM: A Unified PyTorch-Native Package for Discrete Choice Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Estimating large and simulation-intensive discrete choice models (DCMs) requires repeated evaluation of utilities, probabilities, derivatives, and simulated likelihoods over many observations, alternatives, and draws. Existing DCM software provides mature econometric workflows, while recent GPU-oriented tools accelerate selected models, leaving a gap between econometric coverage and scalable differentiable computation. We introduce TorchDCM, an open Python package for discrete choice modeling that compiles choice data and model specifications into a unified PyTorch-native likelihood engine for estimation, inference, prediction, and structured reporting on CPU or CUDA devices. The package covers the principal econometric functionality available across Biogeme and Apollo, including multinomial, nested, mixed, ordered, latent-variable, and panel likelihoods. It also supports ragged choice sets, constrained parameters, covariance estimation, willingness-to-pay analysis, elasticities, and extensible likelihood components. We evaluate TorchDCM against seven other estimation packages in aligned synthetic and real-data full-estimation experiments. TorchDCM completes all 45 synthetic cases, runs fastest in every comparable synthetic case, and satisfies the prespecified final-log-likelihood tolerance in every comparison with at least two comparable solutions. More precisely, it reduces median runtime by 89.1%-99.7% relative to Biogeme and Apollo across model-data settings. CUDA provides an additional 12.0-71.0x speedup over single-core TorchDCM. These results establish a scalable and reproducible foundation for econometric estimation and differentiable choice-model development. The open-source package and executed examples are available at https://github.com/mbc96325/torchdcm.

Method: 提出 TorchDCM，将选择数据与模型规格编译进统一的 PyTorch 原生似然引擎，用于 CPU 或 CUDA 设备上的估计、推断、预测与结构化报告，并支持多种似然类型、不规则选择集、约束参数及扩展组件。

Conclusion: 该工作为计量估计与可微选择模型开发建立了可扩展且可复现的基础；摘要强调其开源包与可执行示例已公开。

papers.title: When AI Writes, Who Gets Cited? Evidence of Citation Monoculture Across Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As language models move from drafting prose to running literature-search agents with tool calls, fabricated references are becoming easier to catch and constrain. The harder failure begins after every candidate is real: different models may still select the same narrow subset, producing citation monoculture without any single citation being wrong. We isolate this effect on 120 real papers. Eleven models from three vendors choose at most ten papers from uniformly random panels of thirty, with real titles and abstracts but fabricated authors, reassigned years, and hidden venues and citation counts. Each run is compared with indifferent selection on the same panel and realized budget. All eleven models concentrate sharply: the top decile receives 23.3-30.2% of citations against 15.6% under the null, one component explains 68-73% of variation across their preference maps, and cross-vendor agreement nearly matches within-vendor agreement. Formalizing the task as fixed-budget subset selection, we turn these patterns into identifiable mechanisms: an exchangeability bound rejects a mapless selector for every model, a spectral decomposition explains why the best cross-fitted mixture still retains 55% of the excess, and a rarity theorem predicts the recursive competition effect we verify within panels. Controlled paraphrase, content-slot crossover, and design resampling attribute about 90% of GPT-5 mini's map variance to paper content. Eight domain experts selecting from the same blinded panels under the same cap show no comparable shared preference, while model concentration persists in selection-only mode. Even when every reference is real and every paper is equally visible, current language models impose a common content-level filter on scientific attention. Equalizing retrieval or mixing vendors is therefore insufficient; the shared preference map itself must be changed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在文献检索中的引用单一文化（citation monoculture）现象：当所有候选论文都真实存在时，不同模型仍会集中选择同一狭小子集，导致没有单个错误引用却整体丧失引用多样性。作者在120篇真实论文、11个来自三家供应商的模型上验证该效应，并借助固定预算子集选择（fixed-budget subset selection）的形式化框架解释其机制。
Motivation: 语言模型从起草文本转向带工具调用的文献搜索代理后，伪造引用变得容易被识别；更隐蔽的失败是模型对真实论文形成共同的狭窄偏好，产生引用单一文化。这种共享偏好可能扭曲科学注意力分配，且仅靠均衡检索或混合供应商无法修复。
Method: 构造120篇真实论文，让11个模型在随机30篇面板中选择至多10篇，面板保留真实标题与摘要但改写作者、年份、隐藏venue与引用数；用同样预算下的无偏好选择作为对照。作者将任务形式化为固定预算子集选择，并用交换性界（exchangeability bound）、谱分解、稀有性定理以及受控改写、内容插槽交叉和设计重采样等分析来分离机制。
Result: 所有11个模型的选择高度集中：前十分位获得23.3-30.2%的引用，而零假设下为15.6%；一个主成分解释模型偏好映射中68-73%的变异，跨供应商一致性接近供应商内一致性。交换性界在统计上拒绝无映射选择器，最优交叉拟合混合仍保留55%的超额集中；约90%的GPT-5 mini映射方差可归因于论文内容。八位领域专家在相同盲面板下未表现出类似共享偏好。
Conclusion: 即使每个引用都真实且每篇论文同等可见，当前语言模型仍会施加共同的内容级过滤器，压缩科学注意力。作者据此强调，均衡检索或混合供应商并不足够，需要改变共享偏好映射本身；但该结论主要基于特定模型面板和合成化论文元数据场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: M3: A State-Event Generative Foundation Model for Market Microstructure Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Market microstructure simulation aims to model how liquidity, prices, and order flow evolve in electronic financial markets. Since market data reveal only one realized trajectory, many important questions are inherently counterfactual and require realistic trajectory-level simulation. Existing financial generative models, however, often model order events and market states, such as the LOB, in isolation, overlooking the dynamic interaction between order flow and liquidity in market microstructure. We propose the \textbf{M3} (\underline{M}arket \underline{M}icrostructure \underline{M}odel), a state-event generative foundation model for market microstructure dynamics. \textbf{M3} learns to generate future order-flow trajectories, while accounting for the evolving interaction between order events and limit-order-book liquidity. Trained on large-scale order-level real stock market data, \textbf{M3} exhibits predictable scaling behavior, reproduces key market stylized facts, and enables practical simulation-based applications including forecasting, stress testing, and market-impact analysis. These results suggest a scalable foundation-model paradigm for counterfactual market simulation at the microstructure level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 M3（Market Microstructure Model），一个面向市场微观结构动态的状态-事件生成式基础模型。它学习生成未来的订单流轨迹，同时刻画订单事件与限价订单簿（LOB）流动性之间的动态交互。基于大规模逐笔真实股票数据训练，M3 表现出可预测的规模行为，再现关键市场程式化事实，并支持预测、压力测试和市场冲击分析等模拟应用。
Motivation: 市场数据只展示一条已实现的轨迹，许多反事实问题需要轨迹级的真实模拟；而现有金融生成模型往往孤立地建模订单事件与市场状态（如 LOB），忽略了订单流与流动性之间的动态交互。
Method: M3 作为状态-事件生成式基础模型，在生成未来订单流轨迹时显式建模订单事件与限价订单簿流动性之间的演化交互，并利用大规模逐笔真实股票市场数据进行训练。
Result: 摘要报告 M3 展现出可预测的缩放行为，能够再现关键市场程式化事实，并支持预测、压力测试与市场冲击分析等基于模拟的实际应用。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为微观结构层面的反事实市场模拟提供了一种可扩展的基础模型范式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Causal Inference under Interference with Learned Exposure Mappings
papers.abstract_en: Exposure mappings are often assumed to be known in causal spillover analyses. In environmental settings, however, they are typically induced by transport processes that are not directly observed and must instead be learned from pollution data. We study how uncertainty in learned transport processes propagates into exposure mappings and downstream spillover inference under interference. We compare mechanistic transport models with modern operator-learning approaches, including PDE, PINO, FNO, and GeoPT, using both simulation studies and an empirical analysis of California PM$_{2.5}$ data. In simulations, all four transport models achieved nearly identical pollution prediction accuracy, yet estimated spillover effects ranged from 1.78 to 2.27. Models that more accurately recovered the induced exposure mapping also produced spillover estimates closer to the true effect. Disagreement was modest for regional interventions but substantially larger for localized point-source interventions. The California analysis showed the same pattern: competing transport models produced similar predictions of observed PM${2.5}$ concentrations while implying different spillover effects under hypothetical pollution-control interventions. Our findings suggest that predictive agreement alone is insufficient for reliable causal inference when exposure mappings are learned rather than directly observed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究干扰 (interference) 环境下，暴露映射 (exposure mapping) 由未观测传输过程诱导、需从污染数据学习时，其不确定性如何传播到下游 spillover 因果推断。作者通过模拟研究与加州 PM2.5 实证分析，比较了机理传输模型与 PDE、PINO、FNO、GeoPT 等算子学习方法。结果显示各模型污染预测精度几乎一致，但估计的 spillover 效应差异明显，提示仅凭预测一致性不足以支撑可靠因果推断。
Motivation: 许多因果溢出分析假设暴露映射已知，但环境场景中暴露映射由未直接观测的传输过程决定，必须从污染数据中学习，这带来的不确定性此前未被系统刻画。
Method: 将机理传输模型与现代算子学习方法（PDE、PINO、FNO、GeoPT）进行对比，在模拟与加州 PM2.5 数据上检验传输模型不确定性如何传播到暴露映射与 spillover 效应估计，并比较区域与点源干预两种情形。
Result: 模拟中四种传输模型的污染预测精度几乎相同，但估计的 spillover 效应范围为 1.78 至 2.27；更准确恢复暴露映射的模型给出的 spillover 估计更接近真实效应。区域干预下模型间分歧较小，而局部点源干预下分歧显著增大，加州实证分析呈现相同模式。
Conclusion: 当暴露映射是学习而来而非直接观测时，预测误差的相似性不足以保证因果推断可靠性；模型对暴露映射的恢复能力才是 spillover 估计准确性的关键。
Relevance: 42

papers.title: Interaction valence reveals contrasting social networks in dairy cattle
papers.abstract_en: Social relationships shape access to resources, exposure to conflict and group stability, yet automated livestock monitoring typically treats behaviour as isolated events. Here, we present a valence-aware social-network framework that transforms video-derived interactions into herd-level representations of affiliative and agonistic organization. A pose-based computer-vision pipeline analysed 7 h 39 min of continuous video from the pre-milking area of one commercial dairy farm. After quality control, 1,183 of 1,414 candidate interactions remained, involving 36 cows and 177 dyads. In a predicted-class-balanced audit of 198 pipeline-detected clips, automated and manual labels agreed in 82.8% of cases, with an unweighted audit-sample macro-F1 of 0.872. These values describe the audited sample rather than prevalence-weighted or end-to-end deployment performance. The aggregated network was connected (density = 0.281; transitivity = 0.513; mean path length = 1.88), and predicted affiliative events formed five algorithmic communities (modularity Q = 0.429). Within the observed zone, predicted agonistic interactions comprised 72.4% of retained events and 76.0% of interaction duration. The cow with the most partners did not have the highest betweenness centrality. Separating events by predicted valence produced descriptively different affiliative and agonistic layers, with contrasting edge sets, community partitions and individual positions. Thus, pooled interaction counts can obscure the behavioural composition of an observed network. Valence-aware analysis provides a framework for testing hypotheses about competition, affiliation and welfare-relevant change, while requiring longitudinal validation before use as a welfare or health indicator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种感知互动效价 (valence-aware) 的社交网络框架，将牛舍视频中的奶牛互动区分为亲和 (affiliative) 与对抗 (agonistic) 两类，并构建群体层面的网络结构。基于姿态的计算机视觉管线分析了商业奶牛场挤奶前区域共 7 小时 39 分钟的视频，质控后保留 1,183 个候选互动，涉及 36 头奶牛和 177 对个体。结果显示按预测效价分离事件会得到描述性不同的亲和层与对抗层，提示汇总互动计数可能掩盖网络的行为构成。
Motivation: 现有自动化牲畜监测通常把行为当作孤立事件，忽视了互动在资源获取、冲突暴露和群体稳定性方面的作用，也缺少对亲和与对抗关系的区分，因此难以从视频数据中构建有行为意义的牛群社交网络。
Method: 采用基于姿态的计算机视觉流程对连续视频进行互动检测，并用预测类平衡审计 (predicted-class-balanced audit) 对比自动标注与人工标注；随后构建聚集网络 (aggregated network)，计算密度、传递性、平均路径长度和模块度，并基于检测出的互动效价分离出亲和层与对抗层。
Result: 在被审计的 198 个视频片段中，自动与人工标签一致率为 82.8%，审计样本未加权 macro-F1 为 0.872。聚集网络连通，密度 0.281，传递性 0.513，平均路径长度 1.88；预测亲和事件形成 5 个算法社群，模块度 Q=0.429。预测对抗互动占保留事件的 72.4%、占总互动时长的 76.0%；拥有最多互动伙伴的奶牛并非介数中心性最高者。

papers.title: Can Conversational AI loosen Us-Versus-Them Boundaries? The Effects of Common, Dual, and Separate Identity Framings on Pro-Immigrant Intergroup Helping
papers.abstract_en: Rising immigration has intensified intergroup tensions in many countries. Traditional bias-reduction programs remain difficult to scale and increasingly constrained by U.S. policy. This preregistered experiment tested whether conversational AI can shift how majority-group members categorize and relate to Latine immigrants. Drawing on the common ingroup identity model, a quota-representative national sample of 658 non-Latine White U.S. adults completed five rounds of dialogue with a LLM (GPT-4o). The model was instructed to frame Latine immigrants in terms of a common ingroup identity (a shared American identity), a dual identity (both Latine and American), or a separate identity (distinct cultural boundaries), or to discuss an unrelated topic in a control condition. The manipulations altered categorization: relative to control, common ingroup identity and dual identity conversations lowered separate categorization, and dual identity conversations raised dual categorization. Although direct effects on behavior and pro-diversity beliefs were nonsignificant, willingness to act was significantly higher in the conditions emphasizing a superordinate identity (common ingroup and dual identity). A path model further revealed indirect associations: both conditions reduced separate categorization, which in turn correlated with greater willingness to act. Semantic similarity analyses of the transcripts confirmed that conversations tracked their assigned narratives; participants' convergence with shared-identity language related positively, and with separate-identity language negatively, to willingness to act. These effects were largely consistent across moderators (need for closure, openness to experience, and political orientation). The findings show that brief AI conversations can loosen us-versus-them boundaries while underscoring the gap between cognitive recategorization and behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过预注册实验检验对话式 AI 能否改变多数群体对 Latine 移民的群体分类。658 名非 Latine 白人美国成年人与 GPT-4o 进行五轮对话，AI 分别采用共同内群体身份、双重身份、分离身份或无关话题框架。结果发现共同与双重身份对话降低分离分类，双重身份提高双重分类，且强调上位身份的条件显著提高行动意愿；路径分析显示分离分类的降低中介了行动意愿的提升。
Motivation: 移民增加加剧群体间紧张，传统减少偏见项目难以规模化且受美国政策限制。作者探索对话式 AI 是否能在大规模人群中松动“我们 vs 他们”的边界，并基于共同内群体身份模型设计干预。
Method: 预注册实验，配额代表性的 658 名非 Latine 白人美国成年人完成五轮与 LLM（GPT-4o）的对话；模型被指示采用共同内群体身份、双重身份、分离身份框架，或讨论无关话题作为控制条件。随后测量分类、行为倾向、亲多样性信念，并对对话文本做语义相似性分析。
Result: 相对于控制组，共同内群体身份和双重身份对话降低分离分类，双重身份对话提高双重分类；对行为和亲多样性信念的直接效应不显著，但强调上位身份（共同与双重）的条件显著提高行动意愿。路径分析显示两种条件通过降低分离分类间接提高行动意愿。语义分析表明对话确实遵循指定叙事，参与者与共享身份语言的收敛程度与行动意愿正相关，与分离身份语言负相关。调节变量（认知闭合需求、经验开放性、政治取向）下效应基本一致。
Conclusion: 简短 AI 对话能够松动我们-他们边界，但结果凸显认知重新分类与行为之间的差距——直接行为效应不显著。发现提示对话式 AI 可作为规模化群体关系干预手段，但改变行为仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: Time-Series Retrieval for Grounding Multimodal Language Models in Remaining Useful Life
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI systems are increasingly being explored for domain-specific maintenance and prognostics tasks, raising the question of whether they can effectively support prognostics and health management (PHM). In this paper, we investigate remaining useful life (RUL) estimation with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) grounded through time-series retrieval. We propose a framework in which historically similar degradation segments are retrieved from the training set and, together with the test trajectory, transformed into a visual comparison artifact that is processed by the MLLM through a structured multimodal prompt. The approach is evaluated on the FD001 partition of the C-MAPSS benchmark under repeated experiments comparing retrieval-based inference against a non-retrieval baseline based on random reference selection. The results show that time-series retrieval consistently improves MLLM-based RUL prediction across the evaluated models, yielding lower error and more stable performance. At the same time, the magnitude of the benefit depends on model capacity, indicating that retrieval is most effective when the underlying MLLM is able to exploit the retrieved evidence. Overall, the study shows that time-series RAG is a promising mechanism for improving multimodal prognostic reasoning, while also highlighting the current limitations of MLLM-based RUL estimation in practical PHM settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通过时间序列检索（time-series retrieval）将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）用于剩余使用寿命（RUL）估计的框架。方法从训练集中检索历史相似退化片段，与测试轨迹一起转换为视觉对比图，并通过结构化多模态提示交给MLLM处理。在C-MAPSS FD001分区上的重复实验显示，检索式推理相比随机参考选择的非检索基线，一致地降低误差并提高稳定性，但收益大小取决于模型容量。
Motivation: 大语言模型和智能体系统正被探索用于领域特定的维护与预测任务，但能否有效支持预测与健康管理（PHM）仍不明确；该文关注MLLM在RUL估计中如何利用检索到的历史证据来提升预测能力。
Method: 提出一个检索增强框架：从训练集中检索与测试轨迹历史相似的退化片段，将其与测试轨迹共同转换为视觉对比图，再通过结构化多模态提示输入MLLM进行RUL推理。评估在C-MAPSS FD001分区上进行，对照基线为非检索的随机参考选择。
Result: 摘要报告检索式推理在多个MLLM上一致优于非检索基线，得到更低的误差和更稳定的性能；同时收益幅度依赖模型容量，表明只有足够强的MLLM才能有效利用检索证据。
Conclusion: 时间序列RAG是改善多模态预测推理的有前景机制，但该研究也凸显了MLLM在实用PHM场景下进行RUL估计的当前局限性。

papers.title: Bounded Sovereignty and the Control Tax: Pricing AI Oversight When the Deployer Does Not Own the Model
papers.abstract_en: AI control research asks how to deploy models safely even when they may be misaligned, but many control protocols assume that the deployer can instrument the model and its surrounding pipeline. That assumption often fails for regulated organisations using frontier models through APIs or managed endpoints, where the deployer may control the business process but not the model weights, serving infrastructure, internal traces, update process, or full interaction logs. This paper introduces bounded sovereignty: partial technical and contractual access across the data, model, infrastructure, and interaction layers of the AI stack. It argues that these access conditions determine which control protocols can be executed in practice. The paper contributes a four-layer access typology, a protocol-by-layer requirements matrix, and the concept of sovereignty discount cost: the part of the control tax spent substituting for missing access through contracts, architecture, audit, vendor assurance, residual risk, or reduced system scope. It also reports a synthetic access-ablation experiment over 1.35 million synthetic case simulations and interprets the findings through an anonymised national-payments-infrastructure scenario. The experiment is not real-world payment-system evidence; it is a construct-validity exercise. The results show that complete logs improve diagnosis, a pre-execution gateway enables intervention, trace access and model-version control strengthen post-incident explanation, and scope restriction can improve safety while reducing usefulness. Control protocols proposed as general safety solutions should therefore state their access assumptions explicitly.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 5 figures. Synthetic access-ablation study; not real-world payment-system evidence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 控制研究中常见的隐含假设——部署者能够完全检测模型及其周边管线——指出该假设在通过 API 或管理端点使用前沿模型的受监管组织中往往不成立。作者提出 bounded sovereignty（有限主权）概念，刻画部署者对数据、模型、基础设施和交互层的部分技术及合同访问权限，并论证这些访问条件决定哪些控制协议可实际执行。文章贡献了四层访问类型学、协议逐层需求矩阵以及 sovereignty discount cost（主权折扣成本）概念，并报告了一个基于 135 万合成案例的访问消融实验，但作者明确说明该实验不是真实支付系统证据，而是构造效度练习。
Motivation: 现有 AI 控制协议常假定部署者可对模型和管线进行充分检测，但使用前沿模型 API 或受管端点的部署者可能无法访问模型权重、服务基础设施、内部追踪、更新过程或完整交互日志，这使许多控制协议在实践中无法执行。
Method: 引入 bounded sovereignty 概念，将 AI 栈划分为数据、模型、基础设施和交互四个层次，并给出四层访问类型学与协议逐层需求矩阵；定义 sovereignty discount cost，即控制税中用于通过合同、架构、审计、供应商保证、残余风险或缩小系统范围来替代缺失访问的部分。作者还进行了一个合成访问消融实验，使用 135 万次模拟案例并通过匿名国家支付基础设施场景进行解释。
Result: 合成实验结果显示：完整日志可改善诊断，预执行网关能够支持干预，痕迹访问与模型版本控制增强事后解释，而范围限制可以在提高安全性的同时降低有用性。作者强调这些结果来自构造效度练习，而非真实世界支付系统证据。
Conclusion: 控制协议如果被当作通用安全方案提出，应当明确声明其访问假设；否则在部署者不拥有模型的实际场景中可能无法按预期执行。

papers.title: How to Navigate Uncertainty About AI Consciousness
papers.abstract_en: Given deep uncertainty about the possibility of artificial consciousness, it is unclear how we should treat potentially sentient AI. On the one hand, we could assume insentience but risk doing terrible harms to entities that deserve moral standing. On the other hand, we could assume sentience and instead risk wasting resources on insentient machines. The intractability of questions around AI consciousness mean that this dilemma is hard to escape. I suggest a way out of that shifts from intractable questions of AI consciousness to tractable questions of AI valence. Specifically, we can assess whether an AI has states that would constitute valenced experiences if it were conscious. I show how this is sufficient to ground a responsible approach to the development of potentially conscious AI.
papers.comment: 8 Pages, Proceedings of AISB 2026 Symposium on AI, Consciousness and Ethics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论在人工意识可能性存在深度不确定性的情况下，应如何对待可能具有感受性的 AI。作者提出把棘手的 AI 意识问题转化为可处理的 AI 效价（valence）问题，即评估 AI 是否拥有如果它是有意识的就会构成效价体验的状态，并论证这足以支撑对潜在有意识 AI 的负责任开发。
Motivation: 关于人工意识的可能性存在深度不确定性，既不能贸然假定无感受性而可能对具有道德地位的实体造成严重伤害，也不能轻易假定有感受性而把资源浪费在无感受的机器上；意识问题的不可判定性使这一两难难以回避。
Method: 提出一种思路转变：从不可判定的 AI 意识问题转向可判定的 AI 效价问题，具体方法是评估 AI 是否具有那些若其有意识便会构成效价体验的状态。
Result: 摘要未报告实证实验，属于概念性论证；作者声称该评估足以支撑对潜在有意识 AI 的负责任开发方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过聚焦可判定的效价问题而非不可判定的意识问题，可以为发展潜在有意识 AI 提供负责任的实践基础。

papers.title: Robust Metaheuristics under Uncertainty for Berth Allocation and Quay Crane Assignment: A Review
papers.abstract_en: The berth allocation and quay crane assignment problem (BACAP) is a representative port-terminal scheduling problem in maritime transportation and freight logistics, where vessel arrivals, berth positions, service durations, and quay?crane availability are tightly coupled. Under uncertainties such as arrival deviations, handling-time fluctuations, and resource disruptions, schedules optimized under nominal assumptions may become fragile during execution, motivating the study of robust metaheuristic optimization for BACAP in port-terminal operations. Although population-based metaheuristics have been widely used for BACAP and related port-scheduling problems, existing studies remain fragmented in their uncertainty repre?sentations, robustness criteria, search mechanisms, and empir?ical evaluation protocols. To the best of our knowledge, this paper provides the first focused review dedicated to robust population-based metaheuristics for BACAP under uncertainty. We first summarize uncertainty sources and information repre?sentations in BACAP, and then organize existing methods from a mechanism-oriented perspective, covering solution representation and decoding, robust evaluation and selection, robustness-guided search dynamics, and feasibility preservation and recovery. We further present a benchmark suite for uncertain BACAP to support controlled empirical comparison and report illustrative baseline results by combining representative metaheuristics with different robustness strategies. Finally, we identify open chal?lenges related to benchmark extension, robustness-aware search design, time-adaptive robustness, and non-stationary uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是首个专门针对不确定性下鲁棒种群元启发式算法求解泊位分配与岸桥指派问题（BACAP）的综述。作者从机制视角归纳现有方法，涵盖解表示与解码、鲁棒评估与选择、鲁棒性引导的搜索动态以及可行性保持与恢复，并提出一个不确定 BACAP 基准套件及代表性组合的说明性基线结果。最后指出基准扩展、鲁棒感知搜索设计、时间自适应鲁棒性和非平稳不确定性等开放挑战。
Motivation: 在到达偏差、作业时间波动和资源中断等不确定性下，基于名义假设优化的调度方案在执行中可能变得脆弱；同时现有研究在不确定性表示、鲁棒性准则、搜索机制和实验协议上较为碎片化，缺乏系统综述。
Method: 作为综述，先总结 BACAP 中的不确定性来源与信息表示，再从机制导向视角组织已有鲁棒种群元启发式方法，并构建不确定 BACAP 基准套件，将代表性元启发式与不同鲁棒策略组合进行说明性对照实验。
Result: 摘要报告提供了可用于受控经验比较的基准套件，并给出代表性元启发式搭配不同鲁棒策略的说明性基线结果，同时识别出多类开放挑战。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是首个聚焦不确定性下鲁棒种群元启发式求解 BACAP 的综述，并指出未来方向包括基准扩展、鲁棒感知搜索设计、时间自适应鲁棒性以及非平稳不确定性。

papers.title: NepOOC-M: Bilingual Nepali-English Benchmark and Comparative Analysis of Multimodal Architectures for OOC Detection
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-context (OOC) misinformation pairs authentic images with misleading captions to construct false narratives without image manipulation, making detection a problem of multimodal alignment rather than image forensics. Despite the prevalence and consequences of OOC misinformation in Nepal, no public benchmark exists for Nepali. We introduce NepOOC, the first publicly available Nepali-dominant multilingual OOC benchmark, comprising 1,090 image-caption pairs (545 pristine, 545 OOC) annotated across five typologies (fabricated, miscaptioned, temporal mismatch, geographic mismatch, identity mismatch) with inter-annotator agreement kappa = 0.84. Systematic evaluation of five multimodal architectures alongside text-only and image-only baselines reveals that caption semantics appear sufficient for strong performance at the current dataset scale. A text-only mBERT model achieves 94.65+/-0.20% Macro-F1, statistically equivalent to the best multimodal system (ResNet-50+mBERT, 94.65+/-0.20%; McNemar median p = 1.000, 0/5 seeds significant at alpha = 0.05). Image-only models perform near chance (33-50%), while training-size scaling suggests that dataset expansion is a more direct path to progress than architectural sophistication or regional specialisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对尼泊尔语中的上下文外 (out-of-context, OOC) 虚假信息检测，提出首个公开的尼泊尔语主导多语言基准 NepOOC，包含 1,090 对图文样本（545 正常、545 OOC），按五种类型标注，标注者间一致性 kappa=0.84。系统评估五种多模态架构及纯文本、纯图像基线后发现，在当前数据规模下，标题语义已足以支撑强性能：纯文本 mBERT 达到 94.65±0.20% Macro-F1，与最佳多模态系统 ResNet-50+mBERT 统计上等价。
Motivation: OOC 虚假信息通过真实图片搭配误导性标题构造虚假叙事，检测本质是多模态对齐而非图像取证；尽管该问题在尼泊尔普遍存在且后果严重，此前没有任何公开的尼泊尔语基准。
Method: 构建 NepOOC 基准，包含 1,090 个图文对，覆盖五种类型（fabricated、miscaptioned、temporal mismatch、geographic mismatch、identity mismatch）；系统性评测五种多模态架构以及纯文本和纯图像基线，并分析训练集规模对性能的影响。
Result: 纯文本 mBERT 的 Macro-F1 为 94.65±0.20%，与最佳多模态系统（ResNet-50+mBERT，94.65±0.20%）统计等价（McNemar 中位 p=1.000，alpha=0.05 下 5 个随机种子均不显著）；纯图像模型接近随机水平（33-50%）；训练规模扩展比架构升级或区域专门化更能直接提升性能。
Conclusion: 在当前基准规模下，标题语义足以支撑可靠的 OOC 检测，图像信息并未带来显著增益；论文认为扩大数据集是比增加架构复杂度更直接的进展路径。
Relevance: 0
