papers.title: Represented but Ignored: A Causal Account of Prosodic Underuse in Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Human speech is richly expressive, with prosody carrying linguistic and emotional information beyond the lexical content. A capable large audio-language model (audio-LLM) should therefore support expressive speech understanding, not only transcribing what was said but also interpreting how it was said. Yet behavioral evaluations alone cannot reveal why a model fails on prosodic input. An error may reflect loss of acoustic information, incorrect internal interpretation, or failure to use a representation that is already available inside the model. We introduce a stage-specific probe ladder for localizing these failure modes in audio-LLMs. Across four understanding-only audio-LLMs, prosodic information is usually preserved in the audio path and decodable in late LLM states. Yet it is only partially expressed in the model's final response. We test the causal status of this latent representation with targeted hidden-state interventions. Every intervention shifts the answer distribution in the predicted direction, and in most model--task cells a single edit at the relevant layer is sufficient to drive the model toward the suppressed prosodic decision, though this recovery is directional rather than a selective restoration of the correct class. Feature-level analysis further suggests that this recoverable signal can be expressed through a small subspace. Some of the highest-attribution features in this analysis align with acoustic cues known to carry prosodic information. Within the matched-content contrasts we test, these results locate the recurring bottleneck not in perceiving prosody but in using it. Models that hear and correctly represent a prosodic cue can still fail to express it in their answers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对音频-语言模型 (audio-LLM) 在韵律 (prosody) 理解上的失败，提出一个分阶段的探针阶梯 (stage-specific probe ladder) 来定位失败环节。在四个仅做理解的 audio-LLM 上，韵律信息在音频路径中被保留并可从后期 LLM 状态解码，但只在最终回答中被部分表达。通过隐藏状态干预 (hidden-state intervention)，作者验证了这一潜在表征的因果作用，并指出瓶颈在于“使用”韵律而非“感知”韵律。
Motivation: 行为评估无法区分音频模型在韵律输入上失败的具体原因：是声学信息丢失、内部解释错误，还是模型已具备表征却未使用。作者希望用可定位的因果分析来分辨这些失败模式，从而回答模型是否真的理解了“怎么说”而非只“说了什么”。
Method: 提出一种分阶段探针阶梯，分别检查音频编码路径和 LLM 后期状态中韵律信息的可解码性；随后对相关层进行目标化的隐藏状态干预，并结合特征级归因分析，考察干预是否能推动模型输出被抑制的韵律决策。实验基于四个仅做理解任务的 audio-LLM 和匹配内容的对比 (matched-content contrasts) 设计。
Result: 韵律信息通常保留在音频路径中且可从后期 LLM 状态解码，但在最终回答中仅被部分表达；每次干预都使答案分布沿预测方向移动，且在大多数模型-任务组合中单次编辑相关层即可将模型推向被抑制的韵律决策，但这种恢复是方向性的而非选择性恢复正确类别。特征级分析还显示可恢复信号可由小子空间表达，且最高归因特征与已知承载韵律信息的声学线索一致。
Conclusion: 作者将这些结果归纳为：模型能“听到”并正确表征韵律线索，却仍无法在回答中表达它，因此重复出现的瓶颈在于韵律的使用而非感知或表征。该结论限定在测试的四个理解型 audio-LLM 和匹配内容对比范围内。

papers.title: Towards On-Board Implementation of ML-Based Helicopter Weight Estimator
papers.abstract_en: This paper focuses on the implementation of a novel supervised Machine Learning model for estimating helicopter weight during takeoff, utilizing extensive datasets from Airbus's global in-service fleet. The study details a learning assurance process aligned with the EASA concept paper for machine learning application, and with the on-going Eurocae ED-324. We propose a set of Machine Learning Requirements, a Machine Learning Model Description, and its implementation for a long short-term memory recurrent neural network. Finally, we verify the requirements on the implementation. Demonstrated on legacy avionics computers, the implementation is suitable for the deployment of the developed Machine Learning Model weight estimator on airborne targets for critical functions such as on-board alerting.
papers.journal_ref: The 2026 Annual Forum and Technology Display (Forum 82), The Future of Vertical Flight (VFS), May 2026, Palm Beach Florida, USA, United States
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对直升机起飞重量估计问题，提出一种基于 Airbus 全球在役机队数据训练的监督式机器学习模型，并给出与 EASA 机器学习应用概念文件和 Eurocae ED-324 对齐的学习保证流程。作者提出一套机器学习需求、模型描述，以及基于长短期记忆循环神经网络 (LSTM RNN) 的实现，并在现有航空电子计算机上验证了需求。结果表明该实现适合在机载目标上部署，用于机载告警等关键功能。
Motivation: 机载关键功能使用机器学习模型时缺乏明确的可认证保证流程，而直升机起飞重量估计是需要在飞行中实时完成的安全相关任务，因此需要一套符合适航要求的学习保证与实现验证方法。
Method: 提出机器学习需求 (Machine Learning Requirements)、机器学习模型描述 (Machine Learning Model Description) 及其实现：采用长短期记忆循环神经网络 (LSTM RNN) 估计起飞重量，并依据 EASA 概念文件和 Eurocae ED-324 流程对需求进行验证。
Result: 在 legacy 航空电子计算机上完成实现并验证了需求，摘要未给出具体数值精度；作者认为该实现适用于在机载目标上部署重量估计模型，以支撑机载告警等关键功能。
Conclusion: 本文展示的 ML 重量估计器满足所提出的需求，并可在现有机载计算机上运行，为机器学习模型在航空关键功能中的机载部署提供了可行性验证。

papers.title: When Irrelevant Text Matters: Affine Margin Shifts in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are frequently exposed to auxiliary textual context, the impact of which on visually grounded tasks remains underexplored. In this paper, we investigate the influence of task-irrelevant context by formulating it as a controlled intervention within a binary visual judgment framework. By maintaining an invariant prompt structure while varying auxiliary inputs, we observe that irrelevant text consistently biases model predictions across diverse benchmarks. To move beyond performance metrics, we characterize this sensitivity through a decision margin defined by the log-probability difference between binary candidates. Our analysis reveals a robust geometric regularity: contextconditioned margins follow a consistent affine transformation of their context-free counterparts. This finding demonstrates that irrelevant context does not manifest as unstructured stochastic noise but as a estimable distortion of model preference. We further interpret the fitted affine parameters as metrics for visual commitment preservation and directional answer bias. These findings provide a margin-level diagnostic view of irrelevant-context effects in MLLMs and offer a basis for future studies on noisy-context robustness
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中任务无关文本对视觉判别任务的影响，将其建模为二元视觉判断框架中的受控干预。通过在保持提示结构不变的同时变化辅助输入，作者发现无关文本在不同基准上一致地偏置模型预测，并用二元候选之间的 log 概率差定义决策边际来刻画该敏感性。分析显示上下文条件边际与其无上下文版本呈一致的仿射变换（affine transformation），说明无关文本并非非结构化随机噪声，而是可估计的偏好扭曲。拟合的仿射参数进一步被解释为视觉承诺保持（visual commitment preservation）与方向性答案偏差的度量。
Motivation: MLLM 经常暴露于辅助文本上下文，但其对视觉接地任务的影响尚未被充分探索；现有工作多停留在性能指标层面，缺乏对预测机制的系统性理解。
Method: 提出将任务无关上下文作为受控干预纳入二元视觉判断框架：保持提示结构不变而改变辅助输入，跨基准观察预测变化；用二元候选的 log 概率差定义决策边际，并拟合上下文条件边际与无上下文边际之间的仿射关系。
Result: 摘要报告无关文本在各种基准上一致地偏置模型预测，且上下文条件边际遵循一致的仿射变换规律；该方法将敏感性的机制性特征从性能指标中分离出来。
Conclusion: 作者认为无关上下文表现为可估计的模型偏好畸变而非随机噪声，所提出的边际级诊断视角可为噪声上下文鲁棒性研究提供基础。

papers.title: Hallucination as a Feature, not a Defect: Evaluating a multi-agent architecture to transform speculative language-model outputs into testable scientific hypotheses
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly aligned to suppress hallucinations, prioritizing factual retrieval over combinatorial creativity. While crucial for mitigating misinformation, this alignment may also restrict speculative Research and Development (R&D) by encouraging what this work operationally treats as semantic overfitting and diversity collapse. In this paper, we propose a Rust-based multi-agent orchestration that uses the contrast between narrative daydreaming and executive control as a functional analogy, not as a neurocognitive claim. The system instigates an Epistemological Friction loop between a high-entropy generating agent and a web-grounded evaluating agent, mediated by a low-entropy semantic bottleneck intended to reduce noise and repetition. Initial experiments generated diverse, viability-rated hypotheses across physical and social-science domains. We additionally report an exploratory paired baseline and ablation study comparing the full system against direct prompting, self-reflection, removal of the semantic filter, removal of search grounding, and removal of lateral lenses. The results place direct prompting among the weakest conditions across most observed metrics, but they do not show a general superiority of the full system over simple self-reflection. Instead, they suggest that each architecture shifts the balance between originality, feasibility, diversity, and empirical grounding in different ways, and that the full system provides its main advantages when hypotheses must survive strong physical, empirical, or institutional constraints. These findings do not show that hallucination is useful in isolation; they suggest that speculative generation gains value only when constrained by architecture, empirical grounding, and explicit evaluation.
papers.comment: 25 pages. Bilingual: full English version followed by the complete Spanish version. Includes an exploratory paired baseline and ablation study (6 conditions). Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20649714
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于Rust的多智能体编排系统，将叙述性白日梦与执行控制的对比作为功能类比，通过高熵生成智能体与基于网页检索的评估智能体之间的认知摩擦循环（Epistemological Friction loop），并利用低熵语义瓶颈降低噪声和重复，从而将LLM的幻觉式输出转化为可检验的科学假设。实验在物理和社会科学领域生成多样化、有可行性评级的假设，并通过配对基线和消融研究比较了全系统与直接提示、自我反思、去除语义过滤、去除检索grounding、去除侧向透镜等条件。结果表明直接提示在多数指标上表现最弱，但全系统并未普遍优于简单的自我反思，各架构以不同方式权衡原创性、可行性、多样性和经验基础。
Motivation: 当代LLM被对齐以抑制幻觉，偏向事实检索而非组合性创造力，这可能限制推测性研发，导致语义过拟合和多样性坍缩。论文旨在探索如何通过架构约束使幻觉式生成变得有用。
Method: 提出Rust实现的多智能体编排：高熵生成智能体与基于web grounding的评估智能体之间形成Epistemological Friction循环，中间由低熵语义瓶颈过滤噪声和重复，并加入侧向透镜（lateral lenses）以增加多样性。
Result: 实验显示直接提示在多数指标上是最弱条件之一，但全系统并不普遍优于简单自我反思；不同架构在原创性、可行性、多样性和经验基础之间取得不同平衡，全系统仅在强物理、经验或制度约束下显示优势。
Conclusion: 摘要强调幻觉本身单独并无用处，推测性生成只有在被架构、经验grounding和显式评估约束时才获得价值。

papers.title: Asymmetric Attention Heads: Structured Head-Wise Context Allocation for Transformer Attention
papers.abstract_en: Standard multi-head attention (MHA) gives every head the same full causal context span, although heads can serve different contextual roles. Some heads may rely mainly on nearby lexical or syntactic context, while others may depend on longer-range relations such as entity interactions, discourse links, or state changes. We present Asymmetric Attention Heads (AAH), a head-wise context- allocation framework that treats context length as an explicit per-head or per-group allocation variable. AAH groups heads using feature-derived statistics, organizes these groups hierarchically, and assigns causal local windows while preserving the standard flat MHA output interface. In 4096- token seed-0 experiments, several AAH-style local-allocation variants achieve lower validation loss than pure full attention. Short-budget ablations show that stable local allocation and head-window assignment structure matter, while fixed/local controls can be competitive with adaptive hierarchy. We interpret AAH as a structured head-wise context-allocation mechanism for quality and analysis, with Attention Coverage Ratio (ACR) reported as a selected-window routing diagnostic
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Asymmetric Attention Heads (AAH)，将上下文长度视为逐头/逐组的显式分配变量，利用特征派生统计对注意力头分组、层级化组织，并分配因果局部窗口，同时保持标准扁平 MHA 输出接口。在 4096-token seed-0 实验中，多种 AAH 风格局部分配变体的验证损失低于纯全注意力。短预算消融显示稳定的局部分配和头-窗口分配结构很重要，固定/局部控制可与自适应层级竞争。作者将 AAH 解释为用于质量与可分析性的结构化逐头上下文分配机制，并报告 Attention Coverage Ratio (ACR) 作为窗口路由诊断。
Motivation: 标准多头注意力给每个头相同的完整因果上下文跨度，但不同头可能承担不同上下文角色：有的依赖邻近词法或句法信息，有的依赖实体交互、话语连接或状态变化等长程关系。该文针对这一结构缺口，提出按头分配上下文长度以适配不同注意力角色。
Method: 提出 AAH 框架，将上下文长度作为逐头或逐组的分配变量；通过特征派生统计对头进行分组，对这些组进行层级化组织，并分配因果局部窗口，同时保持标准扁平 MHA 输出接口。还引入 ACR 作为所选窗口的路由诊断指标。
Result: 在 4096-token seed-0 实验中，多种 AAH 风格局部分配变体达到比纯全注意力更低的验证损失。短预算消融表明，稳定的局部分配和头-窗口分配结构是收益来源，固定/局部控制可与自适应层级取得相当表现。
Conclusion: 作者将 AAH 定性为一种结构化逐头上下文分配机制，兼顾生成质量与可分析性；摘要中的实验限于 4096-token 设置，未报告更大规模或更多基线的结果。

papers.title: Active Inference as Context Acquisition for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Interactive AI agents must acquire the right context as efficiently as possible. When a user omits a constraint, preference, file, or task variable, an agent can proceed with a default assumption or spend tokens on a clarifying question, retrieval call, tool call, or prompt trial. We formulate this tradeoff as active inference for context acquisition. An inner inference step updates beliefs over a latent task state, and an outer decision selects the next context action, task action, or stop action to minimize expected free energy under cost. In deterministic settings, the epistemic term reduces to expected information gain, optionally normalized by token cost. We instantiate the framework in Optimal Question Asking (OQA), with exact posteriors and a dynamic programming oracle, and benchmark frontier language models on binary and multiway categorical tasks from 25 to 300 candidates. We also study clarification before generation and automated prompt optimization under token budgets. The formulation is model-agnostic and views active inference as a design principle for the context-acquisition layer of AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把交互式 AI 智能体获取上下文的过程形式化为主动推理 (active inference)：智能体在默认假设与花 token 提问、检索、调用工具或试 prompt 之间做权衡。框架包含更新隐任务状态信念的内层推断与选择下一上下文动作、任务动作或停止动作的外层决策，目标是使期望自由能 (expected free energy) 在成本约束下最小。作者将该框架实例化为 Optimal Question Asking (OQA)，使用精确后验与动态规划 oracle，在 25 到 300 个候选项的二分类和多分类任务上评测前沿语言模型。
Motivation: 交互式智能体经常面临用户遗漏约束、偏好、文件或任务变量的情况，此时它既可以用默认假设继续，也可以消耗 token 发起澄清或检索；如何高效获取正确上下文是一个核心但缺乏统一框架的问题。
Method: 提出将上下文获取建模为 active inference：内层推断步骤更新对隐任务状态的信念，外层决策在上下文动作、任务动作和停止动作之间选择，以最小化计及成本的期望自由能；在确定性设置下，认知项退化为期望信息增益并可按 token 成本归一化。
Result: 在 Optimal Question Asking (OQA) 实例中，作者使用精确后验和动态规划 oracle，并在 25 至 300 个候选项的二元与多路分类任务上对前沿语言模型进行基准测试；此外还研究了生成前的澄清以及 token 预算下的自动 prompt 优化。
Conclusion: 该 formulation 与具体模型无关，作者将主动推理视为 AI 智能体上下文获取层 (context-acquisition layer) 的设计原则。

papers.title: Automatic bioinformatic software named entity recognition from literature
papers.abstract_en: Bioinformatics software and databases are essential components of modern life science research, yet their mentions in the scientific literature are often inconsistent and difficult to systematically identify at scale. The lack of a comprehensive and up-to-date catalog of bioinformatics resources hinders efforts toward automated biomedical knowledge extraction and streamlined data analysis. Here we present SNAIL, a hybrid named entity recognition framework designed to automatically identify bioinformatics software and database (SW/DB) names from biomedical texts. SNAIL integrates complementary lexical and semantic modeling strategies. The lexical component captures orthographic patterns and contextual cues characteristic of SW/DB names, while the semantic component leverages contextual embeddings generated by transformer-based language models such as SciBERT, combined with an explicit token-masking strategy to enhance entity-focused representations. A large training corpus was constructed automatically through a hybrid pipeline that integrates citation-hinted extraction with large language model-assisted distillation. Evaluation on two independent benchmark datasets and real-world research articles demonstrates that SNAIL substantially outperforms existing approaches, including domain-specific methods such as bioNerDS2 and general-purpose large language models such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and Claude. Applying SNAIL to large-scale literature analysis further reveals distinct journal-level preferences across bioinformatics subfields. These results demonstrate that SNAIL provides an accurate and scalable solution for identifying bioinformatics resources in scientific texts and enables systematic meta-analysis of tool usage and research trends.

Motivation: 生物信息学软件和数据库在文献中的提及往往不一致，难以在规模上系统识别；缺乏全面且最新的生物信息学资源目录阻碍了自动化生物医学知识提取和数据整理。
Method: 提出混合 NER 框架 SNAIL，包含互补的词汇和语义建模策略：词汇组件捕捉 SW/DB 名称的拼写模式与上下文线索，语义组件利用 SciBERT 等 transformer 模型生成的上下文嵌入，并采用显式 token 掩码策略增强实体相关的表示。使用结合引文提示提取与大语言模型辅助蒸馏的自动化流程构建大型训练语料。
Result: 在两个独立基准数据集和真实研究文章上，SNAIL 的性能大幅优于现有方法，包括 bioNerDS2 以及 ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok 和 Claude 等大语言模型；应用于大规模文献分析还揭示了生物信息学子领域间不同的期刊层面偏好。
Conclusion: SNAIL 为在科学文本中识别生物信息学资源提供了准确且可扩展的方案，能够支持对工具使用和研究趋势的系统性元分析。

papers.title: Transformer Models for Text Summarization: A Comparative Study of BART, BERT, and RoBERTa
papers.abstract_en: Text summarization refers to the task of condensing a document into a shorter version while preserving its key information. Automatic text summarization (ATS), driven by advancements in natural language processing (NLP), has developed rapidly in recent years. ATS methods are commonly categorized by input type (such as single-document or multi-document summarization) and by output type (extractive, abstractive, and hybrid). This article presents a focused review of modern summarization techniques with an emphasis on transformer based models and large language models (LLMs), specifically BERT, RoBERTa and BART. It examines their architectures, pretraining strategies, and their suitability for extractive and abstractive summarization tasks.
papers.journal_ref: International Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Applications (IJAIA), Vol.17, No.3, May 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇聚焦于自动文本摘要 (ATS) 的综述，重点考察基于 Transformer 的模型与大型语言模型 (LLM)，特别是 BERT、RoBERTa 和 BART。文章按输入类型（单文档/多文档）和输出类型（抽取式、生成式、混合式）对 ATS 方法进行分类，并比较这些模型的架构、预训练策略及其在抽取式和生成式摘要任务中的适用性。
Motivation: 自动文本摘要在 NLP 进展下快速发展，但相关方法种类繁多，缺少对现代 Transformer 与 LLM 代表性模型的系统梳理。本文旨在填补这一缺口，为研究者提供关于 BERT、RoBERTa 和 BART 在摘要任务中适用性的对比视角。
Method: 采用综述性方法，聚焦 BERT、RoBERTa 和 BART，分析其架构设计、预训练策略，并评估它们在抽取式 (extractive) 与生成式 (abstractive) 摘要任务中的适配性，同时覆盖输入输出类型的分类框架。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或量化结果，属于文献综述性质，未给出模型的性能指标对比。
Conclusion: 文章通过比较 BERT、RoBERTa 与 BART 的架构和预训练方式，为不同摘要任务中选择合适的 Transformer/LLM 模型提供参考；摘要中未提及明确的性能排序、方法局限或未来工作方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Virtual Member of a Community of Practice for the Society of Petroleum Engineers: From Prototype to Deployment
papers.abstract_en: We describe the evolution of a virtual assistant, called ATHENA, designed to support the capture, retrieval, and dissemination of knowledge for members of a Community of Practice (CoP) related to the Oil and Gas sector. An evaluation of a first prototype involving 75 professionals from the Society of Petroleum Engineering (SPE) showed that ATHENA dramatically improved both their productivity and performance equality on a set of realistic well-planning tasks compare to their use of a state-of-the-art RAG baseline system. However, the evaluation also identified areas for improvement. This paper describes technical advances to our first prototype in the areas of multi-document retrieval, support for answer validation, and more focused proactive dissemination. Evaluation results show that this enhanced version of ATHENA provides better support for completing knowledge-intensive tasks related to well planning than does a state-of-the-art baseline. ATHENA has been integrated into the SPE Research Portal and is being deployed for use by the society's membership.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述面向石油与天然气行业实践社区 (Community of Practice) 的虚拟助手 ATHENA 从原型到部署的演进过程。首个原型在 75 名石油工程师学会 (SPE) 专业人员的真实井规划任务评估中，相比先进的 RAG 基线系统显著提升了生产力和表现平等性，但评估也指出改进空间。增强版在多媒体检索、答案验证支持以及更聚焦的主动传播方面做了技术改进，并已集成到 SPE Research Portal 并部署供学会会员使用。
Motivation: 石油与天然气领域的实践社区需要知识捕获、检索与传播支持，而现有方案（如 RAG 基线）在知识密集型井规划任务上的表现仍有不足，初始原型评估也暴露了需要改进的方面。
Method: 在首个原型基础上进行技术增强，涉及多文档检索 (multi-document retrieval)、答案验证 (answer validation) 支持，以及更有针对性的主动传播 (proactive dissemination) 机制，从而形成增强版 ATHENA。
Result: 评估显示，首个原型相对先进的 RAG 基线大幅提升 75 名 SPE 专业人员在现实井规划任务上的生产力和表现平等性；增强版在完成与井规划相关的知识密集型任务时也优于先进的基线系统。
Conclusion: ATHENA 的增强版本已被集成到 SPE Research Portal 并开始向学会会员部署，表明该虚拟助手从研究原型走向实际应用。
Relevance: 3
